title: Supply Chain Management Internship
description:
Job Description

Supply Chain Management Intern

At our company, we aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company. We are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. We use the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. Join our team and contribute to our mission of ensuring compliance, safety, and reliable supply to our customers.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in overseeing the supply chain process, including Supply Management, Demand Management, and Product Management, ensuring responsiveness to real-time demand signals.
  • Support the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process to optimize production schedules and fulfil customer orders timely and accurately for commercial and pipeline products.
  • Help ensure the Integrated Product Team (IPT) meets production schedules and efficiently schedules technical engineering development work.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders, SAP stewardship, and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) to ensure comprehensive supply chain connectivity.
  • Assist with financial planning activities by tracking performance against budgetary targets and maintaining awareness of regulatory requirements.
  • Develop skills in ERP systems, inventory management, report writing, project management, stakeholder management, and vendor management.
  • Develop skills in data analysis and modelling.
  • Foster collaboration both onsite and across the network, with a customer and patient-focused approach, while striving for continuous improvement and innovation.

Qualifications

Required

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree or higher in a related Business, Science, Engineering, or other technical discipline.
  • Interest in gaining experience in a related field, ideally in a manufacturing setting adhering to GMP standards.

Preferred

  • Proficiency in numeric skills and data analysis.
  • Proficiency in MS Office.

Why Join Us?

  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic and innovative environment.
  • Work alongside industry leaders and experts.
  • Enhance your skills with real-world projects and collaboration.
  • Make a tangible impact on the health and well-being of people and animals.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company that values your growth and development.

description:

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Job Description:

Johnson & Johnson is hiring for a Field Clinical Specialist for Shockwave Medical Inc. located in Colorado / Wyoming.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/.

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments. Ready to join a team that’s pioneering the development and commercialization of Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) to treat complex calcified cardiovascular disease. Our Shockwave Medical portfolio aims to establish a new standard of care for medical device treatment of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease through its differentiated and proprietary local delivery of sonic pressure waves for the treatment of calcified plaque.

Position Overview

The Field Clinical Specialist is a visible position that will provide case support to physicians within certain territories. Case support will be done on peripheral and coronary interventional procedures in the pre-market and post-market phases of product development with the Shockwave Medical Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) ® technology. The Field Clinical Specialist will also play a critical role in clinical studies including device training, case support and ensuring timely data collection for clinical programs. Case support may be required to support other territories at certain times.

Essential Job Functions

  • Physician and hospital staff training, and procedural case coverage to ensure the safe and effective use of medical devices.
  • Effectively meet the needs of internal and external customers with a sense of urgency and drive.
  • Present clinical study training materials based on investigational plans to support the safe and effective use of medical devices, inclining study protocol, instructions for use, core lab manuals and case report forms.
  • Manage key study investigators; foster and maintain strong relationships through direct interactions with medical advisors and clinical leaders.
  • Partner with other clinical research colleagues to meet business needs in the field including site re-training, data collection for timely database locks and resolution of critical issues.
  • Administrative activities including training to procedures, manage territory travel and budgets.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in business, science, nursing or related fields, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience directly supporting interventional or surgical procedures within a hospital setting OR, 1 year of industry, hospital-based life sciences, sales support experience. Cardiovascular industry experience preferred but not required.
  • Working knowledge of clinical research, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and regulatory compliance guidelines for clinical trials.
  • A history of effective collaboration with regulatory agencies through clinical studies and market releases.
  • Product knowledge including product vigilance and medical device reporting.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Computer skills (MS Office products, word processing, spreadsheets, etc.).
  • Finance and budgeting knowledge.
  • Good prioritization and organizational skills.
  • Excellent critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent influencing and negotiation skills.
  • High energy and results-oriented individual who is mature and successful in a business environment and is skilled in motivating and inspiring people.
  • Entrepreneurial “hands-on” experience. Pro-active and “can do” attitude.
  • Ability to consider and accept feedback and suggestions for continuous improvement.
  • Works effectively on cross-functional teams. Demonstrated willingness to make decisions and to take responsibility for such.
  • Effective written, verbal and presentation skills with all levels of customers and management.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities
  • Operate as a team and/or independently while demonstrating flexibility to changing requirements.
  • There may be continuous sitting for prolonged periods (more than 2 consecutive hours in an 8 hour day)
  • Significant travel >50% of time requiring the employee to be effective in a remote manner.
  • Employee may be required to lift objects up to 40lbs or more. Employees will be required to work in an air conditioned office space and possibly perform some tasks in our non-temperature controlled warehouse space.

title: Data Engineer
description:
The Role

  • As a data evangelist, you will be the thought leader in data driven decision making.
  • Requires an individual with a background in a quantitative or technical field with experience in large and, at times, dirty data sets.
  • You are a proactive learner, and have demonstrated success in using analytics to drive the growth of a product.


Purpose of the Role

  • Develop data sets to enable operational and exploratory analysis
  • Democratize data by building dashboards on data tools (eg Mode)
  • Automate analysis and authoring pipelines through SQL and ETL framework (eg Python based Airflow)
  • Identify product metrics and define levers of success
  • Monitor and discover trends, patterns and root causes of changes
  • Partner with team members to tell the story behind data and drive decisions
  • Contribute to product roadmap through data based recommendations
  • Prioritize areas of opportunity to drive growth and uplift user satisfaction
  • Data evangelist to team members for best data and analytics practices
  • 4+ years experience with quantitative analysis
  • Advanced in SQL (any variation, we use PostgreSQL)
  • Experience building data pipelines (eg Fivetran, Airflow)
  • Understanding of statistics and experience using statistical methods (hypothesis testing, A/B testing, regressions)
  • Ability to communicate the results of analyses with Product and Executive team to influence the strategy of the product
  • Enjoy an environment of fast growth and ambiguity
  • Experience in statistical languages (R, Python)
  • Degree in Computer Science, Math, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, other technical fields or relevant work experience

Why you'll love working with us:

  • We are a friendly, diverse team, excited about our mission and eager for like minded comrades to help us build
  • We'll located in central Bangkok, right next to a BTS with a modern, comfortable office
  • We embrace self improvement and continuous education - we don't just share knowledge internally, we have an unlimited training budget and are eager to use it
  • You'll be working with the latest, coolest tech - and whatever tools you need to succeed
  • We greatly encourage a flat, constructive organizational culture - we work together, care about each other and everyone is important

If all of this sounds like something you would like to be a part of, please don't hesitate to apply.

title: Program Manager (Ops)
description:
About the role

This is a hands-on program management role. The program manager will work closely with the people doing the work: building project plans alongside engineering managers, product managers, marketers, BD, customer success, and operations staff; breaking programs and projects down to the task level; and keeping multiple concurrent projects moving from initiation to close.

You'll own the day-to-day execution machinery of our program portfolio. You'll translate strategic priorities and committed requirements into detailed, realistic project plans, then actively manage those plans. You’ll surface risks early, chase down blockers, adjust sequencing when reality intervenes, and keep stakeholders informed.


What you'll do

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans for multiple concurrent projects and programs, working directly with the individual contributors and team leads doing the work
  • Facilitate planning sessions with cross-functional teams to break initiatives into tasks, estimates, dependencies, and owners
  • Run day-to-day project execution: standups or check-ins, status tracking, risk and issue logs, and action-item follow-through
  • Administrate communication and project plans via Pearl’s instance of Notion.
  • Identify blockers early and drive them to resolution, escalating what requires leadership attention with recommendations attached
  • Keep project documentation, trackers, and status reporting accurate, current, and useful to both teams and leadership (AI usage is encouraged at Pearl, with accuracy always in mind)
  • Coordinate handoffs and dependencies across departments, catching gaps before they become slips
  • In partnership with the Product team and VP of Operations, build lightweight, repeatable project management practices that fit the goals of the company.
  • Support program-level rollups so leadership has a reliable, at-a-glance view of portfolio health


What we are looking for

  • 4–7 years of project or program management experience, with demonstrated ownership of multiple concurrent cross-functional projects
  • Experience at a startup or small company where you worked directly with delivery teams
  • Strong command of core PM fundamentals: work breakdown, dependency mapping, estimation, risk management, and status communication
  • Excellent facilitation skills: Able to run a planning session with a room of busy people and leave with documented commitments
  • High follow-through and attention to detail; you close loops without being reminded
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can start planning from a rough goal and iteratively sharpen it with the team
  • Clear, concise written communication - in a remote-first environment, documentation and written communication are crucial
  • Proficiency with Notion, AI tools, and automation capabilities for program management

Nice to have

  • PMP, CAPM, or agile certification (or equivalent practical depth)
  • Experience in home performance, energy efficiency, climate tech, SaaS, or data products
  • Experience introducing or maturing PM practices


Why work at Pearl?

  • We are a mission-driven company: we love what we do and the impact we are making.
  • Impact. Everything you do here will matter. Your opinion and contributions will make a big difference to the future of this company and our mission of making home performance matter.
  • Flexibility. We are 100% remote - work where you feel comfortable.
  • Environment. We value candor, excellence, and collaboration while fostering creativity and camaraderie. We are supportive and genuinely enjoy celebrating each others’ wins!
  • Ownership. You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving startup world.
  • Equality between people. We support diversity, championing our differences, and most importantly, learn from one another. Pearl is an equal opportunity employer, and candidates from all backgrounds and life experiences are encouraged to apply.


Compensation and Benefits:

  • Market salary based on experience and local conditions, in the range of $120k to $140k
  • Medical, vision and dental coverage provided at no cost for employees and their families (with an option to purchase upgraded coverage at a minimal cost to employee)
  • FSA, HSA, and dependent care accounts
  • Life insurance coverage
  • Employer paid cell phone service
  • 401(k) with employer match up to 4%
  • Stock options
  • 15 vacation days during the calendar year, plus holidays (including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day), a floating holiday for your birthday, sick days, and paid parental leave
  • Flexible work environment: work remotely from anywhere within the U.S.


Note before applying

In lieu of a cover letter, we ask every applicant to answer a few short questions about their hands-on experience. These replace the cover letter. We're looking for specifics (systems you've actually touched, problems you actually solved), not generic summaries. This is a required part of the application.

title: Credit Analyst

Overview

  • Assist in evaluating numerous transaction types across a broad array of commercial asset classes, including pulling Co-Star reporting as needed

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is USD $25.00/Hr. - USD $35.00/Hr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

title: Senior Analyst, Assurance Technology & Data
description:
Job Title

Senior Analyst, Assurance Technology & Data

Department

Professional Services Operations-BG-UK

Overview of Department

The Risk Assurance & Insight function supports Baillie Gifford’s Investment Risk, Compliance, Business Risk and Anti-Financial Crime functions through second-line monitoring, assurance, risk oversight, reporting, training coordination and operational support activities.

The Risk and Compliance Assurance team provides independent check and challenge across key regulatory, compliance, operational, investment and financial crime risk areas. The team assesses whether controls are designed and operating effectively, identifies areas for improvement and supports the business in maintaining effective risk management arrangements.

Data, management information and technology are used to improve the quality, consistency, coverage and efficiency of monitoring, assurance and reporting activity.

Purpose of Role

The Senior Analyst, Assurance Technology & Data will manage and strengthen the technology, data and automation capability that underpins the firm’s second-line Risk and Compliance Assurance programme. The role will also perform risk-based monitoring and assurance activity, including surveillance case review, control testing, analysis of system outputs and the identification of trends, anomalies and potential control issues.

The role will act as a bridge between assurance professionals, Technology, data teams and system owners, helping to turn assurance requirements into scalable monitoring, surveillance and analytical solutions. It will support the effective use of trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring, data platforms, automation and AI-enabled tools across assurance activity. A key focus will be the day-to-day management and use of trade surveillance and e-communications systems, including system tuning and configuration, alert and case review, analysis of system performance and escalation of matters requiring further review.

This is not a software development role. The role requires experience managing or using compliance surveillance systems, sufficient technical capability to understand systems, data, workflows and controls, and a practical understanding of assurance needs and risk-based testing. The role holder will help confirm that technology supports effective assurance coverage, consistent control testing and clear insight, while retaining appropriate professional judgement and challenge.

Responsibilities

  • Support the day-to-day management, configuration and effective use of compliance surveillance systems, including trade surveillance and e-communications monitoring. This includes rules, parameters, workflows, user access, alert quality and oversight of system outputs.
  • Perform risk-based monitoring and assurance work across Investment Risk, Compliance, Business Risk and Anti-Financial Crime, supporting technology-enabled approaches where these improve coverage, consistency and efficiency.
  • Review alerts and cases, analyse system outputs and assess whether issues require escalation, further review or wider assurance activity.
  • Use data, management information and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, anomalies, exceptions, potential control issues and emerging risks, and to improve the targeting of monitoring and assurance work.
  • Work with assurance colleagues to translate monitoring and testing requirements into repeatable data queries, dashboards, automated workflows and analytical routines.
  • Support data quality, lineage, access and reconciliation activity where these affect the reliability of monitoring or assurance outputs, working with Technology, data owners and system owners to resolve issues.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of continuous monitoring capability, including automated exception identification, risk indicators and repeatable review processes.
  • Assess, test and validate new monitoring, surveillance, automation and AI capabilities before implementation, balancing efficiency and innovation with control, evidential quality and appropriate human oversight.
  • Produce clear management information on system performance, alert volumes, data quality, trends, exceptions, escalations and assurance outcomes for senior colleagues and relevant stakeholders.
  • Help develop standards, documentation and repeatable practices that allow the wider Risk Assurance & Insight team to use surveillance systems, data, technology and AI confidently and consistently.

Your knowledge and experience

  • Experience using technology, data or automation to support and deliver risk-based monitoring, assurance, oversight, audit or control activity, preferably in financial services or asset management.
  • Experience performing risk-based monitoring activity, including reviewing alerts and cases, analysing system outputs, identifying potential issues and documenting clear conclusions.
  • Experience managing compliance surveillance systems, including trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring, workflow, reporting or other oversight platforms.
  • Confidence working with system configuration, rules, parameters, workflows, user access, testing, issue resolution and oversight of system outputs.
  • Strong data literacy, with the ability to analyse alerts, cases, system outputs and management information to identify trends, anomalies, exceptions and potential control issues.
  • Practical understanding of risk and control concepts, including how technology can support evidence-based assurance, control testing and alert-based review.
  • Experience using automation, AI-enabled tools, analytics or low-code/no-code solutions to improve monitoring, assurance or reporting activity.
  • Understanding of responsible AI use, including the need for human judgement, validation, data protection, clear records and appropriate challenge of outputs.
  • Ability to work effectively with assurance specialists, Technology, data owners and system vendors, translating between business, assurance and technical requirements.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, limitations, assurance findings and opportunities clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

The type of candidate that we're looking for

You will be a practical systems, technology and data professional who is comfortable managing compliance surveillance systems and operating in a second-line risk and assurance environment. You will understand how trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring and related oversight systems support risk-based monitoring and assurance activity. You will be able to perform assurance work. This includes reviewing process and control, alerts and cases, analysing system outputs and evidence, identifying trends, anomalies and potential control issues, and documenting clear conclusions. You will be curious and improvement-focused, but disciplined about controls, evidence and accuracy. You will be able to challenge technology and AI outputs rather than accept them at face value. You will understand that AI and automation support professional judgement rather than replace it.

This is not a software development role. It is suited to someone with experience managing or using compliance surveillance systems, working with Technology and data owners, and helping assurance teams make effective use of data, technology and AI.

Critical Skills

  • Data literacy
  • Digital effectiveness
  • Improvement mindset
  • Openness and discernment
  • Team working

Closing Date

September 26, 2026

Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives.


At Baillie Gifford, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful culture in which each of our colleagues can thrive and develop. We believe that our clients are best served by a diverse workforce with the experiences, ideas and perspectives that this brings.


If you are currently working at Baillie Gifford as an employee or contractor please apply to this job from the firm's Workday internal career site.

title: Strategy Senior Associate - Chief Administrative Office Data Strategy
description:
The Chief Administrative Office (CAO) Data Strategy team serves as a strategic advisory and business management function, partnering with business leaders to translate enterprise priorities into strategic initiatives, business outcomes, and actionable recommendations, leveraging data as a key enabler of decision-making. The team operates as an internal consulting capability, supporting -high impact, -cross functional- initiatives that shape how data enables business outcomes across CAO and its business partners.

As a Data Strategy Senior Associate, you will function as an internal consultant embedded within the Data Strategy organization. You will support senior leaders and business partners on complex, ambiguous initiatives that require strong strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement, and data informed decision- making. Your work will focus on identifying opportunities, framing options and tradeoffs, and delivering clear recommendations that bridge analytics execution with -longer-term- business and data strategy.

Projects may span multiple business functions and focus areas, including data and analytics strategy, operating model evolution, AI enablement, and enterprise capability development. This role sits between analytics teams and senior leadership, acting as a translator, strategist, and recommendation driver.

Job Responsibilities
  • Lead well-defined workstreams on cross--functional strategic initiatives, operating- as an internal consultant to business partners
  • Translate business strategy, stakeholder needs, and analytical insights into clear problem statements, options, and actionable recommendations
  • Partner closely with analytics, data, technology, and business teams to develop a strong fact base and understand key drivers and constraints
  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Develop executive ready- presentation materials that clearly articulate insights, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward
  • Facilitate stakeholder discussions to clarify objectives, surface pain points, and align on success criteria
  • Influence outcomes without direct authority by building credibility, trust, and strong working relationships
  • Operate effectively in ambiguous problem spaces, proactively structuring work and refining scope as new information emerges
  • Manage workstream timelines and deliverables, escalating risks and dependencies as appropriate
  • Collaborate closely with Data Strategy leaders, analytics partners, and other project team members to drive initiatives to completion


Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
  • 3-5 years of experience in management consulting, internal consulting, corporate strategy, business transformation, operating model design, or similar strategic advisory roles supporting senior business leaders. This role is particularly well-suited for candidates coming from consulting firms or enterprise strategy organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure and solve complex, ambiguous business problems, developing clear problem statements, strategic options, recommendations, and implementation considerations.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience preparing presentations, recommendations, and materials for senior leadership audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes without direct authority, building alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities and perspectives.
  • Experience leading or supporting cross-functional strategic initiatives, transformation programs, operating model redesigns, business process improvements, or organizational change efforts.
  • Strong hypothesis-driven problem-solving capabilities, including structuring complex business problems, evaluating strategic alternatives, assessing tradeoffs, and developing executive recommendations.
  • Exceptional ability to synthesize large amounts of information into concise executive narratives, actionable recommendations, and decision-ready materials.
  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, undefined environments where priorities, stakeholders, and business needs evolve over time.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Experience at a leading management consulting firm, internal consulting organization, corporate strategy team, transformation office, or chief of staff organization.

title: Scientist- CBA
description:
Scientist,CBA
The Jackson Laboratory | Bar Harbor ME

About the Role

The Jackson Laboratory is seeking a highly motivated Scientist to join our Core Scientific Services team within the Metabolic Phenotyping Core. This position provides scientific expertise, technical leadership, and operational support for advanced in vivo metabolic phenotyping technologies and services that enable cutting-edge biomedical research across diverse scientific programs, including obesity, diabetes, MASH, atherosclerosis and muscle biology. The Scientist will partner with investigators, research staff, and cross-functional teams to develop, optimize, and implement scientific solutions that support internal and external research initiatives. This individual will leverage technical expertise to evaluate emerging technologies, troubleshoot complex scientific challenges, ensure quality standards, and deliver exceptional scientific service to a broad research community.

The ideal candidate is an independent scientist with strong technical proficiency, a collaborative mindset, and a passion for enabling scientific discovery through shared resources and innovative technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, optimize, and execute in vivo metabolic phenotyping workflows, assays, and methodologies that support core service operations and research objectives.

  • Analyze, interpret, and communicate experimental data and results to diverse scientific audiences.

  • Evaluate, implement, and validate new technologies, equipment, and workflows to enhance service capabilities and operational efficiency.

  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), quality control processes, and best practices to ensure data integrity and reproducibility.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical and scientific issues and identify innovative solutions to improve performance and outcomes.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to support research initiatives, grant applications, publications, and strategic projects.

  • Train, mentor, and provide technical guidance to research staff, students, and laboratory personnel.

  • Contribute to the strategic growth and continuous improvement of core scientific services through process optimization and adoption of emerging technologies.

  • Maintain compliance with institutional, regulatory, and safety requirements.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas: obesity, metabolic disease (including type-2 diabetes, MASH, atherosclerosis), aging, skeletal muscle biology, or islet (β-cell) biology.

  • Expertise in preclinical pharmacology, including in vivo efficacy, execution, analysis, and interpretation.

  • Proficiency with indirect calorimetry / metabolic cage systems (e.g., Sable Systems Promethion, or equivalent), Body composition analysis using EchoMRI, DEXA, and/or microCT, core metabolic phenotyping assays, including glucose tolerance tests (GTT), insulin tolerance tests (ITT), and mixed-meal tolerance tests (MMTT), treadmill-based endurance capacity testing.

  • Hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic and hyperglycemic clamp techniques.

  • Muscle biology experience is a strong plus.

Desirable:

  • Surgical proficiency in transplantation techniques, including grafting under the kidney capsule

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in biology, Biomedical Sciences, Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related scientific discipline required; Ph.D. preferred.

  • Four (4) or more years of relevant scientific experience supporting research programs, scientific services, core facilities, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, academic, or contract research environments.

  • Experience with advanced laboratory technologies, instrumentation, and scientific data analysis.

  • Track record of scientific achievement demonstrated through research contributions, publications, presentations, technology implementation, or project leadership preferred.

Why Join Us

As part of Core Scientific Services, you will play a vital role in advancing research across multiple scientific disciplines while working with state-of-the-art technologies and a collaborative community of scientists. This position offers the opportunity to influence research outcomes, drive innovation, and help enable discoveries that improve human health.

Pay Range: $85987 - $143962 per year, dependent upon experience.

About JAX:

The Jackson Laboratory is an independent, nonprofit biomedical research institution with a National Cancer Institute-designated Cancer Center and nearly 3,000 employees in locations across the United States (Maine, Connecticut, California), Japan and China. Its mission is to discover precise genomic solutions for disease and empower the global biomedical community in the shared quest to improve human health.

Founded in 1929, JAX applies over nine decades of expertise in genetics to increase understanding of human disease, advancing treatments and cures for cancer, neurological and immune disorders, diabetes, aging and heart disease. It models and interprets genomic complexity, integrates basic research with clinical application, educates current and future scientists, and provides critical data, tools and services to the global biomedical community. title: Peer Recovery Specialist
description:
Project 180 Overview

Mission: SSG-Project 180 provides practical and clinical behavioral health, re-entry, and diversion solutions that empower justice-involved Angelenos to achieve lasting personal transformation and reclaim their lives.

Org. Summary: Project 180 is a leader in the forensic treatment space, offering high-quality, specialized treatment programs that serve thousands of justice-involved individuals. Our programs span criminal justice intercepts and include pre-arrest interventions, court-based diversions, jail in-reach, and intensive post-release services. Project 180 operates in partnership with Los Angeles County agencies including the Department of Mental Health (DMH), the Department of Health Services (DHS), and the Justice, Care and Opportunities Department (JCOD). Annually, we serve over 1,500 justice-involved individuals.

At the heart of our organization are our core values - our fundamental, non-negotiable beliefs that guide how we make decisions and work with one another in service of our mission:

Humanity: We lead with a people-centered focus, seeking to understand and value the lived experience of others and centering their human dignity.

Integrity: We honor the trust placed in us by doing what is right while fulfilling our commitments - even when no one is watching.

Adaptability: We embrace the pivot, evolving to meet the complex needs of our community.

Empowerment: We cultivate the tools, confidence, resilience, optimism, and agency within every individual to lead their own transformation.

Equity: We honor everyone’s unique journey, meet them where they are and commit to providing the targeted support and resources that allow each individual to contribute and thrive.

Interdependence: We move as a unified team, trading silos for collective strength, recognizing that our greatest impact is achieved together.

The Program

Project 180’s DMH programs provide intensive wraparound, field-based behavioral health services to individuals with significant mental health problems. Clients are served at an intensive outpatient level of care and receive co-occurring services delivered by a multidisciplinary treatment team. Services include, but are not limited to, psychotherapy, case management, medication management, substance counseling, employment, and housing services. Services are provided in partnership with LA County Probation, LA County Department of Mental Health, and LA Superior Court.

The AB109 program provides intensive, wraparound behavioral health treatment to a forensic population. Through Assembly Bill 109, individuals convicted of a felony crime serve a portion of their sentence in jail or prison and are released early with 1 year of community supervision. If appropriate, participants are mandated to behavioral health treatment by LA County Probation. The program aims to reduce recidivism and support clients with personal recovery goals. The program is funded by the Department of Mental Health (DMH), and operates in collaboration with LA County Probation and LA Superior Court.

The Full Service Partnership (FSP) program adopts a “whatever it takes” approach to provide intensive, wraparound, field based services to adults who have significant mental health problems. The FSP program assists with housing, employment and education in addition to providing mental health services and integrated treatment for individuals who have a co-occurring mental health and substance abuse disorder. Services can be provided to individuals in their homes, the community and other locations.

The Position

The Peer Recovery Specialist is a member of the multidisciplinary team providing recovery-oriented services to individuals with a forensic background. This position reports to the DMH Program Supervisor and, using lived experience, the Peer Recovery Specialist promotes hope, engagement, and self-determination while supporting clients with engagement, skill building, community integration and helping clients to access behavioral health services, housing, benefits, and community resources. The Peer Recovery Specialist conducts individual and group sessions and works collaboratively with the treatment team and supports clients in making measurable progress towards their individualized goals.

Essential Functions:

Provide peer-to-peer support and counseling drawing from lived experience

  • Actively engage clients in services through the development of strong rapport, consistent contact and use of motivational interviewing. Provide outreach services as needed, meeting clients “where they are at” (service location, client’s point of view).
  • Maintain a visible and supportive presence within the clinic by welcoming clients, conducting check-ins, triaging immediate support needs and facilitating hand-offs to the appropriate team members.
  • Respond to and deescalate behavioral health situations using trauma-informed approaches while collaborating with the supervisor and the treatment team to ensure client safety.
  • Provide individual and group psychoeducation related to recovery skills. Services to target cornerstones of recovery-oriented care (instilling hope, empowerment, self-responsibility and engaging in meaningful roles).
  • Service delivery is consistent with ethical standards and a harm reduction, strength based, trauma informed framework.
  • Shares life experiences and successes with history of homelessness, incarceration and substance use/mental health recovery when clinically appropriate.

Coordinate community-based substance treatment services

  • Assist in developing community living skills, including navigating public systems, accessing resources, and building natural supports.
  • Develop and maintain partnerships with residential, sobering/detox centers for client referrals.
  • Link clients to needed community resources to support independence (e.g. employment, education, recovery). Monitor ongoing participation in services/use of resources and facilitate problem solving to target barriers. Accompany clients to linkage appointments when appropriate.
  • Collaborate with external partners (i.e. DMH, DPH- SAPC, probation, primary care clinics, etc.) to ensure high quality, integrated care. Facilitate linkage to DPH-SAPC, as needed.

Engage with multidisciplinary treatment team to coordinate client care

  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings with but not limited to residential sites, sobering/detox centers, housing staff, and probation.
  • Conduct pro-active outreach and engagement to individuals in the community alongside with members of the treatment team.
  • Maintain awareness of environmental and situational safety risks during client engagement and take appropriate action to ensure the safety of clients, staff, and community members.
  • Actively contribute to planning and execution of clinical interventions in collaboration with the treatment team, ensuring services are person-centered and recovery-focused. Leverage unique skills and abilities of team members in service delivery.
  • Coordinate crisis response with treatment team and support with linkage to available community resources.

Documentation and reporting

  • Maintain comprehensive case notes in the electronic health record per program guidelines.
  • Maintain and submit billing records per program guidelines
  • Participate in program data collection per program guidelines.
  • Adhere to mandated reporting requirements.
​​​​​​​

Lobby and client coordination

  • Control the entrance of the facility; ensure that clients and visitors are admitted per program and site guidelines.
  • Encourage clients to adhere to site guidelines and escalate any issues as appropriate.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with local law enforcement for safety continuity.
  • Collaborate with treatment teams and relevant entities to assist with the mitigation of risk.
  • Greet and welcome clients and guests in a friendly and professional manner. Assist them in connecting with the person or program they're visiting.
  • Respond to client complaints and provide instruction as to how to address the specific grievance.
  • Answer incoming calls and provide information and/or direct the call to the appropriate person.

Fulfill baseline Project 180 staff expectations

  • Regular attendance required. Holiday or weekend work may be required.
  • Maintain and uphold the Agency mission statement, values, policies, procedures, and principles.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.
  • Maintain active license and/or registrations as applicable (i.e. BBS, CCAPP, Medi-Cal Peer Support Specialist Certification)

Skills and Abilities

  • Empathetic and able to develop strong relationships with clients
  • Communication skills: Clearly conveys information, builds rapport, and effectively engages with clients.
  • Culturally competent: Understands and is sensitive to diverse backgrounds and need
  • Deescalation skills to help stabilize situations to promote safety
  • Customer service skills to provide a welcoming, professional and responsive experience client
  • Collaborative: Able to work in diverse teams to solve complex issues
  • Adaptive to changing circumstances and client needs in a dynamic environment
  • Strong critical thinking and problem solving skills
  • Detail-oriented, organized and has strong time management skills

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

  • Lived experience with mental health and/or substance use recovery and willingness to share recovery experience
  • California Medi-Cal Peer Support Specialist Certification is required upon hire or must be obtained within 90 days of the employees start date.
  • Experience working with culturally diverse populations.
  • Valid CA driver’s license, proof of insurance and own vehicle required. Ability to transport clients in their personal vehicle.
  • Must not be on any type of legal supervision (probation or parole).
  • Verification of Employment Eligibility and Background Check.
  • Basic computer skills

Preferred:

  • Experience working with the forensic and/or dual diagnosed populations.
  • Experience working on an interdisciplinary team in a mental health or outpatient setting.
  • Knowledge of and experience with providing trauma informed services.
  • Spanish speaking

Supervisory Responsibilities

None

Environmental Conditions (Working Conditions)

Job duties are to be performed both in office and field settings, including Project 180’s interim housing sites. Shifts to be scheduled during evenings and or weekends.

Physical Requirements

The employee is expected to move about the worksite throughout the day, which may involve walking, standing, and climbing stairs, or using a mobility device, or similar. The employee is expected to drive, carry a maximum of 20 lbs, listen, and speak in order to complete job requirements.

Mental Requirements

The employee must be able to do any/all of the following: perform complex and varied tasks such as synthesizing information and making decisions without immediate supervision; handle routine distractions, interruptions, noise, and uncontrollable changes in priorities/work schedules; interact professionally and diplomatically in high-stress situations; create and follow plans; meet deadlines.

title: Staff Systems Engineer - Bidirectional Charging
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.


Ford’s Electric Vehicles, Digital and Design (EVDD) team is charged with delivering the company’s vision of a fully electric transportation future. EVDD is customer-obsessed, entrepreneurial, and data-driven and is dedicated to delivering industry-leading customer experience for electric vehicle buyers and owners. You’ll join an agile team of doers pioneering our EV future by working collaboratively, staying focused on only what matters, and delivering excellence day in and day out. Join us to make positive change by helping build a better world where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams.

1. **Certification & Regulatory Compliance**

1. **NRTL Testing**: Lead regulatory certification testing for Bidirectional EVSE with NRTL, interfacing with development teams in Long Beach and India.

2. **Compliance Monitoring**: Relay information on any SW and HW non-compliances that may come out of testing and drive compliance forward within launch timelines.

3. **Standards Consultation**: Consult on requirements for onboard and offboard commodities related to bidirectional V2G and V2H [UL9741, UL1741, UL1741SC, UL1741SB, SAE J3072, UL 3141, IEEE 1547, ANSI C84.1 and Power quality standards].

4. **Automation Tools**: Consult on test tool vendor vetting for UL1741SC and J3072 [IEEE 1547] test automation.

5. **Documentation**: Consult and develop documentation for V2G and HEMS system installation and operation manuals, collaborating with relevant teams within Ford.

2. **Product Strategy & Hardware Roadmap**

1. **Pro EVSE Certification**: Support Pro EVSE certification for public V2G using both LIN-CP (system type D) and 15118 (system type E).

2. **Commercial Pilots**: Apply for interconnection for commercial V2G pilots in Long Beach, Palo Alto, and Allen Park Test Labs, working with regional utility partners.

3. **Hardware Revisions**: Define requirements for hardware revision(s) to allow for:

1. Revenue-grade billing with higher accuracy-class CT — undergo [California CTEP evaluation](https://www.cdfa.ca.gov/dms/programs/ctep/ctep.html)

2. Integration of NFC reader for seamless tap-to-pay in public / integration of Plug and Charge with ISO 15118 contract certificate exchange

3. Retail unit — V2H dark-start battery-less solution using pilot-based power from the EV for infinite black-start capability, or completely off-grid V2H.

4. **EMEA Market Expansion**: Once aligned in cycle plan, begin defining requirements for Type 2 Bidirectional EVSE for the EMEA market — ISO 15118, VDE anti-islanding protection requirements, Eichrecht metering, etc.

3. **External Representation & Utility Partnerships**

1. **Utility Interface**: Interface with Policy, Grid, and Energy Services team; serve as Ford's technical representative with utilities to establish adoption of bidirectional charging interconnection.

2. **Policy & Forums**: Consult on relevant policy proceedings and represent Ford in industry forums and conferences related to V2G and Home Energy Management Systems (including technical working groups, industry forums, Distributech, CES, and others) to further establish Ford as a thought leader in this space.

3. **ChargeScape & Business Models**: Consult on integration strategy with ChargeScape. Support in establishing clearly defined business models with recurring revenue. Drive strategy for a vendor-agnostic API (not limited to OVGIP/ChargeScape).

4. **Industry Working Groups & Standardization**

1. **Active Participation**: Participate in industry working groups such as:

1. CA Rule 21 V2G AC proceedings

2. J3072/x cooperative research projects with national labs

3. Future revisions of UL1741SC, J3072, and IEEE 1547-2018

4. Forums on grid inverter integration to ensure UL1741SC is adopted with utilities

2. **Technical Comments**: Provide comments on relevant UL1741 (bidirectional EV) and UL9741 CRD proposals.

3. **Grid Integration Flow**: Integrate the EPRI Common File Format to streamline grid code installer setup flow.

4. **Research & Advocacy**: Influence utility interconnection procedures to integrate V2G. Potentially work with research industry partners (e.g., EPRI) to write a whitepaper.

5. **Knowledge Transfer**: Cascade emergent requirements from the above to development teams to proactively get ahead of incoming standards and regulations related to V2X.

5. **Internal Collaboration & Validation**

1. **End-to-End Validation**: Collaborate with the Features team to ensure end-to-end validation and test cases are captured for both V2H and V2G for a successful UEV launch.

2. **Platform Alignment**: Align requirements with current and future vehicle platforms for overall V2X company success.

You'll have...

  • - B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • - 5+ years in regulatory certification, standards compliance, or product compliance engineering for electrical/electromechanical products — automotive, grid-connected power electronics, or energy systems preferred.
  • - Direct experience leading or supporting NRTL certification testing (e.g., UL) and managing corrective action / non-compliance findings against a launch timeline.
  • - Working knowledge of bidirectional charging / V2G-V2H standards (UL1741 family, SAE J3072, IEEE 1547, ISO 15118) and the ability to translate them into product requirements.
  • - Experience engaging directly with utilities, regulators, or standards bodies on interconnection, certification, or grid-code requirements.
  • - Experience participating in or contributing to industry standards development — technical committee participation, comment/response submissions, or working group representation.
  • - Ability to author or review compliance-facing technical documentation (installation/operation manuals, certification submissions, standards comments).
  • - Strong systems engineering fundamentals — requirements decomposition and traceability — applied to a compliance and certification context rather than pure hardware/software design.
  • - Ability to represent Ford's technical and policy position to external stakeholders (utilities, standards bodies, suppliers, regulators) and to influence internal engineering teams to meet emerging regulatory requirements.
  • - Comfort operating in ambiguity across policy, regulatory, and engineering domains, tracking multiple concurrent certification and standards efforts.

title: Product-/QA Specialist
description:
About ViroGates

ViroGates A/S is a Danish in-vitro diagnostics company listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market Copenhagen. The company’s mission is to shift healthcare from reactive treatment to proactive prevention through high-accuracy diagnostic tools that enable earlier intervention and better decision-making.

ViroGates’ proprietary suPARnostic® product portfolio is based on the suPAR biomarker, providing clinically validated insights into chronic inflammation and overall health risk. The technology is used across acute care and clinical triage, with a growing focus on preventive health, longevity, and wellness.

Executive Summary

ViroGates A/S is seeking a Product-/QA Specialist to combine product management of its suPARnostic® portfolio with management of the company's quality management system as the company scales. The role suits an experienced IVD or medical device professional who can balance speed of execution with regulatory rigour while safeguarding product quality and patient safety.

Key Responsibilities

Product Management

  • Drive product management of new and existing suPARnostic® products, including leading R&D projects and improving existing products
  • Maintain technical product documentation, including IFUs
  • Act as the primary contact to the contract manufacturer
  • Provide product‐related sales support and customer training, and forecast consumables

Quality Management System & Regulatory Compliance

  • Act as ViroGates’ Co-Management Representative and process owner for the quality management system
  • Maintain and continuously improve the QMS in line with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory requirements (IVDR)
  • Control of documents and records
  • Plan, conduct and support internal and external audits
  • Verify and oversee product storage and shipping/transport conditions (temperature monitoring, deviation/excursion handling, review of transport and storage stability data)

Risk, Vigilance & Post-market Surveillance

  • Risk management and change control
  • Handle nonconformities, CAPAs and complaints, including review and trending
  • Manage vigilance and reporting to authorities
  • Post‐market surveillance and related processes

Management Reviews, Training & Supplier Quality

  • Prepare and participate in management reviews
  • Own training processes across the organisation
  • Manage supplier quality
  • Contribute to management reporting on quality and product performance

Candidate Profile

Experience & Expertise

  • Relevant degree within life sciences, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, bioanalytical or a similar field
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience from the IVD or medical device industry, including product management and/or R&D
  • Documented experience as a QA Specialist / Management Representative and solid working knowledge of ISO 13485 and IVDR
  • Hands‐on experience with core QMS processes (document control, audits, CAPA, complaints, risk management and post‐market surveillance) and with technical product documentation and IFUs
  • Strong cross‐functional collaboration skills

Personal Attributes

  • Structured, detail‐oriented and quality‐minded
  • Able to balance speed of execution with regulatory compliance
  • Pragmatic and hands‐on, comfortable operating in a lean, fast‐moving organisation
  • Able to work across R&D, Sales & Marketing and external partners

Practical Requirements

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); Danish is an advantage
  • Based at or able to work from ViroGates’ HQ in Birkerød
  • Willingness to travel up to 15 days per year

Organisation & Ways of Working

ViroGates operates with a lean organisation and a small, engaged team; the role reports directly to the QA & Product Manager. The culture is characterised by constructive collaboration, open dialogue and a strong focus on execution discipline. This role suits someone who enjoys end-to-end ownership rather than a narrow, siloed function.

Why Join ViroGates

  • Opportunity to work with both product and quality for a differentiated biomarker platform with strong clinical validation and multiple commercial applications
  • High degree of influence relative to organisation size, with direct access to management and decision‐making
  • A pivotal, cross‐functional role at a listed diagnostics company entering the fast‐growing longevity and preventive health markets
  • Collaborative, non‐hierarchical working environment with an entrepreneurial mindset

description:

Job Description:

About Innovative Medicine

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at

We are searching for the best talent for a Laboratory Automation Scientist to be located in Spring House, PA.

Purpose: The Laboratory Automation Scientist is the practical bridge between scientists and the automated workcell. The role translates assay steps, sample formats, reagent needs, instrument sequences, timing constraints, and data outputs into executable automated methods and worklists.

The Scientist will design, configure, troubleshoot, and improve automated laboratory workflows that convert manual discovery and analytical methods into robust, reproducible, data-rich automated processes. They will own method behavior, worklist logic, sample/consumable state, user instructions, scientific readiness, and data context for assigned workflows.

This role complements the Experienced Automation and Robotics Engineer. The scientist owns scientific workflow translation and method execution logic; the engineer owns physical feasibility, robot motion, controls handshakes, safety behavior, serviceability, and machine-side troubleshooting.

You will be responsible for:

Design and Deploy

  • Translating manual protein discovery, analytical, molecular, NGS, screening, biochemical, biophysical, and cell-based workflows into automated methods and workcell configurations.

  • Configuring and optimizing methods on liquid handlers and integrated workcells including sealers, peelers, washers, centrifuges, incubators, readers, labelers, barcode scanners, storage systems, and analytical devices.

  • Contributing to deck layouts, method logic, sample maps, reagent maps, consumable maps, plate/tube movements, worklist structures, user prompts, run controls, and run readiness checklists.

  • Authoring or contributing to method descriptions, UAT protocols, SOPs, work instructions, training materials, data handoff notes, and troubleshooting guides.

Request Driven Execution and Orchestration

  • Supporting translation of scientific requests into automation worklists, sample preparation steps, instrument sequences, data output expectations, and acceptance checks.

  • Participating in defining run states, sample states, consumable states, operator prompts, allowable pauses, manual intervention points, and critical issue thresholds.

  • Working with IT/data teams and scientists to understand ELN, LIMS, GDB, data lake, request tracking, barcode, file transfer, and reporting requirements.

  • Supporting practical adoption by training users, capturing feedback, and improving usability without weakening scientific rigor or traceability.

Improve and Sustain

  • Troubleshooting liquid handling performance, assay transfer issues, device integration, sample routing, scheduling, barcode scanning, data capture gaps, and run exceptions.

  • Analyzing run records, failure modes, cycle times, hands-on time, sample losses, and user feedback to improve reliability, throughput, reproducibility, and data quality.

  • Supporting investigations and corrective actions for automation-related deviations, failed runs, interrupted workflows, and inconsistent scientific outputs.

  • Collaborating with automation engineers and vendors to distinguish method, assay, consumable, device, and physical integration root causes.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support technology evaluations, proof-of-concept studies, workflow readiness assessments, user demonstrations, and vendor evaluations for future automation capabilities.

  • Contribute to laboratory automation standards, workflow templates, data handoff expectations, training materials, and playbooks.

  • Support audit, inspection, or quality documentation requests where automated scientific workflows intersect with regulated or quality-driven environments.

  • Participate in lessons learned and continuous improvement activities to improve future automation delivery and adoption.


Qualifications/Requirements

Education:

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Analytical Sciences, Laboratory Automation, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field is required. An advanced degree is acceptable with relevant automation experience.

Experience and Skills:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years, Master’s degree with 2+ years, or a PhD with 1+ years of relevant laboratory automation, assay automation, analytical automation, or scientific workflow experience.

  • Demonstrated understanding of laboratory workflows, sample handling, plate/tube formats, assay execution, consumable preparation, run documentation, and data capture.

  • Hands-on or practical experience with automated liquid handlers or integrated laboratory automation equipment appropriate to the level of the role.

  • Ability to translate scientific workflows into executable automated methods, worklists, run states, exception pathways, and user-facing procedures.

  • Working knowledge of sample identity, labware identity, reagent identity, consumable state, barcode traceability, metadata capture, and downstream data requirements.

  • Ability to collaborate with scientists, automation engineers, IT, data science, AI, EHS, facilities, vendors, and laboratory operations.

  • Experience configuring, operating, troubleshooting, or improving automated laboratory systems.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Biosero Green Button Go, Cellario, Momentum, Hamilton, Tecan, Beckman, HighRes, Thermo Fisher, Azenta, Agilent, Waters, Python, SQL, APIs, ELN, LIMS, GDB, data lakes, request tracking, or automated sample storage.

  • Experience with assay development, high-throughput screening, cell culture analytics, protein analytics, NGS library prep, SPR/BLI, SEC-MALS, ELISA, or cell-based assays.

  • Experience with method scripting such as VENUS, EVOware, Python/Java-based APIs, or similar vendor software.

Other:

  • Travel may be required for vendor assessments, FAT/SAT activities, site visits, system builds, workshops, training, technology scouting, or cross-site deployment support. Percentage to be finalized with business leadership.

Why Join Us

This role supports the transition from isolated automation projects to integrated, reliable, AI-native, and ultimately self-driving discovery laboratory systems. The work helps connect scientific intent with robust physical execution, reproducible data, model feedback, and scalable operational capability.

title: Verdens bedste matematik- og billedkunstlærer? Eller bare virkelig dygtig? Vi vil meget gerne høre fra dig!
description:
Forventningerne er høje, børnene er søde, stedet er fantastisk. Har du mod på det?

Vejrup Børneby i Esbjerg Kommune søger pr. 1. november 2026 (eller snarest herefter) en lærer til en fast stilling på fuld tid.

Kom ud og besøg os! Ring og få en snak!

En fantastisk stilling venter her!
Vi søger en matematik- og billedkunstlærer, som kan varetage matematik i to af skolens dejlige klasser, samt indgå i vores to ugentlige krea-blokke med billedkunst.

Øvrige undervisningskompetencer vil blive forsøgt sat i spil alt afhængigt af fag.

Højt til loftet med teamet
Vi er som skole kendetegnet ved stort engagement, en professionel og teambaseret tilgang til undervisning og et stærkt fællesskab. I Vejrup Børneby står ingen alene. Der er højt til loftet og generelt store frihedsgrader til udvikling og udfoldelse.

Fakta
Vejrup Børneby har 110 skoleelever fordelt på ét spor fra 0. – 6. klasse og tilbyder fantastiske rammer for undervisning med mindre klasser (15 elever i gennemsnit). Skolen er super velholdt, veludstyret, ryddelig og ren med masser af plads og fine faciliteter ude som inde. Vi har stor hal, multisal, boldbaner, hoppepude, pump track, skolehave, udeværksted, store legepladser og generelt meget plads til udfoldelse inden døre.

Store frihedsgrader, fællesskab og faglighed
Fællesskab
Vi driver en fællesskabsorienteret skole, og er særligt optagede af elevernes tryghed og deltagelse i fællesskabet. Fællesskab er ikke en floskel i Vejrup Børneby, men derimod udgangspunktet i vores værdigrundlag, og vi arbejder systematisk med fællesskab i hele børnebyen.

Praktisk, projektorienteret og tværfagligt fokus
Vi har fag, hvor klassiske fag fusionerer på nye måder, og på fredage arbejder klasserne sammen i faserne med et tværfagligt, fællesskabs- og projektorienteret fokus.

Tryghed
Vi tror på, at gennemgående kendte voksne i klasserne gør eleverne mere trygge, og vi planlægger med at have så få forskellige voksne på klasserne som muligt.

Læsning
Vi er meget fokuserede på læsning, og læner os stringent op ad forskning på området, og har således en opprioriteret strategi på området.

Vejrup Børneby et spændende sted at arbejde, og vi ligger altid godt i de parametre, vi bliver målt på. I de seneste målinger på forældretilfredshed og elevtrivsel lå vi bedst i kommunen, og arbejdsmiljøet er præget af åbenhed, medindflydelse og fællesskab.

Vi er meget flittige med at præsentere børnebyen på Facebook, så orienter dig gerne her:

DU SKAL VÆRE

  • læreruddannet (matematik, billedkunst).
  • struktureret, ansvarlig, venlig. Struktureret og ansvarlig. Struktureret!

VI ER STOLTE AF

  • vores professionelle læringsfællesskab med kollegaer, der er hjælpsomme, anerkendende og ambitiøse.
  • en flot skole med høj faglighed, kreativitet, frihed og masser af humor.
  • at være en moderne arbejdsplads med fladt hierarki, hvor der er fællesskab om løsninger og kort vej til ledelsen.
  • at man let kan tage to-tre kilo på, hvis ikke man kan sige fra overfor fællesskabets gensidige forkælelser.

Opfordring
Send os meget gerne en lille video på ca. 1 minut sammen med ansøgningen, hvor du helt kort fortæller, hvem du er, og om din motivation for at søge. Videoen uploades samme sted som ansøgningen.

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte skoleleder Ole Zoltan Göller, tlf. 21 83 88 92.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst, herunder de gældende bestemmelser om lokal løndannelse. Du kan finde oplysninger om lønniveauet i Esbjerg Kommune via dette link: KRL. Her findes også oplysninger om grundløn og pension. Der kan desuden efter en konkret vurdering aftales kvalifikations- og/eller funktionstillæg afhængigt af stillingens indhold samt dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

I Esbjerg Kommune arbejder vi tillidsbaseret og ser menneskelig forskellighed som en styrke. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede uanset køn, alder eller etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Ved ansættelse i stillingen indhentes straffeattest og børneattest.

Går du videre efter ansættelsessamtale, vil der blive indhentet referencer fra nuværende og/eller tidligere arbejdsgiver, hvis du fortsat er i betragtning til stillingen. Du vil blive informeret inden, at der bliver indhentet referencer.

Ansøgningsfrist:
27. september 2026

Der afholdes ansættelsessamtaler 29. september 2026

Ansøgningen sendes elektronisk. Klik på ”søg stillingen” nederst og vedhæft din ansøgning, CV og relevant dokumentation.

title: Business Operations / Project Manager
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations / Project Manager with a strong AdTech Background to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.

The Business Operations / Project Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.

Core Responsibilities

1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance

  • Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.


2. Project Management & Visibility

  • Own and maintain internal Notion project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond the department, building the systems foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into business line weekly meetings, as aligned with product operating model.


3. Product Rollout Support

  • Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with Group Product Manager to formalize this process as a repeatable model.


4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement

  • Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned.


5. Data & Spreadsheet Management

  • Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for departmental initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable, and scalable systems and models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role.

Who You Are

  • The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).
  • The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.
  • Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
  • Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.


What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

title: Electrical Supervisor
description:
About the position

Solvexis Consult is looking for an experienced Electrical Supervisor for a construction project in Fredericia.

You will be responsible for supervising and coordinating electrical and instrumentation activities on site, ensuring that installations are completed safely, correctly and according to the agreed schedule and quality requirements.

The position requires close cooperation with contractors, subcontractors, engineering partners, the commissioning team and the client.

Responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Supervising electrical and instrumentation installation activities on site.

  • Coordinating the daily work of electrical contractors and subcontractors.

  • Participating in project, coordination and progress meetings with the general contractor, subcontractors and client.

  • Monitoring installation progress and identifying delays, technical constraints and supply-chain challenges.

  • Supporting the contract-management process, including progress evaluation, change orders and potential commercial impacts.

  • Providing technical E&I support and working closely with the client’s commissioning team.

  • Inspecting the installation and testing of LV distribution panels, DCS panels, BMS panels, solenoid panels and associated electrical equipment.

  • Ensuring that drawings, documentation and other project deliverables are provided on time.

  • Reviewing installation and testing schedules and reporting issues or risks to the relevant project leads.

  • Coordinating the safe execution of energisation and LOTO activities in accordance with project procedures and required authorizations.

  • Conducting QA walk downs and identifying quality issues, incomplete work and deviations.

  • Coordinating and supporting punch-list close-out before and after mechanical completion.

  • Ensuring that work is carried out in accordance with project HSE requirements, quality standards and approved procedures.

  • Maintaining clear progress records and communicating status, risks and required actions to project stakeholders.

Qualifications and experience

We expect that you have:

  • A relevant electrical qualification, such as electrician, electrical technician, electrical engineer or equivalent.

  • Proven experience supervising electrical installations on construction or industrial projects.

  • Practical knowledge of LV installations, electrical testing, energisation and LOTO procedures.

  • Experience working with electrical panels and control systems.

  • The ability to read and understand electrical drawings, schematics, specifications and project documentation.

  • Experience with QA inspections, walk downs, punch lists and system handover.

  • Strong coordination and communication skills.

  • A structured and safety-conscious approach to your work.

  • Professional working proficiency in English.

Experience with DCS and BMS installations, commissioning activities or large multidisciplinary projects will be an advantage.

What we offer

At Solvexis, you will be supported by a professional organization throughout your assignment. We provide structured onboarding, administrative support, documentation assistance and regular follow-up, allowing you to focus on delivering high-quality work for the project.

You will join a technically demanding project with close cooperation across contractors, engineering, commissioning and client teams.

Employment terms will be agreed based on your qualifications, experience and the conditions of the assignment.

Application

Please apply through our recruitment portal and upload your CV in English.
