Job Description:

About Innovative Medicine

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at

We are searching for the best talent for a Senior Laboratory Automation Scientist to be located in Spring House, PA.

Purpose: The Senior Laboratory Automation Scientist owns scientific automation readiness for one or more integrated workcells. The role translates complex biological, biochemical, analytical, and screening workflows into executable automated sequences that preserve sample identity, scientific intent, data context, and downstream decision value.


The Senior Scientist will lead design, integration, qualification, optimization, and lifecycle support of integrated laboratory automation workcells for discovery and analytical workflows, with explicit responsibility for scientific operability, handoffs, method robustness, data provenance, exception recovery, user adoption and workflow readiness.

This role is complementary to the Senior Automation and Robotics Engineer. The scientist owns the workflow, method, sample logic, data context, and user adoption; the engineer owns the physical system, machine behavior, robot motion, safety, serviceability, and engineering acceptance.

You will be responsible for:

Workcell Architecture and Scientific Design

  • Leading translation of scientific workflows into process maps, sample flows, consumable flows, method logic, instrument sequences, metadata needs, analytical outputs, data handoffs, and scientific decision points.

  • Designing and deploying integrated workcells combining liquid handlers, plate handling devices, washers, centrifuges, incubators, readers, storage systems, barcode readers, labelers, analytical instruments, and orchestration software.

  • Defining method transfer strategy from manual to automated execution, including pipetting approach, tolerance assumptions, deck layout, consumable selection, reagent stability, timing constraints, controls, and acceptance criteria.

  • Leading UAT design for nominal workflows, edge cases, sample exceptions, data handoffs, intervention paths, recovery cases, and user acceptance.

Inter-Workcell Integration and Data Provenance

  • Owning upstream and downstream handoff requirements for assigned workcells, including labware compatibility, sample format, timing constraints, temperature or sterility constraints, storage conditions, queue logic, and data handoff expectations.

  • Defining sample, labware, consumable, reagent, waste, intermediate product, and run state requirements for assigned workcells.

  • Partnering with IT, data science, AI, and laboratory informatics teams to define metadata, sample lineage, experimental provenance, data integrity checks, file transfer expectations, and model-ready outputs.

  • Supporting integration control documentation between workflows, workcells, orchestration layers, ELN, LIMS, GDB, data platforms, analytical systems, and vendor software.

Recovery, Governance, and Sustainment

  • Designing recovery logic for failed runs, interrupted workflows, missing samples, failed transfers, sample rescue, plate quarantine, rerouting, pause/resume situations, and manual interventions.

  • Leading troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex issues spanning method performance, liquid handling, consumables, assay response, scheduling, sample tracking, metadata, data capture, and user behavior.

  • Supporting vendor selection, Tier 1 and Tier 2 coordination, FAT, SAT, UAT, risk assessments, readiness reviews, hypercare planning, training, and lifecycle support.

  • Driving continuous improvement based on run metrics, failure mode analysis, user feedback, scientific output quality, throughput, hands-on time, and data completeness.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Support technology evaluations, proof-of-concept studies, workflow readiness assessments, user demonstrations, and vendor evaluations for future automation capabilities.

  • Contribute to laboratory automation standards, workflow templates, data handoff expectations, training materials, and playbooks.

  • Support audit, inspection, or quality documentation requests where automated scientific workflows intersect with regulated or quality driven environments.

  • Participate in lessons learned and continuous improvement activities to improve future automation delivery and adoption.

Qualifications/Requirements

Education:

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Analytical Sciences, Laboratory Automation, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field is required. An advanced degree is preferred.

Experience and Skills:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 6+ years, Master’s degree with 4+ years, PhD with 2+ years of relevant experience in laboratory automation, scientific automation, analytical automation, or workcell integration.

  • Demonstrated understanding of laboratory workflows, sample handling, plate/tube formats, assay execution, consumable preparation, run documentation, and data capture.

  • Hands-on or practical experience with automated liquid handlers or integrated laboratory automation equipment appropriate to the level of the role.

  • Ability to translate scientific workflows into executable automated methods, worklists, run states, exception pathways, and user-facing procedures.

  • Working knowledge of sample identity, labware identity, reagent identity, consumable state, barcode traceability, metadata capture, and downstream data requirements.

  • Ability to collaborate with scientists, automation engineers, IT, data science, AI, EHS, facilities, vendors, and laboratory operations.

  • Experience developing and implementing automated laboratory workflows or high-throughput methods.

  • Experience with inter-workcell handoffs, method qualification, user training, exception recovery, technical documentation, and lifecycle support.

Preferred:

  • Experience with ELN, LIMS, GDB, data lakes, request tracking, APIs, scripting, device drivers, scheduling logic, biosafety, contamination control, simulation, digital twin methods, FAIR data, or structured metadata.

  • Experience with biologics discovery, protein production/purification, NGS, biophysics, cell-based assays, screening, analytical development, or protein characterization workflows.

  • Experience with orchestration software such as Biosero Green Button Go, Cellario, Momentum, or equivalent systems.

Other:

  • Travel may be required for vendor assessments, FAT/SAT activities, site visits, system builds, workshops, training, technology scouting, or cross-site deployment support.

Why Join Us

This role supports the transition from isolated automation projects to integrated, reliable, AI-native, and ultimately self-driving discovery laboratory systems. The work helps connect scientific intent with robust physical execution, reproducible data, model feedback, and scalable operational capability.

title: Koordinator til rehabiliteringsindsats for voksne med spiseforstyrrelse
description:
Vil du arbejde med mennesker med spiseforstyrrelser som koordinator på et specialiseret botilbud? Du bliver en del af et stærkt tværfagligt miljø i Askovhus, hvor vi er højt specialiserede inden for spiseforstyrrelser og rehabilitering.

Askovhus er AskovFondens specialiserede behandlings- og rehabiliteringstilbud til mennesker med spiseforstyrrelse. Askovhus er VISO-leverandør og tilbyder en lang række rehabiliterende og terapeutiske indsatser til børn, unge og voksne med spiseforstyrrelse, herunder botilbud, behandlingsforløb, færdighedstræningsgrupper og individuel terapi. Den aktuelle stilling er i vores §107 botilbud.

I Askovhus ser vi det hele menneske, og med afsæt i den enkeltes mål, drømme og ønsker arbejder vi sammen om at skabe et meningsfuldt liv, hvor spiseforstyrrelsen ikke fylder alt. I Askovhus arbejder vi ud fra dialektisk adfærdsterapi (DAT).

Som vores nye kollega i Askovhus skal du indgå i vores koordinatorteam, hvor du koordinerer rehabiliteringsindsatsen for ca. 5 voksne, som har en spiseforstyrrelse og bor eller får hjælp i Askovhus. Du vil få det overordnede ansvar i tæt samarbejde med Askovhus øvrige team samt eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Vores målgruppe er som udgangspunkt indadreagerende. En stor del af vores beboere har komplekse problemstillinger og andre diagnoser; en væsentlig del har autismespektrumforstyrrelse.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Afholde individuelle, koordinerende samtaler
  • Udarbejde udviklingsplaner og statusskrivelser i samarbejde med vores beboere
  • Koordinere samarbejde og sikre dialog og opgavekoordinering blandt interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere, f.eks. kommunale sagsbehandlere og psykiatrien
  • Koordinere den rehabiliterende indsats i et tværfagligt rehabiliteringsteam, herunder tæt samarbejde, opfølgning og sparring med de relationsmedarbejdere (studerende), som indgår i teams omkring de enkelte beboere
  • Blive en del af vores nødtelefonsteam. Nødtelefonen varetages hjemmefra

Vi forventer, at du…

  • Har en professionsbachelor som, pædagog, lærer, sygeplejerske, ergoterapeut eller lignende. Måske har du også en akademisk overbygning som f.eks. cand.mag. fra DPU, RUC etc.
  • At du motiveres af det relationelle og rehabiliterende arbejde, og du gerne at du har erfaring med rehabilitering
  • At du har interesse for spiseforstyrrelsesområdet, og gerne at du har erfaring med arbejdet med mennesker, som har en spiseforstyrrelse og de specifikke udfordringer, der følger med. Vi ser også gerne, at du har erfaring indenfor autismespektrumforstyrrelser
  • Besidder nysgerrighed, selvstændighed og engagement til at tage ansvar og handle
  • Kan skabe en tillidsfuld arbejdsalliance med målgruppen
  • Trives med åbenhed og tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Kan bevare overblik og ro, når der er travlt
  • Har kendskab til og evt. erfaring med dialektisk adfærdsterapi

Vi tilbyder

Som koordinator i Askovhus’ botilbud får du faglige udfordringer i et tæt teamsamarbejde med sparring med dygtige kollegaer og et stort selvstændigt ansvar. Du vil få et job på en spændende og støttende arbejdsplads, hvor vi vægter trivsel højt. Du vil får grundig oplæring, og du vil få medindflydelse på dine opgaver samtidigt med, at du løbende vil modtage supervision.

Askovhus har mange års erfaring med både behandling og rehabilitering til mennesker med spiseforstyrrelse. Som ansat i Askovhus bliver du også en del af NGO’en AskovFonden.

Ansøgningsfrist mandag d. 14. september kl. 12, og vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler kort tid derefter. Vi ser gerne, at du kan starte 1. november 2026. Stillingen er på 37 timer.

Søg stillingen her

For spørgsmål, kontakt venligst afdelingsleder Sussi Harpøth på SH@askovhus.dk.

Læs mere om Askovhus på , og besøg os på eller Instagram/Askovhus.dk

En del af AskovFonden

Askovhus er en del af AskovFonden, som er en non profit NGO med mere end 80 års erfaring med at arbejde med mennesker som er socialt udsatte. Vores løsninger bygger relationer med det mål, at de får styrken og modet til at tage ansvar for deres eget liv og det samfund, de er en del af. I AskovFondens fem indsatser arbejder vi for at skabe bedre vilkår for mennesker der er udsatte i Danmark.

title: Data Surveillance Analyst - based in selected EMEA locations
description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

This home-based position is available to candidates in selected EMEA locations. Applicants must be based in one of the eligible locations.

Picture Yourself At Parexel:

The Data Surveillance Analyst (DSA) is responsible for analyzing scientific and operational data to support the Data Surveillance process and reviewing project-specific Quality Tolerance Limits. They assist in developing Data Surveillance Plans (DSPs) and conduct defined project reviews. The DSA also attends internal and external Data Surveillance meetings, where they present relevant findings to the project team.

What You'll Do At Parexel:

Data Surveillance Plan Development and Technology Configuration:

  • Support the development of a robust Data Surveillance Plan, including Key Risk Indicators, Quality Tolerance Limits, and central statistical analysis.

  • Configure and Maintain Data Surveillance technologies (e.g., CluePoints Central Monitoring Platform):

- Create data import mapping for all data sources

- Create and set-up standard and bespoke KRIs.

- Create and set-up statistical analysis parameters.

Data Surveillance Review:

  • Review relevant data via the scoped technologies and additional sources as required to support reviews designated for the DS Analyst per the project specific Data Surveillance Plan, including project specific Quality Tolerance Limits.

  • Document findings from Data Surveillance activities in the DS Findings Form, Issue Tracking system(s) and other as appropriate.

  • Provide feedback and work with Technology teams to identify potential solutions that match the business and technology strategy.

  • Apply working knowledge and judgment to identify and evaluate potential data quality trend, outliers and emergent issues. Determine and implement appropriate follow-up action with the input of other / relevant parties and / or guidance provided, if applicable.

  • Actively participate in Investigator and other external or internal meetings and audits & regulatory inspections as required.

  • Recognize impact of study non-compliance/issues/delays/data quality signals and communicate/ promptly escalate to FL any site and/or study issues that require immediate action.

  • Perform core reviews per DS Plan.

  • Document instances of atypical data per DS Plan.

  • Collaborate with DS Team Members to correlate findings from various sources.

  • Support Project Leads with DS Review meeting, driving reviews and decisions as needed and agreeing on actions.

  • Engage DS Team to compile signals/actions into client ready list.

  • Support documentation of actions in CluePoints Issue Management system (links to IH for any on-site interventions required).

  • Complete, share, and file Central Monitoring Report.

Here are a few requirements specific to this advertised role:

  • University degree (medical, biological science, pharmacy, and/or data analytics).

  • Fluent English.

  • Hands-on programming experience in SAS, R, and/or SQL is a must-have.

  • Experience with Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) processes and data surveillance methods.

  • Familiarity with centralized monitoring and Data Driven Monitoring practices.

  • Proficient in data analysis, trend identification, and issue triage.

  • Proficient in relevant software: CTMS, EDMS, MS Office.

  • Basic understanding of SDTM domains and data operations concepts.

  • Experience with CluePoints would be a strong asset.

  • Client-focused with strong quality orientation.

  • Effective in matrix and global virtual team environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including presentation abilities.

  • Strong time management and multitasking capabilities.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Why join us:

Be part of groundbreaking projects that are pushing the boundaries of the industry. Experience a collaborative and inclusive work environment that highly appreciates your expertise. Unlock your full potential with professional growth and development opportunities. Enjoy work life balance and flexible working hours!

If this job does not sound like the next step in your career, but you know of someone who would be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Orchard Team Leader/Farm Supervisor
description:

Jealous Fruits is the northernmost large scale cherry producer in North America. We grow premium cherries along the shores of Okanagan Lake in the renowned Okanagan Valley of British Columbia, Canada. Our cherries are all hand packed in our state-of-the-art facility, located right on our farm, and shipped to our customers worldwide.

Under the direction of the Crew Manager, the Team Leader will lead our cherry-picking teams in the field to insure safe and efficient cherry picking.

Manage cherry picking teams of 20+ pickers to ensure safe and efficient cherry picking and safe tree line movement.
Maintaining our quality driven processes.
Take part in and provide Health and Safety and on-the-job training to pickers/field workers as required.
Report all received QC reports to Crew Managers.
Ensure all trees in picking block are picked clean of cherries.
Assist the Crew Managers and Farm/Operations Managers as required.

Hold toolbox crew talks in the morning.
Assist with any team or individual issues.
Ensure that all safety protocols are followed, and workers are following SOP’s.
Maintain ongoing training.

Qualifications

Previous experience in cherry production is an asset.
Strong communications skills
Good attention to detail and accurate reporting.
Must be a flexible team player who works well in a busy and demanding environment.
Able to work for extended periods of time in a focused, safe, and professional manner.
Spanish/French language skills an asset.
Valid First Aid qualification preferred (current OFA level 2 or 3 would be an asset)

Working conditions
Our working environment is extremely challenging over a short period of time. Applicants should be aware that this is a farming environment and days off may be limited during our growing and packing season. Applicants should be aware that:

Work hours are not calendar based, but are dependent on crop maturity and weather.
As agricultural employment that overtime provisions do not apply for these positions.
Working is conducted outside; it is advisable to dress in layered clothing.
Work hours are not calendar based but are dependent on crop maturity and weather.
Work hours are generally up to 50 hours per week and can be longer.
Successful candidates will have flexible schedules (early morning, nights and weekends).
Applicants must be available year round with periods of slow season in December - January.
The candidate must have the ability to work well with people of varying backgrounds and nationalities.
Great teamwork environment.

Anyone who can legally work in Canada can apply for this job. If you are not currently authorized to work in Canada, the employer will not consider your job application.

Job Description

GALT Aerospace is seeking a full-time, salaried Software Engineer II or III to design, develop, integrate, and sustain software for complex aerospace and defense systems. This role involves full-stack software development, distributed systems, hardware/software integration, automation, and deployment into secure and disconnected environments. Key Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of and lead individual software features from requirements and design through implementation, integration, testing, and delivery.

  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks used to configure, provision, and deploy Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) systems and Windows virtual machines.
  • Develop, containerize, deploy, and troubleshoot software components using Podman and OCI-compatible container technologies.
  • Develop and troubleshoot software running across Linux and Windows environments.
  • Develop, integrate, and troubleshoot software deployed across physical and virtualized environments.
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, technical planning, system integration activities, and internal process improvement initiatives.
  • Explore and implement practical uses of artificial intelligence and large language models (LLMs) to improve software development, engineering workflows, system capabilities, and automation.
  • Develop or integrate AI agents and agentic workflows capable of interacting with tools, APIs, software repositories, documentation, and other engineering resources.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues spanning application software, distributed services, operating systems, networking, virtualization, containers, and hardware interfaces.

Required Skills, Experience, and Education

  • Bachelor's degree in in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Experience developing full-stack or distributed software applications using technologies such as:
  • Python or similar programming languages
  • js or similar modern front-end frameworks
  • RESTful APIs and service-based architectures
  • Bash and/or PowerShell scripting Knowledge of Linux administration (RHEL preferred)
  • Strong software development fundamentals, including data structures, debugging, software design, and maintainable coding practices.
  • Ability to independently own and drive software features from requirements through implementation, integration, and testing.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting software on Linux systems; Red Hat Enterprise Linux experience is preferred.
  • Understanding of distributed application communication concepts, including RPC and publish/subscribe messaging.
  • Experience integrating software with external systems, devices, or hardware interfaces.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases and data stores.
  • Experience developing and deploying containerized applications using Podman or other OCI-compatible container technologies.
  • Proficiency with Git and standard version-control practices.
  • Experience with Ansible or similar configuration and deployment automation technologies.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software and system-level components.
  • U.S. Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

Preferred Skills, Experience and Education

  • Hands-on experience using large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and AI agents as part of software development, engineering, or automation workflows.
  • Experience developing or integrating AI agents and agentic workflows, particularly agents capable of interacting with tools, APIs, files, databases, source-code repositories, or other resources to perform multi-step engineering tasks.
  • Experience with AI tool/function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or similar approaches for connecting AI models with external systems and engineering data.
  • Familiarity with local or on-premises AI infrastructure and technologies such as Ollama, Open WebUI, vLLM, Hugging Face, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with local or on-premises AI infrastructure and technologies such as Ollama, Open WebUI, vLLM, Hugging Face, or similar tools.
  • Experience with Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) and RPC frameworks such as gRPC or similar technologies.
  • Experience designing or developing systems using publish/subscribe messaging, event-driven architectures, message brokers, or similar distributed communication patterns.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting software interfaces with external hardware, including serial and other device communication protocols.
  • Experience deploying, operating, or maintaining software in disconnected or air-gapped environments, including offline dependency and package management.
  • Experience developing, deploying, or troubleshooting software in virtualized environments.
  • Networking knowledge including TCP/IP, UDP, multicast, DNS, routing, firewalls, and virtual networking.
  • Experience with low-level hardware/software integration, device APIs, drivers, GPIO, or Linux system interfaces.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices and tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, secure software development, system hardening, and vulnerability management.
  • Experience working within highly regulated, secure, or DoD software environments.
  • Active DoD security clearance or the ability to reinstate a previously held clearance.
  • Advanced degree or relevant technical certifications.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to sit for long periods of time
  • Person in this position needs to occasionally move about the facility
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery

Pay Scale

At GALT Aerospace, base pay is one part of the total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as one grows and develops within a role. The base pay for this role is between $130,000 -$160,000, and a specific candidate's base pay will depend on their skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

title: Comptroller
description:
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
• Oversees day-to-day operations of the team
• Reports financial information (budget, financial performance, forecasts, and
variance analysis) to the Management Committee, the Board other stakeholders
• Leads the budget planning process, monitors the overall budget and its
utilization and responsible for cost control
• Responsible for tax compliance and optimization
• Ensures that the Company has adequate cash to meet the obligations.
• Coordinates with parent company on the funding requirements and assists with
borrowing and financial plans, if any.
• Drives working capital optimization initiatives
• Helps the President with the enterprise risk management by identifying
operational and financial risk areas, establishing materiality level, assessing the
Company’s risk appetite, and developing risk management programs (e.g.,
insurance, business continuity).
• Manages and maintains relationship with third party service providers and
business partners such as banks and other collecting agents

• Oversees the IT operations (infrastructure and applications) and ensures that the
general IT controls are in place
• Monitors key performance and financial indicators
• Recommends and maintains policy and procedures within the areas of
responsibility.
• Helps establish internal controls, including delegation of authority affecting the
financials of the Company, and monitors its effectiveness
• Provides professional advice in other areas of operations in relation to processes
and internal controls.
• Ensures that processes are compliant with Company policies and regulations
• Ensures that a document management process is in place and that the
Company is compliant with the minimum requirement for document retention
(physical and electronic)
• Provides support and guidance to the whole team

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS/ REQUIRED COMPETENCIES OF THE JOB:
• Unquestionable integrity and reputation with strong ethical and moral principles
• Certified Public Accountant
• 10 years or more managing experience in the related field/job
• Highly analytical and detailed
• High-level knowledge of the accounting and reporting standards and
applicable tax regulations
• Preferably has working knowledge of the power industry operations and
regulations
• Familiar with basic IT general controls and with aptitude for learning ERP and
other application systems
• Strong understanding of internal controls and support operations such as
Purchasing, Inventory Management, Payroll and Office Administration.
• Keen understanding of the operational and financial risk areas, at the minimum,
and capable of developing risk management programs
• Ability to rationalize process flow, internal controls, and delegation of authorities
• Ability to recommend and lead process change initiatives
• Can proactively surface issues and recommend workable solutions
• Preferably with exposure to project management
• Proficient both in oral and written English
• Good interpersonal and presentation skills

• Proficient with MS Office applications (power point, word, excel, visio)
• Strong supervisory skills (planning, organizing, leading, coaching, monitoring, and
controlling) and can manage a big group

The Comptroller manages the whole operations of Accounting, Treasury, and IT. It is
ultimately responsible for the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of the
organization’s financial reporting. The role helps establish and direct organization’s
financial goals and objectives, its budget, and the financial plan. The Comptroller also
has the responsibility for ensuring internal controls are in place, enforced and reviewed
periodically for conformance to accounting and reporting standards and applicable
regulations.
As member of the Management Committee, the Comptroller provides strategic
recommendations to the President and leadership team in relation to the operations,
cash management and implementation of business plans.

title: Software Engineer Netwerkzorg (junior–medior)
description:
Bouw mee aan zorg die écht samenwerkt

Bij Ecare werk je niet aan “nog een applicatie”.
Je werkt aan iets wat in de zorg steeds belangrijker wordt: interoperabiliteit.

In de zorg werken veel professionals rondom één cliënt, ieder met hun eigen systemen. Juist daar ontstaan fouten, dubbel werk en onveiligheid. Als Software Engineer Interoperabiliteit zorg jij ervoor dat zorginformatie één keer goed wordt vastgelegd en veilig, correct en op het juiste moment beschikbaar is voor andere systemen.

Dat is technisch werk.
Maar vooral werk dat zorgprofessionals helpt om makkelijker en sneller samen te werken rondom één cliënt.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan oplossingen die verder gaan dan één scherm of één applicatie. Je richt je op de onderliggende laag waarin systemen met elkaar praten en data betrouwbaar wordt uitgewisseld.

Concreet werk je aan:

  • backend-ontwikkeling

  • API’s en standaarden;

  • data-structuren en integraties;

  • oplossingen die bijdragen aan veilige en correcte gegevensuitwisseling.


    Ongeveer     80% van je tijd werk je intern samen met je team.
    Ongeveer     20% van je tijd stem je af met externe partijen, zoals leveranciers, samenwerkingsverbanden, werkgroepen of hackathons.


Dit is nadrukkelijk geen rol voor iemand die alleen wil coderen in isolatie. Je werkt samen, stemt af en denkt mee over context en impact.


We zoeken geen perfecte senior. We zoeken iemand die past.

Je herkent jezelf waarschijnlijk in meerdere van onderstaande punten:

  • je bent junior of medior software engineer;

  • je vindt het interessant om techniek in context toe te passen;

  • je kunt uitleggen wat je bouwt en waarom;

  • je werkt graag samen, ook buiten je eigen team;

  • je hebt interesse in data, standaarden en API’s.

Ervaring met zorgstandaarden is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.
Nieuwsgierigheid en leervermogen vinden we belangrijker.

Omdat je werkt binnen de Nederlandse zorgcontext en met externe stakeholders, is Nederlands spreken en schrijven noodzakelijk.

title: Senior Backend Developer - Python, FastAPI & AI Integrations
description:
Job Description

Company: CYURÆ

Location: Gurugram, Haryana

Work Mode: Full-time, On-site

Experience Required: 5+ years

Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer with 5+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, deploying and maintaining production-grade applications.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, FastAPI, databases, cloud infrastructure and API development, along with a good understanding of AI-enabled applications. You should be comfortable taking ownership of the complete backend lifecycle—from architecture and development to deployment, monitoring and production support.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can independently build scalable backend systems, integrate AI services, work closely with DevOps and guide junior developers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable backend systems using Python and FastAPI.
  • Build secure, reliable and well-documented REST APIs and asynchronous services.
  • Take ownership of backend architecture, database design, API contracts and system integrations.
  • Develop complete backend workflows from requirement understanding to production deployment.
  • Integrate AI models, LLM APIs, recommendation services, embeddings and third-party AI platforms into backend applications.
  • Build structured and reliable APIs around AI services, including validation, retries, fallbacks, rate limiting and error handling.
  • Work with PostgreSQL, Redis and vector databases for transactional, caching and AI-search requirements.
  • Design background-processing systems using queues, workers and event-driven workflows.
  • Optimise backend systems for performance, scalability, security and cost.
  • Containerise applications using Docker and support deployment on AWS.
  • Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with DevOps.
  • Manage environment configurations, secrets, logging, monitoring and production alerts.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Implement authentication, authorisation, role-based access and API security controls.
  • Write clean, maintainable and testable code with proper unit and integration testing.
  • Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, architecture discussions and release planning.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level developers and help maintain engineering standards.
  • Collaborate with AI, mobile, frontend, product, QA and UI/UX teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional backend development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python.
  • Advanced experience building production APIs using FastAPI.
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency and background processing.
  • Experience designing and developing complete backend systems for web or mobile applications.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, API versioning, validation, authentication and documentation.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, database schema design, indexing and query optimisation.
  • Practical experience with Redis for caching, sessions, rate limiting or background jobs.
  • Experience integrating AI services, LLM APIs, machine-learning models or AI-based features into applications.
  • Good understanding of embeddings, vector search, structured AI responses and model API integration.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and containerised application deployment.
  • Experience deploying and managing applications on AWS or an equivalent cloud platform.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git and GitLab or GitHub workflows.
  • Experience with application monitoring, logging, debugging and production support.
  • Good understanding of backend security, data protection and secure API development.
  • Ability to independently take a backend product from planning to production.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and technical ownership skills.
  • Comfortable working full-time from the Gurugram office.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, API Gateway and CloudWatch.
  • Experience with Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS or similar queue and messaging technologies.
  • Knowledge of WebSockets and real-time application development.
  • Experience working with vector databases such as pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus or OpenSearch.
  • Understanding of RAG pipelines, prompt orchestration and AI gateway architecture.
  • Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Amazon Bedrock, Hugging Face or open-source AI models.
  • Experience with microservices, modular monoliths or event-driven architecture.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or developing a product from zero to one.
  • Previous experience mentoring developers or leading backend technical decisions.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is a hands-on developer and not limited to team management.
  • Can independently design and build an application backend end to end.
  • Understands both development and production deployment.
  • Can work effectively with AI engineers and convert model capabilities into reliable product APIs.
  • Takes ownership of performance, security, deployment and production stability.
  • Can make practical architecture decisions without unnecessarily overengineering the product.
  • Is comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment.

This Role May Not Be Suitable For

  • Candidates with experience limited only to basic CRUD API development.
  • Candidates who have not independently deployed or maintained applications in production.
  • Candidates whose AI knowledge is limited only to basic prompt writing.
  • Candidates looking exclusively for a managerial role without hands-on coding.
  • Candidates without practical experience in Python and FastAPI.

What Success Looks Like

During the first three to six months, the selected candidate should be able to:

  • Understand and strengthen the existing backend architecture.
  • Build stable and scalable production APIs.
  • Establish clean development, testing and deployment practices.
  • Improve backend performance, observability and production reliability.
  • Integrate AI services securely and efficiently.
  • Create reusable backend modules and clear API documentation.
  • Support the deployment and monitoring of applications on AWS.
  • Mentor other developers and improve the team's engineering standards.

What We Offer

  • A high-ownership role in an AI-first product company.
  • Direct collaboration with the founders, CTO and core engineering team.
  • Opportunity to influence backend architecture and technical decisions.
  • Exposure to AI integrations, scalable systems, cloud infrastructure and production engineering.
  • Opportunity to build a technology product from an early stage.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and technical capability.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their CV, LinkedIn profile and GitHub/GitLab profile to contact@cyurae.com.

Please include:

  • Current location
  • Total backend development experience
  • Current CTC
  • Expected CTC
  • Notice period
  • Experience with Python, FastAPI and AI
  • Experience deploying applications on AWS
  • Details of one application or product developed and deployed end to end
  • Confirmation that you are comfortable working on-site in Gurugram

title: Principal Data Architect
description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™.
ASRC Federal Technology Solutions, a subsidiary of ASRC Federal, is seeking a Data Architect to remotely support our DHS program that we are bidding on. This position is contingent upon award.

The Data Architect will serve as the lead authority for designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise data architecture under the ICE Law Enforcement Systems and Analysis (LESA) Data Quality Improvement Support Services contract, ensuring that data structures, models, and governance frameworks strengthen the accuracy, accessibility, and operational usability of mission‑critical systems such as the Enforcement Integrated Database (EID), the EAGLE application, and the Alien Removal Module (EARM). This role develops and enforces data standards, creates scalable data models, and collaborates closely with law enforcement stakeholders, system owners, and technical teams to align data strategies with operational requirements, compliance mandates, and long‑term modernization goals. The Data Architect ensures that data environments are optimized for integrity, performance, and interoperability, enabling reliable analytics, informed decision‑making, and continuous improvement across ICE data systems.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the design, development, validation, and documentation of data remediation approaches, analytical methods, to support AI/ML solutions.
Ensure all data approaches align with the LESA Data Quality Potential Error Inventory and comply with applicable DHS/ICE policies.
Develop AI and machine learning models to detect, remediate, and prevent data quality issues, utilizing cleaned and annotated datasets from ongoing remediation efforts.
Oversee the integration of AI-driven models, automation scripts, dashboards, and other data quality tools.
Collaborate with stakeholders to identify data quality issues, determine root causes, and recommend or implement corrective actions.
Facilitate user training and knowledge transfer on analytics and data quality processes.

Qualifications

Minimum bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a closely related discipline; an advanced degree (master’s or doctorate) is preferred.
At least eight (8) years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or a closely related field, with hands-on experience designing and implementing analytical solutions in operational settings.
Demonstrated experience in applying advanced statistical techniques, machine learning, and AI to real-world datasets; proficient with modern data analytics toolsets (SQL, Python, R, Databricks, etc.); strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

Certifications/Clearance

Required: SECRET Security clearance or ability to obtain one, as required for accessing sensitive data.

title: Manufacturing Engineering Co-op (Onsite) - January 2027
description:
Term: January 2027

Duration: 4 or 8 months

Openings: 2 positions

Salary Range: $3,650 - $4,525 CAD per month

Application Deadline: Monday, October 5, 2026, at 9:30 AM PDT

Your Opportunity

By joining the Kardium team, you can help make a difference in the lives of millions around the world. We have developed a ground-breaking medical device for the diagnosis and treatment of the most common heart rhythm disorder, atrial fibrillation – which can cause stroke, heart failure, and other heart-related complications.

Kardium’s mission is to deliver the best treatment for atrial fibrillation. To achieve this, we have developed The Globe® Pulsed Field System – we have a fantastic technical team that has developed a product with strong, unique, and customer-valued differentiators versus other solutions on the market. We have built connections with key opinion leaders who are already using the Globe System and are helping to tell our story.

We have obtained FDA approval and officially begun the commercial launch of the Globe® Pulsed Field System. This is a pivotal and exciting time in our journey, as we bring this life-changing technology to patients!

Please note, this opportunity is an onsite work arrangement, located in Burnaby, BC.

What You Will Experience
You will engage in activities that develop practical and transferable skills such as:

Source and build production equipment to support capacity expansion
Assist with the setup and implementation of new production lines
Collaborate with engineers on the installation, maintenance and optimization of critical facility infrastructure, including HVAC, compressed air, and water systems
Conduct process time studies and provide recommendations for improvements
Work on process improvement projects to increase production efficiency and capacity
Design and implement fixtures and equipment to improve manufacturing processes using CAD software
Implement 5S and other Lean improvements in manufacturing and on the production floor
Provide manufacturing team support to meet the production department’s requirements; troubleshoot and resolve technical problems
Assist in the documentation of manufacturing processes including, but not limited to, work instructions, standards, and reports
Troubleshoot and monitor systems, assess data, and contribute to decision-making for facility improvements and operational efficiencies
Support facility expansions, ensure compliance with regulations, manage schedules and deadlines, and oversee contractors for maintenance tasks while maintaining safety and quality standards

What You Bring to the Team
Our Kardium team is smart, creative, and passionate about creating cutting-edge medical devices to help improve people’s lives. We work within a collaborative environment based on trust and respect. And we understand that only by working together can we solve the unsolvable.
You will be successful in this role because you possess these attributes:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Proficiency in Solidworks
Excellent communication skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
Understanding of Lean Manufacturing/Continuous Improvement methodologies
Enrolled in post-secondary program such as mechanical engineering, operations management, or other program related to manufacturing

Why work at Kardium?
A meaningful Co-op/Intern term experience, working with truly innovative technology and an ambitious team, combined with:

Meaningful Work: Gain hands on experience working on projects that make an impact, giving you valuable experience to kickstart your career
Community of Co-ops: Join a network of 40+ students across the company, with regular social events and monthly co-op events to connect with peers
Development & Growth: Collaborate with engaged leaders and multi-disciplinary teams who are committed to supporting your development and growth

Life at Kardium
What makes us a great place to work?

Our Purpose
Our People
Our Culture

At Kardium, we embrace diversity of background, experience, and perspective and we’re committed to inclusion and equity at every level. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of all communities.
We collaborate with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), as volunteer-led groups who share a common dimension of diversity and come together to provide support, education, and other opportunities across Kardium. Examples of our ERGs include Women ERG, Pride ERG, Race Ethnicity & Cultural Heritage (REACH) ERG, Truth & Reconciliation ERG, Persian Community ERG, Chinese ERG, Barangay Kardium (Filipino) ERG, Brazilian ERG and Irish ERG.
As part of your application, we encourage you to note if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations). There will be an optional section in the application form where you can provide this information to the recruitment team.
And our employees think we are great too – check out Glassdoor to learn more!
Compensation
Compensation for this role is based on multiple factors including your current year of study, the number of previous co-op terms completed, as well as market data.
Candidates must be legally entitled to work in Canada.
Relocation Support

Questions? We're Here to Help: Relocating for the first time comes with a lot of questions. Our Talent team is happy to help with any questions that may come up

Cover letter
Resume
Most recent transcripts (to be combined in one PDF document)

title: Automation QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced automation focused QA Engineer to join a growing quality engineering team. This role will cover the full software testing lifecycle, with a particular focus on expanding test automation while maintaining strong manual testing practices.
You will play an important role in improving quality processes, supporting a move towards CI/CD delivery, and ensuring software is robust, reliable, and thoroughly tested. The role will also provide opportunities to contribute to wider QA initiatives, define best practices, and support the development of less experienced team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain automated tests using Playwright.
  • Build and enhance scalable test automation frameworks using a Page Object Model approach.
  • Perform manual, functional, regression and exploratory testing.
  • Develop automated API tests using REST APIs, Postman or similar tools.
  • Work closely with developers, QA colleagues and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Contribute to the definition and implementation of QA coding standards, processes and best practices.
  • Support the continued integration of automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, efficiency and overall quality processes.
  • Investigate, document and communicate defects effectively.
  • Mentor and support less experienced QA team members.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the wider QA function.
  • Utilise modern AI coding and testing tools, such as Claude, to improve productivity and testing effectiveness.

Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years' commercial experience with Playwright.
  • Strong experience developing automated tests within a large-scale or enterprise-level framework.
  • Strong understanding and practical application of the Page Object Model.
  • Strong manual testing experience, including functional and exploratory testing.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, ideally TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Good understanding of software testing methodologies, techniques, and best practices.
  • Experience testing REST APIs and related concepts.
  • Practical experience creating automated API tests using Postman or similar tools.
  • Experience working within structured software development and QA environments.
  • Ability to establish and follow robust automation coding standards and best practices.
  • Comfortable mentoring and supporting less experienced colleagues.

Desirable

  • Experience with non-functional testing, including performance or load testing.
  • Familiarity with relevant performance testing tools and industry best practices.
  • Experience working within or supporting CI/CD environments.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding and testing tools.

General Dynamics is committed to helping our employees and their families lead healthy, productive lives. General Dynamics offers a wide array of plans in its flexible benefits program with options to help our employees succeed at work and at home.

title: Implementation Project Manager (Spanish Required)
description:
Summary

The Implementation Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of professional services projects to implement or optimize Workiva solutions. This role focuses on mastering and executing the Workiva implementation methodology, serving as the primary point of contact for customer engagements to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and contribute directly to customer value.

What You’ll Do

  • Portfolio & Project Execution: Efficiently manages a portfolio of 20–25 simultaneous standard-complexity projects with variable timelines (ranging from 4-week to 16-week implementation), balancing competing priorities and maintaining delivery standards

  • Core Delivery Management: Owns and drives the end-to-end execution of project plans for individual medium-to-high size/complexity, Workiva-led engagements

  • Stakeholder Management & Communication: Acts as the primary point of contact for the customer and internal project team, ensuring clear, concise, and timely communication

  • Documentation & Reporting: Manages all project documentation, including project plans, status reports, risk logs, and budgets

  • Risk & Issue Management: Proactively monitors and mitigates project-level risks and issues, escalating appropriately when necessary

  • Escalation Support: Helps resolve customer escalations, seeking guidance from leadership as required

  • Change Management: Facilitates standard project change requests and manages expectations within the defined project scope

  • Team Collaboration: Shares best practices, lessons learned, and foundational knowledge across the immediate project team or functional group

What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field, along with 4+ years of project management experience

  • Bilingual in Spanish strongly required (Business level)

Preferred Qualifications

  • SaaS industry experience and PMP or similar project management certification are preferred

  • PMP, PRINCE2, or similar advanced project management certification is highly preferred

  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated experience independently managing stakeholders and resolving customer escalations

  • Commercial acumen with experience in complex scope, budgets, and multi-party delivery models

  • Strong project management discipline with the ability to independently manage a fast-paced portfolio and full lifecycle of assigned projects

  • Proven ability to quickly earn the trust of key sponsors and stakeholders and resolve conflict at the project level

  • Effectively navigates ambiguity, pivoting between project types, solution areas, and support needs as the company moves towards its strategic vision

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively apply implementation methodologies (e.g., Workiva methodology). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira) and familiarity with Waterfall, Agile, or Scrum methodologies is a plus

Travel Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Minimal travel for internal meetings

  • Reliable internet access for any period of time, working remotely and not in a Workiva office

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $74,000.00 - $125,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

title: Air Conditioning Engineer
description:
Air Conditioning Engineer

We are recruiting for an experienced Air Conditioning Engineer to join a well-established and expanding engineering company providing commercial HVAC services to customers across the UK.

The successful Air Conditioning Engineer will primarily cover Manchester, the North West and surrounding areas, travelling directly from home to customer sites. There may also be occasional travel further afield depending on customer requirements.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a business with more than 30 years' experience and an established nationwide engineering operation.

Air Conditioning Engineer Role

As an Air Conditioning Engineer, you will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, fault-finding, repairing and installing a wide range of commercial air conditioning systems.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Responding to service and breakdown calls
  • Testing and servicing commercial air conditioning equipment
  • Diagnosing faults and completing repairs
  • Working on split and multi-split systems
  • Servicing and repairing VRV/VRF systems
  • Working with water chillers
  • Carrying out installations when required
  • Providing customers with technical advice and support
  • Completing work efficiently and to a high standard
  • Reporting to the Technical Service Manager
  • Travelling to customer sites as required
Air Conditioning Engineer Requirements

The successful Air Conditioning Engineer will need to be an experienced commercial HVAC professional with strong service, maintenance, repair and installation capabilities.

You will ideally have:

  • F-Gas Category 1
  • NVQ Level 2 and/or Level 3 or equivalent
  • Strong commercial air conditioning experience
  • Previous service and maintenance experience
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • Air conditioning installation experience
  • Experience with split systems
  • Experience with VRV/VRF systems
  • Experience working with water chillers
  • Electrical knowledge would be advantageous
  • Good communication and customer-facing skills
  • Ability to work independently as a mobile engineer
  • Willingness to travel when required
Air Conditioning Engineer Salary & Benefits

The successful Air Conditioning Engineer will receive:

  • £45,000-£55,000 basic salary
  • Overtime opportunities
  • Door-to-door pay
  • 40-hour working week
  • Company vehicle
  • Company mobile phone / tablet
  • 23 days' holiday plus bank holidays
  • Attendance bonus of £0.80 per contracted hour
  • Ongoing technical training
  • Career development and progression opportunities

The company works with a diverse range of commercial customers across the UK, including police forces, leisure facilities and high-end care environments, providing the Air Conditioning Engineer with exposure to a wide variety of sites and equipment.

This position would suit an experienced Air Conditioning Engineer looking for a well-paid mobile position with a long-established business offering overtime, door-to-door pay and continued career development.

If you are a qualified Air Conditioning Engineer with F-Gas certification and experience across service, fault-finding, repairs and installation, please apply today.

description:
Job Summary
The Registered Veterinary Technician, Laboratory and Pharmacy, under the direction of the Assistant Manager, Public Veterinary Services, is responsible for the administration and maintenance of the in-house pharmacy and laboratory functions supporting veterinary operations. The role provides technical veterinary support through diagnostic testing, pharmacy management, radiography, surgical assistance, patient care, and client communication. The Registered Veterinary Technician, Laboratory and Pharmacy collaborates with veterinarians, clients, and animal care staff to support high standards of patient care, safety, and operational effectiveness. This position contributes to positive patient outcomes and supports the Toronto Humane Society's mission to improve animal welfare through accessible veterinary care and life-saving services.

Job Duties

Pharmacy Management

Maintain and organize the in-clinic pharmacy, including inventory control, drug audits, ordering, receiving, stocking, and storage of medications.
Dispense medications as prescribed and maintain accurate pharmaceutical records.
Order, receive, stock, and monitor medical, laboratory, pharmacy, and animal care supplies to ensure uninterrupted clinical operations.

Diagnostic and Laboratory Procedures

Collect and process diagnostic samples, including blood, urine, fecal, and cytology specimens.
Perform laboratory testing, including hematology, biochemistry, urinalysis, parasitology, and cytology.
Prepare and submit diagnostic samples to external laboratories as required.
Obtain diagnostic radiographs and communicate observations to veterinarians.
Maintain laboratory equipment according to manufacturer instructions and ensure appropriate quality control measures are performed.

Clinical and Surgical Support

Assist veterinarians with physical examinations, diagnostics, treatments, and patient assessments.
Provide surgical support, including patient preparation, induction, intubation, monitoring, and recovery.
Perform non-surgical dental procedures in accordance with established protocols.
Administer medications and treatments in accordance with veterinary instructions and established protocols.
Perform daily husbandry and patient care activities.
Safely handle and restrain animals of varying species, sizes, and temperaments.
Advocate for the health and welfare of animals and support positive patient outcomes.

Equipment, Inventory, and Facility Management

Ensure treatment, laboratory, surgical, and animal care areas remain clean, organized, and prepared for daily operations.
Maintain clinical, laboratory, and diagnostic equipment to support safe and effective operations.
Ensure work areas are appropriately stocked and prepared to support patient care activities.

Documentation, Communication, and Quality Assurance

Enter and maintain accurate patient, treatment, laboratory, and pharmacy records within veterinary software systems.
Communicate effectively with clients regarding patient care, treatments, medications, and follow-up instructions.
Collaborate with veterinarians and other staff to ensure continuity of care and efficient service delivery.
Support quality assurance, patient safety, infection prevention, and risk management initiatives.
Demonstrate cooperation and professionalism in support of a collaborative team environment.

Other Duties

Attend and participate in workshops, seminars, and in-service training to further education, skills, and training.
Be aware of and work within the regulations of all Toronto Humane Society policies and protocols.
Work in compliance with the provisions of the Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA) and its regulations, including understanding and adhering to the requirements of the Health and Safety Manual, and any other rules and regulations established by the Society.
Work cooperatively with all volunteers and recognize the talent and commitment they bring to the Society.
Foster, promote, support and drive inclusion and influence others to promote, embrace and progress Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at the Society.
Other duties as required in the day-to-day operation of the Society.

Job Requirements

Registered Member in good standing with Ontario Association of Veterinary Technicians
Strong knowledge of all essential competencies required to maintain RVT status
Proven ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a large, multidisciplinary medical care team
Demonstrated commitment to maintaining high standards of patient safety, care, and animal welfare
Strong nursing care and biosecurity knowledge
Strong customer service skills with the ability to communicate effectively and compassionately with adopters, foster caregivers, volunteers, and members of the public, including in sensitive or emotionally challenging situations
Demonstrated commitment to collaborative teamwork and fostering positive working relationships within a multidisciplinary environment
Able to lift up to 50 pounds without assistance
Strong communication, computer, time management and organizational skills
Organized with meticulous records maintenance skills and attention to detail
Experience working in animal welfare, shelter medicine, or a high-volume veterinary environment is considered an asset
Ability to multi-task and prioritize critical patient care
Ability to adapt to change and maintain a positive mindset
Demonstrates the ability to maintain poise and efficiency in stressful situations

Work Conditions

Interaction with employees, management, volunteers, students and member of the public
Interaction with others under varying circumstances-including situations of a highly sensitive nature
Flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays
Occasional overtime
Involves the lifting, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling of heavy to moderately heavy objects and materials and some combination of climbing and balancing to include stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling
Ability to safely and humanely restrain animals of various sizes and temperaments when necessary
Performance of essential functions may require exposure to adverse environmental conditions, such as dirt, dust, pollen, odors, wetness, humidity, weather, temperature and noise extremes, hazardous materials, traffic hazards, bright/dim lights, toxic agents, animal/wildlife attacks, animal bites, disease, pathogenic substances, or rude/irate customers.

Overview of the Business Services Team

The EMEA Business Services team at Moelis & Company provides strategic advisory services on M&A, sponsor-led sell-sides and buy-sides, equity capital markets, recapitalisations, and other strategic and capital structure matters. The team advises public and private companies, founders and entrepreneurs, and financial sponsors across professional services, environmental and sustainability services, design and engineering, testing, inspection and certification (TIC), distribution, commercial services, and technology-enabled and industrial services, partnering with the Firm's product, financial sponsors and international coverage teams to deliver differentiated, high-impact advice.

The London-based team is known for its analytical rigor, commercial judgment, and collaborative approach. Associates are given meaningful responsibility early on, with direct exposure to senior bankers and clients.

Moelis’ culture is entrepreneurial and meritocratic. We value initiative, intellectual curiosity, and a strong client-first mindset. Our Associates are encouraged to take ownership of their work, contribute ideas, and develop as trusted advisors while working alongside experienced professionals on some of the Firm’s most important mandates.

Position Description:

We are seeking an Associate to join our EMEA Business Services investment banking team in London. The Associate will play a central role in the execution of M&A, sponsor-led sale processes, equity capital markets and other strategic advisory mandates, supporting all aspects of deal origination, structuring, and execution. The role requires strong financial and analytical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

title: Radiologic Intervention Technologist - Outpatient Vascular Surgery - 8-Hour Days
description:
Job Description

Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence! Cedars-Sinai is a nationally recognized healthcare organization committed to excellence in patient care, research, and employee engagement. Join a team where innovation, teamwork, and compassionate care are valued. You’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients while developing your skills in a collaborative, advanced imaging environment. Come find out why Cedars-Sinai was Voted #1 in California and recognized eleven years in a row on the “Best Hospitals” Honor Roll by U.S. News & World Report!

The Radiologic Intervention Technologist position provides the crucial service of working alongside top-tier vascular surgeons, scrubbing into advanced minimally invasive diagnostic and interventional procedures. Because this is a specialized outpatient role, it offers a highly competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits along with an excellent quality-of-life schedule compared to traditional inpatient hospital shifts.

The Radiologic Intervention Technologist will

  • Perform sophisticated diagnostic and Vascular/Non-Vascular Interventional procedures such as Interventional Radiography, diagnostic fluoroscopy and diagnostic general radiography (x-Ray) procedures.
  • Circulates and scrubs in to assist physicians during diagnostic and interventional procedures. This includes preparing and discarding the supplies and medications needed on a sterile field, loading biopsy and other interventional devices, and ensuring that the sterile field is not contaminated.
  • Perform inventory management and process ordering of interventional supplies.
  • Perform post process sophisticated 3D reconstruction
  • Assists in performing Pre-Ops, SOP’s and properly triages patient’s pre-procedure
  • Performs venipunctures, draws specimens and maintains proficiencies.
  • Acquires patient questionnaire, chart, data/requisition and reviews all to determine contraindication of having an Interventional examination. Ensures patients' comfort and safety during and after the exam and educates patients regarding procedures and equipment.
  • Acquires, archives, transmits and prints images via PACS. When applicable, completes after hours transmission of images and appropriate paperwork
  • Coordinates accurate contrast related to patient having an IR exam
  • Maintains available equipment up-time at the highest level for patient accessibility. Immediately reports any malfunctions; observes potential equipment dysfunctions and reports problems or calls for service
  • May be required to rotate through all imaging modalities, sites, and/or locations
  • Perform Imaging equipment QA/QC and perform PACS/RIS QC
  • Train other staff members
  • Assist with scheduling of patients as needed
  • Actively participates in special projects and process improvement

Qualifications

Education:

  • Vocational/Technical Diploma, Completion of Radiologic Technology program approved by the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists required

Work Experience:

  • 1 year Experience in Interventional Radiography required
  • 2 years Experience in Interventional Radiography preferred

Licenses and Certifications:

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) from American Heart Association or American Red Cross required
  • Imaging CA Radiologic Tech Certified Radiologic Technologist (CRT)- CA State License. Upon Hire required
  • Imaging CA Radiologic Tech State of California CRT Fluoroscopy Permit Upon Hire required
  • Imaging CA Radiologic Tech American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) preferred

title: Clinical Director
description:
REACH Health Services of the Institutes for Behavior Resources, Inc. (IBR) is seeking a FULL-TIME CLINICAL DIRECTOR to join its team. At REACH, you'll have the opportunity to shape innovative behavioral health services, mentor future leaders, advance evidence-based care, and make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals and communities affected by substance use disorders. You will join a collaborative leadership team committed to quality, equity, and continuous improvement in care.


As Clinical Director, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for REACH's clinical services, ensuring high-quality, person-centered care that aligns with regulatory requirements, evidence-based practices, and organizational goals.


Responsibilities include:

  • Oversee the therapeutic, rehabilitative, and clinical operations of the program, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, accreditation standards, and best practices.
  • Lead clinical quality improvement initiatives to enhance client outcomes, safety, service delivery, and the overall client experience.
  • Develop and implement clinical policies, procedures, and program strategies that support excellence in care and operational effectiveness.
  • Provide clinical supervision, mentorship, and leadership to counselors and program staff, fostering professional growth, accountability, and a positive workplace culture.
  • Recruit, onboard, coach, evaluate, and retain high-performing clinical team members.
  • Manage clinical crises, ensure continuity of care, and provide leadership in complex case management and treatment planning.
  • Monitor program performance, productivity, and key outcomes, using data to drive decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate interdisciplinary treatment team meetings to support care coordination, professional development, and quality care delivery.
  • Lead quality assurance, compliance, risk management, and audit readiness activities, including chart reviews, incident follow-up, and accreditation support.
  • Collaborate with organizational leadership and administrative teams to strengthen program operations, revenue cycle processes, and strategic initiatives.
  • Represent REACH in community partnerships, policy discussions, research activities, and other external stakeholder engagements.
  • Oversee health records management and electronic health record (EHR) systems to ensure accuracy, compliance, and effective reporting.
  • Serve as a member of the leadership team, contributing to organizational planning, emergency preparedness, and mission-driven growth.

Work Schedule:

This is a 40 hour/week, full-time, exempt-level position working on-site with a start time of 6am or 7am, Monday through Friday. Work from home may be permitted on a situational basis not more than twice a month. This may be reassessed after the first year of employment.


Pay & Benefits:

In compliance with Maryland's Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, IBR is committed to providing transparent wage information for all posted job opportunities. The salary for this position is $90-120k annually. Compensation is determined based on factors such as Licensure, Education, Experience, and Internal Equity.


IBR offers competitive health benefits, generous PTO, tuition and certification reimbursement, retirement options, and other perks. To learn more details about what we offer, please visit our website.

IBR is an approved facility of the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) Substance Use Disorder Treatment and Recovery Loan Repayment Program (STAR LRP). As a STAR LPR approved facility, we offer a student loan repayment program opportunity.

description:
