title: Lærer søges til Boomerang
description:
Lærer søges til Boomerang - Greve Kommunes nye tilbud til elever i ufrivilligt skolefravær

Vi søger en lærer, der kan se mening i at undervise både online og fysisk, og som forstår, at vejen tilbage til skole kan tage mange former.

En lærer, der ved at skole nogle gange starter ved køkkenbordet på en skærm, og først senere finder vej tilbage til klasselokalet.

Boomerang er Greve Kommunes nye tilbud til elever i ufrivilligt skolefravær. Navnet er ikke tilfældigt. Vi arbejder målrettet for, at eleverne vender tilbage til skolefællesskabet i deres tempo og på deres måde, men altid med tydelig faglig og pædagogisk retning.

Onlineundervisning er en vigtig del af indsatsen i Boomerang, men ikke et mål i sig selv. For mange elever er skærmen det første skridt tilbage i læring, struktur og relation. For andre går vejen hurtigere mod fysisk fremmøde og deltagelse i et skolefællesskab. Vi arbejder bevidst med progression mellem formater, så undervisningen kan bevæge sig fra det digitale til det fysiske, i takt med at eleven er klar. Som lærer skal du kunne bruge onlineundervisning professionelt og meningsfuldt og samtidig have blik for, at det fysiske møde fortsat er centralt i elevens samlede skolegang.

Indsatsen rummer onlineundervisning, en til en undervisning med fysisk fremmøde, hjemmebesøg og det vi endnu ikke ved, vi får brug for. Arbejdet med disse elever følger sjældent en manual. Du skal kunne navigere i skiftet mellem formater og løbende tilpasse undervisningen, så den giver mening for netop den elev, du arbejder med.

Din opgave er klar, også når vejen derhen ikke er det.
Du skal bruge undervisningen, ofte online, som løftestang for motivation, læring og gradvis tilbagevenden til skole. Sideløbende skal du i samarbejde med familierne skabe grobund for tillid, fælles retning og håb.

Relationen til eleverne er ufravigelig også online. Lige så vigtig er evnen til at tænke højt sammen med kolleger, løse komplekse situationer i fællesskab og turde være professionel guide også når løsningen først opstår undervejs.

Vi søger dig, der
• har erfaring med eller stærk lyst til onlineundervisning
• kan skabe struktur og nærvær også i digitale læringsrum
• kan holde rammen mens eleven sætter tempoet
• er en rolig, tydelig og professionel voksen, der tør tænke ud af boksen, når boksen ikke giver mening

Vi vil blive meget glade hvis du

  • Kan føre til eksamen i Dansk
  • Måske ved lidt om vores samfund
  • og kan trylle det hele på engelsk også
  • I et ressourceperspektiv og er klar op opgave i almen.
Boomerang er placeret på Mosedeskolen, hvor arbejdet med skolefravær har haft stort fokus det seneste år.

Ledelsen i Boomerang har stor erfaring med målgruppen, og du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor alvoren tages seriøst, relationerne tages personligt på den professionelle måde, og hvor der også er plads til humor, også når arbejdet er komplekst.



Vil du være en del af teamet?

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen eller Boomerang, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte leder af Boomerang Katrine Bøgsted-Møller på telefon 23618792

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst (ny løn).

Ansøgningsfristen er fredag d. 25. september 2026, og der afholdes samtaler løbende, timetal og opstart efter aftale .Der vil blive taget reference fra tidligere arbejdsgiver/-e efter aftale og blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest.

Send din ansøgning, CV, uddannelsesbeviser og evt. udtalelser.

description:

We’re looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Landscape / Construction Estimator to join our growing team. This role plays a key part in winning new work—helping identify opportunities, build accurate estimates, and support the company’s continued growth and strong project pipeline.

What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, you’ll be at the center of our pre-construction and bidding process—turning plans into accurate, competitive estimates that help us win and deliver high-quality projects.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Identifying and pursuing bidding opportunities to support company growth

  • Explaining estimates, assumptions, and scope details to clients and answering pricing-related questions
  • Collaborating closely with internal teams, landscape architects, clients, general contractors, and subcontractors to refine scopes and pricing
  • Tracking actual project costs against estimates to evaluate performance and improve future accuracy
  • Helping improve estimating processes by incorporating historical data and lessons learned
  • Supporting additional related tasks as needed

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who understands construction from both the field and estimating side, and who can confidently build accurate, competitive bids.

  • 3+ years of estimating experience in landscape construction, site work, or general construction
  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field (preferred)
  • Strong proficiency with CAD and other construction/design software
  • Experience using Bluebeam and RSMeans (or similar estimating tools)
  • Solid understanding of:

title: Blomsterbinder søges til SuperBrugsen på Fanø
description:
Blomsterbinder søges til SuperBrugsen på Fanø

Du bliver en del af en butik med i alt ca. 70 faste medarbejdere. Butikkens ansatte er et godt mix i alle aldre med både fastboende og pendlere. Butikken som blev bygget i 2015, har nogle fantastiske gode rammer til såvel kunder som personalet. Blomsterbutikken er helt nybygget fra 2025, hvilket giver uanede muligheder for at præge butikkens udtryk.

SuperBrugsen Nordby, som er blandt de største SuperBrugser i Danmark ligger på den naturskønne ø Fanø, butikken er en del af Fanø Brugsforening som også driver Brugsen Sønderho, Fanø Blomster, OK tank, vaskeanlæg samt flere udlejningsejendomme.

Fanø er et yndet feriemål, så der løbes ekstra stærkt i ferieuger samt på alle helligdage, men da vi er øens foretrukne supermarked, har vi travlt året rundt.

Transport til Fanø:

Fanø ligger kun 12 minutters sejlads fra Esbjerg og butikken små 10 min. til fods fra færgen.

Dvs. hvis du bor i Esbjerg, vil det cirka tage 20 min., Varde, cirka tage 35 min. og hvis du bor i Ribe, vil det cirka tage 40 min. før du er fremme i butikken.

Færgen sejler 2 til 3 gange i timen fra Esbjerg til Fanø og retur.

Hvis du måtte ønske at flytte til øen, kan vi tilbyde en bolig til en gunstig pris.

Din hverdag som blomsterbinder i blomster afdelingen:

Det indebærer at du:

  • Tager ejerskab for jobbet – og vise det ved at gå foran
  • Skabe en masse salgs dynamik.
  • Er med til at løfte medarbejder trivsel i afd./ skabe en god arbejdsplads
  • Sammen med dine kolleger sørger I for en dynamisk og salgsklar butik med høj standard
  • Sætter kunderne i fokus, så de føler sig mødt og godt tilpas

En stor del af tiden, bruger du i butikken, hvor du står for meget af den daglige kontakt med kunderne. Med SuperBrugsens stærke lokale forankring, er din kontakt med kunderne rigtig vigtig. Du bruger tid på at tale med kunderne, for at kende deres behov og for at få en god relation.

Erfaring fra dagligvarebranchen

  • Det er et krav, at du har kendskab til blomster og ønsker at præge en butik med store udviklingsmuligheder.
  • Du kan være med gå forrest og vise vejen for butikkens medarbejdere med et positivt sind

Som person, er du en team-player der kan gå forrest for at sikre den bedste service til vores kunder. Samtidig er du god til planlægning og til at igangsætte de rette initiativer på de rigtige tidspunkter. Derfor, skal du også være forudseende og kunne se, hvad fokus skal være i butikken både på kort og længere sigt.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Konstitueret Uddeler Lars Jessen på tlf.: 51 92 72 96

Send din ansøgning via "Søg job" senest den. 30 september 2026

Du bliver en del af en mangfoldig og inkluderende virksomhed, hvor vi ser forskellighed som en styrke.
Vi ønsker at skabe lige muligheder for alle samt sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces. Det er derfor op til dig, om du ønsker at vedhæfte en ansøgning samt et billede.

Coop er en af Danmarks førende udbydere af dagligvarer. Vi driver kæderne SuperBrugsen, Kvickly, Brugsen og 365discount. Vi er omkring 40.000 medarbejdere og sammen med brugsforeningerne har vi en samlet omsætning på mere end 40 milliarder kr. i vores ca. 900 butikker over hele Danmark. Derfor er der mange muligheder for både nye opgaver og uddannelse og ikke mindst jobskifte internt i Coop. Vi er ejet af vores 2 million medlemmer og det andelsejede Energiselskab OK.

title: Chief Client Solutions Officer
description:
Job Description:

dentsu is one of the world’s largest media and marketing services organizations. Our North America media practice partners with some of the most sophisticated advertisers in the market, and the way media is planned, bought and measured is evolving quickly. The agencies that win will be the ones that pair outstanding thinking with outstanding execution.

The Chief Client Solutions Officer is a senior executive role responsible for how we deliver for our clients. This leader builds the client operations discipline across our North America media agencies, designs custom operational solutions for our most complex client businesses, and brings AI, data and technology into everyday ways of working so teams move faster and spend more of their time on strategy and ideas.

The work is both standard and bespoke: establishing consistent operating rigor across the practice, and diagnosing what an individual client needs and building the operational framework that delivers it. Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer of Media for North America, this is a build-and-run role for an operator who wants to shape how a major media practice works.

What You Will Own:

Client operations and solutions

  • Build and lead the client operations discipline across our North America media agencies, embedding operations and solutions leadership within key client teams.

  • Define the operating standards that guide account teams: ways of working, decision rights, briefing and approval workflows, and reporting cadence.

  • Design and implement custom operational frameworks for clients whose scale, structure or category calls for a purpose-built approach.

  • Streamline workflows across planning, activation, ad operations, finance and reporting to remove duplication and manual effort.

  • Set delivery quality standards, including QA protocols across planning, buying, trafficking and reporting.

  • Build and develop a high-performing client operations team, and grow the leadership bench to scale the discipline.

Client partnership, performance and growth

  • Establish a consistent framework for understanding client health across the practice, spanning partnership strength, delivery quality, commercial performance and growth potential.

  • Build dashboards and reporting that give leadership and client teams clear, timely visibility into how each relationship is performing.

  • Partner with agency CEOs and client leads on action plans that turn insight into prioritized, owned and time-bound work.

  • Identify the operational solution a given client situation calls for and lead its implementation end to end.

  • Work with Finance and Commercial teams on scope, pricing and resourcing models that support sustainable, high-quality delivery.

  • Codify successful client solutions into repeatable frameworks the wider practice can adopt.

  • Bring the breadth of dentsu — data and identity, creative, CXM, commerce and technology — into client plans where it strengthens the partnership.

  • Contribute operating model and solution design to client renewals and new business pursuits.

AI, data and operational innovation

  • Set the applied AI and automation agenda across briefing, planning, activation, QA, analysis and reporting.

  • Shift repetitive, labor-intensive processes toward AI-augmented workflows with appropriate human oversight, creating capacity for higher-value work.

  • Scale adoption of AI tools and agents across teams, with the investment, governance and enablement required to make them stick.

  • Embed dentsu’s data and identity capabilities into everyday planning and activation workflows, and into custom client solutions where the category warrants it.

  • Measure the impact of these investments on speed, quality, capacity and client outcomes.

What You Will Bring:

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership across media, marketing services or management consulting, including experience inside a media agency or marketing services organization.

  • Demonstrated ownership of operating model design and implementation at scale.

  • A track record of designing custom operational solutions for enterprise clients — diagnosing what a specific client needs and building the framework that delivers it.

  • Senior relationships with large advertisers, including CMO, procurement and marketing operations stakeholders.

  • Strong command of media agency economics: fee models, scope, resourcing and delivery costs.

  • Experience building and executing resourcing plans across onshore, nearshore and offshore delivery models.

  • Practical, current experience applying AI and automation to professional services delivery.

  • Proven change leadership in complex, matrixed organizations.

  • Based in Chicago or willing to relocate, with regular in-office presence and travel across North America.

The Leader We Are Looking For:

  • Diagnostic rigor. Gets to the real cause quickly, and builds the solution that addresses it.

  • A clear point of view. Delivers it with credibility to clients and colleagues alike.

  • Influence across a matrix. Aligns people and teams who do not report to them.

  • A bias toward implementation. Measured on adoption and outcomes, not on the design.

  • Commercial judgment. Understands how operational choices show up in the numbers.

  • A magnet for talent. Attracts, develops and retains strong operators.

The annual base salary range for this position is $236,900 - $316,250. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Additionally, this position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation.

Benefits available with this position include:

• Medical, vision, and dental insurance,

• Life insurance,

• Short-term and long-term disability insurance,

• 401k,

• Flexible paid time off,

• At least 15 paid holidays per year,

• Paid sick and safe leave, and

• Paid parental leave.

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies.     • Provide guidance in scaled Agile frameworks when working with larger programs or cross-functional teams.
  • Support multiple Scrum teams or a highly complex team.
    • Manage the unique needs of two or more Scrum teams simultaneously, ensuring each receives adequate coaching and facilitation.
    • For complex teams (e.g., those with integrated tech stacks or multiple external dependencies), work closely with Product Owner to balance priorities, manage complexity, and ensure delivery.
  • Coach Product Owners an scrum team on effective backlog refinement and prioritization.
    • Partner with Product Owners to ensure backlogs are well-groomed, actionable, and aligned with strategic goals.
    • Coach the team on breaking down epics and user stories, maintaining INVEST criteria (Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable).
    • Promote techniques like MoSCoW to prioritize high-value work.
  • Foster team self-organization and proactive impediment resolution.
    • Empower teams to take ownership of their work, plan effectively, and make data-driven decisions.
    • Encourage the team to identify and solve blockers early, stepping in when escalations or broader support is required.
    • Facilitate team health checks and retrospectives that lead to tangible, iterative improvements.
  • Analyze and use delivery metrics to improve team performance.
    • Track capacity, cycle time, and sprint predictability to identify trends and improvement areas.
    • Use data to help teams plan better, adjust WIP (Work in Progress) limits, and improve delivery confidence.
    • Share metrics transparently with Product Owner/Product Manager while protecting the team from misuse of data.
  • Mentor junior Scrum Masters and help elevate team agile maturity.
    • Share best practices, facilitate Agile workshops, or lead Communities of Practice (CoP).
    • Drive efforts to increase organizational agility, including cross-training, job shadowing, or agile maturity assessments.
  • Collaborate on dependency management and cross-team coordination.
    • Identify and manage cross-team dependencies early, facilitating alignment through Scrum of Scrums or PI Planning (in SAFe).
    • Work with Release Train Engineers (RTEs), Product Managers, or other roles to synchronize timelines, goals, and handoffs.
    • Help teams adapt to shifting priorities by maintaining communication bridges across departments.
  • Contribute to Agile Community of Practice
    • Share learnings, tools, and techniques across the Scrum Master CoP.
    • Participate in ongoing learning and certification opportunities to enhance skills.
  • Support Organizational Agile Maturity
    • Collaborate with leaders to improve Agile practices and support agile transformation goals.
    • Model Agile leadership behaviors that inspire change and drive results.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (What you're good at):

  • Strong understanding of the Scrum framework and Agile methodologies.
  • Working knowledge of Agile scaling models and their application in complex environments.
  • Proficiency in backlog management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, Rally) and agile metrics/reporting dashboards.
  • Familiarity with software delivery lifecycle (SDLC), ADO, and product management practices
  • Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills to identify blockers and facilitate conflict resolution across teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with Product Owners, stakeholders, and other Scrum Masters to manage dependencies.
  • Effectively support multiple Scrum teams or manage a single, complex team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understand product roadmaps and portfolio-level priorities, aligning team efforts to organizational objectives.
  • PMI Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or similar Agile certification is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience required; 5 or more years of progressive experience preferred.

Pay Range: $74,772 - $125,184

title: Loan Servicing Senior Associate
description:
FSG is the solution for operational excellence being sought by private fund managers who wish to focus solely on raising capital and identifying investment opportunities. We support the entire life-cycle of our clients’ private funds and management company, managing the execution of investments, the experience of their investors, and the compliance, finance and human resource solutions needed to satisfy all regulatory requirements. Our team is asked to serve our clients with consistent excellence and accountability, while being allowed to live their definition of success. We focus on bringing new team members on board who share our passion for providing excellence in our service, while never wavering from our Principles of integrity, effort, communication and protecting time with our families.

Loan Servicing Senior Associate

FSG is the opportunity to learn and experience the finance industry for a people-oriented, hard-working, team player. Our unique culture is built by the team and for the team. Our compensation structure provides unlimited upside to our team members. We will teach you all that you need to know to be successful on our team, so we do not require any specific degree or work history. We just hope you are as non-traditional and eager to prove yourself as we are!

Your key responsibilities are to deliver white glove service and honor the FSG Principles while:

  • Provide end-to-end loan administration and middle-office services for private fund clients, supporting the full lifecycle of private credit and loan investments
  • Review credit agreements and establish and maintain loan records in Hazeltree, including key terms, rates, payment terms, maturities, and other required data
  • Process loan activity (including drawdowns, paydowns, restructurings, rate resets, defaults, and amendments)
  • Monitor and reconcile principal, interest, fees, funding, and other loan and cash activity; prepare payoff calculations and resolve payment or cash exceptions
  • Coordinate loan transactions and money movements with clients, fund administrators, and other stakeholders
  • Prepare recurring loan portfolio and valuation reporting, including weekly and other client-required reporting
  • Maintain complete loan documentation and system records, resolve data and documentation discrepancies, and support audits, client/investor requests, and other operational needs

Our requirements for you as an applicant are simple:

  • 2–5 years of relevant experience, preferably in loan administration, private credit, treasury, fund administration, banking, custodial operations, private funds, or Registered Investment Advisors
  • Familiarity with private credit, loan documentation, loan servicing, or investment operations preferred
  • Experience with Sentry, Hazeltree, or another loan administration platform is a plus
  • Strong ability to interpret financial and transaction documentation and accurately capture key data points
  • Exceptional organizational, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Impeccable attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to identify and resolve cash, data, and documentation discrepancies
  • Team-oriented with a persistent work ethic and willingness to learn new systems and processes quickly
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel

If you excel in your responsibilities and fulfill your requirements, our commitment to you is:

  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Base salary commensurate with experience and success: The annual base salary range for this position is $60,000 to $85,000
  • Quarterly bonus that offers unlimited potential growth - 1/3rd of our profits (no matter how much) are shared with our team in bonuses each quarter

We are primarily a remote work company, but some of the training for this role may be best delivered in-person leveraging client sites or local coworking locations. Our clients also ask us to provide on-site support from time-to-time. In the interview process, we can outline expectations about what, if any, in-person training or support time is expected to be required for this role.

You will be successful when you deliver exemplary service to our clients and their investors, fulfill the FSG vision and purpose, and bring success to the entire FSG team. We are excited to have you join our team and appreciate your interest in joining us on a journey to success!

title: District Landman
description:
The primary job function of a District Landman is to analyze complex title chains, statutes, regulations, and oil and gas production data to determine accurate oil and gas mineral and royalty ownership and/or identify significant issues with land ownership. Based on his or her research and analysis, the District Landman must possess the ability to make recommendations to an oil and gas operator, real estate company, utility, or other PLM client, on how to best develop their real property based on the goal of the client. The District Landman will ultimately determine if a parcel of real property is subject to a lease, identify any and all owners (and share/proportion of ownership), and execute a strategy, developed by a Project Manager, that allows a client to use, or not use, real property in the manner desired and stated in a Work Order. A District Landman is also responsible for ensuring that contract vendors submit high quality work and approving or denying vendor’s invoice based on the quantity and quality of work product.

Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze complex title chains to determine surface, mineral, and royalty ownership shares for a given tract of real property and sign off on ownership
  • Identify any burdens or title defects that may halt the development of property in the manner required by the client
  • Identify any necessary curative action, based on analysis of title documents, and successfully execute any necessary affidavits, contracts, or amendments to ensure that a client’s use of land is in accordance with applicable statutes and regulations
  • Communicate real property issues, positive or negative, to the Project Manager in a timely, effective manner
  • Approve or deny invoices submitted by contract field vendors and assess vendor output against their billings
  • Negotiate easements, oil and gas leases, surface use agreements, or other contracts on behalf of PLM’s client at the best possible market rate
  • Performs other related duties as assigned
  • Minimum three (2) years of oil & gas experience as a land professional
  • Bachelor’s degree in Energy Management, Land Management, Energy Commerce strongly preferred
  • Will consider law degree (J.D), or degree in Environmental Sciences, Geology, Petroleum Engineering, or related field or field experience in land as alternative
  • AAPL Membership Required, RL & RPL Certification Preferred
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Director of Software Development for Oncology Data Platform
description:
Director of Software Development for Oncology Data Platform

Posting Number: 2144
Closing Date: Until Filled
Location: Remote, USA

The Public Health Institute (PHI) is an independent, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting health, well-being, and quality of life for people throughout California, across the nation and around the world. As one of the largest and most comprehensive public health organizations in the nation, we are at the forefront of research and innovations to improve the efficacy of public health statewide, nationally, and internationally.

PHI was distinguished as one of the top 50 "Best Non-Profit Organizations to Work For" by the Non-Profit Times in a national search.

POSITION SUMMARY

C/NET Solutions CNExT Cancer Registry software is used by Cancer Registrars for meeting mandated cancer reporting as well as analysis of the cancer population at their medical center. Together with our Cancer Alert System, efficiency in identifying and reporting of cancer is realized. We meet HIPAA and security regulations and allow remote access. All C/NET Solutions software can be run in mixed technology environments where the highest standards in database security or remote access are required.

The Director of Software Development for Oncology Data Platform (Director) will spearhead the strategic transformation of our software offerings, leading the design and development of our next-generation cloud-based oncology data platform (Project Aither / CNExT Cloud) that will replace our legacy system. This critical position combines product vision, technical leadership, and change management to guide our team through this significant transition while delivering innovative, AI-embedded solutions that help researchers and clinicians advance cancer treatment through data-driven insights.

Additionally, this position will manage the ongoing development, implementation, and support of our current hospital registry software (CNExT) and cancer case ascertainment (CAS) product. The Director will ensure that our existing products are updated at least annually as we provide continued support to our legacy product. This position will report to the Program Director.

This is a remote, regular full-time position with a work schedule of 40 hours per week. The incumbent must be able to work during core business hours for the Pacific Time zone and occasionally work more than 40 hours a week and on weekends. Candidates in the United States (all Time Zones) are welcome to apply.

Full salary range for this position: $123,149 to $188,879 per year. The typical hiring range for this position is from $123,149 (minimum) to $156,014 (midpoint), based on 100% FTE. The starting salary is determined using a variety of factors, such as the candidate's knowledge, skills, and experience, as well as internal equity consideration and budget availability.

Employment Type: Full Time

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following:
Lead development of next-generation product (Project Aither - CNExT Cloud)

Serve as the technical and strategic lead for Project Aither, C/NET Solutions' initiative to build CNExT Cloud - a next-generation, AI-embedded, cloud-native SaaS cancer registry platform that will replace the current legacy on-premises system. The Director is responsible for translating the product vision into a structured engineer executable plan and driving delivery through a 24-month phased development plan.

Product Strategy & Roadmap

- Own and execute the end-to-end product strategy for CNExT Cloud, covering both back-end and front-end development.
- Define and maintain the product execution roadmap, sprint plan, and feature backlog informed by competitive gap analysis, SME validation, and SME & customer inputs.
- Drive requirements gathering by engaging internal subject matter experts, cancer registrar users, and external stakeholders to validate feature priorities and document workflows before sprint planning begins.
- Protect and carry forward CNExT's competitive strengths, including SmartHelp, User-Defined Fields, CAS efficiency gains, and MP/H decision support into the new platform.

Cloud Architecture & Technical Leadership

- Architect and oversee the development of a cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS platform built on containerized microservices (Azure/AWS/GCP), with Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipeline, and full DevOps fabric.
- Lead the design and implementation of a browser-based React SPA replacing the legacy Windows client, with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, role-based dashboards, and modern UX.
- Oversee the building of a FHIR R4 / HL7 API Gateway to enable EHR connectivity, real-time ADT and lab result feeds, and EHR writeback, eliminating the need for manual data imports.
- Ensure multi-tenant data isolation, self-serve onboarding, SSO configuration, per-tenant billing, and RBAC are built to enterprise standards from the outset.
- Lead Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) through formal approval with PHI InfoSec, ensuring HIPAA controls, AES-256 encryption, audit logging, and RBAC design are verified prior to development.

AI & Machine Learning Capabilities

- Lead integration of AI auto-abstraction capabilities using NLP and large language model (LLM) engines to pre-populate NAACCR fields from pathology reports and clinical notes, with a human-in-the-loop registrar review and approval workflow.
- Oversee development of an ML-powered smart case-finding engine that scans ADT feeds, lab results, and pathology data with >90% confidence to surface cases registrars might otherwise miss.
- Manage strategic technology vendor evaluations and partnerships (e.g., EHR API connectivity, clinical NLP providers) to accelerate platform capability without building from scratch.
- Manage AI data partnership initiatives - such as the City of Hope collaboration, including data governance, IRB compliance, de-identification protocols, and AI training pipeline setup.

Regulatory Compliance & Quality

- Ensure CNExT Cloud maintains full compliance with NAACCR v23+, CoC accreditation requirements, SEER, AJCC 8th Edition, NPCR, and all-50-state reporting standards.
- Establish coding standards, best practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing workflows aligned to the new platform architecture.
- Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to a team of 3-5 programmer analysts, ensuring high-quality deliverables at each phase milestone.

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement

- Create and execute change management strategies to guide the programming team and broader organization through the transition from the legacy on-premises product to a cloud SaaS model.
- Serve as the primary technical liaison between programming teams, executive stakeholders, and external partners throughout the project lifecycle.
- Manage project timelines and resource allocation across all development phases, ensuring milestone delivery and proactive risk management.
- Provide regular communication and transparency to C/NET staff on Project Aither status, decisions, and next steps through structured staff update forums.

Manage all CNET and CAS application planning, analysis, design, implementation, and documentation (testing and technical) effort

- Analyze annual changes to NAACCR volume II data sets and state collection requirements to design and execute updates to CNET software products.
- Supervise the programming staff as they implement new program code and customize the CNET applications with appropriate prioritization of resources.
- Ensure all testing instructions and technical documentation are maintained and updated according to industry best practices.
- Assist whenever necessary by personally performing programming tasks at any level.
- Lead the Change Control meeting series and ad hoc planning processes to determine the content and timing of releases.
- Work with both the Special Projects and Support teams to analyze and design both user- and technology-directed changes to CAS.
- Supervise the programming staff as they perform further analysis and design of meeting those requirements; implement new program code and customize the CAS application as necessary.

Manage second-level help desk support assistance

- Assist, or assign resources to assist, with support issues escalated through the help desk escalation process.
- Answer, or direct resources to answer, product questions as needed without regard to the underlying issues' escalation status.
- Maintain communication with Support manager to effectively coordinate effort.

Additional Responsibilities

- Actively participate in management, advisory, and user processes and meetings to determine the current and future direction of the C/Net Solutions program.
- Act as mentor to programming staff and ensure that programming staff are fairly treated, assignments given are diverse and challenging, and opportunities for growth are presented.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Minimum Qualifications

- 7 years of related experience in the Health Information Technology field, including at least 3 years as a manager. Knowledge/experience related to leadership can substitute one year of management level experience.
- Experience with healthcare data systems, preferably in oncology.
- Demonstrated experience leading product transformation or legacy system replacement initiatives.
- Experience with HIPAA compliance and healthcare data security standards.
- Experience with data migration strategies and legacy system decommissioning.
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems; or substitute with 4 additional years of related experience in an Information Technology environment.

Other Qualifications

- Proven ability to lead teams through significant technological and organizational change.
- Strong knowledge of software architecture patterns and microservices design.
- Extensive knowledge of Cancer Registry practice and procedures preferred.
- Extensive knowledge of all CNExT products preferred.
- Background in data science or machine learning applications in healthcare.
- Extensive knowledge of software products including (but not limited to) Microsoft Windows, Excel, Access, SQL Server, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, text editors, compression or encryption software and customer relationship management software such as ACT!
- Excellent written language skills particularly experience with technical/instructional writing.
- Ability to work independently from a remote location.
- Ability to communicate with customers and staff at all levels of computer literacy.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills including the ability to compose complex and non-routine communications on a regular basis.
- Ability to travel when required.
- Ability to occasionally work more than 40 hours a week and on weekends.
- Master's degree preferred but not required.

OTHER IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Access to Protected Health Information

This job requires access to Protected Health Information. The incumbent will be responsible for reading, acknowledging, and complying with all C/NET Solutions and Public Health Institute policies pertaining to confidentiality and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

title: Receiving Inspector (Starfall)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

RECEIVING INSPECTOR (STARFALL)

SpaceX is seeking exceptional employees to enable the success of its Starfall, Dragon, and Starship programs at the Bloomfield, Connecticut site. The Receiving Inspector will receive, inspect, kit, and ship the textiles, hardware, and related materials that the soft goods shop consumes and produces. This hybrid role combines receiving inspection, inventory control, and shipping, including flight-critical and ordnance shipments. This role will have a close feedback loop with engineering, production, and the greater SpaceX team in our pursuit of making access to and from space as safe and reliable as possible.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Unpack incoming shipments; count, weigh, and measure against packing lists and bills of lading; transact the receipts, print routing labels, and place unverified or nonconforming material on hold/quarantine
  • Validate part number, quantity, revision, and condition against purchase orders, quality clauses, drawings, and specifications; pull the correct drawing revision for the receipt
  • Review quality documentation (certifications, specifications, certificates of conformance) for completeness; upload and maintain receiving records
  • Inspect incoming materials using visual methods and calibrated tools (scales, micrometers, calipers as required), approve or reject items and document non-conformances
  • Perform tension testing of thread and other textiles per procedure
  • Fill requests for inventory from work orders: pick, kit, and deliver material to the correct shop-floor location, maintaining lot/serial traceability and BOM accuracy; communicate material-preparedness status so production is not delayed
  • Put away material in labeled bins and racks; de-kit unused material; receive finished goods from the floor; and keep physical locations and electronic scan locations accurate
  • Control shelf-life lots where required
  • Perform rotating cycle counts and inventory audits; reconcile discrepancies; and review location-accuracy / stagnant-inventory reports
  • Prepare, pack, label, weigh, and stage outgoing shipments, including flight-critical next-flight-out (NFO) and supplier returns; coordinate carrier pickup; maintain shipping-supply stock
  • Handle ordnance and dangerous-goods shipments; obtain and maintain required certifications
  • Interface with production, engineering, purchasing, and carriers to resolve shortages, damages, and receipt discrepancies; create issue tickets as required
  • Keep receiving, inventory, and shipping areas organized; follow FOD, PPE, traceability, and material-handling procedures. Operate forklifts or pallet jacks per safety procedure when required

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 1+ years of experience in receiving, inspection, inventory, or material handling in a manufacturing environment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with an ERP/WMS (Warp or equivalent) and handheld/RF scanners
  • Hazardous-materials or ordnance shipping certification, or ability to obtain it
  • Experience operating a forklift, pallet jack, or other powered industrial equipment
  • Experience in aerospace, textiles, or soft goods
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
  • Strong communication skills (written and oral)
  • Proficiency in other languages (Spanish, Portuguese, Vietnamese)

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to work long hours (10+) and weekends/holidays as necessary
  • Must be willing to work all shifts and overtime as needed
  • Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods; lifting, bending, pushing, and pulling are generally required
  • Able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. unassisted
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain certifications required to handle and ship ordnance and dangerous goods
  • Must be able to travel to remote sites if required
  • Ability to pass Space Force and Air Force background checks to support travel to Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

title: Maintenance Operations Center Operator (supporting the U.S. Space Force)
description:
ASRC Federal Systems Solutions, LLC, a subsidiary of ASRC Federal, is seeking a MOC Operator to join our team in Colorado Springs, CO supporting Space Force Maintenance tracking and management of satellite, network, and command and control systems. This position is responsible for overseeing maintenance operations center (MOC) activities, ensuring system performance, and exercising independent judgment in the assessment, prioritization, and resolution of operational issues impacting mission-critical systems across multiple Space Force Mission Delta Maintenance activities.
Essential Duties:

Determines appropriate escalation pathways for incident and status reporting based on mission impact and operational priorities.
Direct or coordinate problem resolution responsibility between maintenance agencies and track resolution status.
Receives Mission Impact Reports, direct maintenance personnel as required and ensure documentation of equipment status/malfunctions into MPR database.
Independently identify applicable maintenance data and enter into IMDS or other applicable systems for reportable maintenance actions.
Assigns, tracks, and documents status for all Job Control Numbers, tracks equipment and maintenance status, requests assistance from supporting agencies, coordinate maintenance and supply requests and disseminate information.
Monitors power outages impacting mission operations and equipment and directing maintenance actions when necessary.
Processes Urgent Depot Level Maintenance and Emergency Depot Level Maintenance requests.
Reviews and updates open outage data identifying anomalies and directing actions for resolution.
Monitors and evaluates system performance and equipment status, exercising independent judgment to identify anomalies and determine appropriate escalation or corrective actions.
Serves as a central coordination point for incident and status reporting, ensuring accurate and timely communication to stakeholders and leadership.
Assesses mission impact of system degradations and directs appropriate response actions across maintenance and support organizations.
Coordinates and prioritizes maintenance activities across multiple agencies, ensuring timely resolution of operational issues and alignment with mission requirements.
Analyzes outage and performance data to identify trends, recommend corrective actions, and improve system reliability.
Oversees the management of Job Control Numbers, ensuring proper prioritization, tracking, and resolution in alignment with mission priorities.
Makes determinations regarding urgent and emergency maintenance requests, including Depot Level Maintenance actions, based on mission impact and operational risk.
Provides operational insight and recommendations to improve processes, reporting accuracy, and mission effectiveness.
Ensures integrity and accuracy of maintenance and operational data within IMDS and MPR systems, validating inputs and resolving discrepancies.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in a related field
Active DOD Secret clearance is required. US Citizenship is required for Secret clearance at this location.
Knowledge of satellite communications, earth observation missions, as well as mission operation ground infrastructure (e.g. ESOC, DLR, etc.)
Experience in the field of space and operations is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment in mission-critical operations and/or maintenance

title: Salgsassistent - Rønnede Meny
description:
Hos Lagkagehuset er vi lige så stolte af vores hverdagsglæde som af vores bagværk. Derfor leder vi efter en Salgsassistent, der kan hjælpe os med at gøre de små øjeblikke i butikken til gode oplevelser hver dag. Her bruger du din erfaring med service, nærvær og overblik, så vi sammen kan være et bedre bageri for alle.

Det fortæller en kollega om rollen
”Hverdagen er travl på den gode måde, og ingen dage er helt ens. Jeg elsker energien i butikken og følelsen af, at vi løfter i flok."

Din hverdag bliver fyldt med…
Kort sagt handler rollen som Salgsassistent om at skabe gode oplevelser for vores gæster og være med til at gøre butikken til et rart sted at være.

Den lidt længere version er, at du møder gæsterne med nærvær, venlighed og et godt overblik, så de føler sig velkomne og har lyst til at komme igen. Du hjælper med god service, deler din viden om produkterne og bidrager til, at hverdagen i butikken fungerer godt, både for gæster og kollegaer, også når der er travlt.

Vi tror derfor på, at du vil trives hos os, hvis du…

  • møder både gæster og kollegaer med venlighed, nærvær og hjælpsomhed
  • har lyst til at lære nyt og holde dig opdateret på vores produkter, nyheder og sortiment
  • trives i en hverdag med tempo og mange forskellige opgaver
  • tager ansvar for, at butikken altid er ren, indbydende og klar til gæsterne
  • bidrager til et positivt fællesskab og hjælper til, hvor der er brug for det

Hvad vi tilbyder dig
Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling, samarbejde og fællesskab. Derudover får du rabat i alle vores butikker og adgang til Visma Logbuy, som tilsammen giver lidt ekstra forkælelse i hverdagen.

Din rolle hos os
Din arbejdsuge er på 7 timer. Vagterne ligger primært om eftermiddagen på hverdage og ellers i weekenden fra kl. 06.00 til ca. 18.00. Du skal være parat til at arbejde hver anden weekend og på helligdage.

Det er et krav til denne stilling, at du er over 18 år.

Vil du være en del af Lagkagefamilien? Søg jobbet her.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og kan lukke opslaget, når det rette match er fundet, så send gerne din ansøgning snart. Efter ansøgningsfristen hører du fra os senest inden for 14 dage. Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores ansøgningsportal.

Rather than simply reporting numbers, you'll uncover the story behind the data and provide the insights that help shape strategy across the organization.
Reporting to the Director of Finance & Accounting, you'll partner with leaders across Operations, Program Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance to provide financial analysis, forecasting, business modeling, and performance insights that support strategic decision-making. By turning complex data into clear, actionable recommendations, you'll help drive profitability, improve operational performance, and influence the future of the business.

Leaders across Jered will rely on you as a trusted business partner who transforms financial and operational data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. Your ability to develop financial models, analyze business performance, and identify opportunities for improvement will help shape strategic initiatives, strengthen profitability, and improve operational effectiveness. Just as important as your analytical expertise will be your ability to build relationships across Finance, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management, helping teams understand the story behind the numbers and make confident, data-driven decisions.

Success in this role starts with intellectual curiosity and a desire to understand how the business operates. By connecting financial results with operational drivers, leveraging ERP data and analytical tools, and continuously seeking practical solutions to business challenges, you'll become a valued advisor across the organization. Your commitment to improving reporting, enhancing decision-making, and identifying opportunities for greater efficiency will help support Jered's long-term growth and success.

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, FP&A, operations analysis, or a related analytical role.
Demonstrated experience developing financial models, performing quantitative analysis, and using advanced Microsoft Excel for modeling, reporting, and data analysis.

Understanding of cost structures, indirect rates, labor utilization, and profitability drivers within a manufacturing, project-based, or industrial environment.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex financial and operational data, identify trends, and develop actionable business insights and recommendations.

title: Analytics Strategy Lead-Vice President
description:
Be an essential member of a diverse team of professionals dedicated to making a lasting impact! Join our Home Lending Decision Science team as we build a stronger Product Strategy function to prioritize the next wave of innovation and optimization. You'll be at the center of it, building crisp executive insights and clear business cases that shape what gets funded and built.

As a Vice President, Analytics Strategy Lead in Home Lending Decision Science, you'll be the analytics partner to Product Strategy, helping leaders choose what to do next and why. You'll shape the questions and approach, and deliver executive-ready recommendations with impact sizing, tradeoffs, and business cases. You'll direct the analysis and own the answer, coordinating across a matrix of teams and analysts to get the right work done. You'll be expected to ask "why," challenge weak logic, and drive work to a conclusion.

Job Responsibilities
  • Own a portfolio of executive-facing analytics for Product Strategy; frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and deliver clear recommendations that help leaders prioritize innovation and optimization work.
  • Anticipate the questions leaders will ask, such as risks, tradeoffs, confidence level, and edge cases, and answer them in the first version of the work.
  • Coordinate across a matrix of analysts; align scope, roles, and timelines, and set the standard for what executive-ready looks like.
  • Partner with Strategy, Product, Marketing, Originations, Finance, and Technology to source context, data, and constraints, and make sure the analysis answers the real question.
  • Quantify impact and tradeoffs, including ROI where relevant; challenge assumptions and call out what would change the recommendation.
  • Translate complex analysis into concise takeaways and visuals that help senior leaders decide.
  • Conduct targeted research (market, competitor, and internal performance) to support prioritization proposals and business cases.
  • Manage multiple priorities and tight timelines while maintaining analytical rigor and strong controls around accuracy and results.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Strong track record turning analysis into clear, executive-ready recommendations (tight story, clean numbers, clear "so what").
  • Ability to lead work through influence in a matrixed environment, aligning teams, driving timelines, and raising quality without relying on reporting lines.
  • Robust analytical foundation: hypothesis-driven problem solving, comfort with ambiguity, and sound judgment on what's good enough versus what needs deeper work.
  • Advanced SQL and working experience with at least one analytics language or tool (Python, R, or SAS) to self-serve, review work, and guide approach.
  • Ability to guide, influence, and manage stakeholders across multiple organizations is order to earn trust and move work forward.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Home Lending or mortgage domain experience (originations, marketing, pricing, credit, servicing, or channel performance).
  • Experience building business cases (impact sizing, ROI, sensitivities, and tradeoffs) to support prioritization.
  • Experience in strategy, consulting, product analytics, or a comparable role focused on executive decision support.
  • Experience setting analytics quality standards (documentation, peer review, reproducibility) and operating in a strong controls environment.

title: Bliv funktionschef hos Virksomhedsanalyse i Aalborg
description:
Er du motiveret af ledelse og af at arbejde med mennesker i et dynamisk miljø? Vil du være med til at løfte en vigtig del af kreditprocessen for Nykredit-koncernens erhvervskunder? Og formår du at sætte retning og sikre følgeskab? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver
Som funktionschef i Virksomhedsanalyse får du det daglige ledelsesansvar for et team af otte analytikere. Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du både sikrer den daglige drift, bidrager til den strategiske retning og understøtter den fortsatte udvikling af området.

Teamets opgaver tager udgangspunkt i udarbejdelsen af regnskabsanalyser på Nykredit-koncernens erhvervs- og landbrugskunder, som er en vigtig del af kreditvurderingen af kunderne. Teamet har særligt ansvar for regnskabsanalyser på Nykredit-koncernens Leasing-kunder og mindre erhvervskunder.

Sammen med dit team af analytikere og lederteamet, får du ansvar for at:

  • sikre effektiv driftsstyring og balancere kvalitet og effektivitet,
  • sætte retning for medarbejderne og bidrage til den strategiske udvikling af virksomhedsanalyse,
  • udvikle virksomhedsanalyses produkter, processer og arbejdsgange,
  • udvikle medarbejdere og sikre høj medarbejdertilfredshed,
  • arbejde tæt sammen med ledere i Nykredit Leasing og Nykredit Direkte samt agere faglig sparringspartner,
  • sikre, at regnskabsanalyser understøtter en effektiv og kvalificeret kreditproces for et bredt udsnit af Nykredits erhvervskunder.

Du får også mulighed for at udvikle en ambitiøs udviklingsagenda, hvor mulighederne ved kunstig intelligens afprøves på flere områder.

Du får dermed en nøglerolle i at sikre en effektiv håndtering af en vigtig proces for vores erhvervskunder. Med dit arbejde er du med til at forbedre kvaliteten i kreditindstillingerne, sikre hurtige svar til kunderne og understøtte Nykredit-koncernens fortsatte vækst uden at gå på kompromis med risikostyringen.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?
Du har ledelseserfaring og gerne erfaring med kreditprocessen og/eller regnskabshåndtering, fx fra rådgivning af erhvervskunder eller fra en kreditbevilgende rolle.

Du er motiveret af ledelse, optræder tillidsvækkende og trives med at skabe relationer, følge op på medarbejderes mål og understøtte deres udvikling. Har du erfaring med interessent- eller kundehåndtering, er det en fordel.

Som leder sætter du retning gennem holdånd, gejst og engagement. Du er kundeorienteret, handlekraftig og har fokus på at overholde leverancetider og sikre en god dialog med de kundeansvarlige.

Vi arbejder målrettet med at optimere vores produkter og processer. Derfor forventer vi, at du kan bidrage til at drive udviklingsopgaver, identificere udviklingspotentiale og omsætte idéer til konkrete forbedringer. Du vil blandt andet få mulighed for at præge et par igangværende AI-projekter.

Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.

Dit nye team
Virksomhedsanalyse har ansvaret for regnskabsbehandling og regnskabsanalyser på Nykredit-koncernens erhvervs- og landbrugskunder. Opgaverne er væsentlige for at sikre en god kundeoplevelse, solid kreditrisikostyring og korrekt kapitalbelastning i Nykredit-koncernen.

Du bliver en del af lederteamet i Virksomhedsanalyse, som er en del af kreditområdet. Her vil du samarbejde tæt med de øvrige ledere i kreditområdet og have løbende kontakt med rådgivere og ledere i forretningsenhederne.

Virksomhedsanalyse består af i alt 230 medarbejdere. Du bliver en del af en dynamisk og velfungerende afdeling med 60 analytikere og syv teamledere. Vi har lokationer i København og i Nordhavn. Stillingen og dit team er placeret på Göteborgvej i Aalborg.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt dygtigt miljø med en kultur præget af højt humør, en uformel omgangstone og et fælles fokus på at udvikle både medarbejdere, processer og resultater. Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Vil du vide mere?
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Afdelingsdirektør, Philip Weinreich Holm på tlf. 26 83 05 07.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV senest 13. september 2026. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Product Delivery Manager- Asset Based Lending Wholesale Lending Services
description:
Shape the future of product delivery while crafting solutions that enhance and optimize customer experiences. Lead end-to-end processes, manage dependencies, and liaise with stakeholders as part of a team at the forefront of innovation.

As a Product Delivery Manager in Wholesale Lending Services, you will own end-to-end delivery for ABL transformation initiatives-driving strategy into execution, adoption, and sustained performance improvements focusing on multi-year platform modernization and migration program. As a VP Product Delivery Manager in Asset Based Lending (ABL), you will be accountable for delivering complex, multi-year transformation and modernization across the end-to-end ABL lifecycle (onboarding, collateral setup, borrowing base, monitoring, exceptions, servicing, reporting). You will drive integrated delivery acrossBusiness, Credit, Field Exam, Operations, Data, Controls, and Technology, aligning senior stakeholders to a target-state vision and executing with strong governance and measurable outcomes. You will lead platform modernization and migration efforts (upgrades, data migrations, legacy decommissioning) and enable agentic AI and intelligent automation where it improves productivity and control effectiveness, ensuring solutions are safe, auditable, and resilient.

Job responsibilities
  • Own and deliver ABL WLS product priorities, managing the full transformation delivery lifecycle from opportunity identification to value realization.
  • Drive modernization and system migration programs (platform upgrades, data migrations, legacy decommissioning), including scope definition, feature build, test, deployment, dependency management, cutover planning, reconciliation, and stabilization.
  • Define and drive clear target-state vision and workflows - process, platform design, data, operating model alignment, and controls by challenging legacy workflows to reduce manual and enable automation, AI and straight-through processing where possible.
  • Partner with Product Managers and architects to refine features and user stories aligned to target-state architecture, integration patterns, API's, governed data usage & AI models.
  • Drive end-to-end integrations across ABL platforms and adjacent ecosystems (APIs/event-driven patterns, orchestration, workflow tooling).
  • Develop a forward-looking roadmap for ABL & WLS, leveraging emerging technologies like AI/ML, automation, and advanced analytics that reduce risk, time and enables scale.
  • Build alignment and influence stakeholders across multiple functions, building shared vision, influencing without direct authority and clear communication that results in consensus and key decisions.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to embed automation and AI capabilities into business processes and drive adoption.
  • Monitor industry trends and translate insights into strategic recommendations and innovation opportunities.
  • Run governance forums; manage Progress, Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies; escalate blockers effectively.
  • Oversee platform upgrades, data migrations, and collateral modernization, ensuring readiness, testing, and performance tracking.


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • 8+ years of lending product delivery, transformation experience or equivalent expertise in financial services, ABL, system transformation or a relevant domain area
  • Deep domain expertise in lending, ABL business & operations, platform transformation and modernization
  • Demonstrated success leading complex platform modernization and migration projects under tight timelines, including data migration strategy, cutover planning, and stabilization & enhancements.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a track record of translating strategy into execution.
  • Strong record of stakeholder management and executive-level communication; ability to influence across highly matrixed functions and drive decisions amid competing priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with clear decision documentation.
  • Proven ability to define and drive enterprise-scale lending product transformation strategies and adoption across large, complex organizations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional, enterprise-scale transformation programs covering business process, technology delivery, data, and operating model change.
  • Strong risk and controls mindset, with accountability for governance, access controls, auditability, and resiliency.


Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Deep ABL domain expertise: collateral eligibility, borrowing base, collateral monitoring, field exam coordination, covenant monitoring, exception management.
  • MBA or accounting degree, plus experience in integration, divestiture, or consulting.
  • Proven track record in collateral or loan platform modernization and data migrations within banking, including legacy system decommissioning.
  • Experience with multi-system integrations, such as workflow orchestration and API/event-driven patterns, to support straight-through processing.
  • Background in delivering agentic AI or AI-enabled workflows, including human-in-the-loop design and responsible AI controls.


Additional information

title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About the team

The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning.

This is a zero-to-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like.

The role

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you own the architecture of an security harness with novel exploitability engine end to end, and you’re accountable for the decisions that shape everything downstream. You set technical direction, make the hard calls defensible, and multiply the engineers around you.

What you’ll own

  • The end-to-end architecture of the exploitability engine—from evidence ingestion and entity resolution, through the attack-path probability core and choke-point ranking, to the validation loop that keeps predictions honest.
  • The decisions that cascade through the system: calibrated probability versus ordinal rank, identity as a first-class graph edge, assume-breach seeding, and how the most critical assets are defined. These are model-shaping calls, not implementation details.
  • The probabilistic ranking core: edge-traversal probability, guided path search with hop and likelihood limits, correlated-control-failure modeling, and honest uncertainty bands.
  • The calibration and validation loop—canaries, purple-team and incident replay, calibration measured by zone and vector—that turns modeled weights into evidence rather than opinion.
  • Make-or-break metrics as first-class engineering targets, starting with entity-resolution accuracy and calibration quality.
  • The build-on strategy—extending the existing portfolio rather than rebuilding it, and knowing precisely what to reuse and what must be net-new.

What you’ll do

  • Lead zero-to-one work at production scale: turn an ambiguous, novel problem into a reliable system other teams build on, and set the bar where no precedent exists.
  • Drive technical direction across architecture, design, and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar across the incubation.
  • Mentor senior engineers and lead by influence, not title.
  • Partner with product, security R&D, SecOps to turn customer problems into architecture, and translate that architecture into decisions leaders can act on.
  • Establish AI safety, security, governance, and guardrails for agentic systems running in production.

What you bring

  • A track record of owning architecture across a large system or multiple teams, with deep experience operating production-quality software.
  • Hands-on depth in both agentic and LLM systems and probabilistic or ML-driven scoring—graph modeling, calibration, search and optimization, or risk and probability engineering.
  • Proven zero-to-one at scale: you’ve taken an ambiguous problem to a reliable production system that others depend on.
  • The judgment to make consequential architecture decisions under uncertainty, and make them defensible to engineers and executives alike.
  • Command of distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native development, and data or graph systems.
  • Expert-level Python, and/or Java, Go, or TypeScript.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship that moves teams through influence.
  • Applied interest in security problems—attack-path analysis, vulnerability management, identity security, threat intelligence, or detection and response—is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools and coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Windsurf is a plus.
  • Experience with AI evaluation, safety, governance, or policy guardrails is a plus.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including leading the design and delivery of complex production systems.
  • Demonstrated experience as the technical owner or lead for a major system or across teams.
  • Depth building AI/ML-powered production systems; probabilistic modeling, graph analytics, or calibration and evaluation is a strong plus.
  • Modern AI experience: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, agentic harness and workflows, model evaluation, or AI observability.
  • Strong programming experience in Python and/or Java, Go, or a similar language.
  • Cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, APIs, databases, and scalable architectures.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Cybersecurity or security-product experience, or familiarity with modern security architectures and operations, is strongly preferred.

description:
Vi söker dig som vill arbetar som personlig assistent. Du måste kunna tala och förstå svenska bra, eftersom många tjänster kräver att du skall tolka den personen du arbetar för.

Just nu har vi allt från timanställningar, extrajobb på kvällar och helger och större tjänster på 30-80 % som rullar på så länge assistansuppdraget varar. Vi har sällan tjänster som bara innebär arbete enbart på dagtid på vardagar.

Vi på rekryteringsavdelningen kommer att göra ett urval bland inkomna ansökningar och matcha lämpliga kandidater med någon av de assistansberättigade i GIL som just nu söker personal.

Att arbeta som personlig assistent kan många gånger vara olikt andra arbeten. Hur det blir beror på vem du jobbar hos och vem du är. Ni väljer varandra och bygger upp en relation som känns bra för båda. För många är tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet och utbildningar ganska ointressant, utan oftast handlar det om personkemi.

Arbetsuppgifterna för en personlig assistent beror på vem man jobbar hos. Somliga behöver mycket hjälp med kroppen, andra med knoppen. Vissa festar hårt, reser lång, har många barn. Somliga pluggar, andra jobbar. Någon hänger ofta i stallet, andra gillar hockey. Någon tycker om att måla, en annan älskar prinsesstårtor. Somliga är tystlåtna, andra snacksaliga.

Om du är intresserad av att jobba som personlig assistent i GIL, så skickar du in ett personligt brev, ditt CV och svarar på videofrågorna samt urvalsfrågorna.

Tjänsterna tillsätts löpande!

GIL samordnar personlig assistans sedan 1989. För oss handlar personlig assistans om att skapa förutsättningar för att en person med funktionsnedsättning ska kunna leva det liv hen själv vill leva. I många uppdrag är den assistansberättigade själv arbetsledare, medan andra har utsett en ställföreträdande arbetsledare. Uppdrag och roller ser olika ut beroende på verksamhet och funktion.

GIL:s kontor ger stöd inom bland annat arbetsledning, administration, ekonomi, HR och utbildning. Tillsammans bidrar vi till att vardagen fungerar för både assistansberättigade och medarbetare inom kooperativet.

För att få och behålla trygga och engagerade medarbetare satsar GIL på utbildning och gemensamma aktiviteter.

• GIL:s assistenter har kollektivavtal med Fremia–Kommunal

• Friskvårdsbidrag upp till 2 500 kr/år

• Individuell lönesättning

• Utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister ska visas upp vid anställning

Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, då urval sker löpande.

Working within our Energy & Environment team, you will support a diverse portfolio of projects for clients in the municipal, forestry, oil and gas, utility, government, and broader resource sectors. title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About the team

The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning.

This is a zero-to-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like.

The role

As a Staff ML Engineer, you own a major subsystem of a novel exploitability engine end to end—for example the probability core, the exposure graph and entity-resolution layer, or the calibration and validation loop. You make the design calls within your area and drive them to production.

What you’ll own

  • A major subsystem end-to-end—the probability core, the exposure graph and entity resolution, or the calibration and validation loop—including its design, delivery, and quality.
  • The design decisions within your subsystem, and how it interfaces with the rest of the engine.
  • The metrics that prove your subsystem works—entity-resolution accuracy, calibration quality, or path-ranking precision—owned as first-class targets.
  • Technical direction for the engineers working in your area.

What you’ll do

  • Take a major, ambiguous subsystem from design through production at scale.
  • Drive design and code reviews in your area, and raise the engineering bar around you.
  • Mentor engineers and lead a workstream through influence.
  • Partner with product, security R&D, and SecOps to turn customer problems into subsystem design.
  • Establish AI safety, security, and guardrails for the agentic parts of your subsystem.

What you bring

  • A track record of owning a significant system or subsystem end-to-end in production.
  • Hands-on depth in agentic and LLM systems and/or probabilistic or ML-driven scoring—graph modeling, calibration, search and optimization.
  • Proven delivery of an ambiguous problem to a reliable production system that others depend on.
  • The judgment to make sound design decisions under uncertainty within your area.
  • Command of distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native development, and data or graph systems.
  • Expert-level Python, and/or Java, Go, or TypeScript.
  • Technical leadership that moves a workstream through influence.
  • Applied interest in security problems—attack-path analysis, vulnerability management, identity security, threat intelligence, or detection and response—is preferred.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools and coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Windsurf is a plus.
  • Experience with AI evaluation, safety, governance, or policy guardrails is a plus.
  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, including leading the design and delivery of complex production components.
  • Demonstrated experience as the technical owner or lead for a significant system or subsystem.
  • Depth building AI/ML-powered production systems; probabilistic modeling, graph analytics, or calibration and evaluation is a strong plus.
  • Modern AI experience: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, agentic workflows, model evaluation, or AI observability.
  • Strong programming experience in Python and/or Java, Go, or a similar language.
  • Cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, APIs, databases, and scalable architectures.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Cybersecurity or security-product experience, or familiarity with modern security architectures and operations, is strongly preferred.

The University of Miami, Bascom Palmer Eye Institute, has an exciting full time opportunity for a Polysomnographic Technician 3 for the Sleep Center, in Miami, Florida.

The Polysomnographic Technologist 3 administers various sleep studies to diagnose the type and extent of sleep disorders. The incumbent performs routine patient assessments, scores sleep records, documents other test results, and collects and transmits biological specimens for analysis.

  • Ensures patient safety by applying PAP at the correct pressure level and administering oxygen.

  • Scores sleep and wake stages using professionally accepted guidelines.

Department Specific Functions

Overview:

Promoting Academic Workforce Development in Translational Behavioral and Cardio-Metabolic Research (PINNACLE) is an NHLBI-funded career advancing opportunity at the University of Miami, Miller School of Medicine. It is a learning community providing intensive, didactic, and mentored research training to postdoctoral scholars, aimed at Early-Stage Investigators (ESI) and those with disabilities, interested in developing careers in cardiometabolic research. It focuses on 6 core competencies: conceptual knowledge in translational sciences, communication skills, research skill development, professionalism, leadership and management skills, and responsible conduct of research. It empowers ESI postdocs to conduct research by employing techniques at the forefront of their fields and to become innovative and creative leaders in the academic community.

The T32 Training and Mentoring program brings participants to the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at the University of Miami for a two-year postdoctoral learning experience where they will develop independent academic careers. It uses a congruent mentorship approach whereby mentors and mentees are matched based on common research interest, background, and specialty.
