title: Data Engineer (AI Agents)
description:
We would rather be straight about the difficulty than sell you a tidy version of it.
How we build
Most of our code is now written with AI assistance, including substantial autonomous work. The scarce skill on this team is no longer producing code. It is specifying work precisely enough to delegate, and verifying output rigorously enough to trust. In practice that means we ablate tests rather than admiring them: delete the guard, confirm the test goes red. A test that still passes with the code removed is worse than no test. It means a bug fix starts by proving the test fails against the unfixed code. And it means that when we do not know how a vendor behaves, we probe it and write down the number instead of reasoning about it. You do not need experience with any particular tool. You do need to be comfortable in a codebase where much of the diff was not typed by a human, and to have real opinions about how to verify it. If that is already how you work you will move fast here. If it is not, this will be a frustrating role.
Our stack
  • Transformation — dbt on PostgreSQL: staging, intermediate and marts, with contracts and tests enforced in CI
  • Warehouse — multi-tenant PostgreSQL on AWS RDS, schema per tenant
  • Extraction and loading — Python on AWS Lambda, Glue PySpark, Step Functions, EventBridge, with SAM and Terraform
  • Sources — EHR and clinical systems, accounting (QuickBooks, NetSuite), scheduling, supply chain, IoT and scanner event streams
  • AI layer — AWS Bedrock, a generated semantic catalogue, Qdrant retrieval, Python agent services
  • Engineering — GitHub with gitflow, mandatory review, CI gates, Linear, SOC 2 Type II
  • Five or more years in data engineering or analytics engineering, having owned pipelines a business depended on
  • Strong SQL and Python: production transformations, testing, debugging, performance work
  • Serious dbt experience. Multi-tenant or multi-source projects are what we most want to hear about
  • ETL and ELT against messy real sources: APIs, databases, files, cloud storage, with full and incremental loads, CDC and idempotent reruns
  • A way of working that already assumes AI assistance, and a clear account of how you verify what you did not write
  • Precision in writing. Much of your output is read by a model before a person sees it, so unambiguous descriptions of what a column means are a deliverable, not an afterthought
  • A record of finishing: edge cases, validation, documentation, deployment, production support

title: Technical Product Manager- Salesforce (Contract)
description:
Our Story
Founded in 2008, Hightower is a wealth management firm that provides investment, financial and retirement planning services to individuals, foundations and family offices, as well as 401(k) consulting and cash management services to corporations. Hightower’s capital solutions, operational support services, size and scale empower its vibrant community of independent-minded wealth advisors to grow their businesses and help their clients achieve their financial vision. Based in Chicago with advisors across the U.S., we operate as a registered investment advisor (RIA).
Your Future Team
As the Technical Product Manager for Salesforce Data Migration and Platform Integrations, you will own and continuously improve the internal capability used to migrate acquired RIAs onto the Signature Wealth platform.
This is not a traditional project management role. You will treat the migration process, tooling, requirements, and operating model as an internal product. Each acquisition should produce better requirements, stronger Jira stories, improved tools, and a more repeatable path for the next migration.
Hightower’s ability to integrate acquired RIAs efficiently is a strategic differentiator. This role will help build the operational engine that enables Hightower to repeatedly migrate firms onto Signature Wealth with greater consistency, lower risk, and better advisor outcomes.
What You’ll Do

Own the product backlog for the RIA CRM data migrations and custom build tools that support data readiness and data migration.
Gather, evaluate, and prioritize enhancement requests from business and technology stakeholders.
Define product requirements, acceptance criteria, and roadmap priorities.
Identify opportunities to improve repeatability, quality, speed, and scalability across migrations.
Partner with stakeholders to understand migration pain points, workflows, and operational needs.
Document current and future-state processes.
Translate business needs into clear, actionable technical requirements and user stories.
Refine requirements based on lessons learned from each acquisition.
Develop a strong working understanding of data extraction, ETL processes, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and migration sequencing.
Partner with technical teams to identify data risks, gaps, and process improvements.
Help define data quality standards and migration readiness criteria.
Coordinate delivery across product, engineering, data, Salesforce, and business teams.
Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, testing coordination, release readiness, and environment promotions.
Maintain clear delivery plans, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
Ensure enhancements are tested and incorporated into future migration playbooks.
Build and maintain a working understanding of Salesforce Financial Services Cloud, including its data model, objects, relationships, and advisor workflows.
Ensure migration requirements align with the target-state Salesforce platform and financial-services operating model.
Partner with Salesforce technical teams on data-model and integration considerations.
Provide practical support during migration cutovers and go-lives.
Help advisors and internal teams resolve migration-related questions.
Offer hands-on “elbow support” as new teams transition to Signature Wealth.
Occasionally assist with project delivery and management.

What You’ll Bring

A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, business analysis, data migration, platform implementation, or a related role.
Experience supporting data migration initiatives involving complex source systems and target platforms.
A strong understanding of data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and ETL concepts.
Experience writing product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and maintaining a prioritized backlog.
Experience working in Agile delivery environments using Jira or similar tools.
The ability to translate operational and business needs into clear technical requirements.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced acquisition and integration environment.
Experience with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud or Salesforce data models preferred.
Experience in wealth management, financial services, RIAs, or advisor technology preferred.
Experience with CRM migrations, platform integrations, or acquisition integrations preferred.
Familiarity with data quality, governance, and migration testing practices preferred.
The ability to understand migration concepts and technical tradeoffs without being a hands-on developer.

Success in this role means:

Each migration is easier, faster, and more reliable than the last.
Migration requirements and Jira stories become increasingly reusable and precise.
Data quality, validation, and reconciliation improve over time.
Hightower develops a scalable operating model capable of supporting more than 35 future RIA migrations.
Stakeholders view the migration capability as a continuously improving product rather than a one-time implementation effort.

In Office Monday- Thursday (Work from home on Fridays)
6 Month Contract

Immediate Supervisor: Manufacturing Supervisor
Status: Hourly Non-Exempt
Position Purpose: The Extrusion Operator operates, maintains, and controls the production equipment and process on the production floor to produce a high quality finished hand wrap or machine wrap roll in a safe and productive manner to efficiently service customer orders by performing the following duties.

Principle Accountabilities

Prepares line for shift by ensuring an ample supply of materials is on hand or is readily accessible for the efficient operation of the line
Sets up the line by operating the equipment to form the web, threading the line, and pulling the plastic film through the winders.
Adjusts the line to correct specifications by setting necessary controls and process conditions.
Monitors the line to maintain quality under continuously changing conditions by adjusting die bolts, Extrol controls, edge pinning, winder settings, and other process settings to ensure quality of film produced.
Conducts quality tests by checking film samples for proper prestretch, stretch force, cling, puncture and gauge as compared to quality specifications. Ensures that film doesn’t have any other quality deficiencies. Records results of tests and makes adjustments to process/equipment as required.
Periodically verifies rollweights against target and records those roll weights on Cast Winder Check sheet. Ensures that recipe verifications are completed at the start of each shift and after every product change.
Ensure that all product is properly packaged, correctly labeled, tagged and putaway.
Participates in the correct application of the “Hold Card” for all nonconforming product, including initial investigation of cause.
Properly operates and connects the push-pull system to railcars as assigned by pump tickets received from scheduling.
Properly move, stage, and consume all materials. Return all unused materials to the proper location.
Completes daily paperwork and line closeouts.
Lifts heavy objects by hand, pallet jack, or forklift
Maintains a clean and safe work area, machines, and equipment.
Identifies and reports deficiencies in product quality or packaging.
Operates automatic core cutter.
Operates railcar unloader.
Operates baler and denisifer as assigned.
Operates grinder and repelletizer as assigned.
Weigh, label, tag, and identify all scrap correctly and properly locate.

Essential Skills and Experience

High school or general education degree (GED)
1+ years of production experience.
Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondences, and memos.
Ability to write simple correspondence.
Ability to communicate information in one-on-one and small group situations to other employees.
Ability to perform simple addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Ability to perform these operations using units of weight, length, and time measurement.
Ability to apply commonsense understanding and experience to make decisions regarding rolls that do not meet quality standards, machine adjustments to maintain quality, machine start up and shut down.
Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.
The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

title: Audiology Assistant 3 (H)
description:

The University of Miami/UHealth Department of Otolaryngology has an exciting opportunity for a full time Audiology Assistant 3 to work in Plantation, FL. The Audiology Assistant 3 performs tasks that are prescribed, directed, and supervised by a certified and/or licensed audiologist. The Audiology Assistant 3 serves as a mentor to Audiology Assistant 1’s and 2’s, through training and professional advisement, and may delegate tasks to Audiology Assistant 1’s and 2’s as dictated by clinical needs. This position masterfully ensures clinics remain on time and can cover for all areas of Audiology Assistant responsibility as needed.

CORE JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Supports Audiologist in audiological testing and evaluation, ensuring proper fitting of hearing devices and technology.

  • Performs hearing aid orientation, including basic care and use of hearing aid (insertion, removal, adjusting volume, etc.)

  • Demonstrates care and maintenance of hearing devices to patients and support/care givers.

  • Works directly with the Practice Manager to foster the training of junior Assistants in all areas of responsibility.

  • Submits signed consents to healthcare centers to initiate retrieval of medical records, pathology slides, x-rays, and other pertinent reports.

  • Prepares treatment room for examination of each patient and provides patients with basic instruction and information regarding examination procedures.

  • Assists with examinations by preparing supplies and handing instruments and materials to the Audiologist as directed.

  • Cleans and sterilizes instruments while observing principles of sterile technique.

  • Maintains accurate and complete patient records and documentation.

  • Manages, Organizes, and stocks audiology rooms with all supplies needed by specialty daily and discards expired supplies.

  • Evaluates audiology clinic organization and cleanliness weekly, checks hand sanitizer dispensers and reports the need to have them filled and/or to request deep cleaning.

  • Assists in performing clerical duties such as answering phone calls and maintaining records. Utilizes IDX RIS/PACS to track patient arrival times and advises front desk personnel of patient delays to maintain daily schedule.

  • Greets patients upon arrival and verifies patient information.

  • Directs patient to the clinic or audiology room and ensures the patient is ready for the provider. Assists in copying completed patient paperwork, delivering originals to front desk for scanning, and distributing copies to appropriate reading rooms.

  • Assists in the distribution of patient label stickers in Audiology.

  • Performs daily biologic checks of audiological equipment and documents and reports any problems with equipment to the appropriate managing staff.

  • Reports unusual incidents in a timely manner to appropriate supervisory personnel.

  • Adheres to University and unit-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.

CORE QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

High school diploma or equivalent

Certification and Licensing:

Audiology Assistant Certification completion within the first three months of employment.

Experience:

Minimum 6 years of relevant experience

Knowledge, Skills and Attitudes:

  • Skill in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail.

  • Ability to analyze, organize and prioritize work under pressure while meeting deadlines.

  • Ability to process and handle confidential information with discretion.

  • Commitment to the University’s core values.

  • Ability to work independently and/or in a collaborative environment.

  • Ability to multitask.

#ED-LI1

UHealth-University of Miami Health System, South Florida's only university-based health system, provides leading-edge patient care powered by the ground breaking research and medical education at the Miller School of Medicine. Position Summary

Under the general direction of the Manager of By-law Enforcement and Animal Services as well as technical direction and guidance of the Municipal Law Enforcement Officer III, performs By-law Enforcement Services relating to the education, promotion, maintenance, and enforcement of Regulatory By-laws within the City, including performing all statutory and operational requirements of a Provincial Offences Officer as set out in the Provincial Offence Act and other applicable legislation.
The Municipal Law Enforcement Officer II position also performs Animal Shelter and Animal Control duties relating to operations, administration, maintenance of the City Animal Shelter.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

By-law Enforcement

Investigates infractions and confirms compliance with Municipal By-laws (including but not limited to: traffic & parking, animal control, lot maintenance, boulevard maintenance, taxi, sign, noise, waste management, site alterations, parks, sewer use, food trucks, licenses and other Municipal By-laws) in response to citizen complaints, City-Initiated blitzes, proactive enforcement protocols and application for licenses and permits.
Inspects premises, identifies, or verifies infractions, takes statements and prepares reports as required while carrying out By-law enforcement activities.
Interprets by-laws in accordance with direction and policy, determines by-law violations, advises public of contraventions verbally and/or in writing as required and attempts to resolve disputes. If necessary, serves a Provincial Offences Act (POA) Part I, II or III offence notice and initiates legal proceedings.
Prepares, issues and serves POA documentation and represents the City at relevant legal proceedings, and provides evidence as required.

By-law Enforcement

Inspects premises, identifies, or verifies infractions, takes statements and prepares reports as required while carrying out By-law enforcement activities.
Interprets by-laws in accordance with direction and policy, determines by-law violations, advises public of contraventions verbally and/or in writing as required and attempts to resolve disputes. If necessary, serves a Provincial Offences Act (POA) Part I, II or III offence notice and initiates legal proceedings.
Prepares, issues and serves POA documentation and represents the City at relevant legal proceedings, and provides evidence as required.
Coordinates clean-ups and repairs of properties and sign removal from City and private property.
Investigates animal complaints including dog bites and dangerous dogs as per the Animal Control By-law and reports and consults with other related agencies and officials as required.
Investigates noise complaints including after hours and takes necessary actions to seek compliance with the Noise Bylaw.
Patrols Municipally controlled parking lots, City streets and contracted private properties to enforce parking and non-moving traffic violations, providing education and issuing tickets as necessary. Enforces overnight parking restrictions during winter period.
Responds to reports of prohibited public land use, such as temporary shelters, and encourages compliance and provides a Notice to Vacate the area, as per the City Coordinated Collaborative response.
Conducts Vehicle For Hire inspections and issues warning/charges and removal of vehicle licences.
Conducts related assessment, title searches and certified vehicle ownership searches.
Enforces of Provincial legislation as directed (ie. Reopening of Ontario Act, Emergency Management and Civil Protection Act, etc.).
Calculates fees for additional by-law inspections in accordance with the Rates and Fee’s By-law.
Collects revenues from parking meters and parking control devices, and provides collections to the Treasury Department in a timely manner.
Maintains, installs, removes, converts, and repairs related parking enforcement equipment.

Animal Shelter

Performs day-to-day Animal Care including but not limited to: patrolling, impounding animals, contacting owners, accepting shelter intakes from the public and other contracted municipalities; logging animal intakes, collecting fees, releasing and adopting animals in accordance with the City By-law and procedures.
Maintains, cleans and operates the day-to-day duties of the shelter and related facilities per accepted policies and procedures and senior government requirements. Including the general cleaning of common areas, staff room, bathroom, kitchen, and disposal of waste.
Performs animal care services such as feeding, cleaning, bathing, grooming and monitors and evaluates the health of animals in the Animal Shelter and follows up regarding sick animals with the Animal Shelter Attendant and/or veterinarian. Provides minor health care treatments and collect urine and feces samples as required.
Evaluates housed animals to determine correct sex, breed, age, and health. Maintains a record of animals and documents all medications/procedures the animal receives and logs any additional concerns.
Administers treatment and medication as prescribed or directed by the Animal Shelter Attendant and/or veterinarian including humane euthanasia of skunks and raccoons.
Impounds, monitors, cares for, and quarantines dangerous animals, who have bitten or are suspected of rabies.
Provides environmental enrichment, socialization, and physical activity to the animals within the facility.
Routinely prepares and picks up animals for transport, shelter supplies, and donations.
Performs sick or injured wildlife pickup including but not limited to skunks and raccoons.
Provide administrative support completing daily tracking logs, reporting, record keeping, cash handling and transactions, documentation of animals, medical records, supplies and shelter activities in accordance with legislation, polices, procedures and City requirements.
Assists with fundraising and events to promote the shelter and adoptable animals.
Seasonal maintenance of outdoor areas of the Animal Shelter including grass cutting, snow removal, and salting/sanding of walkways, entrances, and exits.
Provides guidance and assistance to co-op students and volunteers and ensures their compliance with City Policy and Procedures.

Prepares and submits reports to the Supervisor and/or Manager, as required.

Provides excellent customer service when dealing with resident’s inquiries, concerns, and service requests. Provides education to member of the public regarding interpretation of by-law and provision of animal services.

Participates in training/seminars as required by the Supervisor and/or Manager.
Participates in the Master Rotation Schedule including the after-hours and on-call system.
Complies with all applicable regulations and requirements of the Occupational Health & Safety Act, The Highway Traffic Act, Federal and Provincial regulations, including Corporate, departmental, and divisional, policies, procedures, and operating plans.

title: Case Assistant
description:
PURPOSE:
The Jewish Board’s Youth and Family Division supports domestic violence survivors and their family members. Using a non-judgmental, trauma-informed approach, staff guide the residents to create and meet personalized recovery goals, to stabilize their families, to develop independent living skills, and to plan effectively to be able to live in a healthy and secure manner. Our work is guided by principles that emphasize the critical importance of safe and stable housing, utilize a culturally competent and anti-racist lens, and respect the dignity and legitimacy of each individual’s journey.
POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Case Assistant is the introductory level of direct care staff working within the Jewish Board’s supported housing programs to help residents live in the community as independently as possible
KEY ESSENTIONAL FUNCTIONS include but not limited to:

Supports the clinical and case associate staff in their work with residential clients, and provides services to those clients within the scope of program regulations and agency mission.
Sets- up vacant apartments for new families admitted to the program
Completes apartment inspections to ensure that all safety and sanitary conditions are maintained.
Completes intake phone screenings (with training and supervision)
Provides Orientation/Intake for new residents.
Develops, and may run activity sessions
Accompanies clients on trips and outings and supervises activities
May be called upon to work one on one with a client who is displaying significant stress
Ensures that the residents understand the rules and regulations of the facility in which they are housed.
Monitors and ensures that security is maintained within the facility.
Conducts hourly rounds of the facility and document all activity in the Communication logbook.
Participates in regular staff meetings and trainings.
May be asked to travel to off-site meetings and trainings.
Completes regular and timely documentation of all client interactions, including informational notes; files incident reports as appropriate.
Shares their experience and observation of the clients under their care with the treatment team and immediately brings to the attention of the supervisor any unusual issues.
Other duties as assigned.

CORE COMPETENCIES for the position include:

Excellent client engagement skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Attention to detail
Ability to work independently as well as with a team
Ability to travel to visit clients in apartments or to escort clients.
Valid driver’s license and willingness to drive agency van preferred.

EDUCATIONAL / TRAINING REQUIRED:

HS degree/HSE Required
One year of experience in a community mental health or human services setting preferred

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS NEEDED

Willingness to work with a traumatized population, many with experiences of homelessness and substance use.
Compassion and respect for vulnerable individuals.
Patience and understanding for the sometimes slow process of stabilization and recovery.

COMPUTER SKILLS REQUIRED

Familiarity with working in Windows environment
Ability and willingness to learn new systems and application software

If you join us, you’ll have these great benefits:

Generous paid time off in addition to paid agency holidays and 15 sick days
Affordable and high-quality medical/dental/vision plans
Tuition assistance and educational loan forgiveness
Free continuing education opportunities
403(b) retirement benefits and a pension
Flexible spending accounts for health and transportation
27/7 Accessible Employee Assistance Program
Life and disability insurance

Who we are:
The Jewish Board delivers innovative, high-quality, and compassionate mental health and social services to over 45,000 New Yorkers each year. We are unique in serving everyone from infants and their families to children, teens, and adults. We are proud to employ and serve people of all religions, races, cultural backgrounds, gender expressions, and sexual orientations. We are committed to building diverse, equitable, and inclusive teams to help support our mission, and we strongly encourage candidates from historically marginalized backgrounds to apply to work with us.

title: Cisco UC Engineer
description:
We are recruiting for an experienced Cisco UC Engineer to join an established managed services team supporting several key customers.

This is a remote, home-based role with occasional travel to customer sites. You will provide senior-level support and deliver projects across Cisco Unified Communications and collaboration environments, including CUCM, Webex, voice routing and contact centre technologies.

If you are an experienced Cisco collaboration engineer who enjoys resolving complex voice issues, working directly with customers and delivering Cisco UC projects, this could be the role for you.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide senior-level support across a range of Cisco UC and collaboration environments
  • Manage incidents, service requests and problems in line with customer SLAs
  • Act as an escalation point for complex and high-priority Cisco voice incidents
  • Troubleshoot issues across CUCM, Webex, Unity, Expressway, CUBE and associated technologies
  • Diagnose complex telephony problems, including call routing, SIP signalling and one-way or no-way audio
  • Complete root cause analysis and clearly document technical resolutions
  • Support the integration of UC platforms with authentication and identity services
  • Deliver and support Cisco collaboration projects
  • Work closely with customers, Cisco and third-party suppliers
  • Coordinate with customer network and technical teams
  • Mentor junior members of the technical team
  • Participate in a 1-in-4 on-call rota
  • Provide occasional onsite support when required

Essential experience

  • Previous experience in a Cisco UC, Voice or Collaboration Engineer position
  • Experience supporting managed services or working within an MSP or service provider environment
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM)
  • Good knowledge of Cisco Unity Connection, IM and Presence, Expressway and CUBE
  • Experience with Webex Calling or other Cisco Webex collaboration services
  • A strong understanding of SIP, RTP, dial plans and voice routing
  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex telephony and call-quality issues
  • A good understanding of networking fundamentals and telephony-related network configuration
  • Experience delivering or supporting Cisco UC projects
  • Strong customer-facing, communication and documentation skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote position
  • Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel occasionally

Desirable experience

  • Cisco Unified Contact Center Express (UCCX)
  • Webex Contact Center
  • Cisco Unified Attendant Console
  • Cisco UCS, VMware or ESXi
  • Cisco ISDN and analogue voice gateways
  • Call recording or call-logging platforms such as Eleveo or TIM
  • ITIL-based service management environments
  • Current or previous CCNP Collaboration certification

title: Planning Senior Technical Lead
description:
Welcome to Verdantas, where innovation meets sustainability, and your career finds purpose!

At Verdantas, we’re redefining environmental consulting and sustainable engineering through our use of cutting-edge modeling and digital technology and our genuine commitment to people. Our work spans high-growth sectors like water resources, resilient land use, energy transformation, and civil infrastructure.

Our commitment to excellence, across more than 90 offices, is championed by a team of over 2,000 experts, scientists, engineers, geologists, and technical specialists, embedded in a people-focused culture, prioritizing the well-being of our employees, clients, and the communities we serve. We partner with clients to deliver smart, data-driven solutions to complex environmental and infrastructure challenges. We don’t just solve problems; we help shape a more sustainable future.

Join a people-first culture that values your well-being, empowers your growth, and amplifies your impact. At Verdantas, your career goes beyond the expected, and your work helps build a better world.

Ready to shape the future of resilient communities?

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Lead to join our Planning & Advisory Services practice, which delivers high-impact land use planning, long-range policy development, environmental review, and community advisory services to public agencies and regional stakeholders nationwide.

The Senior Technical Lead, Planning is Verdantas' most senior planning authority, a nationally recognized expert who shapes the strategic direction of the planning practice, leads the firm's most complex and consequential planning engagements, and serves as a trusted advisor to public officials, regional stakeholders, and planning bodies.

Building on the Technical Lead foundation of leading major planning contracts, long-range initiatives, and complex policy development, the Senior Technical Lead operates with the broadest scope of influence, driving firmwide planning strategy, cultivating landmark client relationships, and setting the standard for technical excellence and professional development across the practice.

What You'll Do:

Technical Delivery

  • Establish technical direction, methodologies, and best practices for the planning practice
  • Lead major planning contracts, long-range planning initiatives, and complex policy development projects with regional or national impact
  • Review and approve high-complexity deliverables, including:
    • Comprehensive and master plans
    • Environmental Impact Statements (EIS/EIR)
    • Complex entitlement applications and packages
    • Policy and regulatory documents
  • Ensure technical quality, consistency, and methodological rigor across all planning projects
  • Provide expert testimony in regulatory, legislative, and legal proceedings
  • Direct multidisciplinary project teams in collaboration with Engineering, Environmental, Transportation, Natural Resources, and Grants/Funding specialists

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to public planning officials, government agencies, and regional stakeholders
  • Represent Verdantas at industry conferences, professional associations, public forums, and regulatory proceedings
  • Lead strategic planning pursuits and cultivate long-term relationships with key clients and agency partners
  • Strengthen Verdantas' visibility, reputation, and influence within the planning profession

Regulatory Compliance & Documentation

  • Provide expert interpretation of planning laws, zoning ordinances, land use regulations, and development codes
  • Advise project teams, clients, and leadership on regulatory requirements and compliance strategies
  • Monitor emerging regulatory, legislative, and policy trends affecting planning and development
  • Identify and communicate potential risks, opportunities, and strategic implications for clients and the firm

Business Development

  • Lead pursuit strategy and proposal development for major planning and advisory opportunities
  • Develop and maintain executive-level relationships with public agencies, municipalities, and regional stakeholders
  • Drive growth through service line expansion, innovation, and emerging planning practice areas
  • Establish thought leadership through industry engagement, publications, presentations, and professional participation
  • Contribute to strategic planning efforts that differentiate Verdantas in competitive markets

People & Team Development

  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level planners across the practice
  • Establish and maintain technical standards, guidance, and quality expectations for planning services
  • Support employee career development, including AICP certification and professional advancement
  • Participate in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and succession planning initiatives
  • Design and deliver firm-wide training programs that reflect industry best practices and evolving planning trends
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous learning across the planning team

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Urban Planning, Public Administration, Urban Design, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
  • AICP certification required; national recognition in the planning field strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience providing expert testimony and leading complex, multi-jurisdictional planning engagements
  • Comprehensive Planning
  • Policy Research and Analysis
  • Built Environment Planning
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Regulatory Stakeholder Management
  • Business Development

At Verdantas, we offer comprehensive benefits packages for our employees. Actual salary is based on the circumstances of each position and candidate, such as geographic location, skills, and certifications. We recognize and reward exceptional performance and strive to ensure fair compensation across all roles and departments within the company. The salary range for this position is $140,000 - $160,000 (negotiable based on the criteria presented above).

title: Aquatic Program 173012
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living and social responsibility. Develops, organizes and implements high quality, member and community-focused YMCA aquatic programs.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Directs and supervises program activities to meet the needs of the community and fulfill YMCA objectives and goals. Establishes new program activities and expands programs within the community in accordance with strategic and operating plans. Develops and maintains collaborative relationships with community organizations. Recruits, hires, trains, develops, schedules, and directs personnel and volunteers as needed. Reviews and evaluates staff performance. Develops strategies to motivate staff and achieve goals. Ensures records of staff certifications are current and complete. Conducts regular/ frequent sanitation of all equipment (rescue and member used), and assigned areas as outlined by YMCA Leadership.  Monitors daily pool operations to adhere to all state, local, and federal, and YMCA health and safety regulations. Ensures aquatic safety best practices are in place throughout the branch and that a culture of aquatic safety is developed by conducting safety drills that involves multiple departments and assures team adhesiveness in an emergency. This also ensures that all staff members are aware of protocols when responding to an emergency in the facility. Conducts and ensures proper maintenance of pool(s).  Secures and schedules pool facilities.  Maintains accurate records of pool chemical levels and facility maintenance. Conducts/Assures lifeguarding, swim instruction, First Aid and CPR trainings are delivered.  Creates and schedules YMCA aquatics programs (such as swim lessons, water fitness classes, and swim team practices and meets). Assists in the marketing and distribution of program information. Develops and monitors safety, swim team and program budgets to meet fiscal objectives. Assists in YMCA fund raising activities and special events. Models relationship-building skills (including Listen First) in all interactions. Responds to all member and community inquiries and complaints in timely manner. Assists with Program Committee meetings Compiles program statistics. Monitors and evaluates the effectiveness of and participation in program.  Serve as a Cause Driven Leader on Duty (CDLOD).  Performs other duties as assigned.
QUALIFICATIONS:Education Associates Degree preferred.  In lieu of Associates Degree, High School diploma, GED, or equivalent certificate of competency and2-3 years of the related work experience.Experience:  Minimum of three (3) years of related experience required Three (3) years supervisor and/or leadership experience preferred, ex. head Lifeguard, aquatics coordinator or supervisor
Certification(s) and Requirements: Certified Pool Operator required. Preferred before hire, or must be obtained within 90 days of employment. Red Cross Lifeguarding Certification required Lifeguard and Water Safety Instructor Certification preferred CPR and First Aid certification and Safety training required within 30 days of hire

All employees are required to follow the child abuse and neglect reporting process: completion of Suspected Child Abuse/Neglect reporting form, calling children protective services (696-Kids) and notifying your immediate supervisor, branch executive, risk management and human resources department (s).

title: Director, Engineering
description:
Standex Electronics designs custom-engineered solutions across sensing, switching, and power magnetics for high-reliability applications. Organized around three strategic platforms – EDGE, DETECT, & GRID - we design and manufacture technologies that enable precision sensing and measurement, efficient power conversion, and advanced electronic performance. Our solutions support the global acceleration of electrification, expand energy infrastructure, and power next-generation technologies across critical markets. We drive growth through new product development, deeper engagement with customers’ engineering, geographic expansion, and targeted acquisitions.

Our Standex EDGE team is looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Endurance Design Team in the development and launch of Power Magnetics products. You will have responsibility and oversight of engineers and technical solutions as well as engineering processes and programs that interoperate across our multisite business unit. You will manage the coordination and overall integration of technical activities from concept to launch, working cross-functionally with various departments and stakeholders to drive a concurrent engineering methodology to address customer needs and business objectives.

What You’ll Own

Develop and Execute on the engineering department goals and objectives that align to the EDGE Policy Deployment process.
Lead, coach, and manage a multidisciplinary product development team that includes Mechanical and Electrical Design Engineering, Product Engineering, and Document Control.
Drive the EVT phase (Engineering Validation Test) of the NPI process to deliver prototype samples, in addition to supporting the Project Management team’s activities in the DVT/PVT phase to production launch.
Responsible for the functional department Tools, Systems, and Processes that enable the workflows and support to meet employee, project, and compliance needs.

What You’ll Do

Provide technical leadership across power magnetics programs, guiding requirements, design decisions, risk assessment, and overall engineering execution.
Partner with customers, commercial teams, and technical stakeholders to assess feasibility, shape proposals, and translate needs into practical solutions.
Lead the development of new products and sustainment of existing designs, ensuring solutions meet customer, quality, cost, and manufacturability requirements.
Contribute to business and engineering strategic planning processes, including influencing technology roadmaps, innovation priorities, and new product development.
Build and continuously improve engineering standards, processes, and best practices across the organization and multiple sites.
Apply lean methods, RCCA, A3 problem solving, and Kaizen to improve engineering effectiveness and organizational performance.
Define and use meaningful KPIs to make performance visible, identify gaps, and drive improvement.
Set clear goals and expectations, provide timely feedback, and lead performance management and development planning.
Navigate conflicts and tradeoffs with a focus on the best outcome for the customer, business, and team.
Plan and manage engineering staffing, resources, schedules, and priorities to support current programs and future growth.
Drive disciplined program execution and structured problem solving for complex technical and cross-functional challenges.
Stay connected to relevant technologies, suppliers, customers, and industry developments through external engagement as needed.
Foster the Standex behaviors and values: Integrity, Accountability, Teamwork, Innovation, & Empathy

What We Value

At least five (5) years of senior engineering management experience in a design and manufacturing environment.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Physics); Advanced degree a plus.
Ability to work in an ITAR/CUI environment (i.e. a U.S. Person, or ability to obtain an export license for ITAR/CUI).
Knowledge of related electronics component design architectures, such as transformer/inductor, power electronics, and power magnetics is a plus.

Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.
Change agent that can scale processes to maximize impact
Experience leading projects of varying size, scope, and complexity.

Strong communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
Experience applying lean methodologies

Job Description:

About Innovative Medicine

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at

We are searching for the best talent for an Experienced Automation and Robotics Engineer to be located in Spring House, PA.

Purpose: The Experienced Automation and Robotics Engineer provides hands-on engineering depth for integrated workcells. The role connects instruments, robots, sensors, transfer mechanisms, guarding, utilities, and basic control interfaces so scientific workflows can run reliably in automated form.

The Engineer will design, configure, test, troubleshoot, and improve the physical automation and robotics components of integrated discovery workcells. This role complements laboratory automation scientists by owning physical feasibility, robot motion, equipment integrations, controls handshakes, safety behavior, serviceability, layout constraints, and technical vendor follow-up for assigned systems.

At this level the engineer begins to own defined physical integration packages, rather than simply supporting assigned tasks. The role contributes to interface definitions, FAT/SAT execution, safety and serviceability reviews, and remediation of physical, mechanical, and controls-related failure modes.

You will be responsible for:

Physical System Design and Integration

  • Contributing to the design and deployment of robotic workcells, transfer stations, labware nests, custom fixtures, grippers, guards, sensors, actuators, label/barcode presentation points, and automated peripherals.

  • Supporting robot reach studies, equipment layouts, service envelope reviews, deck access assessments, operator intervention points, and physical interface testing between instruments and workcells.

  • Supporting integration between orchestration software, device drivers, robot controllers, PLCs or safety controllers, sensors, instrument PCs, and IT/OT infrastructure.

  • Authoring or contributing to URS, FDS, SDS review comments, interface control notes, FMEA inputs, FAT/SAT protocols, safety test scripts, commissioning records, and punch-list documentation.

Troubleshooting, Reliability, and Recovery

  • Troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, robotic, control, sensor, barcode, utility, and device communication issues in collaboration with laboratory automation scientists, vendors, IT/OT, and operations.

  • Supporting root cause analysis for equipment faults, transfer failures, safety trips, barcode or sensor issues, lost labware position, service access problems, and physical workflow interruptions.

  • Recommending and implementing improvements that increase reliability, maintainability, serviceability, physical workflow robustness, and recovery from machine-side exceptions.

  • Supporting development of practical recovery instructions for physical jams, robot faults, device alarms, and safe re-start after operator or maintenance intervention.

Simulation, Safety, and Vendor Support

  • Contributing to layout, throughput, traffic, robot path, and service access simulation to identify bottlenecks, facility constraints, and unsafe or impractical physical designs before installation.

  • Supporting vendor FAT/SAT activities for physical, control, safety, and recovery behavior, not only nominal workflow execution.

  • Working with Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to clarify assumptions, interfaces, installation readiness, utility needs, access constraints, and remediation actions.

  • Collaborating with EHS, facilities, laboratory operations, and lab automation scientists to ensure safety, biosafety, waste handling, serviceability, and contamination-control expectations are reflected in system design.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support technology evaluations, proof-of-concept studies, design reviews, and vendor demonstrations for future automation and robotics capabilities.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, interface templates, safety review practices, maintenance guidelines, and technical playbooks.

  • Support audit, inspection, or quality documentation requests where automated systems intersect with regulated or quality driven workflows.

  • Participate in lessons learned and continuous improvement activities to improve future automation delivery.

Qualifications/Requirements

Education:

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, Robotics, Mechatronic, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is required. An advanced degree is preferred.

Experience and Skills:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years, Master’s degree with 2+ years, or a PhD with 1+ years of relevant automation, robotics, controls, or equipment integration experience.

  • Demonstrated understanding of robotics, automation, electromechanical systems, controls hardware, sensors, actuators, and instrumentation appropriate to the level of the role.

  • Ability to work with laboratory automation scientists to translate scientific workflow constraints into safe, maintainable, and physically executable machinery, interfaces, and workcell layouts.

  • Working knowledge of technical documentation, drawings, equipment lists, interface notes, FAT/SAT/UAT records, FMEA inputs, punch lists, and change summaries.

  • Strong troubleshooting discipline across mechanical, electrical, robotic, control, safety, communication, and instrument interface issues.

  • Awareness of EHS, biosafety, contamination control, service access, guard/interlock concepts, and operational readiness expectations in a research laboratory or regulated environment.

  • Ability to contribute independently to physical interface design, integration testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and vendor follow-up.

Preferred:

  • Experience with PLCs, robot controllers, AMRs, cobots, machine vision, industrial networks, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, safety PLCs, or device drivers.

  • Experience with simulation, CAD, digital twin, throughput modeling, robot path modeling, or layout planning tools.

  • Experience supporting outsourced technical projects and vendor deliverables such as URS, FDS, SDS, FAT, SAT, FMEA, risk assessments, and punch-list closure.

Other:

  • Travel may be required for vendor assessments, FAT/SAT activities, site visits, system builds, workshops, training, technology scouting, or cross-site deployment support.

Why Join Us

This role supports the transition from isolated automation projects to integrated, reliable, AI-native, and ultimately self-driving discovery laboratory systems. The work helps connect scientific intent with robust physical execution, reproducible data, model feedback, and scalable operational capability.

description:

Primal Pet Foods is a leading manufacturer of fully prepared, human-grade raw foods, treats, and supplements for dogs and cats. Founded on the belief that pets deserve the same high-quality nutrition as their owners, we are committed to enhancing the health, happiness, and overall well-being of pets through wholesome, raw diets that closely mimic what animals thrive on in the wild.

Job Summary
The Batching Operator is responsible for precisely measuring, weighing, and blending ingredients in accordance with established formulas to produce high-quality pet food batches. This role ensures the safe, efficient handling of raw materials while maintaining consistency, product integrity, and adherence to production targets. The position requires a high level of attention to detail, strict compliance with safety and quality standards, and effective collaboration with production, quality assurance, and maintenance teams to support overall operational excellence.
Responsibilities and Duties
  • Accurately measure, weigh, and prepare ingredients in accordance with batch formulas and production schedules.

  • Maintain accurate records of batch details, ingredient usage, and production data in line with company requirements.
  • Ensure the batching area remains clean and organized, adhering to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and food safety regulations.
  • Monitor and adjust mixing parameters to maintain product consistency and meet quality specifications.
  • Communicate promptly with supervisors regarding material shortages, equipment malfunctions, or production variances.
  • Support equipment changeovers, cleaning, and basic maintenance activities as required.
  • Follow all safety protocols, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and lockout/tagout procedures.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and participate in cross-training to support team and operational goals.
Qualifications and Skills
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous experience in food, feed, or pet food manufacturing is considered an asset.
  • Basic math and computer skills, with the ability to accurately operate scales and batching systems.
  • Working knowledge of food safety, quality control, and sanitation standards (e.g., GMP, HACCP).
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform work in a physically demanding environment.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a collaborative team-oriented mindset.
  • Flexibility to work various shifts, including weekends and overtime, based on production needs.
Physical Requirements & Work Environment
  • Regularly required to stand and walk; use hands and arms to handle materials and equipment

  • Working with laboratory automation scientists to understand how physical equipment behavior affects scientific workflow execution, sample identity, labware integrity, timing, and data generation.

Preferred:

Har du erfaring med fx Cubic, Tabula eller lignende – eller lysten til at lære det?

Så er det måske dig – eller jer – vi søger som to nye serviceteknikere til vores team på Sjælland.

Din hverdag hos os

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens.

Du kommer til at arbejde med:

  • Fejlfinding, ombygning og udvidelse af eltavler
  • Service- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver hos vores kunder

Du får frihed under ansvar – og kører direkte fra din bopæl i din egen servicebil, med støtte fra vores service- og salgskontor i Albertslund samt produktionen i Holsted.

Hvad kan du forvente?

Hos os får du mere end bare et job:

  • En hverdag med variation og ansvar
  • Et af branchens stærkeste serviceteams
  • Tæt samarbejde og faglig sparring med +25 specialister i Service
  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder
  • Attraktive vilkår inkl. firmabil og sundhedsforsikring
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er faglært elektriker, industrielektriker, automatikmekaniker eller lignende
  • Har erfaring med fejlfinding og serviceopgaver
  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Er serviceminded og løsningsorienteret
  • Er fleksibel, stabil og trives med kundekontakt
  • Bor på Sjælland og har kørekort

Hvorfor vælge Pro-Automatic?

Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor vi investerer i vores medarbejdere og udvikler fremtidens løsninger inden for eltavler.

Du bliver ambassadør for vores værdier:

Kunden i centrum – Tillidsfuldt samarbejde – Passion for innovation

Klar til at blive en del af holdet?

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, så kontakt gerne vores serviceleder Mathias Wortmann.

Hvis du er klar, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt – vi holder løbende samtaler.

Mød Pro-Automatics servicetekniker Jens Christensen

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Do you want to play a key role in Adnami’s growth journey? Now is the time, because we are looking for someone to take ownership of the Snowflake platform the business runs its decisions on.

Adnami is a Danish-born fast-paced scale-up within the AdTech industry. We launched in 2019 and today we are a trusted go-to solution for media agencies, publishers, and blue-chip advertisers when they buy digital High Impact Advertising.

About the role

We have completed our migration to Snowflake, and this role is about making more of it. You will own the platform end to end: the data models and dbt project that define them, the pipelines that feed them, and the Power BI reports the whole company works from.

You would sit inside our Suite development team and work in their day-to-day rhythm, joining their cycles and their planning instead of taking requests from the outside. Data questions rarely arrive neatly packaged, and being in the room when the work is shaped is most of what makes the answers useful.

There is also new ground. People across the business are starting to build their own AI-assisted reporting apps and look after them themselves. Your job is to make that work: trustworthy data underneath, sensible guardrails, and colleagues who know what they are doing. Done well, the whole company gets faster at answering its own questions, and you spend your time on the problems only you can solve.

It is a broad, visible role with touch points right across the company. You are the person the business comes to with a question it cannot answer yet, and you decide whether the answer is a new model, a new report, or a better pipeline.

This is not a remote role. You would be based in our Copenhagen office, where the team you work with sits.

Responsibilities

  • Own and develop our Snowflake platform: data models, transformations, and the dbt project that defines them.

  • Build and maintain the pipelines and stored procedures that keep data flowing reliably.

  • Provide the modelled, trustworthy data layer that reports and self-service apps are both built on.

  • Enable self-service and keep it honest: help colleagues build their own AI-assisted reporting apps well, set the standards and guardrails, and step in when something needs doing properly.

  • Work as part of the Suite development team: join their cycles, understand what is being built, and make sure the data side is thought through early.

  • Partner with Finance and Sales, who rely on us for the numbers they run on. These are among our most important internal relationships.

  • Take machine learning work from experiment into production.

  • Work with the business to turn open questions into analyses, then into reports people actually use.

  • Bring insight back unprompted, not only when you are asked.

Your profile

  • 3-5 years in a data or BI role. This is not a graduate position.

  • Strong SQL and solid data modelling fundamentals.

  • Python for data work.

  • Comfortable writing and maintaining stored procedures.

  • Ready to pick up our stack quickly, and curious by nature. You want to know why the numbers look the way they do, not only how to produce them.

  • Some exposure to machine learning or AI applied to business data.

  • Able to hold your own with senior stakeholders, including on financial numbers. You can discuss what the data means, not only how it was built.

  • Able to translate a vague business need into a concrete analysis.

  • Confident with large datasets.

  • Happy enabling other people instead of being the sole author. This role involves teaching, setting standards, and making other people’s work possible.

  • Comfortable working inside a development team. You will be in the day-to-day flow with engineers.

  • An MSc in a quantitative field (computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or similar).

It’s a plus if you have

  • Worked in Snowflake already.

  • Dbt, ideally a project you have owned.

  • Power BI, including DAX and Power Query.

  • Put machine learning models into production, beyond the notebook stage.

  • Set up data governance or quality standards for self-service BI.

  • Experience with data API integrations.

  • Worked with finance or commercial data.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and pension.

  • Paid phone and internet subscription.

  • Your birthday off.

  • Referral programme.

  • A flexible working environment where results are what matter.

  • A dynamic workplace.

  • A lovely office in Copenhagen.

About Adnami

Adnami is a well-funded, fast-growing Danish-born technology company with a unique product and proven product-market fit. We give publishers a smooth, scalable way to deliver high impact advertising for their advertisers. We set a new standard for high impact advertising in the Nordic markets in record time, and we are now expanding rapidly into new markets.

We are an equal opportunity employer and support workforce diversity. Our aim is to ensure our workforce is diverse and inclusive, and we promote these values throughout our organisation. We employ, retain, promote, and otherwise treat all employees and job applications according to their merit, qualifications, competence, and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, or disability.

Job Description:

Johnson & Johnson is hiring for a Field Clinical Specialist for Shockwave Medical Inc. located in Palo Alto.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments. Ready to join a team that’s pioneering the development and commercialization of Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) to treat complex calcified cardiovascular disease. Our Shockwave Medical portfolio aims to establish a new standard of care for medical device treatment of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease through its differentiated and proprietary local delivery of sonic pressure waves for the treatment of calcified plaque.

Position Overview

The Field Clinical Specialist is a visible position that will provide case support to physicians within certain territories. Case support will be done on peripheral and coronary interventional procedures in the pre-market and post-market phases of product development with the Shockwave Medical Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) ® technology. The Field Clinical Specialist will also play a critical role in clinical studies including device training, case support and ensuring timely data collection for clinical programs. Case support may be required to support other territories at certain times.

Essential Job Functions

  • Physician and hospital staff training, and procedural case coverage to ensure the safe and effective use of medical devices.

  • Effectively meet the needs of internal and external customers with a sense of urgency and drive.

  • Present clinical study training materials based on investigational plans to support the safe and effective use of medical devices, inclining study protocol, instructions for use, core lab manuals and case report forms.

  • Manage key study investigators; foster and maintain strong relationships through direct interactions with medical advisors and clinical leaders.

  • Partner with other clinical research colleagues to meet business needs in the field including site re-training, data collection for timely database locks and resolution of critical issues.

  • Administrative activities including training to procedures, manage territory travel and budgets.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in business, science, nursing or related fields, or equivalent experience.

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience directly supporting interventional or surgical procedures within a hospital setting OR, 1 year of industry, hospital-based life sciences, sales support experience. Cardiovascular industry experience preferred but not required.

  • Working knowledge of clinical research, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and regulatory compliance guidelines for clinical trials.

  • A history of effective collaboration with regulatory agencies through clinical studies and market releases.

  • Product knowledge including product vigilance and medical device reporting.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Computer skills (MS Office products, word processing, spreadsheets, etc.).

  • Finance and budgeting knowledge.

  • Good prioritization and organizational skills.

  • Excellent critical thinking skills.

  • Excellent influencing and negotiation skills.

  • High energy and results-oriented individual who is mature and successful in a business environment and is skilled in motivating and inspiring people.

  • Entrepreneurial “hands-on” experience. Pro-active and “can do” attitude.

  • Ability to consider and accept feedback and suggestions for continuous improvement.

  • Works effectively on cross-functional teams. Demonstrated willingness to make decisions and to take responsibility for such.

  • Effective written, verbal and presentation skills with all levels of customers and management.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities

  • Operate as a team and/or independently while demonstrating flexibility to changing requirements.

  • There may be continuous sitting for prolonged periods (more than 2 consecutive hours in an 8 hour day)

  • Significant travel >50% of time requiring the employee to be effective in a remote manner.

  • Employee may be required to lift objects up to 40lbs or more. Employees will be required to work in an air conditioned office space and possibly perform some tasks in our non-temperature controlled warehouse space.

title: Aluminum Lay Up & Press Operator CG2
description:
With our strong investment in research and development and our culture of continuous improvement, Hexcel is the industry leader in the manufacturing of advanced lightweight composite materials, including carbon fiber, woven reinforcements, resins, prepregs, honeycombs and engineered core and composite structures. We invite you to join the Hexcel team at various manufacturing sites, sales offices, and R&D centers around the globe. Become a part of the “strength within.”

Hexcel is currently seeking an Aluminum Lay Up & Press Operator for our Casa Grande, AZ, USA location.

Start rate: $25.75 Per Hour during the New Hire Orientation Period – normally 90 calendar days, then increases to $28.13 Per Hour. This position is on Grave shift (11:00PM to 7:00AM, Monday – Friday + O/T as required) and pays a $1.75 per hour shift premium. Note that the workday on Grave shift is designated by the day the shift ends.

The selected individual will be responsible for but not limited to the following obligations:

  • Processes printed aluminum foil into sheets. Stacks sheets into proper sequence to produce a completed laid up aluminum honeycomb HOBE block.
  • Processes aluminum HOBE blocks into bonded aluminum HOBE by controlling the processing of blocks through the high-pressure steam-heated presses.
  • Sets up LUM machine and press to process material in accordance with specifications.
  • Operates LUM and press by controlling the quality of material by making adjustments.
  • Runs tests for the lay up process and press process and maintains records of materials used, rejects, and acceptable materials processed.
  • Conducts or requests in-process checks as required.

Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or general education degree (GED) or equivalent.
  • Minimum of one year experience required preferably in manufacturing. Minimum of 6 months manufacturing experience in the Hexcel Casa Grande facility may substitute in lieu of one year experience.
  • Must be proficient in use of tape measure and ruler.
  • Basic working knowledge of computer data entry function required.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Must be able to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

Eligible candidate must be a: U.S. citizen, U.S. national, person lawfully admitted for permanent residence, temporary resident under sections 210(a) or 245(A) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, person admitted in refugee status, or person granted asylum. Hexcel (NYSE: HXL) is a global leader in advanced composites technology, a leading producer of carbon fiber, and the world leader in honeycomb manufacturing for the commercial aerospace industry.

Hexcel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected class.

title: Inventory / Transition Data Analyst – Telecommunications Service Support Team
description:
We are a growing information technology company that offers its employees a culture of success, the chance to work on revolutionary federal IT infrastructure, and the opportunity to grow alongside cutting-edge technology that is reshaping the industry. We are seeking forward thinking candidates that have strong experience in operational support and can help take to the next level in a pro-active stance.

Chameleon Integrated Services has expertise in operations management, quality systems, data operations and cybersecurity. We secure some of the most sensitive data for the Department of Defense and for other U. S. federal government agencies. We are known for the great care we take with clients and employees, and we believe in promoting from within.

We offer a Full Benefits package including:
  • Competitive Employee Health Insurance options including dental
  • 100% company paid vision plan
  • 401K plan with generous company match and no vesting period
  • 100% company paid Life insurance
  • 100% company paid long and short-term disability insurance
  • Training allowance
  • PTO and more
Inventory / Transition Data Analyst – Telecommunications Service Support Team (TSST)
Work Location – Remote, (DISA treats remote network access as an alternative work site flexibility rather than a contractual guarantee, allowing work at assigned or other designated locations).
Scott Air Force Base, Illinois proximity is highly preferred.

Security Clearance – U.S. Citizenship Required; Must possess an active or interim Tier 1 (T1) National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) eligibility at the time of performance start.

Experience – 2+ Years of IT experience, with targeted expertise in data analysis, database maintenance, or spreadsheet-based inventory reconciliation.

Pay Range – $28.00 - $32.50 per hour (W-2)

Length – 1-year base interval, with up to 4 optional years (November 6, 2026 – November 5, 2031).

Requirement – A signed Letter of Intent (LOI) must be executed before candidate submission to the Government.

Objective Summary
We are seeking multiple enterprise Inventory / Transition Data Analysts to support the core production database and asset tracking workflows for the Chameleon Telecommunications Services Support Team (TSST) in support of the DITCO Transition Program Management Office (PMO). This critical position holds direct accountability for executing high-volume technical data validation and inventory research tasks across 551,000 global service records. The ideal candidate must possess an extensive professional chronology demonstrating 2+ years of IT experience. This timeline should showcase strong capability across data parsing, records verification, multi-source spreadsheet comparison, anomaly tracking, and the generation of structured status reports within highly secured federal parameters.
This expert will ensure the master transition database remains fully current, tracking lines by agency name, service configuration, and scheduled cutover timelines to prevent data fragmentation during massive contract-to-contract migrations.

Mandatory Compliance Metrics
Candidates must satisfy these strict gates to ensure a successful Government onboarding determination:
  • Resume must explicitly reflect a Bachelor's degree in Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/scientific discipline alongside 2+ years of total IT experience.
  • Must possess a verified, active or interim Tier 1 (T1/NACI) adjudication visible within DISS at contract start.
  • Must be fully available to execute data analysis tasks and support team timelines between 8:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. Central Standard Time (CST), Monday through Friday.
  • Must sign a formal Letter of Intent (LOI) authorizing submission of their credentials for this specific DISA/DITCO contract opportunity at the designated target rate.
Principal Responsibilities
  • Perform high-volume tactical inventory research, data entry, and records validation tasks to support complete contract transition visibility.
  • Research and compare complex telecommunications service records across Government databases, GSA vendor portals, and multi-carrier billing spreadsheets.
  • Identify, document, and cross-reference discrepancies in quantities, usage metrics, billed amounts, and line features to maintain a clean master dataset.
  • Update and maintain massive tracking spreadsheets and database fields, ensuring customer and vendor point of contact (POC) emails, phone numbers, and site addresses remain perfectly accurate.
  • Extract data and structure recurring daily, weekly, and cumulative status reports organized dynamically by agency name for program leadership.
  • Log Outside-Generated Reports (including Status of Action Messages and In-Effect Reports) directly into internal tracking registries.
  • Track the live progression of sites under review, identifying which locations have pending orders written, which are being validated, and which have completed cutovers.
  • Support the Lead Data Specialist in executing systematic updates to the master tracking baseline to eliminate data variance.
Core Data & Technical Domain Capabilities
  • Strong quantitative data analysis background with proven experience maintaining large, complex data registries or inventory baselines.
  • Advanced operational proficiency with Microsoft Excel, utilizing lookups, formatting macros, and pivot tables to isolate errors across multiple data sources.
  • Familiarity or direct exposure to processing telecommunications billing records, circuit manifests, or carrier service logs is highly preferred but not mandatory if reconciliation skills are strong.
  • Capability to learn and navigate federal provisioning and data applications; DISA/DITCO will provide system training for StoreFront and related government-centric applications.
Governance, Clearance & Government Infrastructure
  • Comprehensive discipline in protecting sensitive government data assets, unclassified Controlled Technical Information (CTI), and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) in compliance with DoDI 5200.48.
  • Direct experience operating within a structured, compliance-driven framework, maintaining detailed change tracking logs for audit readiness.
  • Strict compliance with defense personnel vetting rules, ensuring all database activities conform with Continuous Evaluation criteria within the Defense Information System for Security (DISS).
Preferred Domain Expertise
  • Direct incumbent experience supporting the DISA/DITCO Telecommunications Service Support Team (TSST).
  • Prior exposure to or familiarity with federal inventory management tools such as GSA E-Morris, TIBI, TBI, TCOSS, DISA StoreFront, or WWOLS.
  • Basic understanding of terminology tied to large-scale federal telecom transitions (such as moving from legacy NETWORX or WITS 3 vehicles to the new GSA EIS contract).

title: TRR hourly Amusement technician
description:
