title: Enforcement Operations Lead, Cloud Partners
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic's Safeguards team is responsible for enforcing our policies, protecting users, and ensuring our platform is not misused. A large and growing share of Claude usage reaches customers through our cloud partners: Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. As the Enforcement Operations Lead for Multi-Cloud, you'll own how Anthropic detects, reviews, and acts on misuse across those surfaces, where the partner owns the customer relationship and often the data path. You'll build the operating model, partner agreements, and documentation that make enforcement on every cloud consistent, auditable, and fast.

This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of coordinating across teams and companies to break new ground and drive work to completion. This work is deeply cross-functional. You'll partner closely with our product managers, policy experts, Safeguards engineering, Legal, and the trust & safety and operations teams across our Cloud partners to maintain a consistent and safe enforcement ecosystem.

Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the end to end enforcement lifecycle on partner surfaces, from detection and review through action, customer communication, and appeal

  • Define enforcement paths for each partner's operating model, including how actions are requested, executed, and confirmed when the partner controls the account

  • Manage SLAs for review, escalation, and action, and evaluate performance against them on an ongoing basis

  • Develop and maintain SOPs and escalation guides for all enforcement workflows, ensuring consistency across clouds

  • Establish red-teaming, Quality processes, and operationalize shared metrics

  • Stand up paired investigations with partner threat intelligence teams, including case referrals, indicator sharing, and paging for high severity incidents

  • Own enforcement metrics across partner surfaces and report them to Safeguards leadership, partners, and regulators

Minimum qualifications

  • Extensive experience in trust and safety operations, enforcement, threat intelligence, or a related field

  • Have managed external partner or vendor relationships where you did not control the other side's systems or priorities

  • Comfortable working across policy, legal, engineering, and operations teams to translate requirements into practical workflows

  • Experience building enforcement programs from the ground up, including SLAs, escalation paths, and quality measurement

  • Highly organized, with a track record of maintaining rigorous documentation and SOPs in fast-moving environments

  • Clear and precise communication, both in writing and verbally, across technical and non-technical audiences, including partner executives

  • Energized by the challenge of building scalable systems in an environment where not everything is already figured out

  • Care deeply about the responsible deployment of AI and the role enforcement operations plays in that mission

Preferred qualifications

  • Direct trust & safety, abuse, or security operations experience at AWS, GCP, or Azure, or at a company that ships through their marketplaces

  • Experience designing incident response or escalation processes that span more than one company

  • Familiarity with data access controls, audit requirements, or privacy constrained review environments

  • Experience with law enforcement referrals, regulatory reporting, or compliance programs

  • Background in AI safety, content moderation, fraud, or abuse detection systems

  • Comfort working with data and metrics to inform operational decisions and surface trends to leadership

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$285,000—$330,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Head of Corporate Development
description:
Mission

TAR’s mission is to power intelligence for the world. We are building the world’s first off-grid power plant for data centers powered by renewable technologies.

We firmly believe AI should be built in the US for the benefit of all people. For that, power must be fast, clean and scalable. We are singularly focused on delivering GW-scale power faster than anyone has ever done, by rethinking every layer of the stack.

We vertically integrate to solve every bottleneck, from racking systems to power electronics to dispatch algorithms to on-site construction.

Leave your mark on the future of civilization-scale energy infrastructure.

Company

TAR is both a hardware and software company, we are building out massive, critical, physical infrastructure. TAR is working directly with one of the largest compute providers to scale and deploy 5GWs by 2028.

We operate on…

  • High ownership. High Agency. Own project end-to-end. Great people don’t need to be managed.

  • Speed. We achieve great things on incredible timelines. We push ourselves to go faster.

  • First principles. No ego. No hierarchy. Challenge every assumption.

  • Passion. Solving the energy problem is one of the largest challenges that faces the world now and in the future.

About the role

TAR develops, builds, owns, and operates fully islanded solar and storage campuses that deliver firm power to AI data centers, and every campus becomes real through a chain of transactions: land, offtake, equipment, and capital. As Head of Corporate Development, you own the capital and commercial transactions that get each campus financed, contracted, and built. You raise project equity and debt, negotiate offtake with customers, structure joint ventures and M&A, and form the entities that hold the assets, working directly with the founders. This is a head-of-function seat for a proven dealmaker: you run the first transactions yourself and build the function as the platform scales. The role is based in Austin, San Francisco, or New York, with travel to counterparties and the West Texas site as deals require.

Responsibilities

  • Own project equity raises for campus SPVs: build the materials and the model, then run the investor process from first outreach through term sheets, diligence, documentation, and close.

  • Lead debt execution across construction and project-level facilities, federal credit programs, and investment tax credit (ITC) monetization, driving lenders and counsel from term sheet to close.

  • Structure and close project financing for gas generation assets alongside the solar and storage campuses.

  • Support the CEO on corporate equity raises, owning the model, materials, data room, and investor diligence.

  • Lead power purchase agreement (PPA) negotiation and structuring with data center customers, balancing price, tenor, and credit support against financeability.

  • Structure and negotiate joint ventures and partnerships with independent power producers (IPPs) and engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firms, from first conversation through definitive agreements.

  • Source, evaluate, and execute M&A across developers, land portfolios, and technology, owning valuation, diligence, negotiation, and integration.

  • Drive land acquisition and deal structuring for new campuses, forming the SPVs, offtaker vehicles, and project companies with counsel and tax advisors so every asset stays financing-ready.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in corporate development, investment banking, infrastructure private equity, or project finance, with significant experience in power or energy infrastructure.

  • Track record as the accountable deal owner on complex transactions taken from first conversation through close: capital raises, offtake agreements, joint ventures, or M&A.

  • Deep command of project finance structures: SPVs, non-recourse debt, tax credit monetization, and how commercial terms drive debt sizing and underwriting.

  • Experience negotiating long-tenor commercial agreements directly with counterparties and their counsel, PPAs or comparable offtake in particular.

  • Strong modeling capability: you build, audit, and defend the valuation and project finance models behind your own deals.

  • Proven ability to run multiple live transactions in parallel, directing external counsel and advisors on aggressive timelines.

  • Excellent written communication: investment memos, term sheets, and board materials that are precise and decision-ready.

Nice to have

  • Experience financing or contracting islanded, behind-the-meter, or single-offtaker assets outside the standard utility PPA mold.

  • Data center or digital infrastructure transactions on the offtake, capital, or M&A side.

  • Transaction experience spanning both renewables and gas-fired generation.

  • Familiarity with federal credit programs and government-backed financing for energy or critical infrastructure.

  • Existing relationships with the investors, lenders, IPPs, and data center operators active in US power, ERCOT in particular.

Salary and Benefits

  • Up to $15K relocation bonus

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • $1K monthly stipend for meals

Job Description:

Responsible for ensuring operations of the Restaurant and Beverage areas currently assigned. Responsible for Restaurant Team Members and Beverage Service Team Members performances are in accordance with Company Policy and Procedures and Gaming regulations, on an assigned shift.

High School diploma or GED required. One to two years restaurant or bar supervisory experience preferred.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills required. Appropriate Licenser. Knowledge of local jurisdiction gaming laws (federal, state, compact, etc.) and attendant regulations as well as company internal controls, policies and procedures.

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instruction, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or Team Members of organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:
Ability to work with mathematical concepts. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

REASONING ABILITY:
Ability to define problems, collects data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

title: Timelønnede guider til Mønsted Kalkgruber
description:
Vi søger:

Timelønnede guider til Mønsted Kalkgruber

Er du serviceminded, historisk interesseret og en dygtig formidler? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som timelønnet guide i Mønsted Kalkgruber!

Om Mønsted Kalkgruber

Mønsted Kalkgruber er verdens største kalkgrube og en eneståenttdlde attraktion i hjertet af Jylland. De kilometerlange minegange rummer en fascinerende historie, smuk natur og en unik undergrundsverden, der også er hjemsted for tusindvis af flagermus. Hvert år besøger gæster fra hele verden gruberne, og vi brænder for at give dem en uforglemmelig oplevelse.

Om jobbet

Som guide bliver du en vigtig del af vores gæsters besøg. Stillingen er et supplerende job, som eventuelt kan kombineres med opgaver i billetsalg og information. Timetallet varierer hen over sæsonen 1. april–31. oktober, og vi forestiller os derfor, at du enten er studerende, efterlønner/pensionist eller har andet arbejde ved siden af.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har godt humør og fremstår smilende, imødekommende og lydhør – både over for gæster og kolleger.
  • Har lyst til at formidle historie, natur og flagermus.
  • Kan møde vores gæster i øjenhøjde og skabe en god oplevelse.
  • Taler og forstår dansk samt kan føre en samtale på mindst ét fremmedsprog.
  • Trives i en arbejdsdag med meget menneskekontakt.
  • Er fleksibel og kan arbejde i weekender, på helligdage og i ferieperioder. Du indgår i en vagtplan, hvor du har indflydelse på din arbejdstid.

Vi tilbyder

  • Kolleger i alderen 15–73 år, der brænder for at give gæsterne en mindeværdig oplevelse.
  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring.
  • En unik arbejdsplads i enestående omgivelser.
  • God løn og flere personalegoder.

Interesseret?

Send en kort ansøgning med billede samt en beskrivelse af dig selv, din baggrund og din tidligere joberfaring til direktør Tina de Linde på tdl@monsted-kalkgruber.dk.

title: Staff AI Engineer - Agent Architecture & Behavior
description:
Artisan · Full-time · In person in San Francisco

Base salary: $250,000–$325,000 USD annually. Equity: 0.15%–0.30%. US visa sponsorship available.

Build something new at the frontier of applied AI

At Artisan, we're working on a new, ambitious project that will push the boundaries of what agentic AI can do. We're keeping the product details private ahead of launch, but we can tell you this: the technical problems are substantial, the scope for invention is real, and this hire will shape the core technology.

We're looking for a hands-on technical lead to design and build the underlying AI architecture. You'll work across agent behavior, complex multi-agent systems, tool use, context, and evaluation, taking promising ideas through to dependable production software.

This is an individual-contributor role with broad technical ownership. You'll make consequential architecture decisions, write the hardest parts of the system, and work closely with our existing engineers and leadership. You should enjoy both exploring an uncertain problem and doing the detailed engineering required to make a solution work.

What you'll own

  • Agent architecture and behavior. Design and implement agent execution loops, planning strategies, tool interfaces, and verification. Turn ambiguous technical requirements into clear system boundaries and working code.

  • Multi-agent systems. Build delegation, coordination, context sharing, and result synthesis. Handle concurrent work, conflicting updates, cancellation, and stale results. Establish when a multi-agent approach improves on a simpler baseline.

  • Reliable execution. Make complex, stateful workflows resilient to interruptions and partial failures. Build checkpoints, recovery strategies, and appropriate human intervention into the architecture.

  • Context, memory, and reusable methods. Improve retrieval, context construction, persistent state, and skill representation. Investigate how systems can use feedback and prior experience to perform better without introducing regressions.

  • Evaluation and experimentation. Build realistic evaluations, analyze task trajectories, and turn observed failures into measurable improvements. Compare approaches using quality, reliability, latency, and cost.

  • Model and tooling decisions. Evaluate models and emerging techniques, prototype promising approaches, and make informed build-versus-buy decisions. Choose tools because they solve the problem, and be willing to replace them when the evidence changes.

  • Technical leadership. Set engineering standards, review important design decisions, and help the team implement a coherent AI system. Stay close to the product and accountable for what ships.

You'll partner with product and infrastructure engineers on production services, integrations, secure execution, and observability. You'll own the AI architecture and its effectiveness, with implementation shared across the team.

What we're looking for

  • You have personally built and shipped a substantial agentic system. Production use or rigorous, reproducible open-source work matters more than the name of a framework or employer.

  • You have deep practical experience with LLM tool use, planning, context engineering, and evaluations. You have implemented multi-agent coordination or substantial parallel agent/tool execution and can explain its failure modes.

  • You have hands-on experience with browser or computer automation in an agentic system, including observing state, verifying effects, and recovering when an interface or execution path fails.

  • You are an excellent software engineer in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language. You are comfortable with asynchronous services, state machines, persistence, concurrency, retries, and cancellation.

  • You know which decisions belong to a model and which guarantees must be enforced in code. You can reason carefully about permissions, untrusted inputs, uncertain external outcomes, and human approvals.

  • You can design meaningful experiments, debug real system behavior, and explain what improved, why it improved, and where the evidence is still weak.

  • You can take technical ownership of an unclear problem, work effectively with other engineers, and ship with urgency and care.

Useful additional experience

Depth in agent memory and retrieval, skill acquisition, reinforcement learning or post-training, trajectory datasets, sandboxed execution, distributed systems, inference optimization, or multimodal and voice models would be valuable. We expect strong foundations and particular depth in a few areas, rather than prior specialization in every one.

There is no required degree, publication record, previous employer, or agent framework. We're hiring for demonstrated engineering ability, judgment, and ownership.

How we work

This role is based in our San Francisco office. Expect a small team, short feedback cycles, direct communication, and high standards. We value people who move quickly, take responsibility for the result, surface problems early, and change their minds when the evidence calls for it.

You'll have substantial freedom to explore ambitious technical ideas and the responsibility to turn the best ones into software that works. We'll discuss the project in more detail during the interview process.

Interview process

Our conversations will center on systems you've built, a practical agent architecture and debugging exercise, and how you work with a team.

When applying, tell us about one agentic system you personally owned: what you built, the hardest failure you fixed, and how you measured the improvement. A project link, technical write-up, or open-source contribution is welcome. You can discuss confidential work without sharing proprietary material.

The base salary range is $250,000–$325,000 USD annually, plus equity. The final offer will reflect relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and the scope of responsibility.

About Artisan

Artisan builds AI employees that take on real work. Our first three are Ava, our outbound AI BDR; Aaron, our inbound AI SDR; and Aria, our AI account executive. Our broader mission is to build AI employees that can take responsibility for work across many roles and industries.

title: GIS Analyst
description:
A GIS Analyst at Purple Land Management must possess a thorough understanding of the ESRI ArcGIS Suite and be able to use that knowledge to generate and organize GIS Data. The GIS Analyst must be able to analyze and review title documents, including oil and gas leases, real property deeds, easements, rights-of-way, and other instruments and determine where they are situated and whether or not they impact a client’s real property. A GIS Analyst must also be able to establish leasehold boundaries against changing surveys, water lines, vegetation, and historical maps, and compare the boundaries against historical production data to determine whether a parcel of real property is validly leased by a producing oil or gas well (determine HBP status).

Responsibilities

  • Support land services projects as assigned by the Senior GIS Analyst by developing and implementing GIS solutions, building maps, comparing historical mapping and survey data against present day tax parcel identification numbers, deed plotting leasehold, and determining HBP status of oil and gas producing properties
  • Build, organize, maintain and manage all of PLM’s client and organizational databases including confidential data
  • Assist District Landmen and Project Managers with the preparation of updates and presentation of data from title research and lease acquisitions
  • Review title documents including real property legal descriptions to assess real property boundaries
  • Build complex KMZ file or equivalent to provide satellite imagery based work product that allows a client to properly navigate a leasehold or acreage position
  • Bachelor’s Degree in GIS is strongly preferred
  • Two years or more experience using GIS in an oil and gas context preferred
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Excel, and cloud computing generally
  • Highest proficiency in ArcGIS required
  • Self-starter and self-motivated with strong organizational and reasoning skills
  • IT experience or proficiency working with computer hardware and software maintenance (preferred)

Managed by Oakmont Management Group, we provide exceptional quality, comfort, and care with five-star services and amenities. Residents enjoy a rewarding lifestyle with individualized comprehensive support that promotes continuing independence. We deliver meaningful lifestyles and relationships with residents, families, and team members by developing a winning culture and living these values: Authenticity * Teamwork * Compassion * Commitment * Resilience.

With communities across California, Colorado, Hawaii, and Nevada, opportunities for career growth, relocation, and travel are significant. In addition, eligible team members may enjoy the following benefits:

  • 401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match
  • Recognition Programs
  • Student Loan Refinancing
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Emergency Financial Assistance

The Medication Nurse is responsible for supervising and assisting in the administration of medications to residents as ordered by the attending physician, under the direction of the attending physician, and in accordance with established nursing standards, policies, procedures, and practices of the company. The Medication Nurse provides complete supervision of the medications room and/or cart, maintains a current account of all medications residents are taking, and completes all documentation required of the company’s Medication policy.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform nursing duties as directed and in accordance with the appropriate scope of the Nurse Practice Act, including administering medications and performing treatments as ordered by a physician. The Medication Nurse is responsible for administering injections, suppositories, enemas, and medications associated with wound care in addition to medications usually assigned to a Medication Technician.
  • Perform nursing duties associated with the Wellness Nurse role as assigned.
  • Coordinate medication services with the resident, pharmacy, and physician.
  • Order and track all medication changes, refills, and deliveries with pharmacies.
  • Prepare medication for distribution to residents as per company policy.
  • Assist residents with taking their prescribed medications.
  • Observe and verify that medication is ingested or applied as directed. Document any instance where prescribed medication is not administered, including reason(s) for refusal, and notify the supervisor.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential resident medication and care records according to company policy. Ensure all medication documentation is current and correct, including medication administration forms, physician’s orders, and dosage changes.
  • Keep medicine rooms and carts orderly, clean, and appropriately stocked. Maintain an inventory of all department supplies and re-order as needed.
  • Control medication room/cart access at all times.
  • Monitor Psychotropic medication use is congruent with physician’s orders and ensures resident behaviors warrant the use of medication.
  • Participate in and complete narcotic count at the beginning and end of each shift. Report any and all discrepancies to the supervisor immediately.
  • Communicate with physicians, family members, and vendors, as needed.
  • Understand the meaning and usage of common medical abbreviations, symbols, and terms relative to the administration of medications as used by the company, pharmacists, and physicians.

Qualifications:

  • Must be a Licensed Vocational Nurse or Registered Nurse holding a valid California nursing license in good standing
  • Prefer one (1) year of experience assisting with medications at a Residential Care Facility for the Elderly (RCFE)
  • Knowledge of and/or ability to learn the theory and practice of assisted living and dementia care
  • Able to work with seniors and patiently interact with cognitively impaired individuals
  • Able to be flexible, adapt and respond to change, make decisions in stressful situations, and prioritize tasks and projects.
  • Able to process information and apply common sense understanding to follow and carry out written or oral instructions.
  • Able to analyze, solve and respond to problems or concerns.
  • Able to count and perform moderately complex math problems
  • Must pass a Criminal Background check and Health Screening tests, including physical and TB Tests.
  • For the health and safety of our team members and residents, Oakmont Management Group may require team members to vaccinate, participate in daily screening, surveillance testing, and to wear face coverings and other personal protective equipment (PPE) to prevent the spread of the COVID-19 or other communicable diseases, per regulatory guidelines.

Oakmont Management Group, based in Irvine, California, is a recognized leader in the senior living industry that manages a portfolio of communities under the Oakmont Senior Living and Ivy Living brands. OMG serves thousands of seniors across communities in California, Nevada, and Hawaii. At OMG, we strive to create an atmosphere of family and community among team members, residents, and resident family members. We know that caring and meaningful relationships are the foundation of a rewarding life, and our team is hand-selected for their skills, previous experience, and passion for working with the elderly. Our practice is to incorporate joy and laughter alongside our expectations of excellence. Walk into our communities and feel our pride of ownership and commitment to service.

title: Remote Benefits Representative | Work From Home
description:
Remote Benefits Representative | Work From Home

AO | Globe Life — 100% Work From Home | Entry Level | Customer Service & Benefits | No Experience Required

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Work From Home
Location: U.S. Residents Only
Schedule: Flexible
Experience: Entry Level Welcome | No Insurance Experience Required
Compensation: Commission-Based | Weekly Pay + Performance Bonuses
Training: Comprehensive Training, Licensing Guidance & Mentorship Provided

Start Your Career From Home

Looking for a legitimate work-from-home career where you can help people, develop valuable professional skills, and create opportunities for long-term income and advancement?

AO | Globe Life is expanding our virtual team and seeking motivated, dependable, and people-focused professionals to join us.

You'll work directly with individuals and families through virtual appointments, helping them understand available benefits, answering questions, assisting with enrollment, and providing continued client service.

This position combines customer service, client relationship management, benefits education, and consultative insurance sales in a fully remote environment.

No experience? No problem.

We provide the training, mentorship, licensing guidance, and ongoing professional development needed to help motivated individuals get started.

✓ 100% Remote / Work From Home
✓ Entry Level — No Insurance Experience Required
✓ Qualified Client Opportunities Provided
✓ No Traditional Cold Calling
✓ No Lead Purchasing Required
✓ Weekly Commission-Based Pay
✓ Performance Bonuses
✓ Flexible Scheduling
✓ Renewal & Residual Income Opportunities
✓ Leadership & Management Career Path

What You'll Do

As a Remote Client Success Specialist, you'll support clients from their initial consultation through enrollment and ongoing service.

🤝 Customer Service & Client Support

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Meet with prospective and existing clients through scheduled Zoom and phone appointments

  • Connect with individuals and families interested in learning about available benefits

  • Listen carefully to client questions, needs, and financial protection priorities

  • Provide friendly, professional, and personalized customer service

  • Answer questions regarding available benefits and coverage options

  • Build relationships through consistent communication and follow-up

  • Assist existing clients with applicable policy reviews and updates

  • Help with beneficiary-related service requests

  • Provide continued support after enrollment

  • Maintain accurate digital client records and documentation

  • Manage appointments and follow-up activities

  • Deliver a positive client experience from beginning to end

🛡️ Benefits Education & Enrollment

Once appropriately licensed, you'll also:

  • Conduct virtual benefit consultations

  • Explain available life, accident, and supplemental health insurance options

  • Help clients understand coverage features and available choices

  • Identify solutions based on individual and family needs

  • Answer questions clearly without unnecessary industry jargon

  • Recommend appropriate benefit solutions

  • Assist eligible clients through applications and enrollment

  • Complete required documentation accurately

  • Provide ongoing service after coverage is established

Our approach emphasizes education, relationships, and helping clients make informed decisions rather than high-pressure sales tactics.

📞 Qualified Client Opportunities – No Traditional Cold Calling

Spend more time helping families and less time searching for prospects.

Representatives have access to qualified client opportunities, including individuals and families interested in receiving information about available benefits.

No lead purchasing is required.

Your focus is on:

Connect → Understand Needs → Educate → Recommend → Enroll → Provide Ongoing Service

💰 Weekly Commission-Based Pay + Performance Bonuses

This is an important distinction:

This is a commission-based independent contractor opportunity—not a guaranteed hourly or salaried CSR position.

Compensation opportunities may include:

  • Weekly commission payments

  • Performance-based bonuses

  • Uncapped personal production potential

  • Renewal income

  • Long-term residual income opportunities

  • Leadership compensation as you advance

  • Performance recognition and incentives

Because compensation is performance-based, your earning potential is influenced by your activity, consistency, production, client service, and results.

Individual earnings vary and are not guaranteed.

🏠 100% Remote / Work From Home

Build your career without the daily commute or traditional office environment.

Your virtual workday may include:

  • Zoom client consultations

  • Phone appointments

  • Digital applications

  • Online enrollment systems

  • Virtual training

  • One-on-one coaching

  • Team meetings

  • Professional-development workshops

  • Client follow-up and service

You'll remain connected to your clients, mentors, and team while working from your own professional home workspace.

⏰ Flexible Scheduling

Remote work provides flexibility, but successful representatives understand that flexibility works best with consistency and accountability.

You'll have the opportunity to organize your schedule around your personal and professional responsibilities while maintaining the activity necessary to:

  • Serve clients

  • Attend training

  • Complete appointments

  • Follow up consistently

  • Develop professionally

  • Reach personal performance goals

This can be an excellent opportunity for self-motivated individuals who prefer autonomy and performance-based growth over a traditional office environment.

📚 No Experience Required – Comprehensive Training Provided

New to insurance? That's okay.

Previous insurance experience is not required to apply.

Our training and professional-development program may include:

  • Structured virtual onboarding

  • State insurance licensing guidance

  • Product and benefits education

  • Customer-service development

  • Client relationship management

  • Consultative sales techniques

  • Virtual presentation skills

  • Application and enrollment procedures

  • Digital business systems

  • Weekly coaching and workshops

  • One-on-one mentorship

  • Professional development

  • Leadership training

We value communication skills, professionalism, work ethic, coachability, dependability, and motivation just as much as previous industry experience.

🎓 Licensing

You do not need to already hold an insurance license to apply.

Because this position involves discussing and enrolling clients in insurance products, representatives must obtain the appropriate state Life & Health Insurance License before conducting licensed insurance activities.

Licensing guidance and support are provided throughout the process.

❤️ Benefits & Professional Support

Eligible and qualifying representatives may have access to:

  • Medical insurance reimbursement opportunities

  • Company-supported life insurance

  • Accidental Death Benefit coverage

  • Renewal and residual income opportunities

  • OPEIU Local 277 representation where applicable

  • Professional coaching and mentorship

  • Leadership-development programs

  • Virtual business technology and tools

  • Professional recognition programs

Eligibility, qualification periods, and applicable requirements may apply.

✈️ Performance Incentives & Recognition

Strong performance may also create opportunities to qualify for:

  • Company-sponsored incentive travel

  • Leadership conventions and conferences

  • Professional-development events

  • Performance bonuses

  • Achievement awards

  • Team recognition

  • Additional performance-based incentives

  • Leadership experiences and advancement opportunities

📈 Build More Than an Entry-Level Career

This opportunity doesn't have to end with customer service.

Representatives who demonstrate strong performance, consistency, professionalism, and leadership potential may pursue opportunities such as:

Client Success Specialist → Benefits Representative → Trainer/Mentor → Team Leader → Management → Advanced Leadership

Advancement is based on performance, initiative, professional development, and demonstrated leadership ability—not simply seniority.

Who We're Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you're:

  • Friendly and comfortable communicating with people

  • Customer-focused and service-oriented

  • An effective verbal and written communicator

  • A strong listener and problem solver

  • Professional on phone and video calls

  • Positive, dependable, and consistent

  • Self-motivated and personally accountable

  • Organized with strong time-management skills

  • Comfortable learning new technology

  • Able to work independently from home

  • Comfortable collaborating with a virtual team

  • Adaptable and willing to learn

  • Coachable and receptive to feedback

  • Goal-oriented and motivated by performance

  • Genuinely interested in helping individuals and families

Your Experience May Transfer Better Than You Think

Previous experience in any of the following can be valuable:

  • Customer Service

  • Client Services

  • Member Services

  • Call Centers

  • Administrative Support

  • Healthcare

  • Hospitality

  • Retail

  • Education

  • Banking

  • Financial Services

  • Account Management

  • Recruiting

  • Military Service

  • Insurance

  • Sales

No previous insurance experience is required.

Entry-level applicants, recent graduates, veterans, experienced customer-service professionals, and career changers are encouraged to apply.

Minimum Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age

  • Be physically located within the United States

  • Be legally authorized to work in the United States

  • Have access to a reliable computer or laptop

  • Maintain reliable high-speed internet

  • Have webcam and microphone capability

  • Maintain a quiet, professional home workspace

  • Be comfortable using Zoom and web-based technology

  • Be comfortable communicating with clients by phone and video

  • Be willing to complete required training

  • Be willing and able to obtain the appropriate state Life & Health Insurance License

💻 100% Virtual Interview Process

Our hiring process is completed virtually.

Qualified applicants will first receive a brief career overview covering:

  • Position responsibilities

  • Customer-service expectations

  • Commission-based compensation

  • Insurance licensing requirements

  • Training and mentorship

  • Client opportunity system

  • Career growth and leadership advancement

Candidates interested in continuing will then have the opportunity to participate in a live Zoom interview with our hiring team.

This process is designed to give candidates a clear understanding of the opportunity before deciding whether it is the right career fit.

Ready to Start Your Fully Remote Career?

If you're looking for a 100% work-from-home opportunity where you can help families, build valuable customer-service and relationship-management skills, receive comprehensive training, and create long-term earning and advancement opportunities based on your performance, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today to be considered for our CSR Fully Remote / Remote Client Success Specialist opportunity with AO | Globe Life.

Work From Home. Support Clients. Help Families. Develop Your Skills. Build Your Future. 🚀

Important Information About This Opportunity

This is a 100% remote, independent contractor opportunity with American Income Life / Globe Life. Compensation is commission-based and performance-driven; this is not an hourly or salaried position.

Candidates selected to move forward should be prepared to:

• Be at least 18 years of age and legally eligible to work in the United States
• Provide their own computer/laptop, webcam, reliable high-speed internet, and professional remote workspace
• Complete required training and participate in virtual meetings
• Obtain the appropriate state Life & Health Insurance License before conducting licensed insurance activities
• Complete applicable pre-licensing coursework, examinations, and state licensing requirements at the candidate’s expense

No prior insurance experience is required. Training, mentorship, licensing guidance, and ongoing professional development are provided.

This opportunity is best suited for individuals who are self-motivated, coachable, comfortable working independently, and interested in a performance-based career with opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

American Income Life / Globe Life is committed to providing equal opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Specific licensing requirements, fees, compensation, and contractor terms may vary by state and will be reviewed with candidates during the hiring and onboarding process.

title: Program Manager
description:
ASRC Federal is seeking an accomplished Program Manager to lead a complex, mission-critical technology program and serve as a trusted partner to our customer. This is a high-visibility leadership opportunity for an experienced technology executive who thrives in complex environments, builds high-performing teams, and is energized by delivering meaningful mission outcomes.

This position is contingent upon contract award.

Work location: Onsite (customer site in Pasadena, CA)

Responsibilities

Provide strategic leadership and overall program direction across technical, operational, contractual, financial, security, staffing, and service-delivery activities.
Serve as the primary customer and executive point of contact, building strong relationships and ensuring program priorities remain aligned with mission objectives.
Lead and inspire an integrated, multidisciplinary team of technical, operational, and business professionals.
Drive delivery of secure, resilient, high-quality technology services that meet or exceed customer expectations.
Establish priorities, align resources, and make timely decisions to keep the program focused on mission success and measurable outcomes.
Lead modernization and continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to enhance performance, efficiency, resiliency, and customer value.
Anticipate and proactively manage program risks, challenges, and dependencies, ensuring issues are addressed before they impact mission or service continuity.
Coordinate effectively across internal teams, customers, subcontractors, and strategic partners to resolve complex issues and maintain seamless service delivery.
Monitor and drive performance across key areas, including service levels, customer satisfaction, cost, quality, security, and operational excellence.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Provide executive-level communication on program performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic priorities.

Requirements

15+ years of progressively responsible experience in IT program management or a related technology leadership role.
7+ years of experience leading programs of significant scale, complexity, and mission criticality.
Demonstrated success leading large, multidisciplinary teams and managing complex customer and stakeholder relationships.
Experience delivering mission-critical technology services, modernization initiatives, and operational transformation.
Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, senior leaders, technical teams, and partners.
Proven ability to navigate complex environments, solve problems, manage risk, and drive results.
Strong understanding of program governance, performance management, financial oversight, and service delivery.
Successful completion of a government issued background investigation.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, engineering, management, or a related field.

title: Principal Scientist / Engineer / Geologist
description:
We are SLR Consulting (Americas), a 1500+ team of advisory, environmental, engineering, and regulatory professionals across Canada, the United States, and LATAM. We deliver environmental and sustainability services to our clients through the integration of over 30 advisory, technical environmental, and engineering disciplines to help clients address some of their most complex challenges around sustainability. We are Making Sustainability Happen.

Role

SLR is seeking a Principal Geologist, Scientist, or Engineer, to join our growing Land Quality & Remediation practice in either our Anchorage or Fairbanks office.

It is an opportunity to help shape the future of our Alaska operations, mentor the next generation of professionals, strengthen client relationships, and contribute to the continued growth of one of the industry's leading sustainability consultancies.

We are looking for a leader who enjoys building strong teams, developing trusted client partnerships, mentoring staff, and collaborating across disciplines to deliver outstanding results. The successful candidate will bring technical expertise, business insight, and a passion for helping the company and staff succeed.

Responsibilities:

Practice Growth & Client Development

  • Grow and expand a portfolio of work through both existing SLR relationships and your own professional network

  • Build lasting client relationships founded on trust, responsiveness, and technical excellence

  • Lead proposal development, project scoping, and pricing strategies

  • Identify new opportunities, markets, and service offerings

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as Principal-in-Charge or senior technical lead on complex environmental projects

  • Provide strategic oversight for investigation, remediation, and regulatory programs

  • Guide and review technical deliverables, including work plans, investigation reports, feasibility studies, risk assessments, and remediation designs

  • Leverage expertise from across SLR's global network to develop innovative, practical solutions for clients

  • Promote a culture of technical quality, continuous improvement, and professional excellence

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a talented, and collaborative team

  • Support professional development and career growth for staff at all levels

  • Help attract, recruit, and retain top talent

Business & Operations

  • Operate in a seller-doer capacity with flexibility based on your strengths and interests

  • Manage project budgets, schedules, resources, and overall performance

  • Contribute to strategic planning and practice development

  • Support operational excellence and delivery of high-quality client service

Working @ SLR

With us, there is no doubt you’ll grow your subject-matter expertise and industry knowledge. We care about investing in our employees for the long-run, and if you ask our team, they’ll tell you that’s just one of the many benefits of working here. We want to be a place where you can experience career growth and satisfaction for many years.

Here’s what else you’ll enjoy as part of our team:

  • Competitive total compensation package including comprehensive benefits, vacation, and a suite of wellness initiatives

  • The salary range for this position is $130,000-170,000. Final agreed upon compensation will be commensurate with individual education, professional designation, experience, internal parity, and location.

  • Full-time, permanent role with opportunities for professional growth and advancement

Qualifications:

  • 10 to 15+ years of experience in environmental consulting, including project, client, and staff leadership. Alaska work preferred.

  • Strong technical background in environmental investigation and remediation involving soil, groundwater, vapor, and sediment and associated waste management.

  • Strong working knowledge of CERCLA, TSCA and RCRA and Alaska-specific environmental regulations, and familiarity with Alaska's regulatory environment.

  • Demonstrated success building and maintaining client relationships.

  • Experience leading or supporting business development efforts, proposals, and client engagements.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and enthusiasm for growing a practice

  • Passion for mentoring and developing others

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Hydrogeology, Geology, Environmental or Civil Engineering, or related field.

  • Alaska Civil or Environmental Professional Engineer license, Registered or Certified Geologist

  • Hazardous waste management experience is a plus, particularly in industrial, environmental, or regulatory settings.

  • OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Certification

  • Existing relationships within industrial, real estate, energy, municipal, or redevelopment sectors

  • Experience in Arctic, sub-Arctic, or remote operating environments

  • Experience preparing Storm Water Pollution Plans and Spill Prevention, Control and Countermeasure Plans

  • Experience working in highly collaborative, multidisciplinary teams

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

Artificial intelligence is not being used to screen, assess, or select applicants.

SLR strives to build diverse teams that reflect the communities we work in, and encourages applications from traditionally underrepresented groups including women, visible minorities, Indigenous peoples, people identifying as 2SLGBTQI+, veterans, and people with disabilities.

title: OmniaBio: Manufacturing Associate I (12-month Contract)
description:
Active Vacancy
Position Summary:
As a Manufacturing Associate I at OmniaBio, you will be part of a high-performing team focused on production projects adhering to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) at OmniaBio’s Hamilton, Ontario, facility. This position is site-based, with work hours adhering to a designated pattern of 12-hour shifts. The primary function of this role is to execute manufacturing activities in support of OmniaBio’s client service provision to manufacture lifesaving cell and gene therapies.

Responsibilities:

Follows OmniaBio’s policies, standard operating procedures and GMP documentation, adhering to Good Documentation Practice.

Utilizes aseptic techniques and behaviours in the execution of the production process under the guidance of experienced colleagues and management.

Operates and cleans cleanroom equipment.

Utilize SAP enterprise system for supporting manufacturing activities.

Supports room and equipment commissioning, qualification and validation activities associated with enabling GMP operations and the introduction of new manufacturing processes.

Ensures that classified space within the manufacturing area is maintained in a clean and safe state of control.

Responsible for the health and safety of the individual, co-workers, and visitors to the manufacturing area.

Participates in investigations to derive root cause of non-conformance activities.

Adopts the OmniaBio Operating Model and embraces a continuous improvement approach to all work activities.

Engages in training and development to perform work in GMP cleanrooms and take on increased responsibilities.

Qualifications and experience:

High School Diploma or a higher qualification

Experience within a manufacturing environment utilizing documented procedures would be preferable.

Strong English written and verbal communication skills.

Experience in a working environment

Able to lift or carry up to 20 pounds.

Desired Competencies and Behaviors:

Able to learn.

Possesses integrity.

Demonstrates resilience and tenacity.

Diligent

Able to work in a team.

Demonstrates inter-personal awareness.

High-energy.

title: Industrial Hygienist:  Entry Level
description:
Industrial Hygienist: Entry Level

Criterion Laboratories, Inc. (Criterion) is hiring a full-time Entry Level Industrial Hygienist to join our growing team! At Criterion, we focus on employee development, and even if you have no experience in Industrial Hygiene, we will work to get you trained, licensed, and on the path to growth as part of our accredited internal training program.


Job Summary: Once you complete your initial training, you’ll be visiting worksites in and around the greater Philadelphia region where you’ll start by performing the basics of environmental investigations and monitoring. These projects include monitoring and testing for industrial and environmental hazards like asbestos, lead, and mold. As you grow in your role, you will continue to receive additional training, licenses, more complex work assignments, and increases in pay commensurate with your level.


We provide very competitive benefits, including employer sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid vacations, paid holidays, retirement with up to a 5% employer match (50% employee match up to 10% of your pay), and more!


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Carries out industrial hygiene field measurements to verify levels of asbestos/pollution to verify that workplaces are free from asbestos, lead, and other contaminants
  • Contributes to environmental investigations by conducting sampling according to protocol of various environmental media, including: drinking water, air, building materials, dust, paint chips and more.
  • Conducts limited asbestos surveys.
  • Trains with more experienced Industrial Hygienists, with an emphasis on asbestos and lead abatement projects.
  • Actively engages in training, both in the classroom and in the field, to pursue the required licenses, certifications, and working knowledge to work as an Industrial Hygienist.

This role requires flexibility regarding work location and what time projects begin each day. There are rare instances when some travel, overnight stay, and/or weekend work may be required.

title: Puunpurkaja
description:
Haemme nyt Imatralle määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen puunpurkajaa lokakuu 2026 – lokakuu 2027 väliselle ajalle. Työskentelet Wood & Energy liiketoiminta-alueella ja raportoit tehtävässäsi terminaalin terminaaliesihenkilölle. Työtehtävän työaikamuoto on TAM27.

Puunpurkajana keskeisiä työtehtäviäsi ovat:

  • puutavaran käsittely terminaalikoneilla (riippupihtikurottaja ja materiaalinkäsittelykone)
  • puutavaravaunujen siirtely robottiveturilla
  • puun syöttö asiakkaalle kuorintaan
  • puun varastointi
  • osallistuminen kuorimon avustaviin työtehtäviin
  • puutavaran mittaukseen liittyvät työtehtävät

Toivomme sinulta

Tehtävässä onnistuminen edellyttää soveltuvaa metsäalan tai vastaavaa koulutustaustaa sekä hyviä työkoneiden ajo- ja käsittelytaitoja. Vähintään B-luokan ajokortti tulee olla suoritettuna ja odotamme että sinulla on hyvät tietotekniset taidot. Kurottajan ja materiaalikäsittelykoneen käyttökokemus vaaditaan.

Perehdytämme kaikki työntekijät hyvin tehtäviin, joten kaikkea ei tarvitse osata ennalta.


Lupauksemme

Teemme työtä ihmisten ja luonnon kanssa, emme kummankaan kustannuksella. Porukassamme onnistumiset syntyvät rennosta ja rehdistä työstä ja ketä tahansa voi nykäistä hihasta, milloin vain. Tarjoamme sinulle kaiken tarvitsemasi tuen ja perehdytyksen tehtävään ja voit joustavasti suunnitella omat työpäiväsi. Loksahdat luontevasti rentoon työyhteisöömme omana itsenäsi ja olet tärkeä osa meitä.

Tervetuloa työskentelemään uusiutuvien materiaalien yritykseen!

title: Hospitality Aide
description:
Role Overview

A Hospitality Aide plays a vital role in supporting the daily life and well-being of residents in a senior living or healthcare community. description:
Term: January 2027

Duration: 8 months, with possibility of extension

Openings: 1 position

Salary Range: $3,650 - $4,525 CAD per month

Application Deadline: Monday, October 5, 2026, at 9:30 AM PDT

Your Opportunity
By joining the Kardium team, you can help make a difference in the lives of millions around the world. We have developed a ground-breaking medical device for the diagnosis and treatment of the most common heart rhythm disorder, atrial fibrillation – which can cause stroke, heart failure, and other heart-related complications.
Kardium’s mission is to deliver the best treatment for atrial fibrillation. To achieve this, we have developed The Globe® Pulsed Field System – we have a fantastic technical team that has developed a product with strong, unique, and customer-valued differentiators versus other solutions on the market. We have built connections with key opinion leaders who are already using the Globe System and are helping to tell our story.
We have obtained FDA and Health Canada approval and officially begun the commercial launch of the Globe® Pulsed Field System. This is a pivotal and exciting time in our journey, as we bring this life-changing technology to patients!
As a member of the FPGA team, you will get hands-on experience in the development and commercialization of complex and leading-edge medical devices. The electronics includes FPGAs, high-speed digital circuits, precision analog signals, RF power and high voltage pulse generation. Small-signal analog inputs are analyzed in real time while either RF or high-voltage pulsed power is delivered to the target heart tissue.
Please note, this opportunity is a hybrid work arrangement, located in Burnaby, BC.
What You Will Experience
You will engage in activities that develop practical and transferable skills such as:

Digital logic design in VHDL/Verilog (e.g. synthesizable circuits for FPGAs)
Digital logic design using block diagrams in Vivado
Verifying the digital logic designs using testbenches
Verifying and troubleshoot the FPGA designs through board-level testing
Developing designs with an embedded soft-core processor (MicroBlaze, Zynq)
Understanding the TCL script used to synthesize with the Xilinx (AMD) tools
Data analysis (e.g. analysis of test data in MATLAB and documentation of results)
System-level testing and debugging of prototypes and preproduction units

What You Bring to the Team
Our Kardium team is smart, creative, and passionate about creating cutting-edge medical devices to help improve people’s lives. We work within a collaborative environment based on trust and respect. And we understand that only by working together can we solve the unsolvable.
You will be successful in this role because you possess these attributes:

A solid understanding of the programmable logic design flow (FPGAs)
Experience with writing hardware description languages such as VHDL, and Verilog
Experience with Xilinx tools such as ISE, XPS, Vivado, etc.
A good understanding of basic electronics theory
Excellent communication and documentation skills
Positive, proactive attitude and able to execute tasks with an appropriate level of independence
Enthusiastic about seeking innovative solutions to unforeseen challenges
Demonstrated success working in a team setting

A meaningful Co-op/Intern term experience, working with truly innovative technology and an ambitious team, combined with:

title: Technologist, Commercialization Engineering
description:
The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers, and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary and NIOD, and BALMAIN Beauty.

Description

Position Summary:

The Commercialization Engineering Technologist is a site based technical role responsible for enabling robust commercialization, process scale up, and sustained manufacturing performance of new and existing products at the Hillmount manufacturing site. The role ensures products are translated from development intent into stable, repeatable manufacturing processes that meet quality, safety, delivery, and cost objectives. Through disciplined engineering trials, process validation, and risk mitigation, the role drives right first time execution and manufacturing readiness prior to commercial release.

Acting as the primary site technical owner for assigned product portfolios, the Commercialization Engineering Technologist leads line trials, establishes process parameters and control strategies, analyzes performance data, and resolves technical issues during launch and ramp up. The role partners closely with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Packaging Development, and cross functional stakeholders to ensure manufacturability, process capability, and post launch stabilization. This position is critical to maintaining manufacturing continuity, strengthening process control, and delivering value realization and agility initiatives within a fast paced, high complexity production environment.

Lead site technical execution of the commercialization process for NPL projects, ensuring products are translated into stable, repeatable manufacturing processes that meet ELC specifications, quality standards, and defined cost targets.

Provide site technical capability assessments, equipment constraint analysis, and manufacturing feasibility input to support manufacturing location and NetLoc decision making. Proactively communicate site manufacturing requirements and process constraints to R&D, Packaging Development, and upstream partners to ensure product design, formula, and packaging solutions align with site capabilities and performance targets.

Maintain cross functional communication throughout commercialization to ensure site manufacturability, validated process parameters, and confirmed line readiness prior to product release.

Collaborate with Packaging Development, Brand Quality, Supplier Quality, R&D, and Process Development to translate product design intent into executable manufacturing processes and clearly defined site success criteria.

Lead site pFMEA risk assessments to proactively identify production risks and ensure mitigation actions are embedded into control plans, standard work, and process settings prior to launch.

Participate in and support dFMEA activities with Development teams to mitigate potential design failure and provide manufacturing feasibility input.

Plan, execute, and document site based Engineering Trials and End to End Line Verification Runs, establish validated process parameters, confirm critical control points, and verify process capability prior to commercial release.

Qualifications

Degree in Engineering, Chemical or Mechanical preferred
3 years of experience
Experience in new product development processes and project management. Basic knowledge of Lean Manufacturing techniques: Root Cause Analysis, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis, and Statistical Process Control. Experience in filling and packaging technologies in the cosmetic, pharmaceutical or food & beverage industry.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills (oral, written), proactive and able to work with short deadlines. Good technical report/writing and presentation skills to directors’ level audience.
Must be highly proficient with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint

Some knowledge in packaging materials is a plus.

In addition, The Estée Lauder Companies offers a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage, wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time. In addition, the Company maintains highly competitive incentive compensation programs (role eligibility may vary based on terms of the respective plan(s)).

You may be eligible to participate in the applicable Commission/Bonus Plan, under the plan guidelines in effect at the time of hire. Additional details regarding the commission plan will be provided as part of your onboarding.

title: Business Intelligence (BI) Developer-Knoxville Office
description:
General Purpose of Job

As a BI Developer, you’ll build and manage data pipelines, architect data stores, and deliver reports and dashboards for internal and external clients.


Duties and Responsibilities (Daily and Monthly)


Pipelines & Integration

  • Design, build, and maintain robust ELT/ETL pipelines (SSIS, SQL Agent) that ingest from Hadoop, flat files, Excel, and APIs — engineered for reliability, auto-recovery, and observability.
  • Implement layered data flow (staging ? integration ? presentation) with automated data-quality checks and clear documentation of sources, transformations, and lineage.

Data Warehousing

  • Design and build data warehouses and subject-area marts using dimensional modeling and star schemas — well-formed facts and dimensions, conformed dimensions, and deliberate slowly changing dimension strategies.
  • Establish a single source of truth with shared definitions, modeling standards, and warehouse-level data quality, so metrics stay consistent as the platform grows.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards in SSRS and Power BI (semantic models, DAX, row-level security, gateways), feeding Azure/SharePoint Lists and Dynamics CRM.
  • Source reporting from the warehouse, define each metric once, and curate a maintainable, certified reporting catalog.

Planning

  • Translate business requirements into scoped, estimated work; manage dependencies and delivery risk; and report progress in sprint ceremonies.

Requirements


Educational

  • Associate degree preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred

Professional

  • Minimum one year experience in Data & Analytics

Computer Skills

  • Data Entry
  • Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word
  • Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams

Additional Requirements: Excellent communication skills and attention to detail.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Minimum one year in Data & Analytics; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Working knowledge of T-SQL, stored procedures, and views on Microsoft SQL Server — including Azure SQL Managed Instance and Azure SQL Database.
  • Working knowledge of SSIS, SQL Agent, and SSRS; knowledge of dimensional modeling, star schema design, and/or SSAS a plus.
  • Working knowledge of Power BI Desktop and/or Power BI Report Builder.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, Data Factory, OneLake, Data Warehouse a plus.
  • Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and solid logic and math skills.
  • Experience in a financial environment and exposure to Agile (Kanban) a plus.

title: Animal Welfare Supervisor
description:
Animal Welfare Supervisor Vancouver Island, BC
Cermaq British Columbia is seeking a permanent full-time Animal Welfare Supervisor to join our Fish Health team.
Located along the beautiful coastal waters of Vancouver Island, Cermaq is an international salmon farming company, which prides itself on playing a leadership role in the global sector. We have a team of more than 3500 employees across Chile, Canada and Norway. A committed team that is proud to grow nutritious seafood for a competitive global market. At Cermaq, you become part of a meaningful and consistently developing workplace. We offer a wide range of job opportunities where you will be able to grow and learn in a rapidly advancing and dynamic sector. We support our employees’ personal development and make it possible for you to realize new ideas and initiatives. Our culture is informal and dedicated. We are smart people in rubber boots. We care for each other, for the environment and for our communities.
Reporting to the Fish Health Environmental Monitoring Manager, the Animal Welfare Supervisor leads the planning and coordination of fish welfare any time our fish are handled with a vessel. This includes sea lice treatments, smolt deliveries, and site to site transports.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead and support the scheduling, training, and development of Animal Welfare and Treatment Technicians, ensuring appropriate staffing, technical competency, and operational readiness.
Coordinate treatment vessel operations, including scheduling, personnel, equipment, site readiness, and logistics to support safe and efficient treatment events.
Oversee fish welfare and water quality monitoring before and during fish handling and treatment activities.
Lead sea lice sampling, data collection, treatment monitoring, and efficacy analysis to support continuous improvement and treatment optimization.
Monitor treatment parameters, including water quality, treatment thresholds, and exposure times, and ensure activities are conducted in accordance with established protocols.
Provide coaching and technical guidance to operations and farm-site teams on fish welfare, sea lice management, treatment practices, and environmental monitoring.
Ensure compliance with government regulations, WorkSafeBC requirements, Standard Operating Procedures, biosecurity protocols, and company policies.
Support farm-site environmental monitoring activities, including plankton sampling, sea lice identification and counting, and real-time environmental sensor maintenance and troubleshooting.
Train and support farm staff in environmental monitoring procedures, sensor maintenance, sampling techniques, and related technical activities.
Analyze operational and treatment data to identify trends, evaluate effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement across Seawater Production operations.
Collaborate across teams to support fish health, environmental monitoring, operational priorities, and broader Seawater Production initiatives, including freshwater activities as required.

Qualifications & Skills:

Ability to effectively manage, mentor, coach, and develop staff, fostering accountability, professional growth, and a high-performing team environment;
Familiar with Project Management principles;
Excellent computer skills (Fishtalk, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook);
Excellent organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills.
BSc or related degree in Biology, Marine Biology, Environmental science or Aquaculture;
Have a minimum of 3 to 5 years’ related work experience, preferably in an industrial setting with fisheries, aquaculture and/or a marine setting or equivalent.
SVOP / PCOC, ROC-M, SDV-BS, First Aid, Transportation Endorsement all considered assets.

Physical Job Requirements:

Capable of car, boat and plane travel
Is capable of safely lifting 50lbs (23 kg)

What we Offer:

Company paid medical and dental benefits upon hire
Company matching RRSP Program
6% Vacation, 3 weeks per year
Starting wage of $70,000 – 75,000/ year

This position is camp based, on vessel and/or Saltwater Facility, working 8 consecutive 10-hour days, followed by 6 days off before returning to work.

How to Apply:
If your qualifications meet the application requirements and you would like to apply for this opportunity, please apply through our careers page at www.cermaq.ca, apply via Indeed, or email your resume and cover letter stating “Animal Welfare Supervisor” in the subject line, to: careers.canada@cermaq.com

Cermaq is an equal opportunities employer who provides a workplace that is free of discrimination.
Cermaq has a progressive view of reconciliation with Indigenous peoples. Although wholly committed to hire the best candidate available, we strongly encourage applications from Indigenous peoples for this role.
We would like to thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
