title: Senior Applied Scientist, AI Studio
description:
Job Description:


We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role:

The Senior Applied Scientist serves as a senior scientific authority for AI Studio, setting the scientific approach and quality bar across multiple engagement pods and mentoring Applied Scientists embedded in individual pods. As part of Wiley’s applied AI professional services practice, the role combines deep domain expertise with applied problem-solving to translate real-world research challenges into scientifically rigorous, deployable AI-enabled solutions and ensure consistent quality across AI Studio’s full portfolio of engagements.

The position requires working directly with customers such as pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, and materials science organizations to embed AI into evidence-intensive research processes, often on engagements with undefined or evolving scientific requirements. The Senior Applied Scientist ensures solutions are grounded in authoritative scientific knowledge and meet rigorous standards for accuracy and reliability, while shaping product direction, extending delivery capacity through external partners, and building Wiley’s scientific credibility in the market.

Job Responsibilities:

Scientific leadership across engagements

  • Set the scientific approach and quality standard across multiple AI Studio engagement pods, not limited to a single active engagement
  • Serve as a technical escalation point and mentor for Applied Scientists on complex or high-ambiguity engagements; review scientific approach and outputs across engagements to ensure consistency and rigor
  • Operate with minimal oversight on engagements with undefined or evolving scientific requirements, establishing approach where no established playbook exists
  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to bridge scientific and technical domains, ensuring successful solution implementation

Delivery partner ecosystem ownership

  • Own AI Studio’s external delivery partner ecosystem (e.g., Prolego, Cactus, and other delivery providers extending AI Studio’s delivery capacity), including:
  • Establishing scientific standards and governance processes partners must meet
  • Defining quality expectations and evaluation criteria for partner-delivered scientific work
  • Managing partner performance against those standards, including escalation and remediation when work falls short
  • Define and monitor service levels, delivery KPIs, capacity commitments, and operating rhythms for external delivery partners.
  • Coordinate with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders on partner onboarding, statements of work, contractual requirements, and renewals.
  • Forecast external delivery capacity and recommend the appropriate partner allocation based on scientific expertise, delivery needs, quality, and commercial considerations.

Product and platform influence

  • Partner with Product leadership to define scientific requirements, validation frameworks, and customer-driven enhancements that influence the ARI platform roadmap
  • Validate product credibility and fitness for use from a scientific standpoint, and provide domain expertise that shapes product positioning

Pre-sales and customer strategy

  • Lead scientific feasibility assessment in pre-sales and early scoping discussions, with authority to determine scientific viability and recommend that engagements be reshaped or declined on scientific grounds.
  • Serve as a senior scientific partner for strategic accounts, building trusted relationships with R&D leaders and identifying opportunities for repeat or expanded engagements in collaboration with Sales and account leadership.

External credibility and thought leadership

  • Represent Wiley’s scientific credibility through publications, speaking engagements, authored technical content, and engagement with customers and the broader scientific community, establishing AI Studio’s authority in pharma AI and other relevant domains.

Standards and delivery model

  • Ensure all solutions across engagements and partner-delivered work leverage authoritative data sources, including peer-reviewed research, and adhere to relevant scientific and regulatory standards
  • Operate effectively in sprint-based delivery models with defined outcomes, tight timelines, and direct accountability to customers — while setting the bar others are held to

Required Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in a relevant scientific discipline (PhD preferred)
  • Extensive post-doctoral or industry research experience (8–10+ years), ideally in:
  • o Pharmaceutical or biotech organizations
  • o Contract research organizations (CROs)
  • o Materials science or engineering environments
  • Track record of setting technical or scientific direction across teams, and of building credibility with senior R&D or scientific leadership (VP/Chief Scientist level)

Demonstrated ability to:

  • Make final scientific calls on ambiguous or contested AI outputs without escalation
  • Evaluate AI-generated outputs and third-party/partner-delivered scientific work for accuracy, grounding, and reliability
  • Apply critical thinking to determine fitness of AI solutions for real-world scientific use
  • Experience with research workflows in evidence-intensive environments and deep understanding of how scientific knowledge is generated, validated, and applied
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to:
  • o Translate between scientific and technical audiences
  • o Present complex findings to senior stakeholders, including in pre-sales and executive contexts
  • o Write clearly for both expert and non-expert audiences, including externally published or presented content
  • ·Experience operating outside traditional academic environments, including:
  • o Managing ambiguous, undefined problems with minimal oversight
  • o Delivering against defined outcomes under time constraints
  • o Working directly with external stakeholders, including third-party delivery partners
  • Experience managing or governing third-party vendors or delivery partners (preferred)
  • Familiarity with AI tools or applications in a research context (preferred)
  • Industry-specific expertise (depending on focus area), such as:
  • o Life sciences (e.g., pharmacology, clinical research, regulatory science) and understanding of regulatory standards
  • o Chemistry, materials science, or engineering, with experience in experimental or quantitative research

We power infinite possibilities.


For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.


Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance.


We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. The range below represents Wiley's good faith and reasonable estimate of the base pay for this role at the time of posting roles in the United Kingdom, Canada, USA, Austria, Czechia, Denmark, France, Greece, Italy, Netherlands, Romania, or Spain. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies.

$60,000-$72,000 annual base salary, commensurate with experience
3 weeks' vacation

Monday–Friday schedule, based at our Fort McMurray branch

title: Fire Sprinkler Technician
description:
About Us

Since 1990, Patriot Fire Protection, Inc. has been an industry leader in fire prevention systems including design, fabrication, installation, maintenance, inspection and rapid response. With offices in Tacoma, Spokane, and Vancouver Washington, our mission is to provide the highest quality systems and services while protecting the lives and property of our customers. Learn more at www.patriotfire.com.

Why You'll Love This Role

Identifying, documenting, and correcting deficiencies in fire sprinkler systems saves lives. This role offers an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about fire safety and hands-on technical work to go beyond inspection alone: diagnosing issues, performing minor repairs and component replacement, and providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

This role focuses on inspection, testing, maintenance, and minor repair of existing water-based fire sprinkler systems. New system installation and larger-scope fabrication or pipefitting work is performed by our union Sprinkler Fitters.

What You'll Do

  • Inspection, Testing, Maintenance: Work in accordance with NFPA 25 and local standards to ensure systems are working correctly and address any issues
  • Repair & Service: Diagnose deficiencies identified during inspections and perform minor repairs, including replacement of sprinkler heads, valves, gauges, and other system components
  • Reporting: Use Google Suite to communicate findings, recommendations and summaries to relevant parties in a consistent and timely manner
  • Collaboration: Work alongside coordinators, sprinkler fitters and alarm teams to manage daily operations, including responding to incoming service calls and escalating larger-scope repair or installation needs to the appropriate team
  • Professional Growth: Embrace opportunities to learn, grow, and take on additional responsibilities

What We're Looking For

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • WA State ITT Certificate of Competency
  • Backflow Certification
  • 2+ years in fire sprinkler inspections, maintenance, and/or repairs
  • Working knowledge of sprinkler system components with the ability to perform minor repairs and replacements
  • Understanding of NFPA 25
  • Familiarity with water-based fire sprinkler systems
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and Google Suite
  • Ability to work in unusual and sometimes difficult positions such as climbing ladders, scaffolding and high lift equipment, utility vaults (confined spaces), above ceilings, etc.
  • Able to work a full-time yet flexible schedule
  • Valid driver's license with excellent driving record
  • Ability to adhere to, implement, and follow safety guidelines and procedures at all times
  • Drug screening and background checks will only be conducted after a conditional job offer is made. We evaluate criminal history based on its relevance to the job duties. Note: this is a safety sensitive role requiring a zero-substance —including marijuana/THC— drug screen result.

Ideal Candidate Attributes

  • Continually seeks ways to improve efficiencies
  • Desire to grow and willingness to learn
  • Positive attitude and professional demeanor including good judgment and honesty
  • Operates methodically and is well organized
  • Takes initiative and can operate with minimal guidance
  • Trains teammates and openly shares knowledge and experience
  • Customer-centric: goes the extra mile to get the job done correctly


If you're ready to take on a rewarding challenge and contribute to a thriving team, apply now to become our next Fire Sprinkler Technician!

Patriot Fire Protection, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.

Position Summary

Position Overview & Financial Operations

The Controller directs the implementation, utilization, and continuous improvement of financial reporting and analytics solutions across the organization. Reporting directly to operational leadership, this role leads the development of annual budgets, long-term financial plans, rolling forecast models, and business insight tools. The position is responsible for identifying relevant financial trends to support strategic decision-making and ensuring department leaders receive dedicated assistance in evaluating monthly operational results.

Team Leadership & Administrative Responsibilities

In addition to financial planning, the Controller directs daily operations for the financial planning and analysis team, establishing annual goals, objectives, and departmental strategies. This role carries full personnel management duties, including recruitment, hiring, performance evaluations, and compensation determinations. Candidates must possess an Associate’s degree along with seven years of relevant experience, including at least five years in a leadership capacity.

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

    • Identifies and communicates appropriate and relevant financial and operational information and trends as a basis for making management decisions. Ensures thorough, accurate, and timely reports are produced on schedule by the team.
    • Provides department leaders with the necessary support for evaluation of their monthly operational results and development of annual budgets.
    • Directs the daily operations of the financial planning and analysis team and prepares annual goals, objectives, and strategies for the team.

title: Solutions Architect - Airline Systems
description:
Synopsis

The Solutions Architect is responsible for defining and driving the technology architecture that enables seamless operational performance and guest experiences across the organisation. The role designs scalable, resilient, and integrated solutions that connect operational processes, frontline teams, enterprise systems, data platforms, and digital channels. Working closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology delivery functions, the Solutions Architect ensures alignment with enterprise architecture standards while leveraging modern technologies to enhance operational visibility, automation, decision-making, and continuous improvement.

Accountabilities

  • Define and govern solution architectures that support operational capabilities and transformation initiatives.
  • Design scalable solutions across key operational domains, including Flight Operations, Technical, Training, and Network Operations.
  • Architect integrations between operational systems, enterprise platforms, and third-party solutions using appropriate integration patterns and technologies.
  • Enable real-time operational visibility and automation through event-driven architectures, monitoring, analytics, and workflow capabilities.
  • Ensure operational data is secure, governed, and accessible for reporting, analytics, AI, and automation use cases.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate operational priorities and challenges into technology roadmaps and solution designs.
  • Evaluate technology and vendor solutions to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, scalability, interoperability, and cost objectives.
  • Provide architectural leadership and technical assurance to product, delivery, engineering, and vendor teams.
  • Ensure solutions meet requirements for security, resilience, performance, availability, compliance, and business continuity.
  • Maintain architecture artefacts, including solution designs, capability maps, data flows, integration models, and roadmaps.
  • Manage architecture risks, technical debt, dependencies, and opportunities for standardisation and reuse.
  • Assess and promote the adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation, where they deliver measurable business value.
  • Support agile delivery by establishing architecture guardrails that enable rapid and effective solution delivery.
  • Collaborate across Digital, Data, Technology, Finance, Procurement, Customer, and Operations functions to deliver business outcomes.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in Solution, Application, or Enterprise Architecture, ideally within large-scale digital transformation environments.
  • Proven experience designing technology solutions for airline operations, with a strong understanding of operational processes and supporting systems.
  • Strong knowledge of APIs, microservices, application integration, and modern integration architectures.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, including cloud-native services, data platforms, streaming technologies, and AI capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience using AI, automation, APIs, low-code platforms, and cloud technologies to develop prototypes and proof of concepts.
  • Experience applying enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF to define architectures, roadmaps, governance, and technology standards.
  • Experience working within Agile and/or SAFe delivery environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking an Intern – Scientist (BioAnalytical – Immunochemistry) to join our team in Singapore

Internship Details:

  • Duration: at least 20 weeks, full-time (Onsite)
  • Dates of Internship: Jan – Jun 2027
  • Compensation: Paid internship
  • Eligibility: Final-year students who are expected to graduate in Jul/Aug 2027 are preferred. However, students at all academic levels who are pursuing relevant fields of study are encouraged to apply.

About Team:

This position reports to the Lab Manager and interfaces with lab scientists. Labcorp is committed to an employee-orientated, high-performance culture that emphasizes empowerment, quality, continuous improvement and the recruitment and on-going development of a superior workplace

Internship Assignment Summary:

  • GLP (good laboratory practice) and GCP (good clinical practice) training.
  • Analyzes biological or chemical samples and/or develops/validates methodologies for various compounds.
  • Sets up, operates and performs routine and non-routine maintenance on general equipment
  • Assists in setting up method development
  • Evaluates data for report preparation and experiment modification as directed

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Current enrollment in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences Bachelor's degree program.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Basic lab skills e.g. pipetting

Additional Job Standards:

  • Good organization and multitasking ability.
  • Able to communicate effectively with excellent verbal/written communication skills.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Creative and self-motivated individuals who work collaboratively in a high-performance team environment.

About the Program As a Labcorp intern, you’ll be immersed in hands-on work that complements your academic background. In addition to your project work, you’ll gain valuable exposure to Labcorp’s global business, culture, and leadership through:

  • Enterprise-wide learning experiences that introduce you to key business functions across Labcorp
  • Leadership exposure and visibility, including direct interaction with senior leaders
  • An immersive, in-person Workshops designed to connect you with peers and deepen your understanding of our mission
  • Senior leader speaker sessions offering insights into strategy, innovation, and career growth
  • Continuous opportunities to connect and grow, from intern cohort communication channels and LinkedIn Learning resources to professional development sessions and storytelling opportunities that highlight your internship journey
  • Connection to Labcorp’s inclusive culture through engagement with our employee resource groups (ERGs)and values-driven community initiatives
  • Dedicated mentoring connections to guide your growth, provide career advice, and support your internship journey

Apply now to launch your career and create real impact for patients worldwide. #FutureofLabcorp

At Labcorp we have a passion for helping people live happy and healthy lives. Every day we provide vital information that helps our clients and patients understand their health. If you are passionate about helping people and have a drive for service, then Labcorp could be a great next career step!


Labcorp is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer:

Labcorp strives for inclusion and belonging in the workforce and does not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind. We make employment decisions based on the needs of our business and the qualifications and merit of the individual. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), family or parental status, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, personal appearance, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. title: Head of Trade Product & Advisory
description:
Introduction

Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

Overview

Reporting to the Head of Global Treasury & Payments, the Head of Trade Product & Advisory will lead the continued evolution of East West Bank's trade business by combining trade advisory, product management, strategic partnerships, and business development into a centralized Trade Solutions function.

As a Top 20 Trade Finance Bank in the United States, East West Bank has established capabilities supporting domestic and international commerce. This role will build upon that foundation by enhancing trade products, improving client-facing capabilities, expanding trade adoption across the Bank, and ensuring clients receive expert guidance on both domestic and cross-border trade solutions.

This role will serve as the Bank's primary trade subject matter expert, partnering closely with Relationship Managers, Credit, Trade Operations, Treasury Management, International Banking, Risk, and Compliance to identify opportunities, structure transactions, and deliver a consistent, scalable, and profitable trade offering.

The successful candidate will combine strong client-facing trade expertise with a practical understanding of trade operations, product management, and market trends. The role will initially lead a small, specialized team and will have responsibility for developing advisory capabilities, managing strategic trade partnerships, and advancing the Bank's trade proposition over time.

Responsibilities

Trade Advisory & Business Development

  • Lead the Trade Finance business
  • Partner with all business lines and segments to evaluate, identify and structure trade opportunities
  • Act as subject matter expert and provide practical guidance on all trade matters, with a particular focus on cross-border trade transactions with an Asia nexus
  • Improve the knowledge and understanding of trade across the Bank

Trade Solutions Product Management

  • Partner with Trade Operations and Technology teams to enhance trade capabilities, efficiency and client experience
  • Monitor competitor offerings, market developments, and regulatory changes to maintain a competitive trade offering
  • Evaluate and manage relationships with correspondent banks, trade service providers, fintechs, digital trade platforms, and other strategic partners
  • Track and communicate performance, pipeline activity, and strategic initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Trade Operations and client servicing to ensure seamless client delivery
  • Collaborate with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Technology
  • Partner with Relationship Managers to support client service team coverage of relationships

Success Measures

  • Growth in trade revenue, fees, and trade-related wallet expansion with clients
  • Increased trade penetration across all Banking segments
  • Number and quality of trade opportunities sourced and successfully converted.
  • Improvement in banker engagement and trade solution utilization
  • Successful expansion of correspondent banking and strategic partner relationships
  • Strong partnership with Credit, Trade Operations, and Relationship Management teams

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; MBA preferred
  • 10+ years of experience in trade finance, international banking, treasury management, or related financial services
  • Deep expertise in trade finance products, trade advisory, and business development
  • Experience managing or enhancing trade products and client-facing capabilities
  • Strong knowledge of trade operations, risk management, regulatory requirements, and international trade practices
  • Proven ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders, and drive business growth across cross-functional teams
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and client relationship management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior executives, clients, and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrated leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to drive growth, innovation, and organizational change

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is USD $250,000.00/Yr. - USD $350,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

title: Estimator
description:
Estimator

Austin, Texas

Direct Hire Opportunity

Superior Skilled Trades is partnered with a national commercial electrical contractor specializing in technically complex, sustainable, and high-performance construction projects. They are seeking an experienced Estimator to join their team in Austin, TX.

This is an excellent opportunity for an electrical estimating professional who enjoys working on complex projects and collaborating with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and other stakeholders to develop accurate, competitive, and comprehensive estimates.

Position Summary

The Estimator will develop detailed and accurate project cost estimates that support project planning, bidding, and execution. This individual will evaluate project documents, scope, market conditions, labor requirements, material costs, subcontractor pricing, and historical data to develop competitive estimates and identify potential risks and opportunities.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of electrical construction and experience estimating commercial or technically complex projects. Experience with data centers, advanced technology, mission-critical facilities, healthcare, life sciences, higher education, industrial, or renewable-energy projects is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare detailed and accurate estimates for moderately complex electrical construction projects
  • Develop pricing for labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and other project costs
  • Review drawings, specifications, scopes of work, and contract documents to identify project requirements, risks, gaps, and opportunities
  • Perform quantity takeoffs and analyze project requirements to develop comprehensive estimates
  • Solicit and evaluate subcontractor and vendor proposals and pricing
  • Coordinate with preconstruction coordinators, project managers, engineers, procurement teams, and other stakeholders throughout the estimating process
  • Assemble comprehensive bid packages and provide bidders with clear scope, instructions, and clarifications
  • Analyze current market conditions, material pricing, labor costs, vendor pricing, and historical project data
  • Support value engineering efforts by evaluating alternative materials, systems, construction methods, and solutions
  • Identify opportunities to improve project cost, schedule, quality, and overall value
  • Document estimate assumptions, qualifications, exclusions, clarifications, and scope considerations
  • Extract and utilize production and historical cost data to improve estimate accuracy and project planning
  • Collaborate across company divisions, including prefabrication and other self-perform capabilities, to incorporate production efficiencies into estimates
  • Participate in estimate reviews and present pricing, assumptions, risks, and recommendations to project leadership
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes, tools, and best practices

Ideal Candidate

  • 4–6+ years of experience in electrical construction estimating, preconstruction, cost analysis, project controls, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of commercial electrical construction and the ability to interpret electrical drawings, specifications, one-line diagrams, and scopes of work
  • Experience estimating electrical labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and related project costs
  • Experience with commercial electrical construction or technically complex projects strongly preferred
  • Experience with power distribution, lighting, low-voltage, medium-voltage, or other electrical infrastructure is highly valued
  • Experience with data centers, advanced technology, mission-critical, healthcare, life sciences, higher education, industrial, or renewable-energy projects is a plus
  • Experience with design-build, VDC/BIM, prefabrication, or self-perform construction is preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple estimates, priorities, and deadlines
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with project teams, vendors, subcontractors, and clients
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and construction estimating/takeoff software
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Year-end bonus based on company performance
  • Full Medical, Vision, and Dental
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability
  • 401(k) with 6% company match
  • 4 weeks of PTO
  • Every 5 years, employees receive an additional 3 weeks of PTO for that year

Why This Opportunity

This is an opportunity to join a growing organization working on high-performance and technically demanding electrical construction projects. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to contribute to complex projects, work alongside experienced construction professionals, and play an important role in developing accurate and competitive project estimates.

The most complete lifting company in the world, Lanco represents four iconic, world-class heavy equipment manufacturers, mobile crane dealerships across US and Canada, the largest parts and service network in North America, and factory-authorized technician training. In this role, you will support Mi-Jack Products, Inc. Established in 1954, Mi-Jack Products is recognized as an industry leader and innovator in Travelift and Translift Rubber Tired Gantry crane manufacturing, sales, service, and support. Mi-Jack is also the industry leader in providing maintenance services, inspections, repairs and parts for the railroad, port and industrial equipment end-users. By designing and engineering maintainable solutions that can integrate into daily operations without missing a beat, we provide our customers with reliable, safe, and efficient solutions. From the engineering department to the manufacturing floor, we are committed to providing a superior product and an unsurpassed customer experience.

As a Lead Software Development Engineer, you will take on a key technical role within our software team, contributing to the development of high-performance applications for real-time embedded control systems. This position focuses on full-stack development, with responsibilities spanning embedded control systems, UI design, and system integration.

You’ll write clean, efficient code, guide architectural decisions, and work closely with teammates across disciplines to build scalable, reliable solutions. This role blends deep technical knowledge with collaboration, mentorship, and a commitment to quality software development. In addition to software development, this role requires a strong background in machine control and real-world equipment integration. The ideal candidate will have hands‑on experience working with heavy machinery systems and be comfortable engaging with hardware in the field.

  • Mentor other software engineers specializing in programmable hardware and displays, providing guidance, feedback, and support to ensure the successful delivery of automation projects.
  • Lead the full software development lifecycle from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, and commissioning.
  • Collaborate closely with vehicle systems experts, electrical engineers, and other stakeholders to define project requirements, develop software solutions, and integrate programmable systems with other control systems and equipment.
  • Defines and owns the software development lifecycle infrastructure for industrial automation projects, including branching strategies, versioning standards, and release governance. Enforce code review, merge policies, and change control practices. Owns toolchain selection and integration across source control, build servers, artifact repositories, and deployment orchestration.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, and schedules; monitoring project progress and identifying any risks or issues that may impact delivery timelines.
  • Implement best practices and standards for programming, ensuring code quality, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Stay current on industry trends, advancements in programmable hardware technology, and emerging standards and regulations; proactively incorporate new tools and methodologies to support continuous improvement and ensure departmental readiness for both new and existing product development.(KS1.1)
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the automation team, promoting knowledge sharing and professional development.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external software, automation, and industrial control partners to enhance development capabilities and ensure supplier components are effectively integrated within the broader company software architecture.(KS2.1)
  • Ability to collaborate with and lead international teams in various time zones.
  • Oversee the development and release of software projects for components and systems for which you are responsible.
  • Uphold company policies and procedures, contributing to a harmonious working environment and strong working relationships.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of software design and development practices, with a focus on heavy machinery.
  • Proficiency with Atlassian toolchain (Bitbucket, Jira) including repository management, branching strategies, pull request workflows, and pipeline configuration. Experience with versioning and release practices for embedded firmware, including build artifact traceability, toolchain integration (compilers, linkers, build systems), and controlled field deployment. Familiarity with Jira for issue tracking and release management, with traceability between Jira issues and source control commits.
  • Proven skills in designing, implementing, and optimizing motion control algorithms and software for industrial applications.
  • Strong programming skills in languages commonly used in motion control systems, such as C/C++, Python, or MATLAB/Simulink.
  • Experience working with various motion control hardware components, such as servo drives, motors, encoders, and actuators.
  • Understanding of communication protocols commonly used in motion control systems, such as EtherCAT, CAN bus, Modbus, and Ethernet/IP.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with the engineering team and external partners.
  • Capable of managing multiple development projects under tight deadlines with a focus on safety and quality.
  • Knowledge of effective collaboration techniques and ability to build networks with people from different countries and cultures.

This is primarily an office classification, and employees work in an office with moderate noise levels, controlled temperature conditions and no direct exposure to hazardous physical substances. May work offsite in various environments. Up to 25% domestic travel may be required.

Travel: Less than 10%

Sponsorship: Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Demands: The position occasionally bends, stoops, reaches, pushes and pulls drawers to retrieve and file information and lifts and carries reports, records, and other materials that typically weigh less than 30 pounds.

Education: Accredited engineering degree with an emphasis in electrical engineering, computer engineering, (KS4.1)computer science, or a related field.

Experience: Minimum of 10+ years of product development experience, preferably within the heavy equipment, off-highway, agricultural equipment, transportation, automotive, or material handling industries.

title: Bliv erhvervsrådgiver i Næstved – hvor relationer og godt bankhåndværk skaber resultater
description:
Vil du være kundernes foretrukne sparringspartner og en del af et team med høj faglighed, godt sammenhold og plads til humor?

Som erhvervsrådgiver i Nykredit og Spar Nord i Næstved får du mulighed for at kombinere vores lokale engagement og tætte kunderelationer med de muligheder, den faglighed og de specialister, vi som foreningsejet bank kan tilbyde vores kunder og kolleger.

I jobbet vil du få ansvaret for din egen portefølje af erhvervskunder og være en central sparringspartner for virksomheder, der har brug for rådgivning, indsigt og løsninger, som understøtter deres udvikling og vækst.

Vær med til at skabe gode kundeoplevelser
Hos Nykredit og Spar Nord i Næstved søger vi en erhvervsrådgiver, der brænder for at skabe værdi for virksomheder gennem tætte relationer, høj faglighed og et tydeligt kundefokus.

Som en del af en solid foreningsejet bank kombinerer vi det lokale engagement og de tætte kunderelationer med ressourcerne, mulighederne og specialisterne fra en af Danmarks største finansielle koncerner.

Vi søger dig, der motiveres af at være tæt på kunderne, forstå deres forretning og hjælpe dem med at realisere deres ambitioner. Du tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem langvarige relationer, et tydeligt kundefokus og rådgivning, der gør en reel forskel.

Hos os handler erhvervsrådgivning om mere end produkter og finansiering. Det handler om at forstå kunden, opbygge langvarige relationer og være den rådgiver, kunderne har lyst til at ringe til, når de står over for deres næste vigtige beslutning.

Du får ansvaret for din egen kundeportefølje og stor frihed til at udvikle den på den måde, du vurderer, skaber størst værdi for kunderne og banken. Samtidig bliver du en del af et dygtigt hold, hvor sparring, videndeling og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Nogle af dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver at:

  • rådgive og udvikle en portefølje af erhvervskunder,
  • udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer og tiltrække nye kunder,
  • samarbejde med specialister og kolleger for at skabe de bedste løsninger,
  • deltage i netværk og aktiviteter, der opbygger relationerne til det lokale erhvervsliv.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?
Du har erfaring med rådgivning af erhvervskunder og motiveres af at skabe gode løsninger sammen med kunderne.

Måske er du allerede seniorerhvervsrådgiver med en solid erhvervsportefølje og et solidt netværk. Måske er du erhvervsrådgiver og klar til næste skridt i din udvikling. Det vigtigste for os er, at du brænder for kunderne, tænker langsigtet i dine relationer og trives i et miljø, hvor faglighed, ordentlighed og samarbejde er en del af hverdagen.

Dit nye team
Du bliver en del af et erhvervsteam bestående af syv erhvervsrådgivere, to erhvervsspecialister og en erhvervschef. Vores erhvervsspecialister er en vigtig del af holdet og hjælper med mange af de praktiske processer omkring kunderne. De understøtter blandt andet lånesager, onboarding, kreditprocesser og koordinering på tværs af banken, så rådgiverne kan bruge mest mulig tid dér, hvor de skaber størst værdi – hos kunderne.

Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes gennem samarbejde, ærlig sparring og respekt for det gode bankhåndværk. Derfor hjælper vi hinanden, deler erfaringer og udfordrer hinanden fagligt. Hos os er der stor frihed til selv at planlægge og udvikle sin portefølje, og vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Vil du vide mere?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Jonas Danielsson på tlf. 44 55 37 58, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Ansøgningsfrist

15.09.2026

By

Næstved

Vi er ikke helt som de andre

Nykredit-koncernen er nemlig ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det giver os bl.a. nogle særlige muligheder for at dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, fx gennem konkrete fordele, der gør det billigere at være kunde hos os. Det mærker man også i de lokalområder, vi er til stede i – fx når alle vores rådgivere i Nykredit og Spar Nord hvert år får et beløb til rådighed til at gøre en forskel for en lokal forening eller klub. Det kalder vi Det lokale løfte.

Som kollega mærker du også vores foreningsejerskab. Vi giver fx et medarbejderløfte, hvor vi lover udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan. Du vil derfor opleve, at din leder er ambitiøs – ikke mindst på dine vegne – og er trænet i at støtte din udvikling og guide dig videre, når du er klar til næste skridt i din karriere. Selvfølgelig i Nykredit-koncernen.

På tværs af Nykredit og Spar Nord får du cirka 5.500 nye kolleger, der sammen skaber vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads. Det gør vi med en kultur, der er præget af holdånd, ligeværd og handlekraft. Og med målet om at give vores kunder markedets bedste oplevelser.

Dét er bare nogle af fordelene ved at være en del af vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads.

Nykredit-koncernen omfatter bl.a. følgende brands Nykredit, Spar Nord, Totalkredit, Nybolig og Sparinvest.

title: Wellness 162021 -  Group Exercise Instructor (Certified)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Group Exercise Instructor is responsible for the design and instruction of safe, high-quality, effective, challenging, and fun group exercise classes as determined by the class format and description.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Design and teach effective, safe and enjoyable exercise classes using proper exercise progressions and cueing techniques, according to guidelines.
Select appropriate music and tempo suitable for the class format and population served
Oversees the proper use, maintenance, and cleaning of equipment and supplies.
Attends all mandatory staff meetings.
Design classes that adhere to the designated format and are appropriate for the participants’ abilities. Teach classes with energy and enthusiasm.
Accurately demonstrate skills being taught in class, explain them clearly, and work at skill level and intensity level appropriate for the particular class. Instructors must emphasize the members’ workouts, not their own.
Frequently and consistently demonstrate multiple movement modifications, and repeatedly encourage members to modify movements and work at their own pace. Monitor participants’ intensity, technique, proper form, and hydration throughout the class.
Consistently utilize clear and easy-to-follow verbal and physical cues in advance of a movement change.
Plan in advance the specific composition/choreography of each class, consistently changing music and routines.
Ensure that the class attendance of each member is accurately recorded in the designated manner.
Begin and end class on time. Be available in the classroom with proper music and all equipment set up and ready no fewer than 5 minutes before class is to begin. Leave program area in a safe "closed-down” manner with all equipment and materials properly cleaned and neatly returned to their proper places.
Maintain positive rapport with participants (and parents of participants, if applicable).
Encourage member involvement in YMCA programs, events and Annual Campaign. Reads announcements to class when requested.
Learn participants’ names, engage them in conversation, and conduct classes in such a way as to encourage members to interact with and get to know each other.
Find a certified and competent substitute instructor if unable to teach assigned class. Notify supervisor of substitute coverage.
May be required to travel to multiple branches and offsite locations to lead classes.
May be required to lead classes in a live or recorded virtual environment.
Responsible for following the child abuse and neglect reporting process including completion of Suspected Child Abuse/Neglect reporting form, calling children protective services (696-Kids) and notifying immediate Supervisor, Branch Executive, Risk Management and Human Resources Departments. All employees of the YMCA of Greater Cleveland are mandated reporters for any signs or suspicion of child abuse and neglect.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Education:

High school diploma or GED required; Associates degree preferred.

Certification(s)& Requirements:

Certification in CPR at the level of Basic Life Support or Professional Rescuer, Basic First Aid, and Emergency Oxygen Administration and associated-determined safety training required within 30 days of hire.
Current national NCCA-accredited Group Exercise Instructor certification, or YMCA Group Exercise Instructor certification.

If not currently certified, must obtain within 90 days of hire.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Introduction

Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

Overview

East West Bank is seeking an experienced Senior AI Engineering to design, build, and operationalize enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI solutions across the Bank. This senior technical leader will translate emerging AI capabilities into secure, scalable, production-ready banking applications that improve operational efficiency, risk management, customer experience, and employee productivity.

The role is expected to be hands-on at the outset while helping establish foundational AI engineering capabilities, operating standards, and a small, high-performing AI engineering team.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI and Generative AI applications for prioritized banking use cases (e.g., customer service, fraud detection, document processing, knowledge management, and operational efficiency)
  • Architect LLM-enabled solutions spanning retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, agentic workflows, MCP, model orchestration, tool/function calling, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Build production-grade services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or Flask, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Databricks, ADLS, and modern cloud-native patterns.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications, developer workflows, knowledge management platforms, automation, analytics, and decision-support processes.
  • Establish engineering practices for CI/CD, testing, model evaluation, observability, performance optimization, security, and responsible AI controls.
  • Establish reusable AI engineering frameworks, reference architectures, code standards, deployment patterns, and governance controls to accelerate enterprise adoption.
  • Partner with business, data, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, legal, and vendor teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory, privacy, auditability, and operational risk expectations.
  • Prototype rapidly with stakeholders, convert pilots into scalable implementations, and define measurable adoption and impact metrics.
  • Evaluate LLM platforms for accuracy, latency, cost, security, explainability, and fit for regulated enterprise use cases.
  • Support hiring, mentoring, and day-to-day technical leadership of AI engineers and cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies and advise leadership on practical opportunities, risks, and implementation tradeoffs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

AI Fluency & Hands-On LLM Skills

  • Hands-on experience with major LLM platforms, including OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot/Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and open-source models such as Llama or Mistral.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, LLM orchestration frameworks, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, and hallucination mitigation.
  • Ability to design AI applications that include data protection, source validation, access control, logging, monitoring, traceability, and human review where appropriate.
  • Strong understanding of Responsible AI, model governance, prompt-injection risks, data privacy, and production controls for LLM-enabled solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering or related technology leadership roles, including experience delivering production AI solutions
  • Proven experience leading AI, data, automation, or emerging technology initiatives from strategy and experimentation through production delivery.
  • Strong hands-on engineering background in Python, API design, microservices, cloud architecture, distributed systems, data pipelines, CI/CD, testing, observability, and secure software delivery.
  • Deep experience with the Azure ecosystem, including Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Databricks, ADLS, Azure AI Search, and related enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience with LLM frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, model registries, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring/observability tools.
  • Strong process and data discipline, including data quality, lineage, metadata, workflow design, controls, operational risk, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience in financial services, banking, fintech, insurance, or another regulated industry with strong understanding of compliance, auditability, risk management, and governance.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders, mentor engineers, and translate complex AI capabilities into practical business solutions.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to define AI roadmaps, operating models, standards, adoption plans, and success metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in AI, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience establishing AI engineering teams, platforms, reusable delivery patterns, and enterprise AI standards.
  • Experience with copilots, enterprise search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation, and AI-enabled knowledge management.
  • Experience driving AI vendor evaluation and selection processes within regulated environments
  • Familiarity with model risk management, third-party/vendor risk, privacy impact assessments, and regulated technology delivery.
  • Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, AI monitoring, evaluation pipelines, model/prompt registries, and production incident management.
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and building high-performing technical teams.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is USD $125,000.00/Yr. - USD $200,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

title: Senior Service and UX Designer Government Digital Transformation
description:
Senior Service and UX Designer, Government Digital Transformation

Full-time Contract | Remote within Canada | Alberta Business Hours

About the opportunity

Aequilibrium is seeking a Senior Service and UX Designer for a potential multi-year public-sector digital modernization initiative.

You will help improve complex internal, partner-facing, and public-facing digital services supporting housing programs across Alberta. The environment includes an enterprise Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform, a Partner Portal and related digital services.

This is a senior, hands-on role combining service design, user research, enterprise UX, accessible interface design and stakeholder facilitation. You will work within a cross-functional Agile team alongside product managers, business analysts, developers, architects and government stakeholders.

The initial contract is expected to run from November 2026 to November 2027, with the potential for two additional one-year extensions. The successful candidate must reside and work in Canada and be available full-time during Alberta business hours.

Compensation

The anticipated contractor rate for this role is $80–$100 per hour, depending on experience, public-sector qualifications, and alignment with the required service-design capabilities. The engagement is expected to be full-time, with approximately 2,000 hours anticipated annually. The initial one-year contract may be extended for up to two additional one-year terms; extensions and annual hours are subject to client approval and are not guaranteed.

What you will do

  • Lead human-centered design across internal, partner-facing and public-facing digital services.

  • Plan and conduct user research, including interviews, discovery workshops, usability testing, surveys and behavioral analysis.

  • Map complex service ecosystems and develop current-state and future-state journey maps and service blueprints.

  • Translate research, user needs and business requirements into information architecture, user flows, wireframes and interactive prototypes.

  • Design intuitive, responsive and accessible interfaces for enterprise web applications and portals.

  • Create and maintain enterprise design systems, including component libraries, design tokens and interaction standards.

  • Apply WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility requirements throughout research, design and implementation.

  • Facilitate design-thinking, co-design and stakeholder-alignment workshops.

  • Collaborate closely with product, business, architecture, development and quality-assurance teams within an Agile environment.

  • Prepare production-ready design specifications and support developer handoff, implementation and design QA.

  • Use usability metrics, analytics and user feedback to measure outcomes and guide continuous improvement.

  • Provide design leadership while remaining actively involved in research and design delivery.

What we are looking for

The following experience is required:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience delivering UX, UI and service design within complex enterprise environments.

  • 5+ years supporting digital transformation within government, the broader public sector or Crown corporations.

  • A post-secondary degree or diploma in interaction design, human-computer interaction, UX design, product design, industrial design, graphic design, computer science or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience designing responsive enterprise applications, portals or complex digital-service platforms.

  • Strong human-centered service-design experience, including user research, journey mapping, service blueprinting and current-state and future-state service modeling.

  • Experience designing citizen-facing, partner-facing or internal enterprise digital services.

  • Experience developing or governing enterprise design systems, component libraries and design tokens.

  • Demonstrated application of WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards.

  • Experience preparing production-ready specifications and supporting implementation through developer handoff and design QA.

  • Strong stakeholder-facilitation and design-leadership capabilities.

  • Experience working with cross-functional Agile delivery teams.

  • Proficiency with Figma, Miro, and FigJam, as well as Jira or Confluence.

  • Ability to work full-time during Alberta business hours, approximately 8:15 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Mountain Time.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, government case-management platforms, partner portals, housing, social services, or similarly complex service environments would be especially valuable.

When applying

Please include:

  • Your current résumé.

  • Your location within Canada.

  • Your availability to begin November 2, 2026.

  • Your hourly contract rate.

  • A summary of your government and public-sector digital-transformation experience, including clients, dates, and your responsibilities.

  • Two examples demonstrating human-centered service design and user research.

  • Two examples involving enterprise UX, design systems and accessibility.

  • Two examples involving citizen-facing, partner-facing or internal digital services.

  • Confirmation that you can provide three client references.

For each example, clearly describe the project, your personal contribution, the research and design methods used, the deliverables you produced, and the resulting outcomes.

title: AI Engineering Lead
description:
As the AI Engineering Lead, you will architect, build, and scale AI-powered solutions that accelerate both the delivery of Integrated Services Data, AI & Analytics (ISDAIA) products and the adoption of AI capabilities across the Integrated Services business.

You will lead the development of enterprise-grade AI applications, agentic systems, copilots, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, and intelligent workflow automation that transform how teams discover insights, make decisions, and deliver value.

This role combines hands-on technical leadership with product thinking and strategic execution. You will partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Teams, Analytics Leaders, and Business Stakeholders to identify high-value use cases, develop reusable AI capabilities, and enable responsible AI adoption at scale.

You will play a key role in shaping the future AI ecosystem for Integrated Services by building scalable frameworks, shared services, and AI-enabled experiences that improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and speed to delivery.

Strategic Thinking & Leadership

  • Partner with business leaders and product teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into scalable AI-powered solutions.

  • Define and communicate AI solution vision, roadmaps, and measurable success metrics.

  • Drive AI strategy across Generative AI, Agentic AI, conversational experiences, AI-enabled analytics, and intelligent automation initiatives.

  • Establish governance frameworks for Responsible AI, security, compliance, scalability, and enterprise adoption.

  • Lead cross-functional AI programs and influence executive stakeholders through compelling business cases, demonstrations, and measurable outcomes.

Technical Leadership & Expertise

  • Architect and oversee end-to-end AI solutions, including:

    • Conversational AI and Copilot experiences

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures

    • Agentic AI frameworks and multi-agent orchestration systems

    • AI-powered analytics and insight generation solutions

    • Natural language interfaces for analytics and business intelligence

    • Intelligent workflow automation and decision-support capabilities

    • Semantic search and enterprise knowledge management solutions

  • Strong proficiency in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services for AI development (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow).

  • Experience designing and deploying enterprise AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), foundation models, prompt engineering, and model evaluation frameworks.

  • Experience building AI systems using Python-based ecosystems and modern AI frameworks.

  • Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, grounding techniques, and retrieval architectures.

  • Implement scalable AI Engineering, MLOps, and LLMOps practices including CI/CD, prompt versioning, testing, governance, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Proficiency in Git, Docker, API-based deployments, cloud-native architectures, and scalable AI services.

  • Apply strong software engineering practices including modular design, testing, observability, security, and documentation.

  • Establish reusable AI frameworks, accelerators, and engineering patterns that improve speed, consistency, and quality of delivery.

  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to accelerate analytics delivery and business adoption.

  • Support architectural reviews and ensure best practices across AI systems, platforms, and products.

  • Implement Responsible AI principles including governance, explainability, privacy, security, and ethical AI compliance.

Delivery Focus

  • Own end-to-end AI solution delivery in partnership with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams.

  • Ensure production-grade deployment of AI applications, copilots, and agent-based solutions using containerization, orchestration, and scalable cloud infrastructure.

  • Build reusable AI accelerators, frameworks, and services that improve speed-to-delivery across the ISDAIA portfolio.

  • Partner with product teams to embed AI capabilities directly into dashboards, self-service analytics platforms, applications, and business workflows.

  • Influence investment decisions using measurable business impact, adoption metrics, operational efficiencies, and ROI analysis.

  • Establish monitoring frameworks for AI performance, solution effectiveness, reliability, governance, and user adoption.

Team Development & Community Leadership

  • Lead and mentor AI engineers while establishing best practices for enterprise AI development.

  • Build AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, shared tooling, libraries, and delivery patterns across ISDAIA.

  • Promote knowledge sharing through Communities of Practice and AI Centers of Excellence.

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, innovation, and engineering excellence.

  • Support talent development in emerging AI disciplines including Generative AI, Agentic AI, conversational experiences, and intelligent automation.

  • Serve as a thought leader for enterprise AI adoption and AI-enabled transformation initiatives.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent).

  • 5+ years of experience using Python-based development technologies and modern software engineering practices.
