title: Mental Health Care Specialist (Part-time)
description:
SUMMARY

The part-time Mental Health Care Specialist (MHCS) supports the mental health department by engaging potential patients via SBIRTs (i.e., Screening, Brief Intervention, and Referral to Treatment), processing and scheduling referrals to mental health (MH), answering and processing incoming telephone calls for MH, and supports LACHC’s mission “to follow Christ by loving and serving our neighbors through comprehensive, quality healthcare” in all job duties and responsibilities and demonstrate Christ-like behavior and attitude. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Include but are not limited to the following: (Other duties may be assigned.)


ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES include:

  • Use effective communication skills to build rapport with vulnerable and homeless clients.
  • Process referrals and requests for services to the MH Dept.
  • Assist with networking with local organizations for referrals to the MH Dept
  • Conduct SBIRTs for wellness checks and to motivate/engage potential clients, including telephoning patients who were discharged from hospitalization for mental health and substance use/alcohol issues.
  • Document SBIRT visits on eClinicalWorks within 3 business days from the dates of service.
  • Triage patients who are referred to the MH Department daily (for urgency).
  • Check therapists’ schedules daily and communicate with MH providers for openings to schedule new client appointments promptly.
  • Maintain a high accuracy rate when entering information into eClinicalWorks.
  • Follow proper telephone etiquette and protocol when answering & processing phone calls.
  • Manages necessary paperwork for clients (e.g., letters to patients) and sends them to clients as needed.
  • Scan required documentation into eClinicalWorks for mental health patients per protocol.
  • Mail referral packets and paperwork (e.g., consent forms) to clients as needed.
  • Communicates patient complaints to the appropriate supervisor.
  • Assist with data gathering and maintain logs (e.g., a log of referrals from partnering local missions) as needed
  • Fill and stock patient lobbies with various handouts (e.g., devotionals, flyers, brochures) regularly
  • Assists with clinic activities involving the MH Dept as needed (e.g., client groups)
  • Other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Must possess excellent interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently under general instructions, self-directed and motivated.
  • Must have reliable transportation including ability to travel locally when needed, including to different clinic sites.
  • Professional and positive attitude with an eagerness to learn.
  • Must have excellent attendance and punctuality.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to multi-task; well-organized.
  • Must be CPR certified.
  • Ability to type 40 wpm preferred.


EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor degree preferred. At least 1-year prior experience working with patients in a health care setting preferred. Prior case management experience preferred. Prior experience working with the homeless, substance using, or chronically mentally ill individuals preferred.

COMPUTER KNOWLEDGE

Experience with Microsoft Word, Microsoft Access, and Microsoft Excel preferred.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Familiarity with medical terms and operations of clinics useful. Proficiency in English required. Spanish-speaking preferred.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as totals, proportions and percentages.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be exposed to carriers of contagious diseases. The employee may have to deal with irate and irrational clients who may or may not be under the influence of mind-altering substances such as cocaine, marijuana, alcohol, etc.

The employee will have access to patient charts which contain confidential information about medical conditions and other personal matters. The employee must display a commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality at all times.

title: Principal Hydrogeologist / Principal Geologist
description:
We are SLR Consulting (Americas), a 1500+ team of advisory, environmental, engineering, and regulatory professionals across Canada, the United States, and LATAM. We deliver environmental and sustainability services to our clients through the integration of over 30 advisory, technical environmental, and engineering disciplines to help clients address some of their most complex challenges around sustainability. We are Making Sustainability Happen.

Our mining practice supports projects throughout the full life cycle, from exploration and baseline studies through permitting, closure, reclamation, and long-term environmental stewardship.

Role

SLR is seeking a Principal Hydrogeologist or Principal Geologist to join our growing practice in Anchorage or Fairbanks, Alaska. This senior leadership position offers the opportunity to guide technical excellence, develop client relationships, mentor staff, and expand SLR's mine water, hydrogeology, baseline characterization, and environmental remediation services throughout Alaska and the North American.

The successful candidate will be recognized for their expertise in hydrogeologic investigations, groundwater resource evaluations, mine permitting support, environmental baseline programs, and closure/remediation strategies. This individual will help shape the future growth of SLR's mining services while serving as a trusted advisor to clients, regulators, and project stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

Mining & Hydrogeology Leadership

  • Serve as Principal-in-Charge or Technical Director for hydrogeologic and environmental projects supporting mining developments.

  • Lead groundwater characterization, aquifer testing, water balance assessments, seepage investigations, groundwater-surface water interaction studies, and predictive hydrogeologic modeling.

  • Provide senior technical oversight for mine water management, dewatering systems, pit lake assessments, tailings facility hydrogeology, and closure planning.

  • Guide projects involving geochemical characterization, acid rock drainage (ARD), metal leaching (ML) assessments, and long-term water quality management.

Baseline Studies & Permitting

  • Lead environmental baseline investigations supporting mine permitting, expansion, and regulatory compliance.

  • Direct groundwater, surface water, water quality, hydrology, and environmental monitoring programs.

  • Support environmental review and permitting efforts, including state, federal, and tribal regulatory processes.

  • Provide technical leadership for environmental impact assessments and mine development studies.

Mine Closure & Remediation

  • Develop and review mine closure, reclamation, and post-closure monitoring strategies.

  • Provide senior oversight for contaminated site investigations and remediation associated with active and legacy mining operations.

  • Support risk assessment, corrective action planning, long-term stewardship, and regulatory negotiations.

Practice Growth & Client Development

  • Expand SLR's mining and hydrogeology services through existing and new client relationships.

  • Identify emerging opportunities related to critical minerals, mine water management, permitting, and closure/remediation.

  • Lead proposal development, project scoping, and business strategy initiatives.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor and develop technical staff across varying experience levels.

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, safety, and innovation.

  • Support recruiting, staff development, succession planning, and practice growth.

Working @ SLR

With us, there is no doubt you’ll grow your subject-matter expertise and industry knowledge. We care about investing in our employees for the long-run, and if you ask our team, they’ll tell you that’s just one of the many benefits of working here. We want to be a place where you can experience career growth and satisfaction for many years.

Here’s what else you’ll enjoy as part of our team:

  • Competitive total compensation package including comprehensive benefits, vacation, and a suite of wellness initiatives

  • The salary range for this position is $130- $180,000. Final agreed upon compensation will be commensurate with individual education, professional designation, experience, internal parity, and location.

  • Full-time, permanent role with opportunities for professional growth and advancement

Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of professional experience in hydrogeology, mining environmental consulting, geology, or related disciplines.

  • Demonstrated expertise in mine-related hydrogeologic investigations and water resource assessments.

  • Experience designing and managing environmental baseline programs for mine permitting and development projects.

  • Strong understanding of mine water management, groundwater modeling, hydrology, geochemistry, and environmental monitoring.

  • Experience supporting mine closure planning, reclamation, remediation, and long-term environmental management.

  • Familiarity with permitting and regulatory frameworks applicable to mining projects in Alaska and North America.

  • Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary technical teams and complex projects.

  • Established or developing relationships within the mining industry.

  • Strong business development, project management, communication, and leadership skills.

  • Desire to grow and lead a high-performing technical practice.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Geologist (PG), Professional Engineer (PE), or equivalent professional registration.

  • Advanced degree in Hydrogeology, Geology, Geological Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or related discipline.

  • Experience with MODFLOW or other groundwater modeling platforms.

  • Experience with mine developments, operating mines, or legacy mine remediation projects.

  • Hazardous waste management experience is a plus, particularly in industrial, environmental, or regulatory settings.

  • Existing relationships with mining companies, government agencies, and industry stakeholders.

  • Experience in Arctic, sub-Arctic, or remote operating environments.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

Artificial intelligence is not being used to screen, assess, or select applicants.

SLR strives to build diverse teams that reflect the communities we work in, and encourages applications from traditionally underrepresented groups including women, visible minorities, Indigenous peoples, people identifying as 2SLGBTQI+, veterans, and people with disabilities.

title: Senior Engineering Lead - NatWest Group
description:
Join us as a Senior Engineering Lead

  • This is a challenging role that will see you design and engineer software with the customer or user experience as the primary objective
  • With your software development background, you'll be working with architects to help define major components of the business-wide target architecture and roadmap
  • You'll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills


What you'll do

As a Senior Engineering Lead, you'll be creating great customer outcomes via engineering and innovative solutions to existing and new challenges, and technology designs which are innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust.

You'll be leading the more significant, complex and technically challenging assignments, coordinating multiple feature teams, making sure that their technical journeys support realisation of the targets, and deliver the values of the relevant metrics published to our investors.

You'll also be:

  • Defining, creating and providing oversight and governance of engineering and design solutions with a focus on end-to-end automation, simplification, resilience, security, performance, scalability and reusability
  • Working within a platform or feature team along with software engineers to design and engineer complex software, scripts and tools to enable the delivery of bank platforms, applications and services, acting as a point of contact for solution design considerations
  • Defining and developing architecture models and roadmaps of application and software components to meet business and technical requirements, driving common usability across products and domains
  • Influencing the development of strategies and architecture at domain and enterprise levels, identifying transformational opportunities for the businesses and technology areas


The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with deep expertise in Java software engineering, application architecture, and API/microservices design. You'll have a strong track record of delivering scalable, resilient solutions within Agile and DevOps environments, combining technical leadership with hands-on engineering excellence to drive innovation and engineering best practice across teams.
You'll work closely with senior stakeholders to shape technical strategy, translate complex business needs into effective solutions, and support the adoption of emerging technologies. You'll be passionate about modern software development, automation, cloud-native solutions, and the opportunities that LLMs and Agentic AI can bring to financial services.

You'll also bring:

  • Significant experience in Java software engineering, architecture, and designing APIs and microservices using modern design patterns and AWS
  • Extensive knowledge of customer journey UIs, with experience or awareness of integrating Agentic AI into user interfaces and workflow design
  • A strong background leading engineering teams in complex matrix environments, defining and delivering technical strategy, and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Expertise in DevOps, Agile delivery, automation, scalability, performance optimisation, resilience, virtualisation, and engineering best practices
  • Hands-on experience with test-driven development (TDD), automated testing frameworks, unit testing, mocking, and stubbing
  • Experience or interest in technologies such as React, Python, Generative and Agentic AI, Amazon Bedrock, AI agent development, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases

description:

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the job Graphic Designer

RMA Group is a multi-sector organization with more than 9,000 employees and an operational presence in 17 countries. For 40 years, we have developed enduring partnerships to support the needs of our clients, underpinned by the core values of Innovation, Integrity and Endurance. Through its various businesses including RMA Automotive, Global Fleet Sales, Comin Asia and Express Food Group (EFG), RMA Group has established itself as the partner of choice for leading automotive, equipment, engineering services, and food brands in Southeast Asia and beyond.

Overview and purpose of the role

﻿Graphic Designer is responsible for creating visually appealing designs that communicate ideas, enhance brand identity, and support marketing and business objectives. The role involves developing creative concepts and producing digital and print materials for various platforms and audiences.

Key responsibilities:
  • ﻿ Creative Production
    • Design visual assets for digital channels (Facebook, Telegram, website), including static posts, banners, and short-form video/motion graphics
    • Produce print and physical materials: brochures, showroom signage, event backdrops, price/spec sheets, and promotional collateral
    • Design assets for model launch events, VIP experiences, and partnership activations + Brand Consistency
    • Ensure all creative output adheres to Mercedes-Benz global brand and design guidelines (logo usage, typography, color palette, imagery standards)
    • Maintain and organize a brand asset library (logos, model imagery, templates) for consistent use across the team
  • Collaboration
    • Work closely with the Marketing Manager and Digital Marketing Executive to translate campaign briefs into visual concepts
    • Support the Product Expert and Relationship Manager teams with sales collateral (e.g. model comparison sheets, feature highlight cards)
    • Coordinate with external vendors (printers, signage companies, video editors) when production needs exceed in-house capacity
  • Photography & Video Support
    • Capture or direct photography/videography of vehicles, showroom environment, and events for use in marketing content
    • Edit photo and video assets to a polished, on-brand standard﻿
Background and experience:
  • ﻿2+ years of experience in graphic design, ideally with exposure to automotive, luxury retail, or brand-guideline-driven design work.
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro or similar) and/or equivalent design tools.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both digital and print design work.
  • Basic photography/videography skills; video editing experience is a plus.
  • luent in Khmer; working proficiency in English sufficient to interpret brand guideline documents.
  • Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent requests.

If you're interested, please send your CV to:

  • Email: recruitment.kh@rmagroup.net-
  • Telegram HR Contact Person:
  • Contact HR at: 070 790 890

﻿RMA Group is an equal opportunity employer, with a diverse group of colleagues globally representing different cultures, backgrounds, and beliefs. Our values of Innovation, Integrity and Endurance are embedded in what we do, and we welcome applicants who are committed to respecting diversity of thought, and in living our values on a day-to-day basis.

description:
WHO WE ARE


We are Fastweb + Vodafone, the leading telecommunications operator in Italy, with some of the most extensive and high‑performance proprietary infrastructures in the country, through which we manage over 20 million mobile lines and 5.6 million fixed lines.

We provide advanced digital services based on 5G, Cloud, IoT, Artificial Intelligence, and Cybersecurity to enable the digital transformation of individuals, businesses, and public institutions.


We believe in a leadership approach founded on trust, constructive feedback, inclusion, and people development.



WHAT IT MEANS TO BE PART OF FASTWEB + VODAFONE


What will you find at Fastweb + Vodafone?


Our values—Spark Passion, Aim High, Stand True—guide our daily work.
Together, we create an environment where every person can make a difference.
Guiding us is our Leadership Model: a shared language that defines how to lead with awareness at every level.


A community, not just a team — BELONGING & INCLUSION
You work in an open and collaborative environment where your ideas matter and differences are a strength.

Continuous learning and development, meaningful feedback, constructive dialogue, and high‑impact projects. In a company that drives real innovation in the country, you have the space to grow and make your mark.


Feel good, work better — FLEXIBILITY & WELLBEING


You have smart working, a shorter workweek, “no clock‑in” and “yes to trust and goals.”
Your wellbeing and work‑life balance come before everything else.


We do things that matter — SUSTAINABILITY & CUSTOMER
Sustainable choices and a customer‑first approach: with our technology, your work has a real impact on Italy and on the future.

YOUR BENEFITS


A benefits package designed to support you at every stage of your life:


Growth and development

Grow through continuous learning and development paths, along with dedicated programs designed to build the skills of the future.


Flexibility and time for yourself

You can enjoy smart working up to two thirds of your working days, plan your in office days over the quarter, and benefit from a shorter workweek with Friday afternoon off.


Parenthood

Up to 4 months of paid parental leave, flexible shifts, and dedicated leave options.


Study and education

Time off to sit your exams, leave options, and support if you have children with special educational needs (BES/DSA).


Wellbeing

Health insurance, psychological support, free legal support, financial education, caregiving support, and the opportunity to take part in sports and cultural events.


Bonus and welfare

A performance bonus that you can convert into welfare benefits, with an additional company contribution.


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


At Fastweb + Vodafone, we are looking for a

INTERNSHIP - Vulnerability Management & Cloud Security

for the Team

Cyber Resilience

In qualità di stagista nel team di Cyber Prevention, con il supporto e la guida del tuo tutor, contribuirai alle seguenti attività:

  • Supporto all'Enabling e Kick-off: collaborare all'organizzazione dei tavoli di avvio dei test, contribuendo alla raccolta dei requisiti tecnici (ambienti, accessi, credenziali) e al coordinamento con i team di Ingegneria e Operations.

  • Supporto all'Analisi dei Risultati: partecipare alle sessioni di chiusura dei test, contribuendo alla verifica della completezza dei report dei fornitori e al corretto inserimento dei finding nella piattaforma di gestione.

  • Supporto alla condivisione delle “Security Issue”: contribuire alla preparazione dei materiali per la spiegazione e la divulgazione delle vulnerabilità verso i team interessati.

  • Supporto alla gestione dei fornitori: affiancare il team nella relazione con i fornitori esterni di sicurezza, contribuendo alla raccolta dei requisiti di progetto e al monitoraggio della pianificazione.

  • Supporto alla valutazione della security posture in cloud (CSPM): affiancare il team nella gestione e nel monitoraggio delle regole di detection.

  • Supporto alla verifica e validazione delle soluzioni cloud/prem: affiancare il team nella verifica della corretta implementazione delle soluzioni di sicurezza in ambiente cloud o on premise, contribuendo alla validazione della loro efficacia.

COSA IMPARERAI?

  • Gestire end to end il ciclo di vita di un assessment di sicurezza

  • Formulare valutazioni risk-oriented sulle implicazioni e sulle conseguenze degli elementi che emergono

  • Relazionarti con i fornitori

  • Comprendere le dinamiche interne di valutazione di problematiche di sicurezza

  • Configurare le piattaforme cloud per segnalare tempestivamente difformità

  • Leggere e interpretare i segnali di deviazione

UNISCITI A NOI SE…

  • Sei interessato/a a intraprendere un percorso di crescita nel mondo della Cyber Security.

  • Le tue competenze e attitudini sono in linea con quanto descritto nella Job Description.

  • Sei curioso e intraprendente e ti piace sperimentare e “toccare con mano” gli aspetti tecnici

MUST HAVE

  • Percorso di studi (in corso o concluso) in materie tecnico/scientifiche (es. Informatica, Ingegneria, Sicurezza Informatica) o equivalente.

  • Buone doti organizzative e propensione al lavoro in team.

  • Capacità di analisi e attenzione al dettaglio.

  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Competenza tecnica nell'uso di strumenti di VA/PT (es. Nessus, Burp Suite, Metasploit) e conoscenza di base dei sistemi operativi e protocolli di rete/web.

  • Possesso di certificazioni in ambito di security (e.g. Comptia Security+).

  • Conoscenza teorica dei principali framework di sicurezza (es. ISO 27001, OWASP Top 10).

  • Curiosità verso il mondo cloud e i concetti di sicurezza applicata (CSPM).

Lige nu søger vi flere udadvendte og strukturerede kolleger, der vil hjælpe med kontakt, support og afvikling af vores events. Vi ansætter løbende og sørger naturligvis for fuld oplæring!

Dine opgaver

Relationer: Du holder den daglige kontakt med vores influencer-profiler og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Support: Du håndterer henvendelser, følger op på aftaler og løser mindre praktiske opgaver.

Eventafvikling: Du er hands-on til vores events sammen med teamet. Du er med til at sikre en gnidningsfri afvikling og en fantastisk stemning – det skal være sjovt at være der!

Kommunikation: Du hjælper med klar og venlig kommunikation, så vores brugere altid oplever et højt serviceniveau.

Koordinering: Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger, både på kontoret og online.

Hvem er du?
Du behøver ikke selv at være influencer. Det vigtigste er, at du kan lide mennesker, er god til at holde overblikket og trives dér, hvor der sker noget.

Du er serviceminded, pålidelig og nem at samarbejde med.

Du formulerer dig klart og fejlfrit på dansk – både på skrift og i tale.

Du kan lide balancen mellem skærmarbejde og at være med "ude i marken" til events.

Bonus: Det er en fordel, hvis du har kørekort og bil, men det er ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

Fuld oplæring: Vi klæder dig grundigt på til alle opgaverne.
Stor fleksibilitet: Vi tilbyder skiftende vagter (efter aftale) på typisk mellem 10 og 36 timer om ugen – perfekt, hvad enten du søger deltid eller fuldtid.

Hybrid arbejdsplads: Du kan arbejde fra vores kontor på Lolland/Falster eller i København, med mulighed for op til 2-3 hjemmearbejdsdage om ugen.

Et stærkt hold: Vi har flere ledige stillinger og ansætter løbende, så du bliver del af et voksende og engageret team.

Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning afsted hurtigst muligt.

title: GSOC Analyst- Night Shift
description:
About Crisis24
Crisis24 is a global, AI-enhanced provider of travel risk management, mass communications, critical event management, crisis-security consulting, personal protection solutions and global medical concierge capabilities, allowing prominent organizations, disruptive brands and influential people to operate with confidence in an uncertain world. Backed by proprietary AI-enabled SaaS technologies, advanced Global Operations Centers, an extensive global footprint, and the largest team of private-sector intelligence analysts in the world, we deliver localized insights and global perspectives alongside medical, security, crisis response, embedded intelligence, and consultancy services as a preferred partner for Fortune 500 corporations.
At Crisis24, we don't just offer jobs – we offer missions. We recruit the very best from the military, intelligence agencies, academia, law enforcement, medicine, or any of our areas of specialty. We protect more than places. We protect people, reputations, and lifestyles, with integrity, discipline, discretion, and purpose. Whether you're stepping into civilian life after service, seeking personal or professional growth, or bringing specialized expertise to a higher calling, we match your ambition with real opportunity. The ideal candidate will have sharp situational awareness, excellent communication skills, and a collaborative mindset. Primary responsibilities include the real-time monitoring of video surveillance systems, intrusion alarms, and access control events, as well as coordinating with on-site security teams to ensure timely and effective incident response.
In addition to monitoring physical security systems, the SOC Analyst will also assist in tracking global events from verified sources to identify any potential impacts to personnel or assets. Candidates must be capable of quickly analyzing incoming information, escalating incidents as appropriate, and drafting clear, concise communications for a broad internal audience. This role is critical to maintaining a secure and informed environment across all operational sites.
What You Will Work On

Monitor and administer access control, video management, and intrusion detection systems, including dispatch of security officers when needed while meeting the performance criteria
Monitor events through open-source collection and coordination with local assets
Respond to inbound calls from employees and security personnel providing customer service focused responses
Write security incident investigation reports to provide situational awareness and communicate risks to management
Monitor designated online tools to conduct situational awareness on social media platforms
Collect, evaluate, and disseminate intelligence to support action plans based on credibility and likelihood
Perform proactive threat intelligence gathering and response, including but not limited to: event monitoring, persons of interest, execution protection intelligence
Contribute to procedures and processes to standardize and enhance risk management
Work closely with various teams responsible for security, operations, and incident management
Provide emergency and non-emergency security system monitoring, event dispatch, and emergency notification services
Process and maintain a wide variety of files, logs, reports, and forms
Responsible for performing, evidencing, and supporting all necessary tasks for audits
Processing badge requests – Printing, deactivating, adding and removing access levels
Be cross trained in all Analyst services
This Job Description is not a comprehensive list of all required activities, duties, or responsibilities. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at the discretion of the leadership at any time with or without notice

What You Will Bring

1–3+ years of experience in a Security Operations Analyst role preferred
Bachelor’s degree in a related field is strongly preferred. Either bachelor's degree or equivalent military experience
Have an interest or direct experience in the following: Intelligence, Security Operations, Critical Incident Management or Corporate Security, Emergency Management
Must be well-versed in current technologies and open-source search methodologies
Must be a competent user of Microsoft Suite and Google Suite
Must be willing to sign an NDA and maintain strict confidentiality
Must be able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing
Ability to maintain a professional demeanor during stressful situations
Must be able to quickly adapt and excel in dynamic situations
Demonstrated organizational and time management skills
Successful client management experience
A demonstrated history of effective conflict resolution skills
Maintain composure in dealing with authorities, executives, clients, staff, and the public occasionally under conditions of urgency and in pressure situations
Ability to attend training events and mandatory meetings that fall outside normal work hours
Ability to work 8 to 12-hour shifts both days and nights

Work Environment
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions. In addition to other demands, the demands of the job include:

Undergoing and meet company standards for background and reference checks, and drug tests if required
Exposure to sensitive and confidential information
Regular computer usage

Occasional reaching with hands and arms, stooping, kneeling, crouching and/or crawling

Technical Skills:

SAP experience is required (or strong familiarity with an equivalent enterprise ERP system).
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Office Suite (considered an asset).
Familiarity with POs, vendor invoicing/VIM, and shipping/receiving documentation.

High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and strong data-entry speed.
Dependable with strong organizational and multi-tasking skills.

Ability to work reliably on-site Monday through Friday (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM).

title: Senior Product Associate for Workforce Planning Applications
description:
Job Description

As a Senior Associate within the Workforce Center of Excellence, you will support transformation of workforce planning and analytics capabilities by partnering with business stakeholders and agile delivery teams. You will help enhance and maintain capacity planning solutions supporting Home Lending and Operations teams, translating needs into well-defined Jira epics/stories and supporting delivery across data, application, and reporting layers.

You will contribute to the transformation and modernization of our forecasting environment by understanding the existing landscape, diving into the pain points and delivering target state solutions. You will have proven success in prior finance and technology roles working closely with planning & analysis teams, with a special focus on Product, and need to have experience in developing and delivering new tools and solutions using cloud-based technologies (i.e., AWS, Databricks, etc.). You will have a keen understanding of the forecasting process, the various budgetary and regulatory cycles, and aim to improve forecast accuracy and efficiency. You will understand the need of Finance and through your ability and passion to think beyond existing data and processes, you will use both existing and cutting edge forecasting solutions to empower the team to create timely and accurate forecasts.

Job responsibilities
  • Partner with business stakeholders to elicit requirements, clarify priorities, and translate needs into a product backlog (epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria) in Jira.
  • Support agile ceremonies (refinement, sprint planning, demos, retros) and work day-to-day with scrum teams to drive execution and remove blockers.
  • Contribute to solution design by collaborating with technology leads and engineers; produce lightweight design/requirements artifacts to support implementation.

title: vi SØGER medhjælper til GC KLUB SLAGELSE (VESTSJÆLLAND)
description:
vi SØGER medhjælper til GC KLUB SLAGELSE (VESTSJÆLLAND)

PÆDAGOG/-ASSISTENT/-studerende/LÆRER EL. LIGN.

5 timer pr. måned

Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for højtbegavede børn og unge og deres familier?

Vi er en frivillig forening med 5.900 medlemmer og et engageret team, bestyrelse og en masse frivillige, der arbejder for at skabe positive forandringer.

Vi er et engageret netværk og interesseorganisation, dedikeret til at fremme trivsel og udvikling hos børn og unge med en IQ på over 125. Det modsvarer de intelligensmæssigt øverste 5% af årgangen. Vores mål er at hjælpe børnene med at udfolde deres fulde potentiale til gavn for dem selv, deres familier og samfundet som helhed.

Om behovet

Vi søger en medhjælper til vores klub i Slagelse/Vestsjælland (på Vestermose Natur- og Idrætsfriskole) 10 søndage om året.

GC Klub er et fællesskab for vores medlemmer, hvor børnene og deres forældre mødes i en af vores ti klubber i landet til fælles hygge, leg, venskab og netværk med andre ligesindede. Vi mødes som udgangspunkt 10 søndage om året i 4 timer.

Som medhjælper er du klubbens faste holdepunkt på hver klubdag, hvor du sørger for at tage imod deltagere, igangsætte aktiviteter, koordinere oprydning til slut og låse af bagefter. Du fungerer desuden som go-to ved praktiske spørgsmål og hjælper med forslag til aktiviteter og deltager også gerne selv i dem.

Klubberne har typisk også tilknyttet en frivillig tovholder fra foreningen, som du koordinerer med ift. fx at aftale aktiviteter, praktiske ting m.m. til næste klubdag.

Personlige egenskaber

  • Du er god med børn

  • Du er pligtopfyldende

  • Du er åben og imødekommende

  • Du har gode kommunikationsevner

Din baggrund

  • I vores andre klubber har medhjælperne forskellige baggrunde, og det kan være, at du er pædagog/-assistent/-medhjælper/-studerende, lærer, lærerstuderende el.lign.

  • Du har erfaring med/interesse for at arbejde børn

  • Du har muligvis kendskab til højtbegavede børn (ikke et et krav)

  • Du er bosat inden for rimelig afstand til Slagelse

  • Du har ren straffeattest og børneattest

Stillingen er en freelancestilling gældende for 10 klubdage om året, der aflønnes med 5 timer pr. gang. Vi prioriterer en person, som ønsker at være vores faste anker i klubben i en længere periode.

Er du interesseret, så send en kort motivation og dit CV til bo.ll@giftedchildren.dk senest 20. september 2026.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtale, hvorfor stillingen kan blive taget ned, hvis en ansættelse sker inden deadline.

description:

Closing Date: Open Until Filled.

Job Title: Outpatient Counselor I, II, or III.

Salary/Wage: $25.34/per hr. $28.73/per hr. $31.73/per hr.

Tribal Level: TL: 114.1, TL: 117.1, TL: 120.1

Location: Siletz, OR.

Classification: Full-Time, Non-Exempt.

Job Posting Number: 4092588



INTRODUCTION:

The incumbent shall be sensitive to the diversity of Native cultures as well as have knowledge of the disease concept of alcoholism/substance abuse and other addictions. Must become certified as a Certified Alcohol Drug Counselor I (CADC I) through Addiction Counselor Certification Board of Oregon (MHACBO) within 24-months of hire.


The incumbent will support the work of the Outpatient Counselor II, Transitional Living Center (TLC) staff, Peer Recovery Mentors, and Mental Health Therapists by assisting them in providing wrap around services for clients.


DUTIES:

  • The outpatient alcohol and other drug abuse treatment program shall provide to each client those services and activities appropriate to address the problems as identified from the diagnostic assessment and document the time or manner of each service or activity in the clients record:
  • Individual, one-to-one, counseling.
  • Group Counseling.
  • Family counseling.
  • Comprehensive alcohol and other drug education.
  • Health education including the potential impact of alcohol and other drug use on the fetus.
  • HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis; sexually transmitted diseases, and other information and risk assessment.
  • Relapse prevention planning.
  • Conduct interviews, evaluation, assessments, and formulate diagnostic impressions.
  • Prioritize treatment plan objectives that are individualized, current, strengths based, include services and activities, include family participation, documents progress, and are appropriate to address identified obstacles to recovery using ASAM Placement Criteria and Indian Health Services Standards (CDMIS).
  • Establish and maintain up-to-date, accurate client case records and submit activity and service records according to ASAM, and CDMIS. Enter client information into NextGen and MOTTS, or other electronic health and/or state database systems.
  • Design with the client the development of an individual, mental, physical, and recreational program; skill building for independent living; and referrals to self-help groups and other service delivery.
  • Work with the Peer Recovery Mentors to assist clients in carrying out the individualized plan.
  • Make referrals to Mental Health and other services, as identified in the assessment and case plan.
  • Serve as an advocate for clientele in obtaining social, medical, educational, or vocational services.
  • Provide individual, group, and family counseling to those in need of such services.
  • Document the client’s response or lack of response towards achieving the individualized objectives in the client’s treatment activities.
  • Assist individuals into an appropriate inpatient treatment resource, if necessary and participate in aftercare planning and service delivery. Refer and assist clients to the appropriate detoxification services programs when it is appropriate, or to local emergency hospital.
  • Be a team member; assist in the continued development and implementation of an overall, comprehensive Behavioral Health program for the Confederated Tribes of Siletz Indians.
  • To the extent of resources available and as clinically indicated, shall provide clients with information; prevention, education and referrals to community and tribal services; and various private, civic, local or governmental agencies/groups. Communicate and coordinate with the inmate counselor at the Lincoln County or other jails to provide Siletz Tribal Members with appointments upon release from jail, and make referrals to providers and residential programs when it is appropriate.
  • Assist to manage and maintain the Ropes course and all the gear and equipment that come with it. Assist with maintaining and organizing rafting, kayaking and wilderness equipment.
  • Acct as a team member to continuously improve the business processes used in the department and the electronic data so that it meets the needs of the department to ensure accurate health care service reporting and billing.
  • Maintain accurate, up to date health records, and participate in quality assurance activities.
  • Gather and report outcome data.
  • Complete other reports as assigned.
  • Build relationships with other treatment providers and resources in the community and the state to provide clients with wrap-around services and more access to treatment in a timely manner.
  • Partner with Prevention and Mental Health staff to provide early intervention and facilitate activities with youth and the general population from with the community.
  • Establish strong relationships with the community, so that the Behavioral Health program is seen as a resource for all community members.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

title: 2nd shift Slitter Operator
description:
Why Great Northern
Established in 1962, Great Northern is a local, privately owned paper-based packaging manufacturer with a long history of providing secure, stable, and meaningful positions. You will experience a collaborative team-first, safe, clean, enjoyable, and predictable workplace where team members support and care for one another. Our team members produce sustainable and eco-friendly products that are supplied to national brands that impact people's day-to-day lives.

Great Northern is committed to making a difference in the lives of our team members, customers, and the communities in which we live and work. Many of our team members were referred by their friends and families who are already a part of the Great Northern team.

Position Summary
The 2nd Shift Slitter Operator is responsible for setting up and running the slitter, cut paper to proper size and measurements according to customer specifications. Helps to produce the finest quality product at rates and standards consistent with the Company's desire to be a Preferred Supplier of cost-effective, top quality products.

Pay/Schedule

Starting salary of $20.00 - $22.00/hour, depending on experience
3:00pm - 11:00pm Monday - Friday

The Benefits of Great Northern

Competitive 401K match and a historically generous profit-sharing retirement savings contribution
9 paid holidays
Paid vacation during your first year of employment
Medical plan options are available to provide flexibility in choosing the one that best suits your individual and family needs
Climate-controlled facility with a clean, comfortable breakroom
Opportunities to advance your career and compensation level
Flexible overtime opportunities when available and/or needed
Ability to give and/or trade shifts with other team members
Annual merit increases as well as market benchmarking to ensure competitive wages
Health/fitness and tuition reimbursements

Responsibilities

Sets up and operates slitter machine to cut continuous lengths of material into strips of specified widths.
Spaces rotary blades on machine shaft, according to width specified for strips, and turns setscrews to secure blades in position.
Mounts roll of material on machine supports and threads material over tension bar, between feed rollers, and under rotary blades.
Observes flow of material in the slitting and rewinding operation and examines cut strips for defects; adjusts as needed.
Disengages winding shaft and removes narrow rolls of material.
Participate in continuous improvement and effectively communicate opportunities to improve efficiencies and effectiveness for this position.
All other reasonable duties as required.

Opportunities for Growth
You will have the opportunity to learn new skills and acquire new knowledge that can be applied to grow into new positions with higher pay. Furthermore, you can grow your career with Great Northern through advancement opportunities available at our facilities both locally and nationally.

Expectation
To be successful your teammates will depend on you to have pride in your work, be on time, work safely, work effectively with others, be optimistic, take ownership of your responsibilities, and look for continuous improvement opportunities.

title: AI First Software Engineer
description:
Bij Ecare ga je niet verder bouwen aan het zoveelste losstaande softwaresysteem.

Je bouwt aan PUUR. Behandel: nieuwe functionaliteit waarmee behandelaren en zorgteams vanuit één cliëntdossier kunnen samenwerken. Geen apart zorg- en behandeldossier, maar informatie en functionaliteit rond dezelfde cliënt bij elkaar.

Je begint niet op een leeg vel. Het platform, de architectuur, de klanten en belangrijke basisfunctionaliteiten van PUUR. zijn er al. Tegelijkertijd staat het nieuwe productteam aan het begin. Juist daar ligt jouw rol.

De functie

Als AI First Software Engineer werk je in een nieuw multidisciplinair team met een Product Owner, een zorginhoudelijke domeinexpert, een architect, QA en een andere software-engineer.

AI First betekent dat je bij iedere stap in het ontwikkelproces bewust beoordeelt wat AI kan toevoegen. Van analyse en ontwerp tot programmeren, testen, code review en datavraagstukken. Je zet AI in waar het je helpt om sneller of beter te ontwikkelen en kiest bewust voor een andere aanpak wanneer dat verstandiger is. Je blijft daarbij zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en begrijpt en beheerst wat je oplevert.

In de eerste productfase werkt het team in ongeveer 4,5 maand toe naar een bruikbare pilot. We proberen niet alles tegelijk te bouwen. Samen bepalen we een haalbare scope en ontwikkelen we behandelfunctionaliteit die veilig is, werkt in de dagelijkse praktijk en een goede basis vormt voor verdere ontwikkeling.


Je houdt je bezig met:

  • Ontwikkelen van nieuwe behandelfunctionaliteit binnen PUUR.

  • Bouwen met C#, .NET en React binnen onze Azure-omgeving.

  • Aansluiten op de bestaande architectuur, platformdiensten en cliëntgegevens.

  • AI inzetten bij onder andere analyse, programmeren, testen, code review en datavraagstukken.

  • Beoordelen wanneer AI wel en niet de beste aanpak is.

  • Controleren, testen en beheersbaar houden van software die met ondersteuning van AI wordt ontwikkeld.

  • Meedenken over technische keuzes, prioriteiten en scope.

  • Samenwerken met behandelaren en zorgorganisaties om functionaliteit in de praktijk te toetsen.


Wat deze rol anders maakt dan veel andere softwarefuncties:

  • AI is geen experiment naast je gewone werk, maar een vast onderdeel van je ontwikkelproces.

  • Je voegt niet alleen nieuwe features toe aan een bestaand product. Je bouwt vanaf de start mee aan een nieuw productdomein.

  • Je hoeft niet eerst een compleet platform op te zetten. De technische basis is er, waardoor je snel aan het product kunt bouwen.

De uitdaging zit in de balans: je maakt tempo en benut AI maximaal, maar blijft zelf verantwoordelijk voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en onderhoudbaarheid.


Wat deze rol interessant maakt

  • Je bouwt vanaf de start mee aan PUUR. Behandel.

  • Je brengt zorg en behandeling samen in één cliëntdossier.

  • Je werkt op een bestaand technisch fundament én aan een volledig nieuw productdomein.

  • Je krijgt veel invloed op de manier waarop het nieuwe team AI inzet.

  • Je werkt met moderne technologie zoals .NET, React en Azure.

  • Je werkt samen met een Product Owner, domeinexpert, architect, QA en software-engineers.

  • Je hebt direct contact met de praktijk waarvoor je ontwikkelt.

  • Je werkt in korte tijd toe naar een product dat daadwerkelijk gebruikt gaat worden.

  • Je ziet direct wat jouw werk betekent voor behandelaren, zorgteams en cliënten.

  • Je hebt ongeveer drie tot vier jaar relevante ervaring als software-engineer.

  • Je hebt ervaring met C#, .NET en backendontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring met React en bent bereid om fullstack te werken.

  • Je hebt ervaring met Azure, CI/CD, DevOps en geautomatiseerd testen.

  • Je gebruikt AI minimaal één jaar dagelijks binnen professionele softwareontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt software waarbij AI onderdeel was van je ontwikkelproces daadwerkelijk naar productie gebracht.

  • Je kunt uitleggen wanneer je AI wel en juist niet inzet.

  • Je begrijpt en controleert de code die je met ondersteuning van AI ontwikkelt.

  • Je denkt na over architectuur, kwaliteit en beheersbaarheid.

  • Je past je gemakkelijk aan wanneer nieuwe AI-tools of werkwijzen beter blijken te werken.

  • Je communiceert duidelijk en werkt graag intensief samen met anderen.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed.

  • Je bent bereid om gemiddeld de helft van je werktijd bij Ecare in Enschede te werken.


Ervaring met zorgsoftware, een elektronisch cliëntdossier of behandeldossiers is een pré, maar geen vereiste.
Dit is geen functie voor een AI- of machine-learningspecialist die modellen ontwikkelt of traint. We zoeken een software-engineer die AI aantoonbaar heeft geïntegreerd in de dagelijkse manier van ontwikkelen.

title: Social- og sundhedshjælper i aftenvagt søges til Kalundborg Kommune
description:
Vil du med på holdet, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Stillingen er som fast aftenvagt på 28 timer. Der er mulighed for andet timetal, hvis du ønsker dette.

Der er mulighed for at arbejde 5-2 men også 3-2.

Om jobbet

  • Vi søger nye kollegaer. Vores teams dækker hele Kalundborg Kommune.
  • Vi arbejder i mindre teams, hvor du som SSH med indflydelse på egne opgaver hjælper og støtter borgere i eget hjem.
  • Du arbejder med helhedspleje.

  • I dit arbejde afspejler du voes værdier, medansvar, dialog, trivsel, respekt og stolthed.
  • Du indgår i et tværfagligt samarbejde, hvor sparring er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Anerkendelse er et af nøgleordene i vores dialoger.
  • Som ny medarbejder, får du en grundig introduktion i gruppen, en oplæring, tilpasset dit behov.
  • Du gennemgår introkursus, kursus i vores omsorgssystem Nexus samt forflytningskursus.

Din profil

  • Du er uddannet Social- og sundhedshjælper.
  • Du sætter pris på godt kollegaskab, og tager det gode humør med på arbejde.
  • Du tør bringe dine ideer i spil.
  • Du arbejder for en udvikling, af både dit eget faglige niveau samt dine kollegers.
  • Du udnytter dine faglige kompetencer i helhedsplejen.
  • Du er god til at skabe et overblik.
  • Du sætter pris på den anerkendende tilgang.
  • Du brænder for det tværfaglige samarbejde, samt et tæt samarbejde med borgerne og deres pårørende.
  • Du arbejder med en rehabiliterende tilgang.
  • Du har kørekort.

Derfor skal du vælge os

  • Vi sætter relations arbejdet i højsædet og ønsker at være de bedste til at skabe kvalitet i borgerarbejdet, i fællesskab med borgerne og gerne deres pårørende.
  • Vi er de hjælpsomme, skønne og lyttende kollegaer.
  • Vi har et miljø, med godt sammenhold kollegaer og ledere imellem, hvor vi er åbne for nye ideer, som kan være med til at skabe den gode arbejdsplads.
  • Du og hele teamet har et fælles ansvar for planlægningen sammen med planlæggger og afdelingsleder.
  • Sammen sikrer vi stabile ruter, som er afgørende for det gode forløb, den gode relation og det rehabiliterende arbejde.
  • Vi prioriterer ressourcer til at styrke vores kompetencer og arbejder målrettet sammen med borgerne, så de oplever at livskvaliteten og deres selvstændige livsførelse øges.
  • Vi arbejder for den gode trivsel og har fokus på forebyggelse af omsorgstræthed.

Hvornår kan du starte, tænker du nok allerede? Vi har svaret til dig lige her:

Gerne hurtigst muligt! og når det passer dig.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Overenskomst mellem FOA og KL

Hvis du vil vide mere

Er du velkommen til at kontakte

Afdelingsleder Janni Rasmussen på telefon 21593266 eller

Afdelingsleder Bodil Mouritsen på telefon 21527983

Ansøgning

Ansøgning samt oplysninger om uddannelse og tidligere beskæftigelse sendes via digitalt link.

Ansøgningsfrist den 21. september 2026

Hos os er medarbejderne med til at gøre en forskel hver dag, sammen med ca. 3500 kollegaer. Kalundborg Kommune er placeret i noget af Danmarks smukkeste natur – og er samtidig hjemsted for en række af de industrier der bidrager mest til den danske økonomi – med vægt på biotech- og energiproduktion.

Der bor cirka 49.000 mennesker i Kalundborg Kommune, som også er hjemsted for flere og flere uddannelser, der er med til at understøtte udviklingen i kommunen.

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a team of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.

The team

This role is part of the Runtime team, but will include deep collaboration with the Research, Hardware, and Fleet teams.

In this role you will:

  • Drive the architecture and implementation of embedded firmware for devices crucial to PI’s data collection goals

  • Work with hardware and software teams to ensure the new devices we are building work seamlessly with existing and future data pipelines

  • Embedded Linux System Bring-up: Lead the integration of embedded Linux devices with real-time sensor processing. This includes developing drivers for high-speed sensors, BSP development and customization, kernel configuration and debugging, hardware bring-up, and performance tuning across the hardware/software boundary.

  • Hardware/Software Debugging: Use hardware abstraction tools and laboratory equipment to identify and resolve complex timing issues, race conditions, and hardware-software interface bugs.

  • Power Optimization: Analyze and reduce power consumption for battery-operated devices, including on radio sleep states and sensor low-power modes.

What we hope you'll bring:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

  • Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills, including building data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and tools for rapid iteration.

  • Comfort working hands-on with hardware.

  • Strong communication skills for collaborating with hardware, software, and research teams

  • Demonstrated experience leading initiatives from concept to production on aggressive schedules, and turning ambiguous product goals into functional requirements

  • Experience leading initial board bring-up and software design for first-of-their-kind embedded devices.

  • Hands-on experience with SPI, I2C, UART, USB, and the ability to debug complex hardware-software interactions.

  • Experience architecting, implementing and debugging concurrent and multithreaded firmware services

  • Deep understanding of modern operating systems, computer architecture, and trade-offs between compute, memory, and storage.

  • Experience bringing up and integrating sensors on embedded systems; camera system bring-up, integration, and tuning is a plus.

  • Proficiency in C++

  • Familiarity with Bash scripting and Python for tooling and automation.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Nice to have: Direct experience with Linux Kernel development, including writing or debugging drivers, managing device trees, or optimizing kernel-space performance.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is seeking Senior Infrastructure Engineers to design, build, and operate the high-performance virtual networking dataplane that underpins OCI gateway services. In this role, you will develop major C and C++ features for packet processing, routing, network address translation, gateway functionality, and security-policy enforcement. You will optimize CPU and memory efficiency, concurrency, latency, and throughput for production systems operating at cloud scale.

You will partner with networking, control-plane, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to build fault-tolerant distributed systems with strong tenant isolation and safe deployment practices. The role includes end-to-end feature ownership: architecture, implementation, testing, staged rollout, observability, on-call support, incident response, and continuous operational improvement. Experience with fast dataplane technologies such as DPDK, VirtIO, eBPF, XDP, SR-IOV, SmartNICs, or userspace packet-processing frameworks is especially valuable.

Key Responsibilities:

Dataplane Scalability and Performance

  • Implement and enhance C and C++ components for OCI’s virtual networking dataplane, including routing, network address translation, network gateways, and security-policy enforcement.
  • Build packet-processing features that support scalable, multi-tenant cloud networking with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Profile and optimize CPU utilization, memory usage, concurrency, latency, and throughput in large-scale production environments.
  • Contribute to fast dataplane development using technologies such as DPDK, VirtIO, Linux networking, SR-IOV, SmartNICs, or userspace packet-processing frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain unit, integration, system, performance, and scale tests.

  • Participate in design and code reviews, applying established patterns for performance, correctness, and maintainability.

Reliability and Availability

  • Implement fault-tolerant networking components that handle failures, maintenance events, and software updates with minimal customer impact.
  • Contribute to resilient designs using health checks, retries, timeouts, graceful draining, failover, and recovery mechanisms.
  • Develop fault-injection, brownout, and recovery tests to validate service behavior.

  • Support staged deployments, automated validation, monitoring, rollback, and recovery procedures.

Observability and Operational Excellence

  • Build and maintain service metrics, alarms, dashboards, telemetry, canaries, and operational health checks.
  • Diagnose Linux, networking, performance, and production issues using logs, metrics, packet captures, traces, profilers, and debugging tools.
  • Create and improve runbooks, diagnostic tools, and automation for common operational issues.

  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action follow-through.

Security and Multi-Tenant Isolation

  • Apply established security and tenant-isolation practices to dataplane and gateway features.
  • Help identify and remediate security, reliability, and operational risks.

  • Maintain technical documentation and follow applicable security, compliance, and change-management processes.

Automation and Change Management

  • Maintain automation and infrastructure-as-code used to build, test, deploy, and operate the service.
  • Implement automated checks and safeguards for configuration changes, software releases, and rollback procedures.
  • Own assigned features through implementation, testing, deployment, production validation, and support.

Core Responsibilities:

Planning and Execution

  • Plan and deliver assigned work with limited supervision, identifying dependencies and risks early.
  • Manage priorities and adjust execution as requirements, timelines, or production needs change.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and technical decisions clearly.

Collaboration and Partnership

  • Work closely with networking, control-plane, infrastructure, security, and operations teams.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, incident reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Document technical decisions and contribute to team standards and best practices.

Problem Solving

  • Independently troubleshoot standard and moderately complex issues using established engineering practices.
  • Analyze data from logs, metrics, traces, packet captures, and tests to identify root causes.
  • Escalate complex cross-service issues appropriately while contributing to their resolution.

Continuous Learning and Improvement

  • Build expertise in C/C++, systems programming, cloud networking, Linux, and high-performance dataplane technologies.
  • Seek feedback and apply it to improve technical and operational skills.
  • Identify practical opportunities to improve testing, tooling, deployment, observability, and team workflows.

Working as a Meat Associate at Walmart Canada is a great opportunity to grow your skills in a fast‑paced retail environment. In this role, you deliver outstanding customer service by living Walmart’s values, keeping the meat department clean, organized, and well‑stocked, and supporting daily sales activities. title: Associate Director - Civils
description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves\: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story\:' https\://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organisation makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centres driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimising energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

About You

We are seeking a commercially astute and technically accomplished civil engineering professional with a proven track record of leading complex projects and high-performing teams. Chartered (MICE or equivalent), you bring significant consultancy experience and the confidence to operate at a strategic level, balancing technical excellence with financial accountability. You will be a natural leader who builds strong client relationships, identifies growth opportunities and inspires those around you. Forward-thinking and solutions-focused, motivated by delivering impactful infrastructure while contributing to the long-term success and direction of the business.

About the Role

As Civil Associate Director, you will play a pivotal leadership role within the business, combining technical excellence with strategic and commercial oversight. You will lead the successful delivery of complex civil engineering projects from inception through to completion, while managing client relationships, driving business development and ensuring financial performance across your portfolio. Working closely with senior leadership, you will help shape the direction of the division, mentor and develop high-performing teams, and uphold the highest standards of quality, innovation and professionalism. This role offers significant influence, autonomy and a clear pathway for further progression.

Responsibilities

As a Civil Associate Director we will count on you to\:

  • Lead the delivery of complex civil engineering projects across infrastructure, drainage, utilities and development schemes
  • Provide technical direction and governance to ensure excellence and compliance
  • Build and strengthen long-term client partnerships
  • Identify, secure and convert new business opportunities
  • Take ownership of financial performance, forecasting and risk management
  • Mentor and develop high-performing engineers and future leaders
  • Contribute to business planning and strategic growth initiatives

Requirements

  • BEng, MSc, or equivalent qualification in Civil, Structural Engineering or relevant subject
  • Chartered Engineer (MICE or equivalent)
  • Extensive consultancy experience designing and managing infrastructure projects within civil engineering (ideally 8yrs minimum). (experience working on Data Centre projects is highly desirable)
  • Strong leadership and team development capability
  • Commercially astute with experience managing budgets and profitability
  • Proven ability to win and grow client accounts
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills

title: Sr. Interior Designer
description:
At Northland Properties, we’re on a mission to build spaces where people come together. We believe in thinking differently, sparking connections, and building strong relationships. We challenge the status quo by partnering our design, construction, and operations groups to create beautifully designed structures and interior spaces, shaped by a deep understanding of context and culture, enhancing how people interact with their environment. We just happen to provide great places to sleep and eat!
Want to come and work with us?
We’re looking for a Senior Interior Designer who shares our passion for bringing people together. The role requires extensive experience in interior design for hotels and restaurants, combined with strong project leadership and mentoring abilities.
Working closely with our owners and leadership group, our Senior Interior Designer will:

Mentor and guide design team members
Lead design development for active ‘new build’ and ‘renovation’ projects
Monitor design projects for alignment to local, national, and international codes, and to Northland Properties standards.
Lead and guide development of design concepts and schematics, including:

Interior space visualization, concept development, and rendering
Space and furniture plan programming
FF&E selection, specification, and documentation
Supplier resourcing
Visual presentation development
Owner and Executive Management presentations

Lead and support the development of comprehensive Interior Design Plan Sets
Collaborate with internal project teams on progressive development of architectural design, interior design, construction drawings, specifications, schedules, cost estimates, and project reports.
Coordinate integration of interior design deliverables across all in-house disciplines, including Architecture, Procurement, Construction, and Operations.
Manage project administration, coordinate project meetings, and facilitate communication.
Lead department initiatives in support of the growth and development of our culture

title: Senior Software Engineer - Developer Productivity - NatWest Group
description:
Join us as a Senior Software Engineer

  • This is an opportunity for a technically minded individual to join us as a Senior Software Engineer
  • You'll be building and maintaining the services we provide to engineering squads
  • With no product owner or tech lead aligned to this squad, you'll have increased responsibility and autonomy.

What you'll do

Y ou'll engage directly with stakeholders, prioritise based on impact, and deal with ambiguity. We use kanban so we can flexibly adapt. If a product squad is blocked, we want to be able to drop what we're doing and help them immediately.

You'll also be:
  • You'll be working on things like CI/CD pipelines, Golden Paths and AI productivity tooling. Right now, our biggest focus is enabling and supporting AI adoption across the business.
  • Collaborating with other squads to help them with their problems
  • On a rota for in-hours support, ensuring that we're there for engineers across the business when they're stuck. W hether that's a broken pipeline, a deployment issue, or something they've never seen before. It's varied, often urgent, and requires strong debugging skills and patience

The skills you'll need
We're looking for someone who can make sound technical decisions and know when to push for quality and when to be pragmatic. You don't wait to be told what to work on - you actively look for ways to improve how squads deliver software, take ownership from problem through to outcome, and can mentor and challenge other engineers through collaboration rather than hierarchy.

Additionally, you'll demonstrate:
  • Experience of being highly collaborative - You enjoy solving problems with other people. Pairing, mobbing, and working through ideas together is how you prefer to work, not a compromise
  • Comfortability with ambiguity - You'll regularly pick up half-formed problems, figure out what's actually needed, engage with stakeholders, and shape the solution yourself
  • Being Technically Flexible - We work across infrastructure, platform tooling, CI/CD, and experience of using Docker and Kubernetes is required. We use multiple languages including Java, Go, Python, and TypeScript. You don't need to be an expert in all of them, but you're genuinely comfortable picking up unfamiliar tools and technologies
  • A focus on the customer - Y ou take pride in helping other engineers. Supporting squads through in-hours support is a core part of the role, and you see it as valuable work, not a chore
  • Excitement about AI - W e're leading the adoption of AI tooling across the business, including agentic AI and developer productivity tools. It's our biggest priority this year. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you should be genuinely excited about how AI can change the way engineers work, and eager to experiment

title: Social- og sundhedshjælper til demensenhed på Plejecentre Sjælsø (dagvagt) - kop
description:
Om jobbet.

Vi søger en dagvagt som har et ønske om at arbejde et sted, hvor medindflydelse, faglig udvikling og gode kollegaer er rammerne for et alsidigt og spændende job inden for ældreplejen?

Vi er et leve bo miljø med 10 demente borgere og personalegruppen består af social og sundhedshjælpere, social og sundhedsassistenter og en sygeplejerske som passer 2 endheder. Vi lægger stor vægt på, at borgerne oplever høj trivsel med nærhed og god livskvalitet. Vi arbejder målrettet med, at både borgere og deres pårørende skal føle sig trygge og tager derfor altid udgangspunkt i deres individuelle ønsker og behov. Vi holder ugemøder med terapeuter og vi bruger triage.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være, at varetage de grundlæggende pleje- og omsorgsopgaver for de borgere du og dine kollegaer har ansvaret for. Du skal selvstændigt planlægge, udføre, evaluere og dokumentere forløbene for de enkelte borgere i tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer.

Herudover, ønsker vi, at du også er med til at varetage de mange forskellige opgaver, små som store, der naturligt opstår på et plejecenter, hvor dagene aldrig er ens. Vi er afhængige af hinandens hjælp for at kunne lykkes med at skabe den bedst mulige livskvalitet for borgerne.

Din profil

Du er uddannet social-og sundhedshjælper og du har måske et par års praktisk demennserfaring fra ældreplejen. Du er faglig dygtig inden for plejen af den skrøbelige ældre, engageret og du har lysten til at blive endnu bedre.

Du er optaget af at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for den enkelte borger, er faglig nysgerrig, har gode samarbejdsevner og udviser fleksibilitet i forhold til løsning af arbejdsopgaverne.Du vægter tværfagligt samarbejde meget højt.

Vi håber du er rig på ideer og er i stand til at omsætte dem i hverdagen. Vi ønsker du er, positiv, har overblik og godt humør.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Du skal vælge os, hvis du er på udkig efter en spændende arbejdsplads med dygtige, engagerede og hjælpsomme kollegaer, hvor et godt grin i løbet af dagen er noget vi vægter højt.

Vi tilbyder en grundig introduktion og oplæring, så du kommer godt fra start, og hurtigst mulig bliver en del af den samlede personalegruppe.

Vi syntes lige som dig, at det har været en god vagt når vi har gjort en forskel for borgerne i godt samarbejde med vores kollegaer.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Jobbet er i fast dagvagt 37 timer ugentlig. Hvis en fuldtidsstilling ikke er det rette for dig, drøfter vi gerne et andet timetal. Jobbet er med start 1. september 2026 eller snarest herefter

Daglig mødetid vil være i tidsrummet kl. 7 til 15 og med weekendvagt hver 3. uge.

Ansættelse på Plejecenter Sjælsø er betinget af en tilfredsstillende straffeattest, som vi bestiller efter aftale med dig.

.

Om os

Plejecentret Sjælsø er en del af Rudersdal Kommune og ligger med udsigt over Sjælsø i naturskønne omgivelser.Bus 196 kører lige til døren fra Birkerød St.

Såfremt du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte

Hanne Dahl

hdahl@rudersdal.dk

19. september 2026
