title: Health Policy Internship
description:
Job Description

Working in a professional and collaborative health policy environment, you will gain practical experience within the External Affairs team at our Red Oak Campus in Dublin. As part of the team, you will support policy development, stakeholder engagement, advocacy initiatives and strategic projects across the Irish and European healthcare landscape.

Working alongside colleagues from across the business and engaging with a wide range of external stakeholders, you will contribute to initiatives that help improve patient outcomes, inform healthcare policy and strengthen healthcare systems.The team operates at the intersection of healthcare policy, government affairs, stakeholder engagement and strategic communications. We help shape the environment in which patients access innovative medicines and vaccines, while supporting healthcare innovation, public health, research and Ireland's life sciences sector.

The successful candidate will work across a diverse portfolio of healthcare, industrial, economic and EU policy issues, contributing to projects that impact patients, healthcare systems and the wider life sciences ecosystem. The role involves close collaboration with internal stakeholders as well as engagement with government departments, healthcare organisations, patient groups, professional bodies, industry associations and other external stakeholders.

During your 9-month placement, you will gain first-hand insight into how policy, government affairs and external affairs supports the objectives of a global healthcare organisation operating in Ireland. You will work alongside experienced policy, communications and public affairs professionals, gaining exposure to senior business leaders, policymakers, healthcare stakeholders and industry representatives while developing practical skills in policy analysis, stakeholder engagement and advocacy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop an understanding of the Irish healthcare system, public policy environment and pharmaceutical industry.
  • Support the planning, coordination and delivery of policy, government affairs and stakeholder engagement activities.
  • Assist with preparing briefing materials, agendas, background notes, stakeholder summaries and key messages for internal and external engagements.
  • Help coordinate policy events, conferences, roundtables, stakeholder meetings and site visits, including logistics, attendee tracking and follow-up actions.
  • Maintain trackers for policy developments, stakeholder engagements, consultation opportunities and key strategic priorities.
  • Monitor political, legislative and healthcare policy developments relevant to patients, healthcare systems and the life sciences sector.
  • Conduct research and analysis on healthcare, public health, industrial, economic and EU policy topics.
  • Support the development of policy submissions, consultation responses, position papers and stakeholder engagement materials.
  • Liaise with colleagues across business to support strategic projects and ensure alignment.
  • Support participation in industry associations, policy forums and stakeholder initiatives at both national and European level.
  • Prepare appealing PowerPoint presentations, reports and briefing documents for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support compliance with all relevant statutory requirements, industry codes and company policies.

Technical Specifications

  • Working towards a degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Public Health, Health Policy, Communications, Law, European Studies, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated interest in healthcare policy, public affairs, government affairs, health systems, public health, politics or the life sciences sector.

  • Experience conducting research, policy analysis, stakeholder engagement, communications or project work would be advantageous.

This Role Is Well Suited To Someone Who:

  • Is organised, driven, proactive and can work on own initiative.
  • Has an interest in healthcare, public policy, Irish politics, public affairs or communications.
  • Wants exposure to healthcare policy, government affairs and stakeholder engagement within a global healthcare company.
  • Is curious about how business, government, healthcare and policy intersect.
  • Enjoys research, problem-solving and working on projects that have real-world impact for patients and healthcare systems.

Qualities We Look For

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong research, analytical and critical-thinking skills.

• Demonstrates initiative, curiosity and a desire to learn.

• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a cross-functional team.

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality written materials.

• Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills.

• Operates with a high level of integrity, transparency and accountability.

• Demonstrates problem-solving capabilities and a willingness to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Team player who actively supports colleagues and contributes to a positive working environment.

• Aligns with and fosters a culture of diversity and inclusion.

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Demonstrates a desire to continuously learn, develop and improve through feedback.

Job Description:

Johnson and Johnson is currently seeking a Director, Medical Affairs, Electrophysiology located in Irvine, CA.

About MedTech| Electrophysiology

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Cardiovascular? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Cardiovascular team develops leading solutions for heart recovery, electrophysiology, and stroke. You will join a proud heritage of continually elevating standards of care for stroke, heart failure and atrial fibrillation (AFib) patients.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at

The Director will have Medical Affairs responsibility in providing therapeutic and clinical expertise in support of the development of medical devices for the treatment of arrhythmias and structural heart disease. This role will provide strong strategic input on long term product opportunities and portfolio strategies, work closely with the Scientific Affairs team in support of evidence generation and dissemination activities that support product approvals, claims development, and product adoption and lifecycle management, and work closely with the R&D teams during product development and with marketing and commercial teams during product launches to provide training and education.

The Director will help shape the industry and build strong relationships externally with key customers and stakeholders (Key Opinion Leaders, Surgeons, Regulatory Agencies, Professional Societies, etc.) to anticipate industry trends, understand clinical/medical insights, unmet medical needs and global standards of care to deliver quality products/solutions.

The Director – Medical Affairs will:

  • Work with business partners including but not limited to R&D, Clinical & Pre-Clinical Research, Regulatory Affairs, Quality & Compliance, Health Economics & Market Access, and Professional Medical Education to influence overall regulatory and commercial strategy, as well as support product development, pre- and post-approval clinical studies, downstream claims, safety assessments, and product launch.
  • Lead the support for all clinical studies – both for regulatory purposes as well as physician initiated collaborative studies. They will be responsible and accountable for case support plans and execution, physician training, internal field training, training materials, data analysis, publication support and collection of data for supporting platform claims.
  • Support the commercial launch of the platform by activating sites, providing physician training to collect and provide regular feedback on product performance and improvements.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of product and/or procedural evidence generation and dissemination strategies for company sponsored and investigator initiated research.
  • Participate in governance forums including Business Unit leadership teams, cross-functional product core teams, EGS teams, portfolio/strategy management teams, and Safety and Quality Review Boards.
  • Engage Key Opinion leaders, Professional Societies, Payers and Providers to understand trends in care and uncover critical insights to support product innovation and HEMA needs.
  • Provide support to Marketing, R&D, Communications, Legal, Quality Assurance/Risk Management/Product Safety and Commercial teams by providing medical and scientific insights to drive optimal business strategic direction and tactical business activities
  • Collaborate with evidence generation colleagues from Preclinical Research and Clinical Research teams in the USA and internationally to develop global strategies for evidence generation for new and existing products in order to support regulatory approval/clearance, health technology assessment, customer access and post-marketing support
  • Provide scientific expertise, oversight and approval for clinical trial concept, design, analysis and reporting of clinical research in assigned areas
  • Provide oversight for the development of materials to be used for study execution (investigator brochures, training materials, etc.)
  • Work closely with Medical Safety team to ensure adverse events from clinical research studies are reviewed, trended and escalated as needed
  • Provide scientific input and expertise in the analysis of study results
  • Work with Regulatory and Clinical partners to prepare report on clinical investigations in preparation for submission to regulatory agencies and/or for publication, to meet evidence requirements
  • Provide medical insights/expertise to the development teams for the risk assessment review for new products and reviews and approves the final risk management report for all new products
  • Account for the medical content of internal product documentation and regulatory submissions for new products and for renewals.
  • Approve Design History Files, Technical Guides and Clinical Evaluation Reports (CERs) as part of the creation of product-specific design dossiers/technical files
  • Reviews and approves educational, promotional and reporting materials for use by internal stakeholders. Strategizes and prioritizes publication proposals in collaboration with Clinical Science.
  • Responsible for ensuring subordinates follow all Company guidelines related to Health, Safety and Environmental practices and that all resources needed to do so are available and in good condition
  • Responsible for ensuring personal and Company compliance with all Federal, State, local and Company regulations, policies, and procedures

Qualifications -

  • Bachelors degree in Medicine, Biomedical/Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent life sciences/technical engineering discipline is required.
  • Advanced degree MD, PharmD or PhD in Medicine, Biomedical Engineering, or equivalent life sciences discipline is highly preferred.
  • Previous Medical Affairs and/or Medical Science Liaison experience in a regulated, commercial medical device business is strongly preferred
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant business experience in product development, within the Cardiovascular industry is required.
  • A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience directly in Medical Affairs is required.
  • Previous clinical experience in the electrophysiology space is highly preferred.
  • Proven track record of the ability to learn complex technology/clinical applications is required.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience supporting clinical cases and proctoring cases is preferred.
  • Demonstrated success in medical data generation, interpretation and publications is required.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills are essential.
  • Strong knowledge of regulatory, compliance, and ethical requirements governing Medical Affairs activities is required..
  • Strong leadership skills and demonstrated ability to build successful relationships with internal and external partners globally is required.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills to successfully influence and implement policy with key customers and partners is critical for success in this role.
  • A proven ability to collaborate well with multiple partners and work effectively in a highly matrixed environment is required.

The anticipated base pay range for this position is $164,000 - $305,900.

To administer and provide central accountability for all Infrastructure server services which include those activities associated with the function, organization, expansion and technical support of existing and future Windows and Linux-based physical and virtual system configurations and supporting systems software (e.g., operating systems, utilities, databases, cloud services and middleware) necessary to deliver the required services (e.g. hosting, web, messaging, remote access, security administration) to support Edfinancial Services, EdAmerica and Medfinancial systems. To serve as an escalation point for System Administrators.



Duties and Responsibilities (Daily and Monthly)

  • Exhibit a broad base of knowledge and skills in server infrastructure, and operating systems to include Windows, Linux, Hyper-V, VMware, and Microsoft Azure including but not limited to IaaS, SaaS, PaaS and serverless services.
  • Maintain the active directory environment including Azure Active Directory, DHCP, GPO, DNS, and certificate management.
  • Manage and monitor M365 environment including mail flow and collaboration products such as email, Sharepoint, Dynamics, Teams, and licensing.
  • Provide primary support for all physical and virtual servers. Maintain documentation on hardware/software.
  • Monitor services for growth and usage trends. Perform long-term capacity planning in conjunction with other team members that would determine both hardware and software purchases.
  • Perform daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of all servers, applications, services, and key processes, reviewing system and application logs, and verify completion of scheduled jobs such as backups and sFTP processes.
  • Recommend, install, test, and manage existing and new servers and software including such systems as messaging, file servers, and database, among others in accordance with standards and project/operational requirements.
  • Provide technical assistance related to daily and assigned use; Assist customers and desktop support staff in identifying source of, and correcting errors.
  • Diagnose system hardware, software, and operator problems; recommend or perform remedial action.
  • Perform, oversee, monitor, and ensure data security including regular backups, recovery, verification of security rights and other steps necessary to ensure data integrity.
  • Collaborate with Security team and other IT staff as necessary to implement, update and test ongoing security improvements including regular and timely operating system patches, security patches and other application updates as necessary to all server infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with other staff to create, test, and keep up to date disaster recovery procedures for all services deemed necessary.
  • Set up, install, test, and administer network printing functions.
  • Assist the IT Infrastructure Manager and IT Systems Engineers in project definition, requirements documentation, and technical writing to support information systems business growth.
  • Monitor and enforce license agreements using appropriate tools relative to hardware and software resources.
  • Monitor and create regular management reports that track usage, performance, capacity, growth trends, etc., as it relates to the company hardware/software.
  • Collaborate with IT Network staff to, install, configure, and generally ensure the tight integration of web services, network links, hardware, and peripheral components into the company LAN and Azure environment.
  • Keep current with new technologies being deployed at the company.
  • Participate in off-hour support rotation.
  • Train selected staff for coverage during absentee periods. (i.e., vacation, seminars)
  • Deal regularly with outside computer vendors; perform a variety of liaison functions between company users and outside consultants/vendors.
  • Performs other duties or special projects as required or as assigned.

title: Geotechnical Driller
description:

The Geotechnical Driller will lead the mobilization/demobilization of the drill rig and/or cone trucks as directed. Provide drilling services for geotechnical drilling projects. Perform routine and standard drilling techniques in obtaining soil samples. This position is responsible for managing project teams to successful completion of all project deliverables, related documents and coordination of project requirements and provide further support for business development.

Accountabilities:

Assist in the mobilization of drilling rigs and/or cone trucks for jobs as directed. Load drill pipe, mud, and equipment.

Working knowledge of Simco, Ardco and CME and other drilling equipment.
Physically complete labor-intensive projects assigned by the Project Coordinator/Project Manager.
Develop and maintain a working knowledge of all equipment and field operations.
Monitor the performance of all equipment to identify maintenance and repair needs.

Perform maintenance and cleaning of equipment and work area as directed.

Complete all required paperwork, including daily reports, safety paperwork, and vehicle & equipment inspections.
Attend all safety meetings and comply with both company and client safety standards and programs.
Maintain a clean and organized working environment, including equipment and job site areas.
Turn in all required paperwork to office on a daily basis.
Ability to lead a crew and mentor other team members
Support in business development

Perform all duties and responsibilities by Company safety rules and procedures.

Qualifications:

Legally Authorized to work in the United States, without restrictions.

Geotechnical Drilling: 3 years or more (Preferred).
Sufficient knowledge of geotechnical drilling techniques to be responsible for an entire project
Be available for drilling projects that require both in-state and out-of-state travel and overnight visits

CDL A License
Geotechnical Drilling Experience - Soils Augers, Wet Rotary and Wireline Coring

TWIC card.
ISTC Basic Plus.

Som entreprenadingenjör är du en central del av projektorganisationen. Du driver och stöttar projektets administration och styrning – från ekonomistyrning till kontraktsfrågor och tidsplanering.   • Utbildning inom projektledning eller likvärdig kompetens
  • 5 års erfarenhet från roller som entreprenadingenjör, platschef, kalkylingenjör eller liknande
  • Gedigen kunskap inom ekonomisk styrning, kalkylarbete, prognosarbete och entreprenadjuridik

Vi erbjuder

  • En arbetsplats med stark laganda och högt engagemang
  • Möjlighet att påverka och utvecklas i komplexa och spännande projekt
  • Kompetensutveckling och stöd för din fortsatta karriär
  • En kultur som präglas av samarbete, ansvar och innovation

Personliga egenskaper

Vi tror att du är initiativtagande, strukturerad och har en naturlig förmåga att skapa goda relationer. Du kommunicerar tydligt och har ett affärsmässigt tänk.

Kontakt: Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Arbetschef Andréas Larsson på andreas.larsson@peab.se eller Arbetschef Pontus Gejervall på pontus.gejervall@peab.se

Har du frågor kring rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta HR Kristin Hafstad på kristin.hafstad@peab.se

Redo att ta nästa steg? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team – tillsammans bygger vi framtiden!

Vi kan komma att genomföra bakgrundskontroller på våra slutkandidater som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess.

I denna rekrytering har vi gjort ett aktivt val av annonsering och rekryteringsstöd och avböjer oss vänligt men bestämt kontakt från rekryterings- eller annonseringsbolag.

I Peabkoncernen blir du delaktig i det spännande arbetet att bygga framtidens hållbara samhälle. Vi engagerar oss i sociala frågor och i frågor som rör miljön för de människor som nu och i framtiden påverkas av det vi bygger och anlägger. Vi vill tillvarata all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden och eftersträvar mångfald.

Det är viktigt för oss att du delar våra kärnvärden jordnära, utvecklande, personliga och pålitliga eftersom de är grundläggande för det vi gör. Hos oss finns stora möjligheter till personlig utveckling. Vill du bygga ett hållbart samhälle med oss?

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Information Systems Security Specilaist
description:
​​ASRC Federal Advanced Research LLC (AFAR)​ is seeking an ​Information Systems Security Specialist​ to join our ​Weather Observations Systems Subteam​ that supports the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This is a ​full-time​ ​remote​ position supporting work at the ​Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC)​ in ​Oklahoma City, OK​.

​​The FAA's Weather Observation Systems Subteam provides critical engineering, lifecycle management, and technical support for a comprehensive network of ground-based aviation weather sensors and information display platforms. By managing diverse equipment—ranging from the Automated Weather Observing System (AWOS) and wind shear detectors such as the Low Level Windshear Alert System (LLWAS) to specialized terminal data displays (ACE-IDS)—the team ensures that air traffic controllers and pilots have the accurate, real-time meteorological data essential for safe flight operations.​

Citizenship/Permanent Residency Requirement

All candidates must have the following to pass the Federal Background Investigation and obtain the FAA Public Trust security clearance.

Be a US Citizen.
Has resided in the US for three (3) consecutive years.
RealID Driver’s License/ID or current US Passport.

Education & Experience Requirement

All non-US Degrees must have a US Equivalency Certificate provided by the candidate at the time of application.

A ​Bachelors​ degree in ​Computer Science or related IT fields, with a minimum of thirty (30) semester hours in a combination of mathematics, statistics, and computer science may be substituted in lieu of the computer science degree, depending on other qualifications and experience.
Knowledge and application of Federal Information Security Management Act of 2002 (FISMA) requirements and associated National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Special Publications and Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) is desirable.​
Experience with NAS facilities, systems, and equipment is ​desired​.
9+​ years of related work experience.

Required Skills

Provides risk analysis for vulnerabilities, incidents, and change requests.
Develops, maintains, and reviews technical documentation, system records, reports, security documentation, and configuration information to support ongoing NAS operations.
Knowledge of computer systems, networking, information technology, and information security principles.
Analyzes system, network, and operational information to identify issues, vulnerabilities, risks, and potential impacts to system availability or performance.
Maintains accurate system, operational, and administrative records with strong attention to detail.
Coordinates technical activities and communicates effectively with government personnel, contractors, telecommunications providers, technical teams, and other stakeholders.
Analyzes technical issues and provides clear, actionable recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Manages multiple activities, service requests, outages, and action items, ensuring appropriate follow-up and resolution with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to:

Work independently, as well as on a team, in an agile environment.
Research, troubleshoot and problem solve quickly.
Learn on the job/willing to self-teach.
Communicate effectively through verbal and written communication with high organization.

Preferred Skills

​​Experience supporting FAA National Airspace System (NAS) facilities, systems, equipment, or operational programs.
Experience with FAA Surveillance and Weather systems, including ASOS and AWOS equipment and operations.
Familiarity with National Weather Service (NWS) Weather Forecast Office operations and FAA/NWS coordination for ASOS maintenance and support.
Knowledge of Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) requirements.
Understanding of federal cybersecurity policies and procedures.
Knowledge and practical application of NIST Special Publications.
Knowledge and practical application of Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS).​

Essential Daily Job Duties

​​Respond to public inquiries.
Travel to support installation, relocation, modification, and field activities for ASOS equipment across the United States.
Coordinate with FAA personnel, NWS representatives, telecommunications providers, field technicians, and other stakeholders to resolve ASOS/AWOS operational issues.
Prepare and submit Purchase Requisitions for ASOS-related equipment, services, maintenance, and program activities.
Maintain and verify accuracy of National Flight Data Center charts and documentation related to ASOS systems.
Initiate, track, and follow up on FAA Telecommunications Infrastructure and service tickets for ASOS/AWOS outages and communication issues.​

Work Environment

Standard flexible work schedule.
Travel is ~15%​.
Cubicle environment.

title: Clinical Educator - Rehab
description:
SUMMARY:

The Clinical Educator – Rehab develops, delivers, and evaluates rehabilitation-specific education, training, and competency programs for Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Speech Therapy teams. The role applies clinical rehabilitation expertise to support onboarding, ongoing education, clinical practice standards, and accurate, current training resources.

The Clinical Educator – Rehab also supports process improvement, policy and procedure development, audits, and discipline-specific projects. The role collaborates with rehabilitation professionals, interdisciplinary teams, center leadership, and other departments to promote consistent clinical practices, regulatory compliance, and quality participant care.

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS:

Rehabilitation Education & Competency Development

  • Develops and delivers rehabilitation-specific education for Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Speech Therapy teams.
  • Develops and coordinates onboarding, orientation, and annual competency programs for rehabilitation employees.
  • Leads and participates in training sessions, webinars, workshops, and other educational activities.
  • Provides clinical guidance related to rehabilitation assessments, treatment planning, equipment recommendations, and participant and caregiver education.
  • Evaluates educational needs and updates training based on changes in clinical practice, organizational requirements, and rehabilitation standards.

Clinical Resources, Policies & Practice Support

  • Develops, reviews, and updates rehabilitation training materials, manuals, clinical resources, and related documentation.
  • Reviews educational and clinical content for accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
  • Contributes rehabilitation expertise to the development and implementation of policies and procedures.
  • Researches current rehabilitation practices and relevant changes within areas of expertise to support accurate and current guidance.
  • Serves as a clinical resource to employees and leaders by responding to questions and providing discipline-specific consultation.

Quality, Compliance & Process Improvement

  • Identifies opportunities to improve rehabilitation workflows, clinical practices, education, and related processes.
  • Supports implementation of process improvements in collaboration with appropriate departments and operational leaders.
  • Participates in rehabilitation audits, regulatory readiness activities, and other compliance-related reviews.
  • Supports corrective education, training, and competency activities identified through audits, reviews, or performance needs.
  • Provides rehabilitation expertise for discipline-specific projects and organizational improvement initiatives.

Collaboration & Operational Support

  • Collaborates with interdisciplinary teams and other departments to support consistent rehabilitation practices and effective implementation of clinical processes.
  • Works with center leadership to support rehabilitation education and clinical operations.
  • Coordinates with Information Technology and other resources when rehabilitation education or clinical practice requires technical or system support.
  • Serves as a rehabilitation resource or subject-matter champion for assigned projects and initiatives.

Organizational Standards

  • Demonstrates behaviors aligned with PACE Southeast Michigan’s mission, values, and Ten Principles.
  • Maintains professionalism, confidentiality, and accountability in all interactions.
  • Builds collaborative relationships with employees, participants, leaders, and business partners.
  • Participates in continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong clinical knowledge of rehabilitation practices, including assessment, treatment planning, equipment recommendations, and participant-centered care.
  • Knowledge of rehabilitation education, competency development, onboarding, and clinical training practices.
  • Knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local healthcare regulations, professional standards, and organizational policies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain clinical information clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to evaluate clinical information, identify educational or practice gaps, and develop effective solutions.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across rehabilitation disciplines and interdisciplinary teams.
  • Cultural competence and the ability to support care for a diverse participant population.
  • Proficiency with electronic health record systems and Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:

  • Delivers accurate, current, and effective rehabilitation education that supports employee knowledge, competency, and clinical practice.
  • Maintains high standards for the quality, accuracy, and consistency of rehabilitation training materials and clinical resources.
  • Promotes rehabilitation practices that support participant-centered care, safety, and quality outcomes.
  • Maintains compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, professional standards, and organizational policies.
  • Responds to clinical education and consultation needs in a timely, professional, and solution-focused manner.
  • Builds effective working relationships across rehabilitation disciplines, interdisciplinary teams, and organizational departments.
  • Identifies opportunities to strengthen education, clinical practices, and processes and contributes to sustainable improvements.
  • Demonstrates reliability, professional judgment, accountability, and commitment to continued clinical and professional development.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Physical Therapy or Occupational Therapy from an accredited institution required.
  • Current license to practice in the State of Michigan required.
  • NBCOT certification required for Occupational Therapists.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience as a Physical Therapist or Occupational Therapist in a PACE program required.
  • Demonstrated experience with participant-centered rehabilitation assessment, care planning, treatment, and clinical practice required.
  • Experience providing clinical education, training, onboarding, or competency development preferred.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer, with regular periods of standing and walking.
  • Regular travel to PACE Southeast Michigan locations as needed to provide training, education, clinical support, and competency activities.
  • Must successfully complete all required post-offer background checks, drug screening, and health screenings.
  • Must meet organizational health requirements for direct or occasional participant contact, including tuberculosis (TB) screening, communicable disease clearance, and required immunizations.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 50 pounds and perform occasional strenuous physical activity when assisting participants or handling rehabilitation equipment and supplies.
  • Ability to safely assist participants with mobility, transfers, and activities of daily living using proper body mechanics and approved assistive devices and equipment.
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position while maintaining participant safety and dignity.

title: Lead Pricing & Taxation Specialist
description:
Bliv den faglige motor bag prisfastsættelse og afgiftsområdet i Jyske Finans

Vil du have en central specialistrolle med stor faglig indflydelse på, hvordan vi arbejder med prisfastsættelse og afgiftsforhold i en af Danmarks største leasingforretninger?

Hos Jyske Finans får du mulighed for at sætte retning på to forretningskritiske områder. Du omsætter analyser, markedsindsigt og specialistviden til beslutninger, der har direkte betydning for vores lønsomhed, risikostyring og kundeoplevelse. Samtidig bliver du den naturlige sparringspartner for både kolleger, ledelse og samarbejdspartnere inden for Pricing & Taxation.

Om rollen

Rollen er for dig, der motiveres af at have et tydeligt fagligt ansvar og mulighed for at sætte retning inden for dit specialistområde. Du får stor indflydelse på beslutninger, processer og metoder i en forretning, hvor Pricing & Taxation spiller en central rolle.

Som Lead Pricing & Taxation Specialist får du det faglige ansvar for to centrale områder i Jyske Finans: prisfastsættelse og afgiftsforhold.

Du bliver den person, organisationen går til, når der skal træffes beslutninger om restværdier, service- og dækaftaler eller afgiftsmæssige forhold. Samtidig spiller du en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at vores metoder, processer og beslutningsgrundlag understøtter en sund og robust leasingforretning.

Hverdagen veksler mellem analyse, faglig sparring og udvikling. Du omsætter markedsindsigt og data til konkrete anbefalinger, bidrager til udviklingen af vores prismodeller og arbejdsgange og sikrer en professionel håndtering af afgiftsområdet, herunder dialogen med Motorstyrelsen.

Dine primære ansvarsområder bliver:

  • Prisfastsættelse af restværdier samt service- og dækaftaler
  • Afgiftsberegning og faglig kvalitetssikring
  • Udvikling og forankring af metoder og processer
  • Faglig sparring til kolleger, ledelse og forretningen
  • Dialog med Motorstyrelsen og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere

Din profil

Du trives med at være specialist og motiveres af at skabe et solidt fagligt grundlag for forretningens beslutninger. Du kan dykke ned i komplekse problemstillinger, men formår samtidig at omsætte analyser, data og regler til løsninger, som skaber værdi i praksis.

Du arbejder struktureret og fokuserer på både detaljerne og den større forretningsmæssige sammenhæng. Samtidig motiveres du af at tage ansvar for et fagområde og bidrage med sparring, når beslutninger kræver både faglig indsigt og forretningsforståelse.

Rollen indebærer mange samarbejdsflader, og du trives derfor i dialogen med både kolleger, ledelse og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Du formår at formidle komplekse problemstillinger klart og omsætte din viden til anbefalinger, som andre kan handle på.

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med ét eller flere af følgende områder:

  • Prisfastsættelse og kommercielle vurderinger
  • Afgiftsberegning og regulatoriske forhold
  • Leasing, automotive eller beslægtede brancher
  • Service- og dækaftaler eller lignende porteføljeforretninger

Om afdelingen og Jyske Finans

Du bliver en del af Supply Chain, et team på 12 specialister, hvor høj faglighed, sparring og korte beslutningsveje præger hverdagen.

Stillingen refererer til Director, Supply Chain, og du får et tæt samarbejde med både forretningen, tekniske specialister, interne støttefunktioner, eksterne samarbejdspartnere og ledelsen.

Jyske Finans er et datterselskab i Jyske Bank-koncernen og beskæftiger ca. 170 medarbejdere. Vi er et af landets største og mest erfarne selskaber inden for låne- og leasingfinansiering af biler og materiel til erhvervslivet.

Vores domicil ligger i Silkeborg, og vi har kontorer i Aalborg og Roskilde. Kulturen er uformel og præget af høj faglighed, korte beslutningsveje og en klar ambition om at skabe resultater sammen.

Ansøgning og proces

I Jyske Bank koncernen mener vi, at diversitet skaber bedre beslutninger og relationer samt et mere varieret arbejdsmiljø. Vi arbejder aktivt for inklusion og lige muligheder og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV og en kort motivation for, hvorfor netop denne rolle tiltaler dig.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 15. september 2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Senior HR Business Partner Anni Bech Kristoffersen varetager rekrutteringen, og har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Director, Supply Chain, Kristoffer Mortensen for en uforpligtende dialog.

title: Senior DBA Administrator
description:
Introduction

Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

Overview

East West Bank is seeking a highly skilled Database Administrator (DBA) to support and manage the Bank's enterprise database platforms. The DBA is responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, integrity, and recoverability of mission-critical database systems across on-premises and cloud environments. This role partners closely with application development, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and business teams to deliver secure, resilient, and highly available data platforms that support the Bank's operations and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

Database Administration & Operations

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server environments across development, test, disaster recovery, and production platforms.
  • Manage database availability, performance, capacity planning, and overall platform health.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot database, operating system, and application performance issues.
  • Administer Always On Availability Groups, clustering, replication, and other high-availability technologies.
  • Support database patching, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Maintain database standards, configuration baselines, and operational procedures.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and enforce database security controls, authentication, authorization, encryption, and auditing requirements.
  • Manage database access requests and privileged account administration.
  • Ensure compliance with Bank policies, standards, regulatory requirements, and audit expectations.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing documentation, evidence, and technical expertise.
  • Assist in vulnerability remediation and security hardening efforts.

Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Develop, monitor, and maintain database backup and recovery strategies.
  • Execute and validate database restore testing activities.
  • Support disaster recovery planning, testing, and recovery operations.
  • Ensure recovery objectives and data protection requirements are met.

Cloud & Data Platform Support

  • Administer Azure SQL Database, Managed Instance, and related cloud database technologies.
  • Support cloud migration initiatives and modernization efforts.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architecture teams on database platform strategy and governance.

Change Management & Automation

  • Participate in change management, release management, and production deployment activities.
  • Develop and maintain automation solutions using T-SQL, PowerShell, and other tools to improve operational efficiency.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and operating procedures.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Work closely with developers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior DBAs and support personnel.
  • Participate in major incident response and problem management activities.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for database technologies and best practices.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Working Relationships

The DBA works closely with:

  • Application Development Teams
  • Information Security
  • Infrastructure and Cloud Operations
  • Enterprise Architecture
  • IT Risk and Compliance
  • Business Application Support Teams
  • Audit and Regulatory Examination Teams

Success Measures

  • Database platform availability and reliability
  • Successful backup and recovery testing results
  • Regulatory and audit compliance outcomes
  • Security and vulnerability remediation performance
  • Incident reduction and operational efficiency improvements
  • Delivery of database modernization and automation initiatives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience administering Microsoft SQL Server environments.
  • Strong experience with:
    • SQL Server 2022 and 2025
    • Database performance tuning and optimization
    • Query tuning and troubleshooting
    • Backup and recovery processes
    • High availability and disaster recovery solutions
    • Security administration and auditing
  • PowerShell scripting and automation
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced financial services environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise database environments.
  • Experience with Azure SQL Database, Managed Instances, and AWS cloud database services.
  • Familiarity with SSIS, SSRS, Azure Data Factory, and enterprise data warehouse platforms.
  • Experience supporting financial institutions or other highly regulated environments.
  • Knowledge of FFIEC, NIST, SOX, GLBA, SOC, and related regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, database deployments, and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies.

Key Competencies

  • Database Performance Management
  • High Availability & Disaster Recovery
  • Information Security & Data Protection
  • Automation & Process Improvement
  • Incident and Problem Management
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Risk Awareness
  • Team Collaboration
  • Technical Leadership
  • Continuous Improvement

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is USD $130,000.00/Yr. - USD $165,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

  • Initiative: Takes prompt action to accomplish objectives. Seeks to resolve problems without being asked.

  • Coordinate all aspects of incomplete treatment plans in a timely manner to ensure patients receive the care they need.
  • Verify insurance coverage and obtain prior authorizations for services as required by individual insurance plans.
  • Coordinate with the billing department and/or dental clinical staff as needed on prior authorizations, handle denied authorizations and ensure proper management of claims.
  • Ensure task box is managed efficiently, answering questions from support center staff regarding dental patients.
  • Communicate information and updates to patients and providers.
  • Document care coordination, telephone calls, and other relevant clinical information in EHR.
  • Assemble paperwork and requested medical information and submit to specialty offices as needed for referrals or other patient coordination efforts.
  • Ensure specialists accept the patient’s insurance plan.
  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with all staff, providing excellent customer service.
  • Inform leadership of concerns, backlogs, or insurance issues.
  • Correspond with dental staff to ensure effective communication and scheduling.
  • Plan and manage the infection control plan to meet OSHA, CDC, and ADA standards.
  • Support and assist with special community outreach care programs.
  • Prepare and mail follow-up correspondence to parents or patients.
  • Call/correspond with parents to schedule students/patients with healthcare needs for office or telehealth visits.
  • Assist providers in ensuring all patient records and documents are accurately completed and filed.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality at all times.
  • If credentials allow, provide clinical coverage as needed to fill temporary gaps in staffing.
REFERRAL MANAGEMENT:
  • Document in the patient’s record the referral to specialty services, including the date of referral, name of the provider, and scheduled appointment date.
  • Track dental specialty referrals using the Grace Health Referral Tracking process.
  • Monitor the performance of specialty providers, ensuring quality care and removing any provider who does not meet standards.
  • Establish formal or informal referral agreements with specialists.
  • Manage referral agreements with specialists in more remote locations if local specialists are unavailable.
PRIOR AUTHORIZATION (PA):
  • Monitor treatment plans for services that require prior authorization, and initiate PA process according to Standard Operating Procedure (SOP).
  • Work PA by collaborating with dental clinical and billing staff to (re)submit the required information.
  • Communicate with patients and staff as necessary to move through the PA process and ensure the patient receives the treatment they need.
  • Monitor in-progress PA requests to ensure timely documentation and follow-up.
OTHER SERVICE LINES:
  • Assist with coordination with schools to schedule patients, check eligibility and benefits, enter demographics, scan documents, or abstract data as needed.
Work with other entities to coordinate care with our clinic sites, such as scheduling appointments, coordinating paperwork, and communication with the entity for coordination of care, billing, and other needs.

  • Team members must demonstrate excellent communication and coordination skills to provide quality patient care.
  • Care coordination includes communication with community organizations, health plans, facilities, and specialists.
  • Care team members must understand and embrace the concept of population health management and proactively address the needs of patients and families served by the practice.
  • Team members must demonstrate the skills and knowledge necessary to communicate effectively with vulnerable patient populations.
  • Team members must participate in Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) activities within the organization to ensure patients receive high-quality care.

  • Team members will participate in the review and evaluation of practice performance and help identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Team members will participate in Grace Health's advocacy program.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

description:

title: Formuerådgiver - skab økonomisk tryghed for 800.000 privatkunder
description:
"I PFA får du mulighed for at kombinere meningsfuld rådgivning med stærke forretningsmuligheder. Du bliver en del af et team med kompetente og engagerede kollegaer, hvor høj faglighed, sparring og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Her får du frihed til at skabe resultater, udvikle dig og gøre en mærkbar forskel for kunderne,” siger Martin Lyager Jørgensen, leder af Rådgivning Vest.

Så hvad er det egentlig, du skal?

Som formuerådgiver i PFA hjælper du privatkunder og deres partnere med at skabe overblik og træffe beslutninger om deres samlede økonomi. Du rådgiver om pension, investering og formue – både i opsparings- og nedsparingsfasen. Du får en hverdag med mange kundekontakter og indgår i et fagligt miljø, hvor I samarbejder om at skabe gode kundeoplevelser.

Du skaber overblik og økonomisk tryghed

Som formuerådgiver bliver du ansvarlig for at:

  • Holde fysiske og online møder med privatkunder og deres partnere, hvor du afdækker muligheder i husstandens samlede økonomi.
  • Rådgive kunder helhedsorienteret om pension, investering og formue – både før og efter pensionering.
  • Fremme kundernes relation til PFA gennem nærværende rådgivning, der tager udgangspunkt i deres behov og økonomiske situation.
  • Håndtere mange daglige kundekontakter og kontakte kunder proaktivt om relevante rådgivningsmuligheder.
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og specialister på tværs af PFA for at skabe sammenhængende og gode kundeoplevelser.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har erfaring med formuerådgivning fra pensions- eller bankverdenen.
  • Du har en relevant uddannelse, eksempelvis niveau 4 fra Forsikringsakademiet eller en anden finansiel uddannelse.
  • Du skaber tillid i både fysiske og digitale kundemøder og formidler komplekse økonomiske emner enkelt og nærværende.
  • Du arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for både kundedialogen og kvaliteten i din rådgivning.
  • Du er forretningsorienteret og motiveres af at levere rådgivning, der skaber stor værdi for kunden.
  • Du trives med mange daglige kundekontakter og bidrager aktivt til samarbejdet med kolleger og specialister.

Din nye afdeling

Du bliver en del af ét af tre teams i Rådgivning, hvor vi sammen arbejder for at skabe økonomisk tryghed for 800.000 privatkunder. I teamet får du 16 kollegaer, der deler viden og hjælper hinanden med at finde de bedste løsninger for kunderne. I arbejder tæt sammen med specialister på tværs af PFA, så kunderne oplever en helhedsorienteret rådgivning. Samtidig er godt kollegaskab og fælles succeser en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Hvad er det helt særlige, vi kan i PFA?

I PFA er hverdagen noget, vi glæder os til. Vi tror på, at arbejdsglæde og trivsel skaber markante resultater for vores 1,3 mio. kunder og dermed samfundet. Vi gør os umage for at skabe et sted, hvor det både er sjovt og meningsfuldt at gå på arbejde. Her kan du udvikle dig fagligt og personligt, samtidig med at du bidrager til noget større.

Vi er nemlig omkring 1.400 kolleger, der hver dag arbejder for, at vores kunder kan leve et godt liv, både nu og i fremtiden. Vi hjælper mennesker gennem hele livet, særligt når det handler om vores kunders økonomiske tryghed, deres sundhed og deres seniorliv. Derfor støtter vi selvfølgelig også dig, og vi tilbyder:

  • Muligheden for at gøre en forskel i Danmarks største pensionsselskab, hvor vi har et højt medarbejderengagement
  • Et inkluderende fællesskab og medarbejderklubber
  • Fleksible rammer med mulighed for hjemmearbejde og en arbejdsplads, der prioriterer trivsel og arbejdsglæde
  • Moderne kontor i hjertet af Århus og Vejle
  • Attraktiv lønpakke med arbejdsgiverbetalt pension samt en god sundheds- og tandforsikring

Kan du se dig selv i en hverdag som PFA’er? Send os bare dit CV!

Du behøver ikke at skrive en lang ansøgning. Vedhæft blot dit CV og tilføj et par linjer i dit resumé om, hvorfor du er interesseret i jobbet inden deadline d. 17. september 2026. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Martin Lyager Jørgensen, Leder af Rådgivning Vest på +45 24 91 74 52

location: Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

R&D Product Development

Job Sub Function:

R&D Electrical/Mechatronic Engineering

Job Category:

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Job Description:

About Innovative Medicine

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at

We are searching for the best talent for a Principal Laboratory Automation Scientist to be located in Spring House, PA.

Purpose: The Principal Laboratory Automation Scientist sets the scientific automation architecture for integrated discovery platforms. The role defines how scientific requests, sample states, consumables, automated methods, data provenance, UAT, metadata, exception logic, and user adoption should work across interconnected workcells.

The Principal Scientist will serve as a domain expert for advanced laboratory automation, multi-workcell orchestration, scientific workflow transformation, data provenance, metadata strategy, and AI-ready laboratory execution. They will define the scientific workflow architecture that enables autonomous discovery platforms to generate trustworthy, reproducible, model-usable data.

This role is paired with the Principal Automation and Robotics Engineer. The scientist owns scientific and data architecture for automated workflows; the engineer owns robotics, controls, safety, physical automation, serviceability, and machine architecture. Together they provide the core architectural partnership for self-driving laboratories.

You will be responsible for:

Reference Architecture and Standards

  • Defining cross-workcell laboratory automation architecture spanning scientific requests, instruments, workcells, sample stores, consumable stores, scheduling layers, data systems, user interfaces, and model feedback loops.

  • Creating standards for labware, sample identity, reagent identity, consumable identity, state models, method versioning, interface control, recovery logic, run context, data provenance, and operational handover.

  • Establishing design patterns for request intake, automated worklist generation, queue management, workflow routing, workcell handoffs, exception handling, and data feedback into scientific decision making.

  • Defining acceptance criteria for nominal workflows, edge cases, failure modes, recovery scenarios, operator interventions, data completeness, and lights-out readiness from a scientific workflow perspective.

Scientific Leadership and Workflow Transformation

  • Defining scientific and technical requirements for integrated automation platforms supporting biologics discovery, small molecule discovery, protein engineering, screening, analytical sciences, NGS, cell-based assays, biophysics, protein characterization, and translational workflows.

  • Resolving complex issues spanning scientific method performance, liquid handling, assay suitability, automation constraints, orchestration, data flow, sample logistics, software behavior, facilities constraints, biosafety, and vendors.

  • Leading cross-functional investigations and improvement programs that increase reliability, scalability, data quality, throughput, scientific adoption, and model feedback utility.

  • Advising senior partners on workflow maturity, automation readiness, manual versus automated boundaries, standardization opportunities, and scientific risks before major investment decisions.

SDL Enablement and AI-Ready Data

  • Leading throughput modeling, queue modeling, workflow simulation, digital twin strategy, AI-ready metadata, experimental provenance, sample lineage, failure annotations, and data contracts.

  • Shaping roadmaps for autonomous execution, physical AI integration, closed-loop experimentation, human oversight, human intervention guardrails, and model feedback.

  • Defining data quality expectations that connect instrument outputs, sample context, run metadata, environmental context, and scientific interpretation.

  • Mentoring laboratory automation scientists and influence communities of practice around method robustness, data provenance, automated workflow design, and adoption.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support technology evaluations, proof-of-concept studies, workflow readiness assessments, user demonstrations, and vendor evaluations for future automation capabilities.

  • Contribute to laboratory automation standards, workflow templates, data handoff expectations, training materials, and playbooks.

  • Support audit, inspection, or quality documentation requests where automated scientific workflows intersect with regulated or quality driven environments.

  • Participate in lessons learned and continuous improvement activities to improve future automation delivery and adoption.

Qualifications/Requirements

Education:

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Life Science, Analytical Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Laboratory Automation, or a related field is required. An advanced degree is strongly preferred.

Experience and Skills:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree with 10+ years, Master's degree with 8+ years, or PhD with 5+ years of relevant laboratory automation, scientific automation, analytical automation, high-throughput discovery, or workcell integration experience.

  • Demonstrated understanding of laboratory workflows, sample handling, plate/tube formats, assay execution, consumable preparation, run documentation, and data capture.

  • Hands-on or practical experience with automated liquid handlers or integrated laboratory automation equipment appropriate to the level of the role.

  • Ability to translate scientific workflows into executable automated methods, worklists, run states, exception pathways, and user-facing procedures.

  • Working knowledge of sample identity, labware identity, reagent identity, consumable state, barcode traceability, metadata capture, and downstream data requirements.

  • Ability to collaborate with scientists, automation engineers, IT, data science, AI, EHS, facilities, vendors, and laboratory operations.

  • Recognized expertise in laboratory automation, integrated workcells, assay automation, workcell orchestration, scientific workflows, and data flow.

  • Ability to define architecture, standards, interface models, recovery logic, and data requirements across multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred:

  • Experience with SDLs, digital twins, FAIR data, AI-ready metadata, SiLA 2, OPC UA, APIs, event-driven architectures, microservices, workflow engines, and Tier 1 integrator models.

  • Experience with biologics discovery, small molecule discovery, protein engineering, high-throughput screening, analytical sciences, NGS, cell-based assays, and model feedback workflows.

  • Record of scientific or technical innovation through platform deployments, invention disclosures, patents, publications, or external collaborations.

Other:

  • Travel may be required for vendor assessments, FAT/SAT activities, site visits, system builds, workshops, training, technology scouting, or cross-site deployment support.

Why Join Us

This role supports the transition from isolated automation projects to integrated, reliable, AI-native, and ultimately self-driving discovery laboratory systems. The work helps connect scientific intent with robust physical execution, reproducible data, model feedback, and scalable operational capability.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

Employment Type: Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Pay Type: Salary Exempt, $85K - $115K
Work Location: Remote, with occasional travel required for company-wide team events or client meetings.
Travel Requirement: Yes (occasional)

About VeilSun

VeilSun delivers value-based innovation for AI and Low-Code driven custom applications. We provide immediate value for complex solutions while building for long-term scalability. We begin with a customized Technology Blueprint to fully understand our customers’ business objectives, then design and deliver applications that drive quick ROI and strong user engagement.

We specialize in QuickBase development and consulting, cloud integration, and leading low-code/no-code platforms, including Mendix and Microsoft Power Apps. We’ve helped hundreds of growing companies achieve their business goals through a scalable technology vision.

Purpose of this Position

VeilSun's Project Manager is the client's primary delivery partner — the person who owns the relationship, drives the engagement, and ensures that every project reflects the precision, partnership, and craft that define the VeilSun Way. This role is more than a coordinator of tasks and timelines. It is a trusted consulting role that requires the confidence to guide clients through complex decisions, the boldness to redirect poor ones, and the discipline to keep engagements moving with clarity and purpose.

The Project Manager is assigned to Quickbase, Mendix, and Technical Resources engagements and works closely with Technical Leads, Solution Consultants, and web development resources to deliver outcomes that clients value and VeilSun is proud of. They bring strong client engagement skills and delivery instincts to every project — and they understand that the best project management is nearly invisible to the client, because everything is handled before it becomes a problem.

Business Outcomes

Success in this role means projects are delivered well, clients feel genuinely partnered with, and VeilSun's reputation grows stronger with every engagement. You will be measured on:

  • Delivery performance — projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the standard clients expect; risks are surfaced and managed before they become issues
  • Client satisfaction — clients feel heard, informed, and confident throughout the engagement; communication is proactive, clear, and never a source of surprise
  • Scope and budget discipline — scope is managed with rigor; changes are identified, communicated, and handled through proper channels
  • Methodology adherence — VeilSun's delivery standards, tooling, and reporting requirements are followed consistently on every engagement
  • Team collaboration — technical resources assigned to your projects have clear direction, are unblocked, and are set up to do their best work

Core Responsibilities

Engagement Leadership & Client Management

  • Own the client relationship on assigned engagements — be the consistent, trusted presence that clients rely on throughout the project lifecycle
  • Lead project kickoffs, discovery sessions, and ongoing client meetings with confidence and preparation; set expectations clearly from day one
  • Act as a trusted consultant to assigned clients — understand their business well enough to offer perspective that goes beyond task management, and be bold enough to redirect clients away from poor technology or workflow decisions
  • Communicate proactively with all stakeholders: surface risks and tradeoffs early, present options clearly, and drive decisions without letting uncertainty stall progress
  • Manage client expectations with honesty and confidence — deliver difficult news directly, with context and a path forward
  • Actively work toward ODP conversion on assigned project accounts — identify clients with recurring needs and strong satisfaction, nurture the relationship toward a retainer model, and partner with the Client Success Manager to facilitate the commercial transition when the timing is right
  • Keep the CSM informed on project client health, satisfaction signals, and relationship status so that the client relationship is actively managed between project milestones
  • Surface expansion opportunities within assigned client relationships to the Senior PM, PMO Manager, or CSM as appropriate

Project Planning & Execution

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and resource schedules for assigned engagements
  • Achieve and maintain radical alignment with clients on requirements before development begins — ensure that scope is genuinely understood and agreed upon, not assumed
  • Track project progress against plan on a weekly basis — scope, budget, timeline, and client satisfaction — and take corrective action when variances emerge
  • Manage risks and issues proactively: identify them early, document them clearly, and drive them to resolution without waiting for escalation
  • Coordinate project resources across Technical Leads, Solution Consultants, and web development team members to ensure that project objectives are met efficiently

Scope & Budget Management

  • Serve as the scope gatekeeper on assigned engagements — identify scope changes early, communicate their implications clearly, and manage them through proper channels
  • Monitor project budgets and flag variances to the PMO Manager before they become problems
  • Ensure that estimates are accurate and that commitments made to clients are commitments the team can keep

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate, current project data in VeilSun's delivery tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) as a professional standard
  • Produce and deliver bi-weekly project status reports consistent with VeilSun's reporting templates — accurate, comprehensive, and actionable
  • Conduct project retrospectives and contribute lessons learned to the PMO's continuous improvement process

Team Collaboration

  • Provide clear direction and context to technical resources on assigned projects — ensure they understand what they are building, why it matters, and what success looks like
  • Remove blockers quickly; do not let technical resources sit on uncertainty or wait for information they need to move forward
  • Partner with Technical Leads to ensure that technical delivery aligns with client expectations and that scope, timeline, and quality are collectively owned

Decision Authority

You have authority to:

  • Make day-to-day delivery decisions on assigned engagements, including client communication, task prioritization, and issue resolution
  • Hold or redirect scope on active projects in coordination with the Technical Lead and PMO Manager
  • Escalate project risks, client issues, or resource conflicts to the PMO Manager or Senior Project Manager
  • Recommend changes to project plans, timelines, or resourcing when conditions on the ground require it

Desired Behaviors and Attributes

  • Trusted Consultant Approaches every client relationship as a long-term partnership. Invests in understanding the client's business, goals, and constraints — not just the requirements of the current project. Is confident enough to challenge a client's direction when it is not in their best interest, and skilled enough to do it in a way that strengthens trust rather than damaging it.
  • Radical Alignment Does not let projects proceed on assumed or unvalidated requirements. Drives alignment with rigor and patience before development begins and re-validates continuously throughout the engagement. Understands that ambiguity tolerated at the start becomes rework — and client frustration — at the end.
  • Proactive Communication Keeps every stakeholder informed without being prompted. Surfaces risks, tradeoffs, and decisions early — never lets a problem age before raising it. Communicates with clarity and confidence across all levels of the client organization.
  • Delivery Ownership Treats every project as their own. Owns the outcome, not just the process. Does not wait for someone else to solve a problem — identifies it, owns it, and drives it to resolution. Keeps commitments and flags early when something is at risk.
  • Boldness Says what needs to be said — to clients, to teammates, and to leadership. Does not hedge when a situation requires directness. Addresses hard topics with confidence and professionalism, including redirecting a client from a decision that is not in their best interest.
  • Collaborative Instinct Works well with technical resources, practice managers, and peers. Creates clarity for the people around them — when they are involved, people know what they own, what the next step is, and why it matters. Earns trust through consistency and follow-through.
  • Organizational Discipline Manages multiple concurrent engagements without losing clarity. Keeps project data current and accurate. Treats information hygiene as a professional responsibility. Operates with urgency without creating noise.

Failure Patterns We Avoid

  • Proceeding through ambiguity — unvalidated requirements and unresolved alignment are delivery risks that must be addressed, not tolerated
  • Managing tasks instead of outcomes — a Project Manager owns the engagement's success, not just the calendar
  • Avoiding difficult conversations with clients — redirecting a client from a poor decision is an act of partnership, not conflict
  • Letting scope drift without surfacing it — scope changes must be identified, communicated, and managed; silent absorption is not acceptable
  • Reacting to problems instead of anticipating them — proactive risk management is a core competency of this role
  • Keeping leadership in the dark — escalate early, escalate clearly, and escalate to the right person

Preferred Capabilities

  • 4+ years of project management experience in a professional services, consulting, or technology delivery environment
  • Demonstrated experience managing client relationships directly — comfortable as the primary client-facing presence on an engagement
  • PMP certification preferred; Agile certification (CSM or equivalent) is a plus
  • Familiarity with Quickbase, Mendix, or low-code platforms is a meaningful plus — sufficient to engage credibly in technical conversations without being the technical expert
  • Experience with delivery tooling including Jira, Confluence, or equivalent
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without losing clarity or momentum
  • Demonstrated experience managing scope, budget, and timeline on technology delivery projects
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $85,000 - $115,000, depending on experience. This role is not eligible for commission.

Benefits

VeilSun offers an exceptional benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and supplemental insurance, short- and long-term disability, options for profit sharing, eligibility to participate in company stock or equity programs, 401(k), paid vacation, and sick time.
