title: Senior Telecommunications Designer
description:
Senior Telecommunications Designer

Immediate Requirement

Offsite + Onsite

CSE is seeking a Senior Telecommunications Designer to provide telecommunications infrastructure and construction-management support for the VA Milwaukee Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) Infrastructure Upgrade project. The Telecommunications Designer will serve as the senior telecommunications infrastructure subject matter expert, with primary responsibility for Telecommunications Rooms (TRs), fiber/network infrastructure, and integration of telecommunications systems with the overall construction project.

The position combines technical telecommunications expertise with construction oversight, inspection, quality assurance, documentation, and coordination with Government, contractors, engineers, and other project stakeholders. Responsibilities include reviewing construction documents and submittals, conducting inspections, identifying deficiencies, monitoring installation and testing, and providing technical recommendations.

The position is full-time, offsite during the pre-construction phase (estimated through January 2027), followed by onsite work at the Clement J. Zablocki VA Medical Center in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Telecommunications Rooms

  • Conduct site assessments and evaluate existing Telecommunications Room conditions.
  • Review TR layouts, rack configurations, cable management, patch panels, pathways, grounding/bonding, power, cooling, lighting, and physical security interfaces.
  • Verify that TR construction and installations comply with approved drawings, specifications, applicable standards, and project requirements.
  • Inspect rack elevations, cable routing, labeling, termination, cable management, and equipment installation.
  • Identify deficiencies and coordinate corrective actions through completion.
  • Verify TR readiness for testing, commissioning, turnover, and Government acceptance.

Fiber & Telecommunications Infrastructure

  • Provide technical oversight of fiber optic backbone infrastructure, including inside-plant (ISP) and outside-plant (OSP) systems where applicable.
  • Review fiber routing, pathways, splice locations, termination hardware, patch panels, FODPs, and inter-building connectivity.
  • Monitor fiber installation, termination, fusion splicing, testing, and certification.
  • Review and validate copper structured cabling installations, including Cat 6/Cat 6A systems.
  • Verify cable bend radius, pathway fill, separation/segregation, support, labeling, and workmanship.
  • Witness and review OTDR/OLTS fiber testing and copper certification testing as applicable.
  • Validate end-to-end cable schedules, port maps, labeling, and connectivity documentation.

Design & Construction Oversight

  • Review telecommunications drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, shop drawings, and as-built documentation.
  • Conduct constructability and field-condition reviews.
  • Evaluate contractor installation against approved design intent.
  • Support development and review of Engineering Installation Plans (EIPs) where required.
  • Coordinate telecommunications requirements with electrical, mechanical, architectural, IT/network, and construction teams.
  • Participate in design reviews, construction meetings, inspections, and technical coordination meetings.
  • Provide technical recommendations to Government/project leadership.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Perform field inspections of telecommunications infrastructure.
  • Identify nonconforming work and track deficiencies through resolution.
  • Verify compliance with applicable BICSI, TIA/EIA, UFC, NEC, DoD, and project-specific requirements, as applicable.
  • Review testing and certification results.
  • Maintain inspection records and technical documentation.
  • Support punch-list development and final acceptance.

Documentation & Closeout

  • Review and validate as-built drawings and telecommunications documentation.
  • Verify cable schedules, rack elevations, port maps, test results, labeling records, and equipment inventories.
  • Support commissioning and operational turnover.
  • Identify incomplete documentation or testing before Government acceptance.
  • Support warranty and post-construction issue resolution.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • U.S. Citizenship Required
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain Security & Facility Access.
  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum six (6) years of experience in the design and/or construction of telecommunications and data communications infrastructure.
  • Active BICSI RCDD certification.
  • Demonstrated experience with:
    • Telecommunications Rooms / MDF / IDF.
    • Fiber optic backbone infrastructure.
    • Copper structured cabling.
    • ISP/OSP infrastructure.
    • Cable trays, conduits, pathways, and cable management.
    • Rack and patch-panel configuration.
    • Fiber termination/splicing.
    • Fiber and copper testing/certification.
    • Grounding and bonding.
    • Telecommunications drawings and specifications.
  • Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, shop drawings, submittals, RFIs, and as-built documentation.
  • Experience conducting site surveys and field inspections.
  • Strong understanding of BICSI/TIA telecommunications standards and applicable DoD/federal requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with Government personnel, engineers, contractors, subcontractors, and IT/network teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Federal or DoD telecommunications infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with UFC 3-580-01 and related DoD telecommunications requirements.
  • Experience with Air Force/Army/Navy facilities.
  • Experience with large-scale fiber backbone projects.
  • Experience converting or constructing Telecommunications Rooms.
  • Experience with occupied/mission-critical facilities.
  • Experience reviewing OTDR and OLTS test results.
  • Fiber optic splicing experience.
  • AutoCAD/Visio proficiency.
  • Experience with Procore, BIM360, or similar construction-management/documentation systems.

Location: VA Medical Center, Milwaukee, Wisconsin

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Offsite until January 2027 (estimated).
  • Onsite January 2027 and throughout the contract period.
  • Occasional after-hours support may be required for deployments, production incidents, or scheduled maintenance.
  • The role requires collaboration with government customers, contractors, developers, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders.

BACKGROUND AND SECURITY SCREENING

  • Final candidates may be subject to employment verification, education verification, professional reference checks, criminal background screening, security clearance verification, and/or suitability review, as permitted by applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  • Candidates are expected to provide accurate and complete information throughout the application and interview process. Any material misrepresentation, omission of relevant information, falsification of qualifications, certifications, employment history, clearance status, or educational credentials may result in removal from consideration or withdrawal of an employment offer.
  • For positions supporting federal agencies or government contracts, additional security, clearance, credentialing, or customer-specific suitability requirements may apply.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Who we are - CSEngineering, a Service-Disabled Veteran-owned small business established in 2002, is dedicated to becoming the premier engineering and services firm in our industry, all while prioritizing client satisfaction above all else.

What we do - With a rich history of excellence, we boast significant expertise in a wide array of areas, including satellite systems, weapons and missile systems, naval architecture, aviation systems, IT and Enterprise Architecture, and more. We offer a comprehensive range of services, including logistics, program management, and IT operations. As a recipient of the Hire Vets Gold Medallion award, we're proud of our commitment to veteran hiring, retention, and professional development.

Why should you be a part of CSE - At CSEngineering, our employees are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a culture of passion and growth, where individuals are encouraged to excel, build fulfilling careers, and continually strive for excellence. Our dedication to innovation and excellence propels us forward, as we continuously strive to set new standards in our industry. Join us and be part of a team that's redefining what's possible.

title: Quality Software Engineer
description:
ABOUT US
Amphenol Network Solutions, headquartered in Liberty Lake, Washington, is a division of Amphenol Corporation, one of the world’s largest manufacturers of interconnect products, with global headquarters in Wallingford, Connecticut. Guided by a bold vision to connect people with technology, Amphenol serves a wide range of markets including IT Datacom, Mobile Devices, Mobile Networks, Broadband, Industrial, Automotive, Commercial Aerospace, and Military.
At Amphenol Network Solutions, we are at the forefront of global connectivity, delivering a high‑quality, seamless portfolio of fiber distribution, cable management, power solutions, racks, passives, and enclosures. From fiber crossing oceans to networks spanning continents, our technologies enhance the performance of our customers’ products, systems, and networks—one connection at a time.

Recently recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in the Inland Northwest, we believe that coming to work every day is a choice—and a meaningful one. We foster an environment where innovative, hard‑working, passionate, honest, and fun‑loving people thrive. If you’re looking to be part of a global force shaping the future of communication and connectivity, you’ve found it.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Software Quality Engineer owns end-to-end quality assurance for Amphenol Network Solutions’ next-generation intelligent infrastructure products. This position designs, executes, and automates test strategies across embedded firmware and web-based user interfaces for smart power panels, DC distribution systems, and smart optical interconnect devices. The role bridges hardware behavior and software interfaces to ensure mission-critical products meet the reliability, security, and zero-downtime expectations of tier-1 telecom and data center customers.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
The statements in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by incumbents. The list is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required by all incumbents. Incumbents may perform other duties as assigned.

Design, build, and maintain automated test setups for firmware deployed on smart power distribution panels and optical routing platforms.
Validate embedded communication protocols, including SNMP, Modbus, REST APIs, TCP/IP, CAN, MQTT, and HTTPS, for accurate telemetry, remote monitoring, and control.
Conduct hardware-in-the-loop testing, edge-case fault insertion, power-cycle resilience testing, and firmware regression cycles.
Build and maintain automated UI test frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright for embedded web interfaces and network-management software.
Validate real-time data synchronization, telemetry visualization, alert notifications, API behavior, browser compatibility, and user-permission hierarchies.
Lead the transition from manual testing to scalable automation pipelines integrated with CI/CD workflows.
Create and maintain test strategies, test plans, test cases, traceability records, and validation reports for major software and firmware releases.
Partner with firmware, hardware, and web engineering teams to identify, document, reproduce, and resolve defects early in the development cycle.
Perform root cause analysis on field issues and internal failures using logic analyzers, serial debuggers, digital multimeters, and packet-capture tools such as Wireshark.
Support compliance of software and firmware releases with applicable enterprise security, quality, and telecom-industry requirements, and perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field required; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
Three to five or more years of software quality engineering experience validating products that combine embedded firmware and web-based user interfaces preferred
Hands-on experience testing embedded C/C++ firmware or Linux-based embedded edge controllers and working with serial and network communication protocols.
Experience in a lab environment using power supplies, digital multimeters, logic analyzers, serial debuggers, or packet sniffers.
Preferred experience in DC power distribution, telecom rack infrastructure, fiber-optic monitoring, industrial IoT systems, CI/CD tools, or cybersecurity testing for network devices.
Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.

LANGUAGE AND PEOPLE SKILLS
Ability to communicate technical defects, test results, risks, and recommendations clearly to electrical hardware engineers, firmware developers, frontend developers, leadership, and other stakeholders. Must collaborate effectively across disciplines, write clear technical documentation, manage competing priorities, and apply sound judgment when diagnosing whether failures originate in firmware logic, electrical behavior, network performance, or frontend rendering.

COMPUTER SKILLS
Proficiency in Python or another test-automation language such as C# or JavaScript/TypeScript; hands-on experience with Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright; and experience with API testing tools such as Postman or REST-assured. Familiarity with embedded C/C++, Linux-based embedded systems, Wireshark, SNMP, Modbus, MQTT, HTTPS, TCP/IP, CAN, REST APIs, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps is required or strongly preferred based on project needs.

PHYSICAL & MENTAL DEMANDS
This position requires extended periods of sitting, computer use, keyboarding, focused visual review, analytical problem-solving, and detailed technical documentation. The employee must be able to move within an engineering lab, connect and disconnect test equipment and devices, and occasionally lift or carry equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. The role requires sustained attention to detail, sound judgment, prioritization, and the ability to troubleshoot complex hardware-software interactions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
Work is performed in a professional office, engineering lab, and office work environment. Regular onsite work in Liberty Lake, Washington, is required for hardware-in-the-loop testing, use of specialized lab equipment, product troubleshooting, and cross-functional collaboration. The position involves close computer work and exposure to powered electronic equipment in a controlled lab setting. Occasional travel may be required.

title: Senior Analyst, Risk and Compliance Assurance
description:
Job Title

Senior Analyst, Risk and Compliance Assurance

Department

Professional Services Operations-BG-UK

Overview of Department

The Risk Assurance & Insight function supports Baillie Gifford’s Investment Risk, Compliance, Business Risk and Anti-Financial Crime functions through second-line monitoring, assurance, risk oversight, reporting, training coordination and operational support activities.

The Risk and Compliance Assurance team provides independent check and challenge across key regulatory, compliance, operational, investment and financial crime risk areas. The team assesses whether controls are designed and operating effectively, identifies areas for improvement and supports the business in maintaining effective risk management arrangements.

Data, management information and technology are used to improve the quality, consistency, coverage and efficiency of monitoring, assurance and reporting activity.

Purpose of Role

The Senior Analyst, Risk and Compliance Assurance will support the delivery of the firm’s second-line Risk and Compliance Assurance programme across Investment Risk, Compliance, Business Risk and Anti-Financial Crime.

The role holder will perform risk-based monitoring and assurance activity, including thematic reviews, control testing, surveillance reviews and targeted oversight work. They will assess the effectiveness of key controls, identify emerging risks and produce clear, evidence-based findings and recommendations.

The role requires strong judgement, attention to detail and a deep understanding of how to plan, execute and conclude assurance work. The role holder will work closely with colleagues across the CRO function and wider business, providing constructive challenge and supporting timely remediation of identified issues.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver risk-based monitoring and assurance reviews across Investment Risk, Compliance, Business Risk and Anti-Financial Crime in line with the agreed Risk and Compliance Assurance plan.
  • Scope and plan reviews by understanding the underlying risk, regulatory obligation, process, control environment and available evidence.
  • Perform control design and operating-effectiveness testing, thematic reviews, surveillance reviews and targeted monitoring using appropriate sampling and evidence standards.
  • Review and challenge evidence, identify control gaps, weaknesses, emerging risks and root causes, and reach clear conclusions supported by the work performed.
  • Draft concise, evidence-based findings, actions and recommendations that distinguish clearly between material issues, improvement opportunities and observations.
  • Engage constructively with process owners and senior stakeholders to test conclusions, agree proportionate actions and support timely remediation.
  • Track management actions to completion and independently validate closure where required.
  • Support trade and e-communications assurance activity, including review and investigation of alerts and analysis of relevant trading, communications and conduct data.
  • Use data, management information and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve testing quality, coverage and insight, while retaining professional judgement over conclusions.
  • Prepare clear reporting for senior colleagues and governance forums, drawing out themes, trends, recurring issues and changes in risk exposure.
  • Maintain awareness of relevant regulatory, business and industry developments and reflect these in assurance planning, scoping and testing.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of assurance methodology, documentation, quality assurance and team practices.

Your knowledge and experience

  • Strong experience delivering second-line monitoring, assurance, oversight, internal audit, external audit or control testing, preferably within financial services or asset management.
  • Good understanding of risk and control frameworks across regulatory, conduct, operational, investment and financial crime risk areas.
  • Demonstrable experience scoping and executing risk-based reviews, testing controls, analysing evidence and reaching defensible conclusions.
  • Experience producing clear findings and recommendations and discussing them constructively with senior stakeholders and control owners.
  • Understanding of assurance methodology, including risk assessment, control design, operating effectiveness, sampling, evidence standards, issue grading and action validation.
  • Knowledge of conduct, regulatory, operational and financial crime risks, including how these may arise through trading activity, business processes or communications.
  • Experience of trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring or other specialist oversight activity would be beneficial.
  • Ability to use data, management information and technology to support assurance work and identify trends, anomalies or potential issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgement and the confidence to provide constructive independent challenge.
  • Academic, business, compliance, risk or audit-related qualifications would be helpful, but are not essential.

The type of candidate that we're looking for

You will be an experienced assurance or control professional who understands what good assurance looks like from planning through to final conclusion. You will be comfortable moving from detailed evidence review to a clear view of what matters and why. You will be able to ask effective questions, challenge constructively and distinguish between technical control failures, broader risk themes and opportunities to improve. Your conclusions will be proportionate, evidence-based and clearly communicated. You will be organised, curious and comfortable working across a broad range of risk areas. You will also be willing to use data and technology to improve assurance activity, without losing sight of the professional judgement and independence that underpin credible second-line assurance.

Critical Skills

  • Data literacy
  • Digital effectiveness
  • Improvement mindset
  • Openness and discernment
  • Team working

Closing Date

September 26, 2026

Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives.


At Baillie Gifford, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful culture in which each of our colleagues can thrive and develop. We believe that our clients are best served by a diverse workforce with the experiences, ideas and perspectives that this brings.


If you are currently working at Baillie Gifford as an employee or contractor please apply to this job from the firm's Workday internal career site.

title: Security Operations Center (SOC) Operator
description:
Security Operations Center (SOC) Operator
Advanced Professional Security (APS) is seeking a dependable, technology-oriented (SOC) Operator to join our operations team.
The SOC Operator serves as a central point of communication and coordination for APS security operations. This position requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, excellent computer skills, and the ability to manage multiple situations simultaneously in a fast-paced security environment.
Key Responsibilities
The SOC Operator will be responsible for:
  • Answering incoming telephone calls from security officers, supervisors, clients, and management.
  • Communicating professionally with security personnel using two-way radios, telephone, text, and email.
  • Monitoring CCTV/video surveillance systems and identifying activity that requires follow-up or escalation.
  • Monitoring security officer locations through GPS and guard-management systems.
  • Monitoring scheduled shifts and identifying officers who are late, absent, off post, or otherwise require follow-up.
  • Receiving employee call-offs and immediately beginning the process of locating qualified replacement personnel.
  • Coordinating with supervisors and management to arrange shift coverage after call-outs or staffing shortages.
  • Preparing accurate security, dispatch, incident, and operational reports.
  • Reviewing and monitoring incident reports to ensure required information is complete and appropriate follow-up occurs.
  • Following up on open incidents, client concerns, employee issues, staffing problems, and other operational matters until they are resolved or properly transferred to management.
  • Maintaining detailed documentation of telephone calls, radio communications, incidents, staffing changes, and significant operational activities.
  • Corresponding professionally with employees, supervisors, clients, and management through email.
  • Using AI tools and other technology to improve efficiency, organize information, draft communications, summarize operational information, and assist with report preparation.
  • Escalating emergencies, serious incidents, client complaints, and other significant issues according to APS procedures.
  • Maintaining accurate electronic records and ensuring important information is communicated to the appropriate department or manager.
Documentation Standard
If it is not documented, it did not happen.
SOC Operators are expected to accurately document significant operational activity. Documentation must be timely, factual, professional, and detailed enough that another SOC Operator or manager can understand what occurred, what actions were taken, who was contacted, and what follow-up is still required.
Minimum Qualifications
Candidates should have:
  • Previous experience in a Security Operations Center, dispatch center, security office, call center, monitoring center, or similar environment.
  • Experience answering and managing multiple telephone calls professionally.
  • Experience communicating over two-way radios.
  • Experience preparing written reports or incident documentation.
  • Experience with CCTV or video surveillance monitoring.
  • Strong computer and technology skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to compose professional emails.
  • Ability to learn new software platforms quickly.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to remain professional and composed during emergencies or high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to follow established procedures and chain-of-command requirements.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining constant communication with the operations team.
Technology Expectations
This is a technology-intensive position. Candidates must be comfortable working with multiple computer systems at the same time, including:
  • Security scheduling and workforce-management software
  • GPS and guard-location monitoring systems
  • CCTV/video surveillance platforms
  • Email and Microsoft Office applications
  • Electronic incident and security reporting systems
  • Telephone and radio communication systems
  • Artificial intelligence (AI) productivity tools
Candidates who are uncomfortable working extensively with computers, software, email, and electronic reporting systems may not be a good fit for this position.
What We Are Looking For
The ideal SOC Operator is someone who is organized, accountable, calm under pressure, technologically capable, and persistent about follow-up.
We are looking for someone who does not simply receive information—they take ownership of making sure the information is documented, communicated, escalated when necessary, and followed through to completion.

Compensation Details:
This position is considered an hourly, non-exempt full-time role. Hourly pay will range between $24.00 - $27.00/ hourly DOE.

Advanced Professional Security (APS) is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Vi mangler DIG i Klinik for Spiseforstyrrelser
description:
Vi søger en sekretærkollega på 32 eller 37 timer til vores sekretariat i Klinik for Spiseforstyrrelser.

Du vil sidde på kontor med de to fuldtidsansatte lægesekretærer i et tremandskontor, hvor vi er til rådighed både for patienter, pårørende, kollegaer og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi har ingen skrankefunktion, men har til gengæld mulighed for at lukke døren til kontoret fx ved travlhed.

Vores patientkontakt foregår primært via telefonen.

Du vil blive en del af et socialt og fagligt stærkt team, som har fokus på det gode arbejdsmiljø og kvalitet i opgaveløsningen. Der arbejdes i et tæt tværfagligt miljø med de øvrige personalegrupper i ambulatoriet.

Vi forventer at

  • Du er uddannet lægesekretær eller SAK
  • Du har erfaring med at arbejde i Sundhedsplatformen
  • Du har gode samarbejdsevner og er mødestabil
  • Du er fleksibel og parat til at hjælpe kolleger på tværs af teams, når det kræves
  • Du er udadvendt og serviceminded
  • Du finder interesse i at understøtte både patientjournal, kolleger og afsnitsledelse med relevant data og overblik

Vi tilbyder

  • En grundig introduktion til stillingen
  • Egne ansvarsområder
  • Vekslende arbejdsopgaver
  • Godt tværfagligt samarbejde, herunder tæt samarbejde med læger, plejepersonale og øvrigt personale
  • Fleksibel arbejdstid
  • Godt kollegialt sammenhold med flere sociale arrangementer

Arbejdsopgaverne vil blandt andet være

  • Kontakt med patienter, familier og samarbejdspartnere
  • Indkaldelse og planlægning af førstegangssamtaler
  • Deltagelse i patientkonferencer og teammøder
  • Dokumentation og registrering i Sundhedsplatformen
  • Koordinering af udrednings- og behandlingsforløb
  • Varebestilling, øvrige relevante specialopgaver mv.
  • Tæt samarbejde med ledelse

Arbejdstid

Arbejdstiden er placeret i almindelig dagstid mandag til fredag kl. 07.30-15.00, du skal dog påregne at have en fast vagt til kl. 15 hver 3. fredag.

Derudover er vi åbne for at imødekomme dine ønsker under hensyntagen til både arbejdsplads og privatliv.

Klinikken er centralt beliggende i Roskilde med gåafstand til Roskilde Havn.

Lidt om Center for spiseforstyrrelser.

Center for spiseforstyrrelser består af klinik, dagbehandling, udekørende team og døgnafsnit U2. Vi behandler børn, unge og voksne med spiseforstyrrelser fra hele Region Sjælland.

Klinikken står for det ambulante arbejde rettet mod børn, unge og voksne med spiseforstyrrelser og varetager behandling af psykoterapeutiske forløb, individuelt, gruppe eller familieterapi.

Klinikken er specialiseret i behandling af anoreksi, bulimi og er delt op i teams: børn/ungeteam og voksenteam.

Denne stilling er knyttet til voksenteamet. Der arbejdes tværfagligt på tværs af faggrupper, herunder læger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, diætister, socialrådgivere og sekretærer.

Yderligere oplysninger

Oversygeplejerske Ninna Lundsgaard tlf. 9355 7937

Dasirije Ljoki Ledende overlæge tlf. 2041 3327

Ansøgning:

Ansøgning vedlagt dokumentation for uddannelse og tidligere beskæftigelse. Ansøgningen fremsendes elektronisk via ”søg jobbet”.

Ansøgningsfrist: 21/9-26.

Ansættelsessamtale: 23/9-26 kl. 8.30-11.00

Ansættelse: Den 1. november 2026

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

title: Java Lead Software Engineer
description:
We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial and Investment Bank, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

Job responsibilities
  • Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
  • Develops secure and high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others
  • Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
  • Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
  • Identifies opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring issues to improve overall operational stability of software applications and systems
  • Leads evaluation sessions with external vendors, startups, and internal teams to drive outcomes-oriented probing of architectural designs, technical credentials, and applicability for use within existing systems and information architecture


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Formal training or certification in software engineering concepts with 5 plus years of applied experience

  • Advanced understanding of agile methodologies, including continuous integration and delivery, application resiliency, and security

  • Experience with distributed caching platform such as Gemfire or Redis

  • Exceptional client relationship skills, including the ability to uncover true requirements underlying feature requests, recommend alternative technical approaches, and drive efforts to meet committed timelines

  • Ability to self-drive delivery and take ownership end to end


JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. title: Equipment Engineering Co-op (Hybrid) - January 2027
description:
Term: January 2027

Duration: 8 months

Openings: 1 position

Salary Range: $3,650 - $4,525 per month

Application Deadline: Monday, October 5, 2026, at 9:30 AM PDT

Your Opportunity

By joining the Kardium team, you can help make a difference in the lives of millions around the world. We have developed a ground-breaking medical device for the diagnosis and treatment of the most common heart rhythm disorder, atrial fibrillation – which can cause stroke, heart failure, and other heart-related complications.

Kardium’s mission is to deliver the best treatment for atrial fibrillation. To achieve this, we have developed The Globe® Pulsed Field System – we have a fantastic technical team that has developed a product with strong, unique, and customer-valued differentiators versus other solutions on the market. We have built connections with key opinion leaders who are already using the Globe System and are helping to tell our story.

We have obtained FDA approval and officially begun the commercial launch of the Globe® Pulsed Field System. This is a pivotal and exciting time in our journey, as we bring this life-changing technology to patients!

The Equipment Co-op responsibilities will include improvements in equipment management efficiency, development of troubleshooting guides and maintenance plans, implementing tool related aspects of a 5S program, and assisting in the organization and execution of infrastructure upgrades while working with the equipment and facility team.

Please note, this opportunity is a hybrid work arrangement, located in Burnaby, BC.

What You Will Experience
You will engage in activities that develop practical and transferable skills such as:

Assist in equipment efficiency and down time studies
Assist in the management of spare parts inventories and sourcing
Work with engineers to develop maintenance plans and trouble-shooting procedures
Assist with calibration management
Assist in the organization and execution of infrastructure projects
Develop equipment tracking and management systems
Catalog and organize a production hand-tools as part of Kardium’s 5S program
Design and implement fixtures and equipment to improve manufacturing processes using CAD software

What You Bring to the Team
Our Kardium team is smart, creative, and passionate about creating cutting-edge medical devices to help improve people’s lives. We work within a collaborative environment based on trust and respect. And we understand that only by working together can we solve the unsolvable.
You will be successful in this role because you possess these attributes:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
Understanding of Lean Manufacturing/Continuous Improvement methodologies
Enrolled in post-secondary program such as Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Management, or other program related to manufacturing

Why Work at Kardium?
A meaningful Co-op/Intern term experience, working with truly innovative technology and an ambitious team, combined with:

Meaningful Work: Gain hands on experience working on projects that make an impact, giving you valuable experience to kickstart your career
Community of Co-ops: Join a network of 40+ students across the company, with regular social events and monthly co-op events to connect with peers
Development & Growth: Collaborate with engaged leaders and multi-disciplinary teams who are committed to supporting your development and growth

Life at Kardium
What makes us a great place to work?

Our Purpose
Our People
Our Culture

At Kardium, we embrace diversity of background, experience, and perspective and we’re committed to inclusion and equity at every level. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of all communities.
We collaborate with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), as volunteer-led groups who share a common dimension of diversity and come together to provide support, education, and other opportunities across Kardium. Examples of our ERGs include Women ERG, Pride ERG, Race Ethnicity & Cultural Heritage (REACH) ERG, Truth & Reconciliation ERG, Persian Community ERG, Chinese ERG, Barangay Kardium (Filipino) ERG, Brazilian ERG and Irish ERG.
As part of your application, we encourage you to note if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations). There will be an optional section in the application form where you can provide this information to the recruitment team.
And our employees think we are great too – check out Glassdoor to learn more!
Compensation
Compensation for this role is based on multiple factors including your current year of study, the number of previous co-op terms completed, as well as market data.
Candidates must be legally entitled to work in Canada.
Relocation Support

Relocation Allowance: We offer a relocation allowance to support out-of-province students moving to Burnaby BC for their Co-op/Intern term
Community Before Day One: Out-of-province students make up about 30% of each cohort. We connect all incoming students through email before the term starts to help with planning the move
Questions? We're Here to Help: Relocating for the first time comes with a lot of questions. Our Talent team is happy to help with any questions that may come up

How to apply
To apply for this position, please upload three separate documents in PDF format via our Careers Page:

Cover letter
Resume
Most recent transcripts (to be combined in one PDF document, unofficial or co-op transcripts are acceptable)

Please note, there are also required questions to be completed, as a part of your overall application.

title: Quality Inspector I, 2nd shift
description:
Inspectors are key personnel in the Accurus Quality Department and their duties are integral to our overall quality management system and customer satisfaction. Inspectors perform inspections on newly received goods and work-in-process, and are responsible for final inspections of machined aerospace parts and assemblies to ensure compliance with engineering requirements and work instructions. Inspectors are required to document specific information regarding approvals and non-conforming parts and may be involved in problem-solving internally to identify re-work requirements. Inspectors may provide quality and/or manufacturing process training for manufacturing personnel.
Essential Functions
To accomplish this job, an individual must be able to perform each essential function. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Determines and utilizes appropriate inspection methods and instruments (micrometers, height gauges, air gauges, radius gauges, calipers, etc.) to complete in-process and final inspection of machined aerospace parts and assemblies, including simple to moderate layouts and setups on a surface plate
Initiates nonconformance records and disposition of parts not meeting requirements
Continually strives to improve inspection effectiveness and efficiency by recommending and supporting the implementation of process improvements
Communicates effectively and professionally with internal and external personnel to identify root causes, troubleshoot and address errors and trends, and negotiate the resolution of non-conforming parts and necessary re-work or re-inspection
May obtain knowledge/instruction to perform CMM inspections under tutelage of qualified CMM operators
Completes other duties as required
Regular attendance on-site at the workplace is required

This role is identified as requiring ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) compliance; therefore, qualified candidates must meet the definition of a U.S. Person (per EAR Part 772 and ITAR 120.15):

An individual who is granted U.S. citizenship, or
An individual who is granted U.S. permanent residence (i.e., a "Green Card" holder), or
An individual who is granted status as a "protected person"

Required Education and Work Experience

A high School Diploma or GED equivalent
An associate degree or similar post-secondary or vocational training in a related field is preferred
A minimum of six (6) months of experience in inspection for machined parts and/or assemblies is required; aerospace industry experience is preferred

Other Required Skills and Abilities

Demonstrated accuracy in reading and interpreting blueprints, planning and engineering documents, quality standards, customer specifications, and other technical design standards
Advanced mathematical skills (add, subtract, multiply, and divide using fractions and decimal equivalents)
Experience in accurately reading precision measuring instrumentation, including mics, calipers, height gauges, tape measures, and other similar devices
Completion of assigned internal training for Level I Inspectors, and periodic retraining or recertification is required
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing (English)

Physical Demands and Work Environment
To perform the essential functions of the role, employees must be able to perform the following activities with or without reasonable accommodations:

Regularly stand and walk throughout the facility, including all buildings and the manufacturing areas
Regularly lift, carry (short distances), and push/pull up to 50 pounds
Regularly climb steps, stairs, or ladders
Occasionally bend, crawl, stoop, squat, or kneel
Constantly communicate verbally and in writing (English) using a phone, texts, or other messaging
Visual acuity to accurately read mics, calipers, or other precision measuring instruments; accurately distinguish colors
Use hands and fingers to operate computer keyboards, measurement instruments, and manually examine parts

Working Conditions
Work is performed in a manufacturing shop environment where working conditions may vary significantly; the employee will be exposed to:

Excessive noise (hearing protection required)
Dust, smoke, fumes/vapors (occasionally)
Extreme temperatures (occasionally)
Hazardous equipment, including forklifts, hand tools, cranes or other lifting devices, and other equipment used in a machine shop environment

The use of PPE, including hearing protection, eye and hand protection, and safety footwear is required
This position is classified as safety-sensitive.
2nd Shift: Monday - Thursday, 2:00 pm - 12:30 am, Shift Differential $2.00/hr!

About Accurus Aerospace Kent, LLC
Accurus Aerospace Kent LLC was founded in 1977 in Kent, WA. Over the past three decades, Accurus has evolved into a preferred supplier of sheet metal fabricated parts, high-precision machined parts, kits, and bench top assemblies to the Aerospace and Defense Industry. Located in a 47,000 square foot facility only 15 minutes from the Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, Accurus is a center of Aerospace excellence and one-stop source for high-speed precision machining, fabrication, and assembly.

title: Digital Project Manager
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

09

The Role: Digital Project Manager

We’re looking for an experienced project manager to lead the delivery of visual storytelling and editorial-led design and digital experiences across a globally distributed creative team.

You’ll work at the intersection of design, editorial, data and technical execution, partnering with designers, journalists, developers and stakeholders to deliver high quality visual content at pace and at scale.

You will bring clarity, structure and momentum to complex creative work — enabling our creatives to focus on craft and our developers to focus on stable execution. You ensure projects run smoothly from brief to delivery.

About the Team

Content Design is a global, multidisciplinary team producing thousands of graphics and visual assets each year across hundreds of publications and channels for S&P Global Energy.

We specialize in:

  • editorial infographics
  • interactive data visualization
  • visual and scrolly telling experiences
  • custom-coded large scale data tools
  • digital and experiential content

This content shows up on our product platforms, online, on social media, and at our global events and conferences.

Our work supports the S&P Global Energy business and plays a key role in how its insight and data are communicated to our worldwide community.

The Impact:

This has a pivotal role in the success of our visual storytelling operation.

You will:

  • shape how creative work is delivered across the team
  • improve stakeholder engagement and project flow
  • raise the standard for how complex creative projects are planned, resourced and executed.

What’s in it for you?

You will:

    • work on the wide range of creative outputs listed above
    • join a highly respected team, with the opportunity to influence ways of working
    • enjoy strong learning and career development opportunities
    • flourish in a collaborative, people first culture that values craft, creativity and partnership

    Responsibilities:

    • Manage creative projects end to end, from brief and scoping through to final delivery
    • Plan and track scope, timelines, budgets, and dependencies
    • Translate editorial and stakeholder needs into clear project plans, timelines and deliverables
    • Partner with creative, editorial, marketing and events leads on resourcing, prioritization and capacity planning
    • Coordinate internal and external creative talent, including designers, editors, developers, UX, QA, vendors and business stakeholders
    • Coordinate our tech and dev ops teams to support integrations, migrations, releases, and digital enhancements of custom designed tools
    • Manage risks, change control, and delivery governance for digital projects
    • Ensure technical requirements are understood and met
    • Oversee testing, releases, and post-launch fixes
    • Act as the primary day-to-day contact for stakeholders, providing clear updates and managing change
    • Help define and improve project management processes tailored to creative and editorial workflows

    What we’re looking for:

    We welcome applications from candidates with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. You’re likely to be a great fit if you can demonstrate:

    • Ability to manage complex digital, creative and editorial projects from concept to launch
    • Proven experience working within design studios, agencies, media/publishing or in‑house brand/content teams on digital initiatives
    • Demonstrable ability to translate between technical specialists, creatives and business stakeholders, building shared understanding and alignment
    • Experience coordinating both creative disciplines (designers, editors) and technical teams (developers, UX, QA) to deliver integrated solutions
    • Strong understanding of delivering bespoke, non‑templated creative work in digital environments
    • Familiarity with digital publishing and design workflows, and collaborating across content, design and development
    • Experience partnering with developers and designers to produce content for CMS platforms and gated digital experiences
    • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across regions and time zones, maintaining momentum and clear communication
    • Excellent organizational skills, with a strong focus on meeting deadlines and managing budgets responsibly
    • Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex digital projects to non‑technical audiences
    • Comfort operating in a fast‑paced, evolving environment, adapting to change while maintaining high delivery standards

    Nice to have

    • Experience with B2B content or data driven storytelling
    • Experience working in global or matrixed organizations

    Notes to applicants:

    • All employees are required to work from the office a minimum of 2 days per week.
    • We require all candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at their nearest S&P Global office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.

    About S&P Global Energy
    At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

    S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at .

    What’s In It For You?

    Our Mission:

    Advancing Essential Intelligence.

    Our People:

    We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

    Our Values:

    Integrity, Discovery, Partnership


    Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

    Benefits:

    We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

    Our benefits include:

    • Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.

    • Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.

    • Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.

    • Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.

    • Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

    • Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

    For more information on benefits by country visit: https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries

    Global Hiring and Opportunity at S&P Global:

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
This Commonwealth agency protects Australia’s critical systems and information from sophisticated threats, while delivering technical capabilities that support the Government’s national security objectives.

The Opportunity

This role sits within an infrastructure engineering function responsible for the physical, virtual, networking and cloud infrastructure underpinning mission-critical digital services.

You'll work across the full system development lifecycle, from design and build through to installation, testing and eventual decommissioning, rather than being confined to a single stage.

You’ll have the opportunity to:
  • Work on complex, security-critical infrastructure most infrastructure engineers never get access to
  • Have end-to-end involvement, from design and build through to installation, testing and decommissioning
  • Build deeper Linux administration, system hardening and automation experience in a high-assurance environment
  • Have direct engagement with stakeholders across the capability development lifecycle, not just your immediate team
  • A 12-month initial contract with two 12-month extension options, with room to build depth in the role
The Role

As the Infrastructure Engineer, you'll provide engineering services across the system development lifecycle for physical, virtual, networking and cloud infrastructure.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Installing, configuring, testing and correcting hardware and software, including diagnosing and resolving malfunctions
  • Designing, coding, testing, documenting and refactoring moderately complex programs and scripts
  • Defining integration builds and produce build definitions for software generation
  • Reviewing externally developed test plans and procedures to confirm alignment with requirements and verification processes.
  • Resolving issues that arise during capability development
  • Leading infrastructure and platform design, implementation and support
  • Engaging with stakeholders across the capability development lifecycle as required
The Ideal Person

You're comfortable working in a high-assurance environment where documentation, testing and change discipline matter as much as technical skill.

You will bring the following skills and experience:
  • Demonstrated experience in Linux administration and system hardening
  • Demonstrated experience in configuration management and automation
  • Experience installing, configuring, maintaining and de-installing infrastructure systems
An existing Positive Vetting security clearance is essential to be considered.

Salary / Rate
  • $140/hr – $160/hr
  • 12-month labour hire contract with two 12-month extension options
  • Based in Canberra, with situational work-from-home arrangements
How to Apply

To apply online, please click on the appropriate link.

For a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Pat on 02 6108 4878 quoting ref no. 21878.

title: Senior Product Manager - Automation Portfolio
description:
Discover Vanderbilt Health: With eight hospitals and over 180 clinics, we are the region’s largest comprehensive academic health system. Vanderbilt Health has a long tradition of providing world-class care to the people of the Mid-South, living out our mission of moving medicine forward through preeminent programs in patient care, education and research. Here you’ll find a spirit of collaboration and a supportive community where your expertise is valued, your knowledge expanded and your uniqueness celebrated. We are committed to fostering an environment where talented, compassionate people are united in bringing the most advanced care to our neighbors throughout the region.

Organization:

VUMC IT Automation Services - Service Delivery

Job Summary:

The Senior Product Manager, Automation Portfolio provides strategic leadership for VUMC's growing automation portfolio by overseeing project intake, prioritization, portfolio governance, stakeholder engagement, and alignment of automation initiatives with organizational objectives. This role serves as the primary product and portfolio leader for enterprise automation services, translating business needs into scalable automation solutions that improve operational efficiency, service delivery, and business outcomes.

The Senior Product Manager is responsible for managing a diverse portfolio of automation initiatives across multiple customer groups, balancing competing priorities, and driving execution from concept through delivery. This individual partners with senior leaders, operational stakeholders, and technical teams to identify opportunities, define roadmaps, evaluate emerging technologies, and ensure automation investments deliver measurable organizational value. Success in this role requires strategic thinking, strong executive presence, accountability, problem-solving skills, and the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously while fostering trusted relationships across the organization.

(Note: this role can be performed remotely from most US locations.)

.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of Product Management, Program Management, Portfolio Management, or related leadership experience in healthcare, technology, automation, or digital transformation environments.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, customer engagements, and strategic initiatives.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business and operational challenges into technology-enabled solutions.

  • Experience developing product roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, business cases, and portfolio governance processes.

  • Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.

Preferred:

  • Experience with automation workflow and intelligent automation platforms, including:

    • Automation Anywhere (preferred)

    • Microsoft Power Automate (preferred)

    • Blue Prism

    • UiPath or similar automation technologies

  • Healthcare operations experience and understanding of clinical, administrative, revenue cycle, or shared services workflows.

  • Epic knowledge or experience.

  • Experience evaluating customer needs, identifying automation opportunities, and driving solution design and implementation.

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled automation, process mining, workflow orchestration, and enterprise automation strategies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and manage the vision, strategy, roadmap, and governance framework for VUMC's automation portfolio.

  • Lead intake, evaluation, prioritization, and lifecycle management of automation initiatives across multiple business areas.

  • Partner with operational leaders to identify opportunities that improve efficiency, reduce risk, enhance customer experience, and drive strategic outcomes.

  • Translate customer needs and business objectives into scalable automation solutions and product roadmaps.

  • Establish prioritization frameworks that optimize resource allocation and maximize organizational value.

  • Provide leadership and direction to technical and delivery teams responsible for automation solution development and deployment.

  • Manage relationships with key stakeholders, vendors, and technology partners.

  • Communicate portfolio performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to identify opportunities for innovation and expansion of automation capabilities.

  • Drive accountability for portfolio outcomes, value realization, adoption, and customer satisfaction.

  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators, success metrics, and reporting mechanisms for automation initiatives.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across the organization regarding automation strategy and digital transformation opportunities.


TECHNICAL CAPABILITIES
• IT Portfolio Management (Intermediate): Demonstrates mastery of IT Portfolio Management in practical applications of a difficult nature. Manages a portion of the Company's Application Portfolio that focuses on comparing spending on established systems based upon their relative value to the organization. Manages a portion of the Project Portfolio which addresses the issues with spending on the development of innovative capabilities in terms of potential ROI and reducing investment overlaps in situations where reorganization or acquisition occurs.
• Product Vendor Management (Intermediate): Can lead the development of a software or hardware contract. Serves as the primary contact for issue notification, escalation, and resolution in day to day operations including monitoring of key performance indicators, quality, and leadership concerns. Works effectively with the vendor to develop the necessary technical specifications. Is recognized by participating departments as a leader in contract negotiation. Understands the financial rationale for "make versus buy" decisions and extrapolates internal and vendor costs to develop Financial and Quantitative Analysis.
• Emerging Technologies (Intermediate): Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of the new technology and its impact on the systems infrastructure of the company. Demonstrates acute knowledge of industry trends, promising technologies, competitors' products and services, regulations and legislation impacting the company. Attends industry seminars and forums on a regular basis. Successfully investigates, evaluates, recommends and implements new technology to meet requirements of state-of-the-art systems and projects.
• Project Coordination (Intermediate): Performs project tracking and reporting relative to task completion dates, dependency effects, problem anticipation, schedule conflicts, and assignment to appropriate staff for resolution. Manages prioritization procedures for changing scope [i.e., change management] and project acceptance procedures. Measures progress toward goals and revises project objectives and documents applying change control procedures. Assumes responsibility [as appropriate] for resolving issues and seeing work through to successful completion. Provides training to project managers and others on project related templates and toolsets. Develops methods to measure customer satisfaction and obtains feedback at critical milestones and at project completion to ensure project efforts meet customer expectations.
• Product Knowledge (Intermediate): Possesses sufficient knowledge, training, and experience to be capable of successfully developing or supporting applications for the product without requiring support and instruction from others. Able to educate and train others regarding the process.

About the Department:

VUMC IT

VUMC IT provides hardware, software and service solutions for the entire Medical Center. With over 40,000 workstations in the Medical Center, our teams can assist not only with hardware support, but also software and application support and services to enhance security and protection of your information.

Our professional administrative functions include critical supporting roles in information technology and informatics, finance, administration, legal and community affairs, human resources, communications and marketing, development, facilities, and many more.

At our growing health system, we support each other and encourage excellence among all who are part of our workforce. High-achieving employees stay at Vanderbilt Health for professional growth, appreciation of benefits, and a sense of community and purpose.

Problem Solving/ Complexity of work: Utilizes multiple sources of data to analyze and resolve complex problems; may take a new perspective on existing solution. description:
Job Description

Job Description

Senior Software Engineer

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours/week)
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Senior Software Engineers to support an AI training project by creating reinforcement learning environments that evaluate AI models on complex software engineering tasks using Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools.

You will design reproducible environments, deterministic verification, and reference solutions for tasks such as bug fixing, feature implementation, codebase refactoring, and performance optimization. No prior AI experience is required.

Key Responsibilities
  • Create reinforcement learning environments for software engineering tasks.
  • Design tasks involving bug fixing, feature development, refactoring, and performance optimization.
  • Build deterministic verification systems and golden reference solutions.
  • Evaluate AI agents' ability to reason through complex codebases and use MCP tools effectively.
  • Develop realistic, reproducible software engineering scenarios.
  • Ensure tasks accurately measure coding ability, problem-solving, and tool usage.
  • Document solutions and provide clear technical feedback.
Required Skills
  • Strong proficiency in Python 3, Java, Rust, C++, or TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding of algorithms and data structures.
  • Experience with bug fixing and debugging complex software issues.
  • Proven experience in feature implementation and codebase refactoring.
  • Strong knowledge of performance optimization and tuning.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Strong attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with large-scale or distributed codebases.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML systems is a plus but not required.
  • Experience with rigorous code reviews and software engineering best practices.
  • Experience working effectively in remote or cross-functional teams.
Hiring Process
  1. Submit an application and screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview (~30 minutes).
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Hiring Manager review.
Compensation

Compensation is output-based, with payment provided per task that meets project specifications. Minimum weekly submission requirements may apply.

Availability

Selected experts should be prepared to begin their first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: Director, Accident Reconstruction
description:
The Role:
The Director of Accident Reconstruction is responsible for leading a team of Accident Reconstructionist in the execution of technical investigations, reporting, and client engagement. This role oversees project delivery, ensures adherence to scope and budget, and maintains high standards of technical accuracy and timeliness.
The ideal candidate has an established client network and has a strong track record of building rapport and maintaining lasting client relationships.
In This Role, You Will:

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of accident reconstruction experts.
Oversee project execution, ensuring quality work, strong client service, and on-time deliverables.
Manage client relationships and identify opportunities for new and repeat business.
Support business development activities, including conferences, networking, and industry engagement.
Ensure workload is evenly distributed across the team.
Conduct field investigations and document collision scenes using advanced forensic technology.
Analyze vehicle damage and supporting crash-related data.
Process 3D scan files and reconstruction evidence.
Develop collision models and visualizations with technical specialists.
Perform crash simulations using reconstruction software.
Apply engineering analysis to determine speeds, forces, and vehicle dynamics.
Coordinate with clients to set up site visits and complete deliverables on projects.
Create reports as requested by clients detailing the accident reconstruction process and including findings and conclusions.
Provide reports to clients to assist with determining the contributory factors of an accident.
Review reports and deliverables to ensure accuracy, quality, and consistency.
Research papers and journals related to vehicular accident reconstruction to advance the scientific techniques used in the reconstruction work.
Perform additional duties as assigned.

What You Bring:

Degree in Mechanical Engineering required.
15+ years of experience in biomechanics, accident reconstruction, premises liability, or related work
PE license, ACTAR certification, and/or SAE certification
Advanced expertise in collision dynamics, including impact and departure speeds, forces, and trajectories 
Strong background in automotive engineering and control systems
Extensive experience working with insurance carriers, attorneys, and/or adjusters
Experience performing computer simulations
Highly proficient in CAD
Prior deposition and courtroom testimony experience
Willingness to travel to remote site locations as needed

Who We Are:
YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation.
YA Group’s Accident Reconstruction & Biomechanics team applies scientific investigation, engineering principles, and advanced technology to determine how collisions occur and why. Our experts bring extensive training and experience using sophisticated tools—including 3D modeling, vehicle and site inspections, Event Data Recorder downloads, and forensic animations—to analyze physical evidence and reconstruct events with clarity and accuracy. Capable of handling the full spectrum of motor vehicle accidents—from low‑speed impacts to complex rollover events, heavy‑truck collisions, autonomous vehicle incidents, and ADAS evaluations—our multidisciplinary specialists deliver analytically grounded findings that support clients across insurance, legal, corporate, and transportation sectors. In addition, our professionals are experienced in litigation support and are courtroom‑qualified experts, providing clear, confident testimony to effectively communicate reconstruction results and technical conclusions.
What We Offer:

Employee-focused culture
Strong commitment to work-life balance
Remote work
Flexible vacation & Paid holidays
Paid family care/sick leave
Parental leave
Medical, Dental, Vision + more
401k w/match
Career growth
Competitive salaries + Bonus

YA will never ask for personal financial information (such as bank account numbers or identification numbers) via social media or chat-based apps. We also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment, post job opportunities on Craigslist or conduct interviews solely via text message.
All official email communications regarding your application will come from notify@dayforce.com or directly from a member of our talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name.

Our PowerConnect platform delivers real-time threat detection, compliance automation, and deep operational visibility across SAP environments.

We are a bootstrapped, profitable company with a lean, highly skilled team operating across North America, EMEA, and APAC. We move fast, think strategically, and build things that last.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Senior Sales Engineer to anchor our EMEA pre-sales function. You will own the full technical sales cycle — from discovery through proof of concept to close — for enterprise accounts across Europe. You bring deep SAP functional expertise, a consultative sales mindset, and the credibility to lead CxO-level conversations. You will also mentor junior SE team members and help shape how we approach pre-sales across the region. Experience range: 6–8 years.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer SAP landscapes, security posture, and compliance requirements
  • Deliver tailored demonstrations of PowerConnect and the RHONDOS platform to both technical and executive audiences
  • Develop and present proof-of-concept engagements, architecture proposals, and technical responses to RFPs
  • Partner with account executives throughout the sales cycle as the primary technical voice
  • Translate customer requirements into solution designs that map to RHONDOS capabilities
  • Build and maintain strong technical relationships with customer IT, security, and SAP Basis teams
  • Mentor junior Sales Engineers and contribute to SE playbooks, demo environments, and technical assets
  • Provide market and competitive feedback to Product and Engineering teams
  • Represent RHONDOS at regional SAP and cybersecurity events, conferences, and webinars
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Professional Services on smooth post-close handoffs

Requirements

What You Bring

Required

  • 6–8 years of experience in a Sales Engineering, Pre-Sales, or SAP consulting role
  • Deep SAP functional expertise — 6+ years working with SAP security, GRC, Basis, or enterprise SAP platforms
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences
  • Proven track record supporting complex enterprise sales cycles alongside account executives
  • Strong written and verbal communication in English; German, French, Dutch, or other European languages a strong plus
  • Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities in parallel
  • Based anywhere in Europe — German-speaking regions (Germany, Switzerland, Austria) a plus

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with SAP Security, SAP GRC, or SAP Identity Management
  • Familiarity with SIEM platforms, security observability, or threat detection tools
  • Experience with Splunk, Dynatrace, or similar monitoring and analytics platforms
  • Prior experience building or leading a pre-sales function in a startup or scale-up environment
  • Knowledge of SAP BASIS, ABAP, or SAP cloud platforms such as BTP or S/4HANA

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: €140,000 annually
  • Variable/Commission: Up to €60,000 tied to quota attainment
  • Remote-first working environment with flexibility
  • Direct exposure to a global enterprise customer base across EMEA and APAC
  • A small, high-caliber team where your work has immediate impact
  • Opportunity to grow with a profitable, product-led company in an expanding market

Employment for this role is structured through an Employer of Record (EOR) in your country of residence.

This Role Is Not for Everyone

If you need heavy process, hand-holding, or prefer a large corporate environment — this probably isn't the right fit. If you want to build something meaningful, own your work, and develop commercially at the intersection of SAP and security, we'd love to talk.

RHONDOS is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status.
